author: Anna
headline: Love!
comment:
This stuff is wonderful! As dry as my skin is now in my 50's, I dont always want something that feels heavy on my skin. This is perfect- it's very light but has amazing coverage. I have some redness due to dryness and the weather, and this basically erases it with very little product. It will be great in the summer when you want  coverage without the heaviness. 

I went with the lightest color they have as I have had issues in the past with IT Cosmetics foundations oxidizing and turning orange on me, but I have not had any issues.

과거 IT Cosmetics 파운데이션이 산화되어 주황색으로 변하는 문제가 있었기 때문에 가장 밝은 색상으로 갔지만 아무런 문제가 없었습니다.

author: Julie
headline: Just meh
comment:
I really wanted to love this, but it just didn't work for my skin. I have mature skin, and while the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tinted Face Balm felt nice going on—lightweight, smooth, and comfortable—it didn't wear well at all.
Within about an hour, my wrinkles looked more pronounced than before I even applied it. Instead of blurring or softening lines like I expected, it seemed to settle into them and highlight texture in a way that wasn't flattering.
I will say, the initial feel is great and it gives a nice, natural look at first. But the wear time just isn't there if you're concerned about fine lines or deeper wrinkles.
If you have very smooth or younger skin, this might work better for you. But for mature skin, this was unfortunately a pass for me.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] At almost 40 I'm really enjoying this  face balm. I have dry skin so I gravitate towards lightweight complexion products that add hydration without emphasizing my texture as much as possible and this one feels really comfortable on the skin. I received the shade Light Neutral 120 which was a little yellow, but once i finished my face it all looked good. The balm textures melts in easily and blends in perfectly with a brush. This is a sheer coverage meant to even skin tone so if you're looking for more coverage this isn't for you. I appreciate the added benefit of skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid and peptides. All things that help my dry skin stay hydrated. I got about 6 hours before I noticed any settling but it wasn't too bad. The first time I used it I didn't set it and it still looked good at the end of the day. As long as you skin prep I think you'll love this especially on mature skin.

headline: My new favorite
comment: I never leave reivews but I really really love this product! It very nicely evens out my skin tone, minimizes discolorations and fills in my pores. Also I find using this plus a powder foundation does give a really nice medium coverage for when I'm wanting a more full face look. So in that sense this works for me no matter what look I'm going for. My favorite thing about this is how natural it looks. Seriously can pass as me wearing nothing. This is definitely not for everyone, but if your'e a simple makeup girlie who's looking for your skin but better I highly highly recommend this. Definitely my new go to!

author: Valerina
headline: Highly moisturizing, serum packed balm with light coverage!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is an amazing product! I expected more of a cream foundation feel, but it is more like a serum with coverage. Very smooth consistency and application that goes on and stays dewy, as it's highly moisturizing. 

I think a lot of people expect a more matte appearance, but considering my face leans towards dry, I really liked it. Plus, I was able to apply some loose powder afterwards and combat the shininess that comes from the included serums. Additionally, I loved that it's light coverage, more like a tinted moisturizer - see the before and after pics. 

I highly recommend this product and feel a little goes a long way, increasing it's value. I was gifted this product in exchange for my honest review.

author: PNW
headline: Not Terrible
comment:
After going back and reading the description of this product I felt like I understood how this is supposed to work, its a tinted moisturizer.
The first time I used it with a brush, as I would with a foundation or skin tint, and the product caked up so fast and did not look good at all. It settled into undereye lines I didnt even realize I had and the product got so shiney by the end of the day, it looked mask-like and very similar to other It Cosmetics products (CC cream comes to mind).
I tried it again with my fingers and worked it into my skin like I would a moisturizer and it worked SO much better. The product instantly soaked in and looked like my skin, it was great. I was not able to build the coverage all that much, but honestly if I want coverage I will just use a foundation.
Overall I think the product is worth purchasing if you and looking for a tinted moisturizer , but its not going to provide too much coverage without looking heavy and shiney.

처음에는 파운데이션이나 스킨틴트처럼 브러쉬로 사용했는데, 제품이 너무 빨리 굳어 전혀 눈에 띄지 않았어요. 나도 모르게 눈 밑 라인이 자리 잡았고, 하루가 끝날 무렵 제품이 너무 윤기나서 마스크처럼 보였고 다른 It Cosmetics 제품과 매우 유사했습니다 (CC 크림이 떠오름).

author: Nina
headline: Worth to try it
comment: Was expecting for it to be on the oily side but to my surprise, it's more hydrating then anything. It feels cool when it touched my skin. The way it blends out is different, you don't even have to try, it naturaly just spreads and glides on your face. It didn't flare up my rosacea and didn't cling to dry skin and it didn't separate or melted off my face. Also, dont belive all the reviews you see, just try it and decide for your self. Most reviews come from people that dont know how to apply makeup or prep skin or don't even know their own skin type and what works for them specifically. Anywho, I did a wear test with a more full coverage glam and it held up longer then expected since it's so sheer. IT cosmetics did something very unique with this formula.

author: Kerry
headline: Glowing skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love products that simplify my routine, and this one really lives up to its name. If you like a natural, low-maintenance makeup look, this balm is definitely worth trying.

The texture is really unique — it feels lightweight, creamy, and almost skincare-like when applied. It melts into the skin easily and blends out effortlessly with fingers, which makes it perfect for quick morning routines. The coverage is very sheer, but it evens out my skin tone just enough to make my skin look healthier and more polished.

What I love most is the finish. It gives a natural, slightly radiant glow without looking greasy. My skin still looks like skin, just smoother and more balanced. It's perfect for "no-makeup makeup" days or when I don't want to wear a full foundation.

Another plus is how comfortable it feels throughout the day. It doesn't feel heavy or cakey, and it layers nicely with concealer and a little powder if I want to build up my look.

The only thing to keep in mind is that the coverage is minimal, so if you're looking to cover blemishes or redness, you'll still need a concealer. But for light, everyday complexion enhancement, it works beautifully.

Overall, the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm is a great option for anyone who wants a quick, easy product that gives the skin a healthy, natural-looking tint.
comment_ko:
[솔직한 리뷰를 대가로 받은 제품입니다.] 저는 일상을 단순화하는 제품을 좋아하는데, 이 제품은 이름에 걸맞는 제품입니다. 자연스럽고 유지 관리가 적은 메이크업 룩을 좋아한다면 이 밤을 시도해 볼 가치가 있습니다.

질감이 정말 독특합니다. 바르면 가볍고 크리미하며 거의 스킨케어 같은 느낌이 듭니다. 피부에 쉽게 녹아들어 손가락으로 가볍게 블렌딩해 빠른 아침 루틴에 딱 맞습니다. 커버력은 매우 얇은 편이지만, 피부톤을 균일하게 정돈해 주어 피부를 더욱 건강하고 윤기나게 만들어줍니다.

제가 가장 좋아하는 점은 마무리입니다. 번들거림 없이 자연스러우면서 살짝 빛나는 광채를 선사합니다. 내 피부는 여전히 피부처럼 보입니다. 더 부드럽고 균형이 잡혀 있습니다. '노 메이크업'을 하는 날이나 풀 파운데이션을 바르고 싶지 않은 날에 딱 맞습니다.

또 다른 장점은 하루 종일 편안함을 느낀다는 것입니다. 무겁거나 뭉치는 느낌이 없고, 컨실러와 약간의 파우더를 섞어 레이어링하면 룩을 더욱 돋보이게 할 수 있습니다.

다만 주의할 점은 커버력이 미미하기 때문에 잡티나 붉은기를 커버하고 싶다면 컨실러가 필요하다는 점이다. 하지만 가볍고 일상적인 안색을 개선하려면 아름답게 작동합니다.

전반적으로 IT Cosmetics의 Do It All Sheer Tint Balm은 피부에 건강하고 자연스러운 색조를 선사하는 빠르고 쉬운 제품을 원하는 모든 사람에게 훌륭한 선택입니다.
text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love products that simplify my routine, and this one really lives up to its name. It melts into the skin easily and blends out effortlessly with fingers, which makes it perfect for quick morning routines. The coverage is very sheer, but it evens out my skin tone just enough to make my skin look healthier and more polished. What I love most is the finish. It gives a natural, slightly radiant glow without looking greasy. My skin still looks like skin, just smoother and more balanced. It's perfect for "no-makeup makeup" days or when I don't want to wear a full foundation. Another plus is how comfortable it feels throughout the day. The only thing to keep in mind is that the coverage is minimal, so if you're looking to cover blemishes or redness, you'll still need a concealer. But for light, everyday complexion enhancement, it works beautifully. Overall, the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm is a great option for anyone who wants a quick, easy product that gives the skin a healthy, natural-looking tint.

headline: Surprisingly oily-friendly when set. Lightweight.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was pleasantly surprised by this! At first swatch, I thought it was going to be greasy, but it sinks in and virtually disappears, save for a light coverage and dewy effect. I daresay it wears better than other tinted moisturizers and sticks I have in my "vault." I have super-oily mature skin (age 44) and I prefer to powder it and wear a light layer of setting spray. In my photos I also have diffused concealer on under my eyes and around the edges of my nose. The last photo is after about 6.5 hrs wear. You can see it has broken up some around my nose (I wear glasses) but it's still hanging in there for the most part. The shade was slightly yellow for me, but when buffing it out with a dense brush, the difference isn't noticeable. Overall, I would recommend this. author: Carla
headline: AMAZING!…but…
comment:
As a 43 year old perimenopausal woman who also suffers from type 2 rosacea, I've been on the hunt for a lightweight tint for everyday that wouldnt accentuate any dryness I have on my (normal/dry) face while also not accentuating wrinkles and covering sunspots. This is it! It wears beautifully! I have never seen my skin look so amazing! HOWEVER. The shade range is for the birds. I have a medium skin tone that runs more cool, however my neck runs more warm. I purchased the shade medium cool (which I tried on in store and was able to see in various light) and wore it for 2 days. It didnt match my neck and ultimately bought out the pink in my skin. 
I went back to ulta today to see if the shade medium neutral would work. I was again shade matched, and while it that shade matched my neck perfectly, it ran too warm on my face. 

I'm hoping to make these work—maybe mixing them?—since the formula is amazing. Hopefully they will come out with more shades in the future!
comment_ko:
제2형 장미증을 앓고 있는 43세 폐경 전후 여성으로서 저는 (보통/건조한) 얼굴의 건조함을 강조하지 않으면서도 주름을 강조하고 흑점을 가리지 않는 가벼운 데일리용 틴트를 찾고 있었습니다. 이것이다! 예쁘게 입네요! 나는 내 피부가 이렇게 놀라워 보이는 것을 본 적이 없습니다! 하지만. 그늘 범위는 새들을 위한 것입니다. 저는 중간톤의 피부색을 가지고 있어서 더 시원해 보이지만 목은 더 덥습니다. 저는 미디엄 쿨 색상(매장에서 입어보고 다양한 조명에서 볼 수 있었던 색상)을 구매해서 2일 동안 착용했습니다. 그것은 내 목과 맞지 않았고 결국 내 피부의 핑크색을 샀습니다. 
나는 오늘 ulta로 돌아가서 중간 중간 중간 색상이 효과가 있는지 확인했습니다. 나는 다시 색상이 일치했고 그 색상이 내 목에 완벽하게 일치했지만 내 얼굴에는 너무 따뜻했습니다.

author: Emily D
headline: Disappointed
comment: I really wanted to like this. For a product that's supposed to be moisturizing, it clings to any slight blemish or dry spot. This also does not blend well with other products. I tried to use my tart shaped tape for a little extra coverage and it makes a huge mess, the products don't blend well. I compare the ingredients lists and they should be compatible. This also does not seem to blend well with my skin care, which is it cosmetics confidence in a cream. Product does not dry down and I know its supposed to be dewy but this will smudge and wipe off at the slightest touch. I don't see how you could wear this without setting it. These five star reviews have to be incentivized because this product is not it. I had high hopes and I was very disappointed.

headline: Lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm a 37 year old mom, and my mornings are usually rushed, so I love products that are quick and easy- and the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tiny Face Balm has been perfect for that. It's really lightweight and blends in effortlessly with just my fingers, which makes getting ready so simple. The coverage is sheer, but enough to even out my skin and give it a healthy, natural glow without looking like I'm wearing a lot of makeup. It feels hydrating and comfortable all day, never heavy or caked. This has become one of my favorite grab and go products for a quick morning routine.

author: Misty
headline: I love this so much and will buy again and again!!
comment: I was absolutely thrilled to try this new product from It Cosmetics! First, full disclosure- I have been a longtime user of the brand. In fact, I have been using products since they first launched years ago. Especially their skin products. I used their CC and powder foundations for years. So all this to say I'm not new to the line. And this is a phenomenal new addition to the brand line up! Its claim is that it's 92% skincare infused. That alone is huge! The coverage tho- is what impressive. It's natural and yet covers flawlessly and get this- it's not at all heavy feeling!! It feels amazing- like a lightweight skin serum. Yet it covers so well and doesn't look cakey, so long as you apply it decently. You can see the coverage and texture in my pics. It's thick in the jar but sheets and melts into the skin almost instantaneously.  I use a dense stippling brush to apply and it's been beautiful in application without needing anything additional. I've tried it with and without primer and same with powder and it still looks great. I'd say my very favorite attribute is the feel. It's slightly cooling but it breathes.  I love the jar delivery- my brush picks it up perfectly and it hasn't dried out yet after weeks of consistent use! It's small but mighty and the glass jar feels sturdy. It doesn't feel heavy or thick. A very little goes a long way and tho it's not a huge jar, you don't need a lot to get it done. It plays well with my sunscreen and doesn't pill. It holds my blush nicely as well. The only thing I keep playing with is its setting factor. Some days it seems to stay slightly damp and takes about an hour til it fully feels set. I am experimenting with ways to increase staying power because I love it that much! I hope to continue on with it and find the perfect combination of products to make it my everyday go to- especially with summer and warmer days heading close. The skincare aspects are impressive and I love that it never looks dry or cakey. I love this and will continue purchasing it!!
headline_ko: 이거 너무 맘에 들어서 계속 구매하고 싶어요!!
comment_ko: 잇코스메틱(It Cosmetics)의 새 제품을 사용해보고 정말 기뻤습니다! 첫째, 전체 공개 - 저는 오랫동안 해당 브랜드를 사용해 왔습니다. 사실 저는 몇 년 전 처음 출시된 제품부터 사용해 왔습니다. 특히 스킨 제품이요. 나는 수년 동안 CC와 파우더 파운데이션을 사용했습니다. 그래서 이 모든 것은 제가 이 분야에 새로운 사람이 아니라는 것을 의미합니다. 그리고 이것은 브랜드 라인업에 새롭게 추가된 놀라운 제품입니다! 그 주장은 92% 스킨케어가 주입되어 있다는 것입니다. 그것만으로도 엄청나다! 적용 범위는 정말 인상적입니다. 자연스러우면서도 결점없이 커버되서 굿- 전혀 무거운 느낌이 아니에요!! 가벼운 피부 세럼처럼 놀랍습니다. 그래도 커버력이 너무 좋고, 적당히만 바르면 뭉치지 않는 것 같아요. 사진을 보시면 커버력과 질감이 보이시죠? 항아리 안에는 두껍지만 시트가 깔려 있고 거의 즉각적으로 피부에 녹습니다.  저는 촘촘한 스티플링 브러쉬를 사용해서 바르는데, 따로 추가할 필요 없이 발색이 너무 예뻐요. 프라이머를 사용하거나 사용하지 않고 파우더를 사용하여 시도해 보았지만 여전히 멋져 보입니다. 제가 가장 좋아하는 특성은 느낌이라고 말하고 싶습니다. 약간 시원하지만 숨이 쉰다.  나는 병 배송을 좋아합니다. 브러시가 완벽하게 집어 들고 몇 주 동안 지속적으로 사용해도 아직 건조되지 않았습니다! 작지만 강력하고 유리병이 견고한 느낌을 줍니다. 무겁지도 두껍지도 않은 느낌이에요. 아주 조금만 노력하면 큰 효과를 볼 수 있고 큰 병이 아니더라도 완료하는 데 많은 노력이 필요하지 않습니다. 그것은 내 자외선 차단제와 잘 어울리고 약을 먹지 않습니다. 그것은 내 홍당무도 잘 잡아줍니다. 내가 계속해서 가지고 노는 유일한 것은 설정 요소입니다. 어떤 날은 약간 축축한 상태로 유지되는 것처럼 보이며 완전히 굳어질 때까지 약 한 시간 정도 걸립니다. 워낙 좋아해서 지속력을 높이는 방법들을 실험하고 있어요! 나는 계속해서 이 제품을 일상생활에 사용할 수 있는 완벽한 제품 조합을 찾고 싶습니다. 특히 여름과 더 따뜻한 날이 다가오고 있는 요즘에는 더욱 그렇습니다. 스킨 케어 측면이 인상적이며 결코 건조하거나 끈적해 보이지 않는 점이 마음에 듭니다. 이거 너무 맘에 들어서 계속 구매할 예정이에요!!

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This applies beautifully with a brush and gives me a radiant smooth, your skin but better finish. author: Stacy
headline: Loved this formula!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is completely worth the Hype. I love this formula! It's smooth and creamy, goes on so easy, made my skin so soft and supple. The shade was perfect for my fair skin and it didn't smell like chemicals. I really liked the sheer coverage,  it made things look more natural for me,  which is sometimes a challenge. The only drawback to this product is that it does not come with a sponge applicator,  so you have to figure that out on your own.

Maybe with its next launch, they'll find a way to add a sponge inside the lid or something. All in all though, this stood up to the Brands name and didn't let me down.

author: Erin
headline: Love this!
comment:
I am very happy with this product.  I got shade 125.  What appealed to me about it is that it is skin care. I am very busy in the morning with little time to do my make up. I generally go for a less is more, tinted moisturizer kind of look because I am almost 43 and find that heavier foundation settles into my fine lines and wrinkles.  

I am very happy with the ease of application and the coverage of this product.  I use a foundation brush for application.  

It is very light, velvety, and balmy.  I was concerned it might wear a little greasy or shiney but it actually dries down but in a moisturing kind of way, if that makes sense.  It leaves a dewey to skin like finish.  I did set my tzone with powder but it doesn't really need it.  I haven't noticed much oxidation either.  

I have worn it for three days now and like it very much. I immediately put it on to try it out when I got home with it from Ulta. I then cooked dinner for my family, including boiling pasta.  Before checking in the mirror, I figured it would have melted off or smudged all over my face due the steam. I was very pleasantly surprised that it was not only fully intact, but almost mattifying considering the amount of heat and steam it had endured. I think it will be great for summertime.

I also played tennis in it the next day and was very impressed that it lasted through two hours of tennis.  My cheeks usually turn very red with exercise and this product not only lasted but completely concealed the redness.

It gives a beautiful "no make up" make up look and lasts through anything.  And delivers skincare at the same time.  Great product!

이 제품의 사용감과 커버력은 매우 만족스럽습니다.  저는 파운데이션 브러쉬를 사용해서 바르는데요.

지금 3일째 입었는데 너무 맘에 들어요. 나는 Ulta에서 그것을 가지고 집에 오자마자 그것을 시험해 보기 위해 즉시 착용했습니다. 그런 다음 나는 파스타를 끓이는 것을 포함하여 가족을 위해 저녁 식사를 요리했습니다.  거울을 보기 전에는 김 때문에 얼굴 전체에 묻어나거나 녹았을 거라고 생각했어요. 나는 그것이 완전히 손상되지 않았을 뿐만 아니라 그것이 견뎌낸 열과 증기의 양을 고려하면 거의 매트하다는 사실에 매우 놀랐습니다. 여름에 딱 좋을 것 같아요.

headline: Great for a fresh no makeup look
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the IT  Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, and overall I really like it. It gives beautiful natural finish that evens out my skin without looking cakey or heavy. It is perfect for days when I want a fresh minimal makeup look. 

On application, it does feel slightly tacky at first, but once I set it with a light powder, it wears really well. After setting, it looks smooth and natural and stays comfortable throughout the day. The coverage is sheer but effective, giving skin a healthy appearance. 

This is a great option if you're looking for something easy and lightweight that enhances your skin rather than covering it up. As long as you're okay with setting it, it's a really nice everyday product that delivers a clean effortless look.

The product has a very nice, smooth texture and glides on really well. It absorbs into the skin easily , leaving a nice glow. This would be a great skin tint if you want to leave the house with a no makeup look but just have a little more than nothing.

author: Jane
headline: Nice Texture but didn't work for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product in exchange for my honest review. 

The idea of of a hydrating face tint, that looks like natural skin only better is something that really appeals to me so I really wanted to love this product. I'm also pretty lazy so cosmetics that do more than one job is also a plus. I adore the IT Cosmetics brand but the Do It All Sheer Tint does not work for me. 
 
The packaging is lovely & easily slips into a purse or even a pocket without the risk of spillage, so great for a trip or for touch ups on a night out. I travel a lot & have a 'ready for trips' slimmed down make-up bag & in theory this would have been perfect for that. 

I tried prepping my skin in various ways before using the product but the result was always the same. When I blend it in I look like my skin is peeling in places or I still had the residue of a face mask. At first I thought it was because I had sun block on, but it did the same thing when I was only wearing barrier cream. I tried applying it with a brush but that was too thick & didn't blend into my skin at all. It just sat on top of my skin making my pores look more obvious. I googled how to apply it thinking I was using it wrong but that didn't help either. Applying it with a damp sponge had a better result but still not what I was hoping for. 

If your skin is already perfect then this could be a good addition to your lazy girl make-up routine.

The texture & coldness of the product is really nice. I just couldn't get it to blend properly.

[본 상품은 솔직한 리뷰의 대가로 제공되었습니다.] 본 상품은 솔직한 리뷰의 대가로 제공되었습니다. 

자연스러운 피부처럼 보이는 수분 공급 페이스 틴트에 대한 아이디어가 정말 매력적이어서 이 제품을 정말 좋아하고 싶었습니다. 나는 또한 꽤 게으른 편이어서 여러 가지 일을 하는 화장품도 장점이다. 나는 IT Cosmetics 브랜드를 좋아하지만 Do It All Sheer Tint는 나에게 적합하지 않습니다. 
 
포장은 사랑스럽고 흘릴 위험 없이 지갑이나 주머니에 쉽게 들어갈 수 있어 여행이나 밤 외출 시 수정하기에 좋습니다. 나는 여행을 많이 하고 '여행 준비'를 위한 슬림한 메이크업 가방을 가지고 있는데 이론적으로는 이것이 완벽했을 것입니다. 

제품을 사용하기 전 다양한 방법으로 피부 정돈을 해봤지만 결과는 늘 같았습니다. 섞으면 피부 곳곳이 벗겨지는 것 같거나 마스크팩 잔여물이 남아있는 것 같아요. 처음에는 자외선 차단제를 발라서 그런 줄 알았는데, 베리어크림만 발라도 마찬가지였습니다. 브러쉬로 발라봤는데 너무 두꺼워서 피부에 전혀 묻어나지 않더라구요. 그것은 내 피부 위에 앉아서 모공을 더욱 분명하게 보이게 만들었습니다. 제가 잘못 사용하고 있는 줄 알고 적용 방법을 찾아봤지만 그것도 도움이 되지 않았습니다. 젖은 스펀지로 바르면 더 나은 결과를 얻었지만 여전히 제가 기대했던 결과는 아닙니다. 

당신의 피부가 이미 완벽하다면 이것은 게으른 소녀 메이크업 루틴에 좋은 추가가 될 수 있습니다.

제품의 질감과 차가움이 정말 좋습니다. 다만 제대로 섞이지 못했을 뿐이죠.

author: Farrah
headline: Great for the "no makeup" look!!
comment:
I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Balm and I was honestly a little skeptical about whether or not I was going to like it because let's face it, I'm in my late 40's and I have a slew of skin issues and problems. I also don't care to wear heavy foundations or skin tints simply because it feels too heavy and it likes to settle into all of my fine lines, wrinkles, and imperfections. This is a balm that contains 92% of serum-based products so it literally looks and feels like skincare. It went on so easily and blends like a dream but the best part is that it looks like my skin but better! It's perfect for women like myself that prefer a lighter weight, no-makeup look because it gives that beautiful dewy, moisturized, hydrated, healthy skin glow and I love that. I included a photo with half of my face completely free of any of the skin balm and the other side I have done my makeup with the IT Cosmetics skin balm, setting powder, and a little bit of blush and the difference is insane. It didn't look cakey or dry it just looks like my skin but better. The coverage is very buildable and it looks very natural all while leaving a dewy, radiant finish. It took very minimal effort to blend it out with a brush and you can even use your fingers too. A little bit definitely goes a long way. 
I think this would be perfect for women with normal to dry skin however you can add a little setting powder if you're oily. I adore all of the products from the IT Cosmetics brand but this one is definitely going to stay in my makeup bag. I loved this skin-tint balm and I highly recommend it.

The first time I used it, it looked great when first applied, but it didn't wear well at all. It ended up being blotchy after a couple of hours and it settled into my creases and lines. I had used it in conjunction with my regular skincare routine, so I decided to try again by only using a hyaluronic serum underneath and it worked much better. It's a very sheer product, so it's not going to have much coverage, but it does even the completion out. In the photo, I applied it to the right side of the back of my hand. You can see that it has a seamless blend and blurs the imperfections. I have a lot of redness and I like using this balm on days when I don't want to get made up, but still want to look my best. It's hydrating, easy to apply and blend, and it leaves a somewhat glowy, matte finish that gives me a healthy skin look and feel. All in all, it's a good product, just be careful what other products you use it with.

author: Joan
headline: Very sheer skin tint with a glowy finish
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This sheer skin tint is indeed sheer! I had to apply two layers to get a bit of coverage. It would be something I could wear when I'm just out running errands instead of a full coverage foundation. It applied smoothly over my skin after my skincare. However, it felt quite drying on my skin and seemed like it soaked up all of my skincare. I would definitely have to use a hydrating mist/setting spray after use. It does provide a bit of a glow to the skin as well. I'm not a fan of the packaging as I applied the product with my fingertips and you have to keep dipping your fingers in to the jar. I could use a brush but I'm not sure how this would apply with a makeup sponge as I feel I would need a new clean sponge each time.

headline: Light coverage with multiple uses

I feel it's quite silicone-y and slides on the skin, so I'd need to set it with powder. However - this stuff BLURRS! The consistency reminds me more of a primer and I use it as such. It's also great for touch ups throughout the day. While I'm not using it as intended, it lives in my purse.

headline: light coverage and quick application.
comment:
I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for free for my honest review.
It has a smooth texture and applies fairly easily with your fingers. The Light Neutral shade was slightly darker than I expected it to be, but because of its sheer nature it worked fine with my complexion. I tried it over 2 different tinted moisturizers and it worked well with both. I usually set my liquid skin tint with powder, but found I didn't need to set this with anything. It wears off naturally throughout the day, (picture after about 8 hours) but didn't empho or creases. This is a nice option if you ke light coverage and quick application.

author: Kara
headline: Will go back to the CC Glow
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The first thing I noticed is that the shade I chose is darker than it appears in the site. I chose Light Warm because I'm fair but not quite porcelain, however this shade is a bit too dark for me. It looks more like the Light Medium shade on the site. I definitely recommend going to a store to see the product before choosing a shade. I applied the balm using a brush, but it didn't blend as easily as I expected it to. I had to apply some extra moisturizer to get it to blend evenly. Once blended, it does look pretty natural but can look a bit cakey if your skin is not hydrated enough. The coverage seems to be minimal, although it's buildable. It doesn't seem to feel quite as hydrating as the makeup I normally use, and it leaves a matte finish. (I've been using the IT CC Glow for the past few years and absolutely love it. It's the perfect shade, blends with ease, looks super natural, feels hydrating, and contains SPF.)  I had high hopes for this balm since I love the brand, but I prefer my usual makeup much more and will continue using that one daily.

author: Jen
headline: Nice, lightweight balm.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try out this sheer face balm, as I'm not one to wear heavy or full-coverage foundation. I would definitely describe the texture of this to be balm-like. It is very creamy, and it's easily blended onto the face. I used a brush with tapping motions, and this worked out nicely. This balm looks very luminous on the skin upon application, although I do feel like that goes away somewhat as it dries. Interestingly, it also feels cooling on the skin at first, which feels nice. This product didn't dry down all the way for me and remained a bit tacky, and it also settled into my fine lines. The coverage is very light. It definitely doesn't cover imperfections, but it camouflages them a bit. Overall, I like this product, and I will continue using what I have. I'm not sure if I will purchase this in the future or not, as I already use a lightweight foundation that I love more. Definitely give this a try if you're looking for a very light coverage, luminous face balm.

Light enough to look natural but buildable to smooth out the areas on my face that needed it. It claims a radiant finish but don't mistake that for a sheen or an unnatural glow. I don't see anything like that, just a nourished, natural, healthy look. I purchased the Light Neutral #210 with pink undertones and it's a perfect neutral - not dead looking like some can be. I'm actually looking forward to wearing this because I think it's going to make me feel good about how I look. Highly recommend!

author: Johanna
headline: Sheer, no coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Face Balm is a great concept: sheer coverage with serum incorporated. 
It applies easily and does feel nice on the skin, but I found it felt "slippery" wishing a couple hours of application. 
As a mature woman with uneven, textured skin with wrinkles, I prefer a product with stronger coverage. It just doesn't give me the "made up" look I prefer. 
The concept of the Do It All face balm is clever, it's just not for those of us with less than perfect complexions.

author: Jessica
headline: Wrong color for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's safe to say that this is not my color. So aside from the fact that the light warm is too dark for me, it seems to work as advertised. It goes on smooth. The balm stays pretty solid but melts when your fingers touch it. It didn't seem very sheer to me but that could be because the color was too dark. It didn't run when water got on it and even repelled it. Though, I was able to wipe it right off with a towel. So as long as you wear it and don't get wet or try to wipe it away or rub it, it should stay. I probably wouldn't get this even in a lighter color but that's mostly because it wipes off too easily. If you just want to use it for a short period, this would probably work for you.

author: KR
headline: A quality tinted balm with good results
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review].  I chose the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in the shade Fair Cool (125). Initially I was a bit worried when I opened the jar and saw the color of the balm. It appeared to be a darker shade than I needed, but once applied it thinned out to a lighter shade that worked for me. I used my fingers for application and the texture of the balm is quite nice. It's smooth and has a wet feel to it. It glides onto the skin and spreads easily and evenly. It's a very simple and quick balm to apply. It has the coverage level of a typical tinted moisturizer. It evens out your skin tone, but it isn't going to hide any major imperfections. The one issue I had was that even though the balm felt hydrating, it accentuated a dry area I had so I'd make sure your skin is exfoliated before applying. Other than that I really like this product and I look forward to seeing the skin benefits it promises with continued use.

headline: Thin like a veil but texture shows
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like it, and I like the idea of it being good for your skin, and it looks lovely with my makeup, however I don't like it closeup. I felt it accentuated texture and fine lines.  I have used a product just like this in a jar for years by L'Oreal Age Perfect line which for me had more of a coverage. Also, it has no SPF, so you cannot skip that step. It is sheer— I expected that— but even building doesn't do much. I still had to use concealer. So what's the point? The jar is small, and considering the need to reapply, I don't feel it's good value.

headline: My Skin but Better
comment:
I really like this! And I'm super picky with foundation. I like foundations to feel like nothing or like skincare, and when I look in the mirror I look like myself. I don't need a ton of coverage, just even out my skin tone.

With other foundations I've tried, it's super common for me to look in the mirror and not really recognize myself. Those foundations are pretty, I look pretty, I just don't look like myself, it's like uncanny valley.

This Balm foundation makes me look like myself, my skin, just more polished. Honestly, I can't ask for more than that.

I have dry skin, I'm fair and cool toned, and I thought 125C was going to be too deep, but it was perfect.

author: Nikki
headline: Patchy, hard to blend, and pills with everything — it just d
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really wanted to love this because I have dry skin and at first it feels very hydrating and comfortable. Unfortunately, thats where the positives ended for me. The formula doesnt blend into the skin well and tends to sit on top rather then melt in. It takes quite a bit of effort to work it in, and even then it never truly looks seamless. 

In the photo of me I submitted, you can clearly see it emphasizing texture and creating a patchy uneven finish. The longer it wears the more noticeable it becomes. It pills with almost every makeup and every sink care item I've tried layering it with, which made it very difficult to incorporate it into a routine. I tested it multiple ways and couldnt find a combination that worked. 

For me this just didnt perform the way I expected especially at this price point and for the usual great products this company puts out.

author: Samantha
headline: Absolutely OBSESSED!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I am literally OBSESSED with the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I already repurchased it in a lighter shade because Midwest winter has me paler than usual 😅 and I needed a better match.
This product is seriously unlike anything else I've used. It's incredibly hydrating and smoothing, and it gives the most natural-looking finish of any complexion product I've ever tried. The consistency is honestly hard to describe — it looks thick, almost like the consistency of a stick foundation in the pan, but once you apply it, it feels unbelievably silky, smooth, and lightweight on the skin.
It blends beautifully, looks gorgeous all day, and — this is huge for me — it's the ONLY product that doesn't crack around my nose. That alone makes it a winner. Plus, it hasn't caused any irritation or skin issues at all.
If you want something natural, smoothing, and comfortable that still makes your skin look amazing… this is it.

author: Hayley
headline: Game changer for no-makeup makeup days!
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product really surprised me. I'm someone who likes to put a full face on on the weekend when I'm going out but during the week or for errands, I rarely wear makeup because it's too much work. However, this might change the game. The color 210 light neutral matched my winter skin tone perfectly. I wasn't sure how I wanted to apply it at first. I used my fingers but then used a foundation brush which I enjoyed more. The formula was surprisingly not dry and pretty easy to work with. This is advertised as a sheer tint balm and I think that accurately describes it. This gave me a little bit of coverage to even out my skin tone, but almost looks like I don't have anything on. This would be perfect for those days that I don't want to spend time doing my make up but want to look put together. After hours of running errands, where I kept forgetting, I had makeup on and touching my face, it still looked good. Can't wait to wear this on my no-makeup makeup days!

headline: nice lightweight base
comment:

author: Lynn
headline: Won't set on top of SPF
comment: I really like the texture of this balm. It's probably one of the most accurately named products I've ever tried. I apply it with my fingers and go over it with a brush. It sits so close on my skin, almost like it sinks in and is undetectable. The only downside is I cannot get it to set on top of my SPF. Even with powder, it ends up looking greasy.  I do really enjoy using it so I've been trying it different ways but, unless I skip SPF completely it kinda slides around my face. Without SPF it's super pretty and natural and makes my skin feel nourished, but the formula is not buildable.

author: Aubreeanna
headline: Good Product Bad Shade Match
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review I really enjoyed the melty hydrating texture of this product as someone with extremely dry skin! It melts in beautifully and leaves a lovely hydrated plump finish to the skin! When applied with a brush it pretty much sat on top of the skin and i was not a fan so the warmth of your fingertips is the way to apply for a seamless result. The shade Fair warm is unfortunately substantially too dark and saturated for my super fair skin and is giving "she needs to get her liver function checked" which is definitely NOT what i am going for. It reminds me of a sheer version of the since discontinued confidence in a compact foundation which was one of my personal favorites. So If you can find a good shade match i would say it is worth a try if you enjoy sheer coverage dewy products!
comment_ko: 솔직후기로 제품을 제공받았습니다 극건성 피부인 제가 이 제품의 멜티한 수분감이 정말 맘에 들었어요! 아름답게 녹아들어 피부에 촉촉하고 보송한 마무리감을 선사합니다! 브러시로 바르면 피부 위에 거의 자리 잡았고 나는 팬이 아니기 때문에 손끝의 따뜻함이 매끄러운 결과를 적용하는 방법입니다. Fair Warm 그늘은 불행하게도 내 매우 고운 피부에 비해 너무 어둡고 포화되어 있으며 "그녀는 간 기능을 검사해야 합니다"라고 말하고 있는데 이는 확실히 내가 원하는 것이 아닙니다. 그것은 제가 개인적으로 가장 좋아하는 것 중 하나였던 콤팩트 파운데이션에 대한 이후 단종된 자신감의 순수한 버전을 생각나게 합니다. 따라서 좋은 색상과 일치하는 제품을 찾을 수 있다면 투명 커버리지 이슬 제품을 좋아한다면 시도해 볼 가치가 있다고 말하고 싶습니다!

author: Gretchen
headline: This would be great to travel with!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is a versatile balm that blends into your skin. I got the shade Fair Cool 125 as I am actually more of a neutral but I think it was a better fit for my skin than the warm shades. Either way, because it melts into your skin and it's overall pretty sheer I think it's pretty forgiving. It does tend to have a natural finish so I used powder on top to matte it out. It's a great product and I will be taking it on vacations and trips as it's easier to pack than liquid foundation.

author: Tracy
headline: Didn't work well with my mature skin.
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I wanted to share the different aspects of this on my arm. By the wrist is a swatch of the actual color. Next to that I blended it out. It does have decent coverage and can be built up depending on your likes. It does dry down after a bit without setting it. Up top of my arm I used translucent power to set it. It did settle into the cracks and fine lines leaving my mature skin and facial wrinkles very highlighted and pronounced. It really does not work great with my mature skin. Overall I don't see myself using this again.

headline: Do not recommend for oily skin but great for normal or dry.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the idea behind this product and the light- weight, skincare- infused formula. It blends beautifully and gives a very sheer, natural finish perfect for "no- makeup makeup" look.

headline: Really good

author: Jillian
headline: My new go-to daily product!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint face balm is my new favorite product. It feels so light and almost cooling. The coverage is light and blends easily. I do touch up later in the day because it doesn't last but I love the natural look it gives me and it's so quick to reapply that I don't mind. The shade range is a bit lacking, I did get a shade too warm for me, but it'll be perfect for my summer shade. In fact, I like it so much I went back and bought my winter shade too. It doesn't feel like wearing makeup and I love that for an everyday look. It gives my skin a healthy glow without looking shimmery or oily like some other products. I highly recommend trying it out.

headline: Comfortable wear

It comes packaged in a nice glass jar like container.  It last all day.  I have combo skin though so I prefer to wear it with a powder.  Overall I think it's great for maturing skin.  It doesn't emphasize any wrinkles and it feels good on the skin.

author: Sarah
headline: Great for no-makeup days
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm applies and blend smoothly with fingers for an easy application or a brush for more precise placement. I do apply it after my regular moisturizer, and it absorbs well into my skin with no oily feel. While the shade sent to me is too warm for my skin tone, it blends wonderfully and adds a bit of color correction. I have not noticed any changes to my fine lines with this product, but I do love it for no makeup days when I don't need sunscreen.
comment_ko: [본 상품을 제공받아 솔직하게 작성한 리뷰입니다] 손가락으로 부드럽게 펴 바르거나, 브러시로 사용하면 더욱 정밀하게 발리는 틴티드 밤입니다. 일반 보습제 사용 후 바르면 오일리한 느낌 없이 피부에 잘 흡수됩니다. 저에게 보내주신 색상은 제 피부톤에 비해 너무 웜한 색상인데, 놀랍도록 블렌딩되어 약간의 컬러보정 효과를 더해줍니다. 나는 이 제품을 사용했을 때 잔주름이 달라지는 것을 느끼지 못했지만, 자외선 차단제가 필요하지 않은 화장을 하지 않은 날에는 이 제품을 정말 좋아합니다.

author: Holly
headline: Natural barely there tint
comment: This is a sheer barely there skin tint. It's basically a dupe for an older L'Oréal skin tint. It is glowy and doesn't offer enough coverage for me, it's hardly any coverage at all. If you spot conceal over top you'll get a more polished look. Def set with powder or I don't think it will last very long. I appreciate getting to try the product but wouldn't recommend it for the price. The wet n wild skin tint is so much better for $5.
comment_ko: 투명감이 거의 없는 스킨 틴트입니다. 기본적으로 오래된 로레알 스킨 틴트에 속는 것입니다. 윤기가 나고 커버력이 충분하지 않고 전혀 커버력이 거의 없습니다. 윗부분을 가리면 좀 더 세련된 모습을 얻을 수 있습니다. 파우더로 세팅하면 오래 지속되지 않을 것 같아요. 제품을 사용해 볼 수 있어서 감사하지만 가격 대비 추천하고 싶지 않습니다. 5달러면 웨트 앤 와일드 스킨 틴트가 훨씬 낫습니다.

author: Heather
headline: I love this skin balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great skin tint! It has great, skincare ingredients which I always welcome! It applies evenly and blends out nicely and looks like skin but better! Perfect for no-makeup days. The finish is great, not too matte or too dewy. It also takes very little for my whole face so one jar will likely last me ages! Definitely recommend this!

headline: Smooth and dewy
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been enjoying IT Comestics Tint Face Balm. It applies smoothly and blende effortlessly, leaving a nice dewy finish. I love how it evens out my skin tone without leaving it looking heavy or cakey. The coverage is light to medium, perfect for smoothing and evening things out but not enough to fully covet blemishes. It's a great every day option when you want a radiant, natural finish rather than full glam coverage.

author: Heather
headline: If you buy any makeup this year, let it be this!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics did not disappoint with this one! I absolutely love this! The face balm is sheer but glowy and beautiful! Allowing your natural skin to show through. It's easy to blend and makes me feel like there is nothing on my skin. I did try this with powders on top and I felt like those dried out the balm. So I did try it with very little powder on and under my eyes over the concealer that I used, little dusting around my nose and a blush on my cheeks. I also used a setting spray. This did very well! After several hours, I feel like it looks even better than when I first applied it. It definitely makes my skin look and feel healthy. When I washed this off, my skin felt smooth and soft. Not dried out like others tend to do. I honestly want to throw away all my other foundations and just use this from now on haha! I cannot wait to see how this performs during the summer! author: Katherine B
headline: Good tinted moisturizer
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For the past few years I've been mostly doing no/light makeup looks, so I pretty much stopped buying full coverage foundations. I am always exploring new tinted moisturizers so that I can compare the results but I have never tried a balm version, so I was very curious to try the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. What's amazing about it is that it's not just a balm, it's essentially a serum that transitions into a lightweight but buildable tinted moisturizer. It is packed with great ingredients such as hyaluronic acid, collagen peptides, and vitamin E - all the stuff that makes your skin hydrated, younger and smoother. I don't use the product with anything else - I use it as solo foundation on my skin and it works great for me. My skin is on a dry side, but this balm doesn't emphasize that and actually helps cover some of my fine lines. It's cold season right now so I can't really tell how well it'll perform in the humid NY weather in the summer, but so far it lasts a decent amount of time during the day for me. The packaging is okay but I'm not too keen on sticking fingers in jars, so a brush/sponge combination is a must for me. The only thing I kind of wished it had is SPF, but it's no big deal - I apply my spf separately anyway. Overall, I've been using it almost daily now and I like it.

author: kkelly040
headline: My new Favorite 🩷
comment:
*For reference, I am 44 yrs old and have combo, leaning dry, skin. I have occasional breakouts on my chin area and most of my texture is on my cheeks and nose area. Most of my bases tend to break apart in between my eyebrows & on my upper lip, especially when I sweat*

I have been on the hunt for the perfect skin tint, which for me, is light to medium coverage and something that is barely detectable. Ofc others can tell I wear makeup because I wear a full beat daily but I was looking for something that didn't start to fall apart in places throughout the day. Being a home health aide for a 96 yr old woman is somewhat similar to chasing a toddler around. Therefore, I sweat. ALOT lol. I had recently purchased ((and returned)) Natasha Hi-Glam foundation, Hourglass Illusion foundation, Bobbie Brown's Weightless foundation, and Laura Mercier Skin Tint-because they ALL wore off in a really noticeable way....and then I saw this. I have always been a fan of It Cosmetics, from skincare to their face products so I had high hopes, which was right! This has became my fave skin tint within a week. It wears SO pretty, literally showcases by best face regardless of what kind of skin day I'm having, is dewy and gives me such a youthful glow, keeps my face hydrated throughout the day with long wear, smoothes and blurs all my texture, didn't cling to or emphasize my dry areas, and didn't wear funky in my T-Zone!! I tan, so I can be a different shade daily, but this matches them all lol. If I could make my own perfect skin base, this would be it! Cannot recommend enough for anyone looking for your skin but better in a bottle. Get it!!
comment_ko:
*참고로 저는 44세이고 복합성,기분건성 피부입니다. 가끔 턱 부분에 트러블이 생기고 대부분의 질감이 볼과 코 부분에 나타납니다. 특히 땀을 흘리면 눈썹 사이와 윗입술의 베이스가 대부분 부러지는 경향이 있습니다*

나는 완벽한 피부 색조를 찾고 있었는데, 그것은 나에게 가벼운 것에서 중간 정도의 범위이고 거의 감지할 수 없는 것입니다. Ofc 다른 사람들은 제가 매일 풀 비트를 하기 때문에 메이크업을 한다고 말할 수 있지만 저는 하루 종일 곳곳에서 무너지기 시작하지 않는 것을 찾고 있었습니다. 96세 할머니에게 가정 건강 도우미가 되는 것은 어린아이를 쫓아다니는 것과 다소 비슷합니다. 그러므로 나는 땀을 흘린다. 많이 ㅋㅋㅋ. 나는 최근에 나타샤 하이 글램 파운데이션, 아워글래스 일루젼 파운데이션, 바비 브라운의 웨이트리스 파운데이션, 로라 메르시에 스킨 틴트를 구입했습니다(그리고 반품했습니다). 왜냐하면 모두 정말 눈에 띄는 방식으로 닳았기 때문입니다....그리고 나서 이것을 보았습니다. 저는 스킨케어부터 페이스 제품까지 잇코스메틱스의 팬이어서 기대가 컸어요. 맞아요! 이것은 일주일 만에 제가 가장 좋아하는 피부 색조가 되었습니다. 정말 예쁘게 바르고, 어떤 날의 피부와 상관없이 말 그대로 최고의 얼굴을 선보이고, 촉촉하고 젊어 보이는 광채를 선사하고, 오랫동안 착용해도 하루 종일 얼굴을 촉촉하게 유지하고, 모든 결을 매끄럽고 흐려주고, 건조한 부위에 달라붙거나 강조하지 않고, T존에서 펑키하게 입지 않았습니다!! 태닝을 해서 매일 다른 색상을 연출할 수 있는데 이게 다 잘 어울려요 ㅋㅋㅋ 나만의 완벽한 피부 베이스를 만들 수 있다면 바로 이것! 당신의 피부를 찾는 사람에게는 충분히 추천할 수 없지만 병에 담아두면 더 좋습니다. 그것을 얻으십시오 !!

author: JJ
headline: Not So Dry Skin Friendly
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. As much as I love It Cosmetics, I can't quite figure out how to make the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm best work for me at this time. 

This balm claims to be a "your skin but better", easy breezy coverage product. It is a blendable, light texture. I found the coverage quite light yet the color pigment quite dark. As I tried to build coverage up ever so slightly, I found the serum/balm color built up darker & the tone mismatch became more apparent. (I did attempt to apply with both a Beauty Blender and a foundation brush.) The product seemed to sit on my skin with either application method. It didn't really give the skin-like look I had hoped for. As a person with under eye dark circles, concealer with this was a must. Ultimately, I ended up applying more makeup than I intended on putting on in the first place. 

All this to say, I will re-visit this product in the summer when I have more of a tan and my skin isn't as dry. I really want to like this one, so I won't give up hope just yet! I do love the compact, it is very makeup bag-friendly packaging. For now, it isn't the best choice for me day to day and I cannot say I would repurchase.

이 밤은 "피부가 더 좋아지고", 산뜻하고 산뜻한 커버력을 갖춘 제품이라고 주장합니다. 블렌딩이 가능하고 가벼운 질감입니다. 커버력은 꽤 밝았지만 컬러 피그먼트는 꽤 어둡다는 것을 알았습니다. 커버력을 조금씩 쌓아가다 보니 세럼/밤 컬러가 더 짙어지고 톤의 불일치가 더욱 뚜렷해졌습니다. author: Mary
headline: Good ingredients
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Overall, the IT Coametics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is good. 

I tried it alone and with several different primers along with applying with fingers, brush, and sponge. I found it worked best alone, over moisturizer/sunscreen, or with Jane Iredale primer using a sponge. I also found that it needed to be set with Laura Mercier Blurring setting powder for my mature skin. 

It does "smooth out" my skin making my pores appear smaller and lessened any redness. I had to make sure my skin wasn't dry or it kinda form little patches. Maybe using over time would help with that since it does have good-for-your skin ingredients. 

I picked the wrong shade to try for the winter months but will probably buy the correct one in store. I feel the lightness of this product with be great for the warmer months.

author: Amber
headline: Dewy, Unscented Sheer Coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been wanting to try It Cosmetics for a while now because I've only ever been able to sample it at Ulta, though I have always been impressed with the results when I have tried this brand. I was able to try the IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in shade Light Warm 215. At first glance, the balm appears harder. When I actually tried it, the Sheer Tint Face Balm melted faster than butter beneath my fingertips, providing a smooth application. It reminded me of coconut oil because it readily thinned from my body heat (smooth texture, not clumpy). Even though it looks thin, it dries into a satin-smooth finish rather than feeling oily or greasy. I think it would be a great balm for a sheer, natural-looking appearance. It clearly added color to my hands overall, but didn't really change the color of my skin other than deepening the tan, or make the veins on my hands look any less noticeable. Just gave them a more even tone and slightly blurred pores. It would be great for clear skin, but I might pair it with a concealer and maybe even foundation; otherwise, use it as a moisturizing base if a fuller coverage is necessary.
I see it being useful for time spent outside and places where minimal makeup might feel more acceptable or preferred. The color itself is a bit darker than I would normally choose, but that means it'll make a better summer color for me and a better contour hue. I also like this tone because most of my current facial powders are too light and make my skin look washed out, so I can use my lighter powders for brightening and highlighting when setting, and rely on the It Cosmetics tan shade (Light Warm 215) balm for a warmer glow on my lighter nude skin. Since it has a sheer feel, even though I don't normally do this because I have sensitive skin, I'd likely also be able to spread It Cosmetics Face Balm to my neck without it causing any redness or irritation on my acne-prone skin. I don't notice any scent when I sniff it or look at the ingredients, aside from the typical smell of makeup. The IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm with 92% Skincare Serum offers a hydrating, dewy finish while creating a subtle glow and light coverage. I think this formula would be great for normal to dry skin, especially mature skin, due to its easily maneuverable, hard-to-creamy-to-dry consistency. It's priced well, considering the balm works fine without a primer or moisturizer underneath and doesn't get cakey. It readily blends without accentuating pores, fine lines, or creases. So, I think it's worth the price. It would also be a great travel/work companion, eliminating the need for extra products and saving time on the go.
comment_ko:
[본 제품은 솔직한 리뷰로 제공받았습니다.] 얼타에서만 샘플을 볼 수 있었기 때문에 한동안 잇 코스메틱을 사용해보고 싶었지만, 이 브랜드를 사용했을 때 항상 그 결과에 깊은 인상을 받았습니다. 라이트 웜 215 색상의 IT 두 잇 올 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 사용해 볼 수 있었습니다. 언뜻 보면 밤이 더 딱딱해 보이는데요. 실제로 사용해보니 쉬어 틴트 페이스밤이 손끝에서 버터보다 빠르게 녹아서 부드럽게 발려요. 몸의 열로 인해 쉽게 묽어지기 때문에 코코넛 오일이 생각났습니다(뭉침이 없고 부드러운 질감). 얇아 보여도 건조해지면 기름지거나 기름진 느낌보다는 새틴처럼 매끈하게 마무리됩니다. 투명하고 자연스러운 모습을 연출하는데 아주 좋은 밤이 될 것 같아요. 손 전체에 확실히 색을 더해 주었지만, 태닝을 깊게 하거나 손의 정맥을 덜 눈에 띄게 만드는 것 외에는 피부 색을 실제로 바꾸지 않았습니다. 좀 더 균일한 톤과 약간 흐릿한 모공을 주었습니다. 깨끗한 피부에는 좋겠지만 컨실러나 파운데이션과도 함께 사용할 수도 있습니다. 그렇지 않고, 더 완전한 커버가 필요한 경우 보습 베이스로 사용하세요.
밖에서 보내는 시간과 최소한의 메이크업이 더 수용 가능하거나 선호되는 장소에 유용할 것 같습니다. 색상 자체는 제가 일반적으로 선택하는 것보다 조금 더 어둡지만, 이는 저에게 더 나은 여름 색상이 되고 더 나은 윤곽 색조가 될 것임을 의미합니다. 현재 사용하고 있는 페이셜 파우더 대부분이 너무 가벼워서 피부가 칙칙해 보이기 때문에 저는 이 톤을 좋아합니다. 그래서 설정 시 밝은 파우더를 사용하여 브라이트닝과 하이라이터를 적용할 수 있고, It Cosmetics의 황갈색 쉐이드(라이트 웜 215) 밤을 사용하면 더 밝은 누드 피부에 더 따뜻한 빛을 발할 수 있습니다. 투명한 느낌이 있기 때문에 피부가 민감해서 평소에는 하지 않더라도 It Cosmetics Face Balm을 여드름이 나는 피부에 붉어짐이나 자극을 유발하지 않고 목에 바를 수도 있을 것 같습니다. 냄새를 맡아보거나 성분을 살펴봐도 특유의 화장품 냄새 외에는 아무런 향도 느껴지지 않습니다. IT 코스메틱스의 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤(92% 스킨케어 세럼 포함)은 수분을 공급하고 촉촉한 마무리를 제공하는 동시에 은은한 광채와 가벼운 커버력을 선사합니다. 나는 이 포뮬러가 쉽게 조작할 수 있고 크림 같거나 건조하기 어려운 일관성으로 인해 중성 및 건성 피부, 특히 성숙한 피부에 적합할 것이라고 생각합니다. 프라이머나 보습제 없이도 밤이 잘 작동하고 끈적거리지 않는다는 점을 고려하면 가격이 적당합니다. 모공, 잔주름, 주름을 강조하지 않고 쉽게 블렌딩됩니다. 그래서 가격만큼 가치가 있다고 생각합니다. 또한 추가 제품이 필요하지 않고 이동 중에 시간을 절약할 수 있어 훌륭한 여행/업무 동반자가 될 것입니다.

author: Kelly
headline: My skin, airbrushed - a light-as-air natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As an IT Cosmetics fan, who has been using the CC+ Cream for some time, I was excited to try the IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review. It's a unique product in that it comes in a small pot, and is firm yet turns into a gel-feeling serum texture. The directions suggest you can apply with fingers or a brush. I tried both, and highly recommend going the brush route! This product requires blending, so applying with a foundation brush was much more efficient, and used less product. A little goes a long way. What I love about this product: it gives a natural look with minimal effort. It's my skin with a slight filter. You can still see my skin, with the imperfections toned down and "air brushed". What I like: the formula is light as air, glides on, and blends easily.  What could use improvement: I don't find it to be buildable. It becomes very wet and transfers badly when I try to build coverage. One "coat" is perfect- stop there. If you're looking for flawless full coverage, this isn't the one. Also, one layer of product gives the glowy airbrushed look. Building it seems to settle into and accentuate my pores and fine lines -no thank you!  Making sure my skin is well moisturized and primer helps. All in all, I like this for an easy, quick, everyday natural look, but prefer a different product when I want a full coverage look.

author: MuppetMama
headline: User friendly balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Do It All Sheer Balm has been fun to play with and compare to the other IT foundations I have. The balm comes in an easy open but secure screw on lid pot. The balm is buildable and bendable but will never provide medium or full coverage even with lots of layers. Going too heavy does not yield best results. I have a photo to try to show the difference between full coverage and balm. I have found it works best just after moisturizing and being sure to stay on top of my exfoliating routine. I have used it as an under eye concealer, redness blender, spot blender, and all over color. I have found it to wear well over the day and prefer it to other brands of similar type balms. I found the color to be consistent across the brand and recommend this for a flexible use product for those who want to show their skin just blend imperfections. I have used it many times and barely made a dent in the tub so I expect to get a lot of uses. I would like to see a teeny tiny tub of this for portability.

author: Amanda
headline: This will be a staple in my spring summer routine
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a creamy formula I got the shade light natural 210 base on what the color looked like on my screen. This shade is darker than anticipated. With it being winter and it being darker than what I was expecting this is more of my late Spring early summer tan on my skin. With that said I did a swatch test for this review and I did do a wear test for a full day around my house. Applying this as 9am with a makeup brush and doing a full routine of home chores, walking the dog and then having some time to relax before washing my face at 8 pm I can say it was a good foundation. It is advertised as shear but I found it to be a medium to build full coverage foundation. I also found a little bit goes a long way so I feel like that will make it worth the money. Now for the longevity, when I used it around my house it lasted all day, I felt it didn't move much if at all. I didn't experience any creasing or settling in to my finer lines around my eyes. I had a breakout that it easily covered. I definitely looked forward to getting to use this regularly when I get some color to my skin when the sun returns.

author: Kaitlyn
headline: Natural and Effortless!
comment:
I received a complimentary pot of the IT Cosmetics Do It All sheer tint face balm in exchange for my honest review, and it has been a beautiful addition to my everyday routine. I have loved IT Cosmetics for a few years now and regularly use several of their products, so I was curious to see how this one would compare. The balm has a smooth, almost velvety texture that melts in easily and feels genuinely comfortable on my skin.

What stands out most is how natural it looks. It does not mask my skin, but instead softens redness and creates a more even, rested appearance. My complexion looks clearer, more youthful and balanced, and quietly radiant, like I'm just having an especially good skin day.

It also feels hydrating throughout the day. It gives me exactly the kind of effortless, refined finish that I gravitate toward. I highly recommend it for those who enjoy light coverage that doesn't drown you out.

author: Juanita
headline: The perfect tint balm
comment: Im in love with this balm! I love the feel of it. It glides on so smoothly. I love how I don't have to apply foundation anymore. I use this as a sheer foundation and apply a bit of translucent powder above and love how my skin looks so natural. You can still see some of my imperfections but not that clearly and ! like that because it makes it look so much more natural. The pigmentation of the tint in this balm is perfect for me. The price is on point as well. I will definitely be buying this again.

author: Karen
headline: IT Do it All Does It All
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face is a versatile beauty essential. It's as smooth as butter! It wears well without turning ashy. It holds up well too. It survives a little sweat and humidity without running into your collars. My dilemma was that this shade is a tad too light but it's creamy texture made it perfect as an under eye concealer and a primer for days when my hyper pigmentation wants to show off. Easy to apply, with or without a brush; for girls like me that use their fingers and or sponges. My only recommendation is to add more color options for darker skin that capture our unique undertones.

author: nikkm4509
headline: The perfect tinted face balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was impressed with the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, which came in a compact case similar to blush. The product features a smooth, balmy texture, making it easy to apply with the finger. Personally, I prefer to use it under my eyes, as it helps reduce the appearance of dark circles. I appreciate that it hydrates the skin while blending in seamlessly. When paired with my IT Cosmetics foundation, it provides excellent coverage, conceals imperfections, and adds a touch of color to my pale winter skin. I plan on continuing to incorporate this product into my makeup routine.

author: Cassidy
headline: Feel great on skin, natural looking coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm feels great on the skin and is easy to apply. It definitely covers up blemishes and some of my redness in a way that still looks natural. It is slightly buildable, but since it's sheer it doesn't build up to full coverage. I think this is a perfect product to use going into the warmer months where you want coverage, but something that feels light.

headline: MY NEW FAVE!
comment: I have used Clinique, Ilia Youthforia, Maybelline, and so much more for the perfect skin tint because I'm very active on the gym, outdoors, and just as equally on camera. When I saw a skin tint balm, it already sounded perfect, but when I tell you... when I stuck my brush in and it just glided onto my face better than butter... I INSTANTLY KNEW this was going to be my #1 go to! The coverages, the feel, the stay.. This is the first time I've found a PERFECT skin tint- foundation for me. I'M IN LOVE!

author: Margaret
headline: I will definitely buy this again
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I finally have a makeup for a lady in her 50s. It is so hard for me because I have fine lines and still have an oily T-Zone. I found it best to apply with the full round brush from It cosmetics. Then use a sponge to apply more where needed. For me I used a setting powder in the T-Zone. It wore well on most days except for the hot days where nothing will stay on. It was a perfect match for my skin tone. The only thing you have to be careful of is how much primer and what kind of primer you use.  I find it best to treat it like skin care. This for me is a must have especially if you are over 50.

author: Janesa
headline: Natural Glow, Effortless Coverage!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review; I've been really impressed with this sheer tint balm.
The texture is smooth and lightweight, blending effortlessly into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. It gives a natural, healthy glow while subtly evening out my complexion, making it perfect for no-makeup makeup days. I love that it feels more like skincare than foundation, and it doesn't emphasize pores or fine lines. The finish is breathable, comfortable for all-day wear, and ideal for quick routines. Overall, a great multitasking product if you want light coverage with a radiant, skin-like look.

author: Emily
headline: truly buildable and natural
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've seen very mixed reviews of this tint balm, and I think it ultimately comes down to the finish you're aiming for. I have dry, over 50 skin with fairly even tone and texture and very small pores. I like a natural finish, and something that is moisturizing. With a serum base and buildable coverage, I can build up areas that need more concealer and lightly brush over others. The makeup trend toward products with "skincare ingredients" is overplayed, IMO, and honestly makeup with ingredients that are healthy for the skin are simply my standard, although I'm unconvinced that the quantity of these ingredients are enough to really promote long-term skin improvements like firming or a reduction in the appearance of fine lines. I did, however, find that the formula doesn't settle into my lines and make them more pronounced. Because I received this for review, I didn't receive the shade I might have chosen, but the sheerness lets my skin stay natural-looking. I haven't experienced any oily residue even after a day of wear, and haven't had any breakouts.

"스킨케어 성분"이 포함된 제품에 대한 메이크업 트렌드는 과장되어 있습니다. author: Deep
headline: Glowy Skin in a Balm – Makeup That Feels Like Skincare
comment:
I've been using the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm (92% skincare serum), and I'm honestly impressed with how lightweight and skin-loving it feels.

First, the texture is beautiful — it melts into the skin like a balm but blends out into a sheer, natural tint. It doesn't feel heavy, cakey, or greasy. Instead, it gives a soft, healthy glow that makes your skin look like your skin, but better. Perfect for everyday wear when you don't want full foundation.

What I love most is how comfortable it feels throughout the day. My skin doesn't feel dry or tight, and it doesn't settle into fine lines. It gives a hydrated, smooth finish without emphasizing texture. The coverage is light, so it evens out redness and minor imperfections while still looking very natural.

This is ideal if you prefer minimal makeup and want something that bridges skincare and makeup. If you're expecting full coverage, this isn't it — but for a fresh, dewy, effortless look, it's a win.

Overall: great for no-makeup makeup days, quick routines, and skin-first beauty lovers.
headline_ko: 밤에 빛나는 피부 – 스킨케어 같은 메이크업
comment_ko:
저는 IT 코스메틱스 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤(92% 스킨케어 세럼)을 사용해왔는데, 가볍고 피부에 닿는 느낌이 솔직하게 인상 깊었습니다.

첫째, 질감이 아름답습니다. 밤처럼 피부에 녹아들다가 블렌딩되어 투명하고 자연스러운 틴트가 됩니다. 무겁거나 퍽퍽하거나 기름진 느낌이 들지 않습니다. 대신 부드럽고 건강한 윤기를 선사해 피부를 원래의 피부처럼 보이면서도 더 좋게 만들어줍니다. 풀파운데이션이 싫을 때 데일리로 착용하기 딱 좋아요.

제가 가장 좋아하는 점은 하루 종일 편안함을 느낀다는 것입니다. 피부가 건조하거나 당기는 느낌이 없고, 잔주름이 생기지 않습니다. 질감을 강조하지 않고도 촉촉하고 매끈하게 마무리됩니다. 커버력이 가벼워서 붉은기와 작은 잡티를 고르게 잡아주면서도 매우 자연스러워요.

최소한의 메이크업을 선호하고 스킨케어와 메이크업을 연결하는 제품을 원하는 경우에 이상적입니다. 완전한 커버리지를 기대한다면 그렇지 않습니다. 하지만 산뜻하고 촉촉하며 자연스러운 룩을 원한다면 이것이 승리입니다.

종합: 노메이크업 메이크업을 하는 날, 빠른 루틴, 피부를 최우선으로 생각하는 뷰티 애호가에게 적합합니다.

author: Lauren
headline: Pretty gel texture, light coverage, hydrating
comment:
I was gifted this product for my honest review. This product has a beautiful gel like texture and it feels light on the skin. I think you can see from the photo this is not much coverage , kind of like a skin tint. I think it has a pretty texture and tones down my redness though. I tend to range from fair to light and right now I'm more fair and this is a little dark for me so I'd say true to color on depth but it's a little warm for a neutral shade (Light Neutral). What I love about it is it blends quickly, doesn't look dry on my dry skin, and I can reapply it over makeup without removing anything and it looks good. All of that is a bit of a miracle because everything looks dry on my winter skin right now. I do think my skin looks better after removal which is probably the extra hydration. I've worn it every day for a few weeks which says a lot with my large makeup collection. I find it looks good through my work day but I'd have to reapply after that, which is good for a skin tint texture.
It is a bit messy in the jar, so if that bothers you skip it. I'd skip it for oily skin for sure. I'll definitely buy this when I run out, but color match in person to see if I can find something more neutral.

author: Mahima
headline: Perfect for light coverage
comment:
I have honestly never seen a tint balm that works like skincare too. When I first read "balm," I thought it would feel oily or heavy, but it's actually very lightweight and comfortable. My combination skin feels fresh and breathable after applying it. It covers my pigmentation and redness really well while still looking natural. My dry patches stay hydrated all day, and it layers nicely under sunscreen or powder.
It's so creamy — I used my fingers to apply it, and it glided perfectly on my skin. It blends effortlessly without any patchiness and feels super smooth while applying. It's not full coverage, so if I need extra coverage on spots, I either use concealer or dab on a little more product. Overall, it gives a fresh, healthy glow that makes me feel put together without makeup. I think it's perfect for no-makeup days or when I want a soft, natural look.

headline: Too sheer

headline: Lovely Natural Base
comment:

This balm is a lightweight, skincare forward base perfect for those who want their skin to be the feature of their look. This balm offers lightweight coverage perfect for a no makeup makeup look or clean aesthetic. I was surprised by how much I loved the cooling sensation when applying it. It isn't intense and immediately dissipates, but it feels refreshing as you apply. I cannot wait to use this in the summer. 

Because the coverage is so light, the shades are quite flexible. The shade I use is a little too warm for me right now but during the summer it'll be perfect. Despite the slight mismatch during the winter, because it's so sheer I can still make it work with some contour and blush. 

Because this is so soft, it doesn't have a ton of staying power. It'll last through the day with a primer and setting spray, but for longer than about 8 - 9 hours you will have to reapply. It's not a long wear base, but for a natural look, it's great. 

If you like clean, skin that looks like skin bases, I would highly recommend this balm. It feels lovely, looks natural and is quite unique. I'm a big fan.

author: Elizabeth
headline: Cool Shades Have Yellow Undertones
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] (I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.)

As I have gotten older I have switched to a more minimal makeup look. As such, I have spent the last few years trying to find the best sheer foundation. I have tried over a dozen, and this is for sure in my top five. I am super picky with products, and I was pleasantly surprised with this one.

I received this in the shade "Fair Cool 125". It comes in a nice glass container with a twist off lid.

The coverage is sheer but buildable. One layer gives skin a radiant glow but no coverage. Two layers starts to be more noticeable and tame redness. Three layers evens skin tone on a similar level to a medium coverage foundation. I don't recommend more than 3 layers because then it starts to look cakey.

The texture of this is unique. It almost seems whipped, but it is slightly more stiff and has a break when you dip into it. It feels cold when applying, almost gel-like. It is a somewhat odd sensation that makes my face feel wet, but it would be refreshing in hot weather. It is creamy but slightly oily once applied to skin, and blends in easily. It washes off easily with a gentle cleanser.

It has no added fragrance, and no natural scent either. It smells like nothing.

I have combination skin with occasional oily and  dry patches, and this didn't highlight the dryness. It is slightly oily and doesn't completely dry down, so it leaves skin somewhat tacky. I prefer to set it with powder or setting spray for this reason. 

I have tried this on bare skin, with primer, with and without setting g products, and every combination thereof. It stays on for 8+ hours used alone, no primers or setting sprays necessary. However, because it doesn't fully dry down, it can rub off, so I recommend setting it for extra assurance.

I tried applying this various ways, and found it blended the best with a dense brush. I lightly dip the brush directly into the pot, then blend into skin using small circular motions. 

My biggest complaint with this is the shade range. The FC 125 "cool" shade I received is not cool. It has an obvious yellow undertone that intensifies as it dries. I have very cool toned skin with pink undertones. When I apply one layer of product it isn't too noticeable, but 2 or more layers you can really see the yellow come through.

I used this for several weeks and did not see any improvements in my skin, so I am skeptical of the skincare claims. 

I would recommend this to anyone with neutral to warm skin tone who is looking for a light coverage tint. It gives a healthy glow, and is an excellent product overall. I would continue to purchase this product if the cool tones were true.
comment_ko:
[본 상품은 무상으로 제공받아 솔직한 리뷰를 작성하였습니다.] (본 제품은 무료로 제공받아 솔직한 리뷰를 작성하였습니다.)

나이가 들면서 좀 더 미니멀한 메이크업으로 바뀌었어요. 그래서 나는 지난 몇 년간 최고의 투명 파운데이션을 찾으려고 노력해 왔습니다. 나는 12개 이상을 시도했는데 이것이 확실히 상위 5개 안에 들었습니다. 나는 제품에 대해 매우 까다로우며, 이 제품에 놀랐습니다.

나는 이것을 "Fair Cool 125" 색상으로 받았습니다. 뚜껑이 열려 있는 멋진 유리 용기에 담겨 있습니다.

적용 범위는 순수하지만 구축 가능합니다. 한 겹만 바르면 피부에 빛나는 광채가 나지만 커버력은 없습니다. 두 개의 레이어가 더 눈에 띄고 발적을 길들이기 시작합니다. 3겹으로 구성되어 미디엄 커버력의 파운데이션과 비슷한 수준으로 피부톤을 균일하게 만들어줍니다. 3개 이상의 레이어를 권장하지 않습니다. 그 이유는 레이어가 케이크처럼 보이기 시작하기 때문입니다.

이것의 질감이 독특합니다. 거의 휘핑한 듯한 느낌이 들지만, 조금 더 뻣뻣하고 담그면 부서지는 느낌이 있습니다. 바르면 젤처럼 차가운 느낌이 듭니다. 얼굴이 젖어드는 듯한 묘한 느낌이지만 더운 날씨에는 상쾌할 것 같아요. 크리미하지만 피부에 바르면 약간의 오일리함이 느껴지고 쉽게 블렌딩됩니다. 순한 클렌저로 쉽게 씻어냅니다.

향이 첨가되지 않았으며 천연 향도 없습니다. 냄새가 전혀 나지 않습니다.

나는 가끔 지성 및 건성 패치가 있는 복합성 피부를 가지고 있는데, 이것은 건조함을 강조하지 못했습니다. 약간 오일리하고 완전히 건조되지 않아서 피부가 다소 끈적끈적해집니다. 그래서 저는 파우더나 세팅 스프레이로 세팅하는 것을 선호합니다. 

나는 맨살에 프라이머를 바르고, g 제품을 세팅하거나 하지 않은 상태에서, 그리고 그 모든 조합을 사용해 보았습니다. 단독으로 사용하면 8시간 이상 지속되며 프라이머나 스프레이 설정이 필요하지 않습니다. 다만, 완전히 마르지 않아 벗겨질 수 있으니, 더욱 안심하고 세팅하시길 권해드립니다.

다양한 방법으로 발라봤는데 촘촘한 브러시와 가장 잘 섞이더군요. 브러시를 냄비에 직접 가볍게 담근 다음 작은 원을 그리며 피부에 블렌딩합니다. 

이것에 대한 가장 큰 불만은 음영 범위입니다. 내가 받은 FC 125 "쿨" 색상은 쿨하지 않습니다. 그것은 건조되면서 더욱 강해지는 명백한 노란색 색조를 가지고 있습니다. 저는 핑크빛이 많이 도는 쿨톤 피부에요. 한 겹 바르면 크게 눈에 띄지 않지만, 두 겹 이상 바르면 노란색이 확연히 드러나는 것을 볼 수 있습니다.

나는 이것을 몇 주 동안 사용했지만 피부가 개선되는 것을 보지 못했기 때문에 스킨 케어 주장에 회의적입니다. 

뉴트럴~웜톤 피부에 가벼운 커버력을 원하는 분들에게 추천해드려요. 건강한 윤기를 선사하며 전체적으로 우수한 제품입니다. 쿨톤이 사실이라면 계속 이 제품을 구매할 의향이 있습니다.
text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] (I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.) As I have gotten older I have switched to a more minimal makeup look. As such, I have spent the last few years trying to find the best sheer foundation. I have tried over a dozen, and this is for sure in my top five. I am super picky with products, and I was pleasantly surprised with this one. I received this in the shade "Fair Cool 125". It comes in a nice glass container with a twist off lid. The coverage is sheer but buildable. One layer gives skin a radiant glow but no coverage. Two layers starts to be more noticeable and tame redness. Three layers evens skin tone on a similar level to a medium coverage foundation. I don't recommend more than 3 layers because then it starts to look cakey. The texture of this is unique. It almost seems whipped, but it is slightly more stiff and has a break when you dip into it. It feels cold when applying, almost gel-like. It is a somewhat odd sensation that makes my face feel wet, but it would be refreshing in hot weather. It is creamy but slightly oily once applied to skin, and blends in easily. It washes off easily with a gentle cleanser. It has no added fragrance, and no natural scent either. It smells like nothing. I have combination skin with occasional oily and dry patches, and this didn't highlight the dryness. It is slightly oily and doesn't completely dry down, so it leaves skin somewhat tacky. I prefer to set it with powder or setting spray for this reason. I have tried this on bare skin, with primer, with and without setting g products, and every combination thereof. It stays on for 8+ hours used alone, no primers or setting sprays necessary. However, because it doesn't fully dry down, it can rub off, so I recommend setting it for extra assurance. I tried applying this various ways, and found it blended the best with a dense brush. I lightly dip the brush directly into the pot, then blend into skin using small circular motions. My biggest complaint with this is the shade range. The FC 125 "cool" shade I received is not cool. It has an obvious yellow undertone that intensifies as it dries. I have very cool toned skin with pink undertones. When I apply one layer of product it isn't too noticeable, but 2 or more layers you can really see the yellow come through. I used this for several weeks and did not see any improvements in my skin, so I am skeptical of the skincare claims. I would recommend this to anyone with neutral to warm skin tone who is looking for a light coverage tint. It gives a healthy glow, and is an excellent product overall. I would continue to purchase this product if the cool tones were true.

author: Jenn
headline: Light weight and Light Coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product offers a lightweight, light coverage face tint that is perfect for everyday. I saw this on others and wondered if I would like because in some reviews it appears greasy and heavy. I am wondering now if this is due to application. I apply initially with fingers just very lightly then buff into the skin with a makeup sponge. This gives me a no makeup look that evens out your skin tone and blends slight imperfections. If I need more coverage I use a concealer, I do not attempt to add additional layers of this product. I do not notice a scent and this is not a product you are buying for the packaging, it's functional, not an additional reason to buy the product. 
Bottom line, if you want an easy to use light coverage face tint then this is the product you should try.
