author: Emily
headline: your skin but better
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face tint balm is perfect for those who prefer very little coverage and want a skin-like finish! This balm essentially gives you a more polished version of your own skin and who wouldn't want that?

I personally prefer a bit more coverage and found that there's no real way to build up coverage with this. I also don't love the little jar packaging, strictly for hygienic reasons, since aesthetically is does look nice and it feels heavy, so I wouldn't worry about dropping it and it breaking.

I think this product would be great for those with mature and/or dry skin, and of course those who don't want to look like they're wearing makeup. I can see myself wearing this on travel days, to the gym/pilates and on days where I'm running around doing errands.

I can't see myself buying this in the future, as my the skin tint I typically wear can be built up to provide almost medium coverage and I like my foundation products to have some versatility.
comment_ko:
[제품을 받아 솔직하게 리뷰한 후기입니다] 커버력이 거의 없고 피부결 같은 마무리를 원하는 분들에게 딱인 페이스 틴트밤이에요! 이 밤은 본질적으로 자신의 피부를 더욱 매끈하게 만들어줍니다. 누가 그것을 원하지 않겠습니까?

나는 개인적으로 좀 더 많은 적용 범위를 선호하며 이것으로 적용 범위를 구축할 실제 방법이 없다는 것을 알았습니다. 나는 또한 위생상의 이유로 작은 병 포장을 좋아하지 않습니다. 미학적으로 보기에도 좋고 무거워서 떨어뜨려 깨질 염려가 없기 때문입니다.

피부가 노화되거나 건조한 분들은 물론, 화장한 것처럼 보이고 싶지 않은 분들에게도 이 제품이 좋을 것 같아요. 여행을 가는 날, 헬스장/필라테스에 가는 날, 심부름을 하러 뛰어다니는 날에도 이 옷을 입고 있는 제 모습을 볼 수 있어요.

author: Kiran
headline: Overall, a good foundation
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using IT Cosmetics CC+ cream in Medium Tan for few years and I love it. So I got this face balm in the same shade. And I used it with and without serum and moisturizer. 
1. For the face balm, I will get one or two shades lighter because this was not like the liquid cream shade I used. It feels that this formula gets oxidized very fast.
2. I've combination skin, it blends easily on the parts that are oily. But for the dry part like forehead, you need to use a moisturizer in addition. It will not work for dry skin.
3. It lasted 2-3 hours for me, then I had to reapply. Provides medium coverage.
Overall, a good foundation but I would prefer the liquid formula.

1. 페이스밤은 제가 사용했던 리퀴드 크림색상과 다르기 때문에 한두개 정도 연하게 바르겠습니다. 이 포뮬러는 매우 빨리 산화되는 느낌이 듭니다.

But the moment I applied it on my face, I actually wished it was darker! The tint is so mild and so natural looking, sometimes I'm not sure if there's actually a tint. I am truly pale, so you'd think it would be more noticeable. With that said, the balm really is smoothing on the face and I love the way it feels. I do find in order to truly see the tint, I need to layer it on a bit, but then it starts to sit in my creases and it ain't cute. So I'm trying to find a happy medium. All in all the product is nice, the packaging is nice, I will keep on using it.

author: Morgan
headline: Clean Girl
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been a longtime fan of IT Cosmetics and have used their CC+ foundations on and off over the years. I like the coverage but the original CC+ formula can feel a bit heavy depending on the look I'm going for. Do It All Face Balm is a completely different experience. It feels more like skincare than traditional foundation or CC creams and it blended beautifully on my skin, giving me more of a clean girl look. 

The product is buildable with a subtle glowy finish. When it first arrived, I was worried that I'd ordered the wrong shade because it looked so dark in the container. The color lightened quite a bit as I blended it and was closer to my natural skin color.

author: Victoria
headline: Lightweight and Buildable
comment:
I've been using the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Medium Neutral, and I'm really impressed. It goes on super smooth and blends easily into the skin. It gives light, buildable coverage that evens everything out without looking heavy or cakey.

What I love most is how lightweight it feels. Some cream products can feel thick or sit on top of the skin, but this one doesn't at all. My skin actually feels moisturized and comfortable throughout the day.

It's packed with collagen peptides, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E, so it feels like skincare and makeup in one. The Medium Neutral shade works really well with my skin tone and looks very natural.

There's no scent (which I appreciate), and I love the little glass container it comes in — it feels clean and elevated.

It leaves my skin looking fresh, healthy, and glowy. I would definitely purchase this again!
comment_ko:
저는 두 잇 올 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤 미디엄 뉴트럴을 사용해왔는데 정말 감동받았어요. 그것은 매우 매끄럽게 진행되고 피부에 쉽게 혼합됩니다. 무겁거나 뭉치게 보이지 않으면서 모든 것을 고르게 만들어주는 가볍고 구축 가능한 커버력을 제공합니다.

무엇보다 마음에 드는 점은 가벼움이라는 점입니다. 일부 크림 제품은 뻑뻑한 느낌이 들거나 피부 위에 얹혀지는 느낌이 들 수 있는데 이 제품은 전혀 그런 느낌이 없습니다. 내 피부는 실제로 하루 종일 촉촉하고 편안한 느낌을 받습니다.

콜라겐 펩타이드, 히알루론산, 비타민E가 가득 들어있어 스킨케어와 메이크업을 하나로 담은 듯한 느낌을 줍니다. 미디엄 뉴트럴 색상은 제 피부톤과 정말 잘 어울리고 매우 자연스러워 보입니다.

향이 없고(고마워요), 들어 있는 작은 유리 용기가 마음에 듭니다. 깨끗하고 고상한 느낌이 들거든요.

그것은 내 피부를 신선하고 건강하며 빛나게 만듭니다. 나는 이것을 다시 구입할 것입니다!

author: Maria
headline: Hydrating and a Great, Natural Finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very pleasantly suprised by the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! Since I've been rotating a couple of foundations in my routine, I hadn't been on the hunt for a new one but I was happy to try it out when I had the chance and I'm so very glad I did. 

The packaging is very plain and I probably wouldn't have given it a second glance in the store. Upon opening this product, I couldn't smell any discernible fragrance, which is a plus for many people when we're talking about face makeup. 

The texture of the balm is very soft and almost slippery but it does not fall apart. Once I applied the balm on my skin, I realized I had very much misjudged it - it sank quickly and felt very hydrating to my dry skin. The coverage was almost perfect - it covered most of my dark spots but looked very natural, which I prefer and appreciate. 

I would absolutely repurchase this balm, especially for the winter months.

포장은 매우 단순하며 아마도 매장에서 다시 한 번 살펴 보지 않았을 것입니다. 이 제품을 개봉했을 때 눈에 띄는 향이 전혀 나지 않았는데, 이는 얼굴 화장을 할 때 많은 사람들이 선호하는 장점입니다.

author: ceooftheglow
headline: A beautifully natural face balm
comment:

There is a good amount of product in the pot and I love the fact that it's made with clean ingredients. I ended up removing one star because this product does have some caveats. One issue was this is a very light shade (Fair Warm) and as you can see, it's got quite an orange undertone. I was able to make it work, but very fair skin likely won't. Although it is hydrating, it can cling to very dry patches, so skin prep is a must if you have this issue. The coverage is definitely buildable, but I recommend letting each coat dry fully down and then set fully with powder, otherwise it WILL transfer. The staying power is average, you'll need a primer if you want 8+ hours out

headline: Lovely Match, Beautiful Finish
comment: I received IT Cosmetics Do It All Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review and I have really enjoyed using it. The finish when applied with hands is light and dewy. author: SDG1
headline: Glowy finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The new Do It All Tint Face Balm is an all-in-one multitasker best suited for dry/mature skin. I love that it contains SPF however I'm not very keen on the hard clay like texture. The shade wasn't a match either (that's on me), however upon application the product further oxidizes leaving an orange hue behind. 

The finish is glowy and it doesn't settle in fine lines and wrinkles too much. Loaded with skin caring ingredients, I think I'll need to try the absolute fairest shade because I like the product but after oxidization it's too dark and muddied on my face. 

Removes easily with an oil cleanser, foaming cleanser or regular wipes if I'm feeling lazy. Because of the SPF content, it's suited for daytime wear. I could get a good 7 hour wear out of it before it started to fade.

[본 제품은 솔직한 후기로 제공받았습니다] 새롭게 출시된 두 잇 올 틴트 페이스밤은 건성/노화 피부에 가장 적합한 올인원 멀티 태스커입니다. 나는 SPF가 포함되어 있다는 것을 좋아하지만 질감과 같은 딱딱한 점토에는별로 열중하지 않습니다. 색상도 일치하지 않았습니다(그건 제 책임입니다). 그러나 적용 시 제품이 더욱 산화되어 주황색 색조가 남습니다. 

마무리감은 윤기나고 잔주름이나 주름이 많이 잡히지 않습니다. 스킨 케어 성분이 듬뿍 들어있어서 가장 밝은 색상을 시험해 봐야 할 것 같아요. 제품은 마음에 들지만 산화 후에는 얼굴이 너무 어둡고 탁해지거든요. 

게으른 경우 오일 클렌저, 포밍 클렌저 또는 일반 물티슈로 쉽게 제거됩니다. SPF 성분으로 인해 주간 착용에 적합합니다. 나는 그것이 퇴색하기 시작하기 전에 그것을 7시간 동안 충분히 착용할 수 있었습니다.

author: Krystal
headline: My New Everyday Product
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
I am so extraordinarily surprised with this tinted face balm. I wasn't able to get it in the fairest shade but instead got it in light warm shade and I am so surprised with it and how amazing it looks on me. Normally I am a casper white being a natural red head. However, this light warm shade gives me a sweet natural sun kissed glow that I have never got from any other product. This sheer tint is just that, super sheer and light weight, but even outs your skin tone, helps to reduce redness, which I am always, and gives your skin this beautiful glow that doesn't look like you have any kind of makeup on at all.
It Cosmetics has really out did themselves with this versatile product that I find myself wearing every single day. I don't wear as much makeup as I used to but this is something I can put on after my moisturizer and feel like I am put together without much effort.
I am very happy with this sheer face tint and will be getting it in other shades too.
comment_ko:
[본 제품은 솔직한 리뷰의 대가로 제공되었습니다.]
나는이 착색 된 얼굴 밤에 매우 놀랐습니다. 나는 가장 밝은 그늘에서 그것을 얻을 수 없었지만 대신 밝고 따뜻한 그늘에서 그것을 얻었고 나는 그것에 너무 놀랐고 그것이 나에게 얼마나 놀랍게 보이는지 놀랐습니다. 일반적으로 나는 자연스러운 빨간 머리인 캐스퍼 화이트입니다. 하지만 이 밝고 따뜻한 색상은 다른 어떤 제품에서도 얻을 수 없었던 달콤하고 자연스러운 태양빛을 선사합니다. 이 쉬어 틴트는 정말 투명하고 가벼우면서도 피부톤을 균일하게 만들어주고, 붉은기를 완화하는데 도움을 주며, 제가 항상 그렇듯이, 전혀 화장을 하지 않은 것처럼 아름다운 광채를 피부에 선사합니다.
It Cosmetics는 제가 매일 착용하고 있는 이 다재다능한 제품으로 정말 뛰어난 성과를 거두었습니다. 예전만큼 메이크업을 많이 하지 않지만, 수분크림을 바른 후 바르면 별 노력 없이도 뭉친 듯한 느낌이 들거든요.
나는 이 투명한 얼굴 색조에 매우 만족하며 다른 색조로도 얻을 것입니다.

author: Bea
headline: Free for review
comment: I received this free for review. This is a 4in1 tinted moisturizer that is supposed to improve your skin over time. It has sheer buildable coverage to firm, hydrate, and minimize fine lines. It has many moisturizing ingredients and leaves a light dewy finish. You can apply this with a brush or your fingers.  The product feels cold when you first apply it. Almost like cool water. It set on my dry to combo skin without having to use powder. It does have light coverage. Even though it is hydrating, it still clung to dry patches and would not cover my pores. I get better results with applying with fingers. I have an olive skin tone and the shade, while being light warm, still blended well and was workable. It does not blend over silicones very well so avoid those types of primers.

author: Chantelle
headline: ​The perfect "no-makeup" look (if you don't over-apply).
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I'm honestly impressed by how natural it looks. If you look at my side-by-side photos, the one where I'm wearing it (the closer shot!) just looks like my skin but a lot more hydrated and "awake". It doesn't heavy-handedly cover everything up; it just blurs the redness and gives me a nice, healthy dewiness.
My biggest takeaway? Put the brushes away. I found it applies way better when I just use my fingers—the warmth makes it sink right in instead of just sitting on top of my skin.
One word of caution: It is super easy to overdo it! I included a photo of what "too much" looks like on my fingers. That amount was way more than I actually needed for my whole face. A tiny bit goes a long way, so start small and build it up if you want more coverage.
Overall, if you're into the "no-makeup" look, this is definitely worth a try. Just remember: less is definitely more!

author: Trisha
headline: Amazing for fine lines and wrinkles
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really torn about giving this product 4 or 5 stars, so let's get into it.
What I loved: The formula is amazing, it blends so nicely and doesn't settle into fine lines or wrinkles. HUGE WIN! It's a light coverage that was strong enough to even out my rosacea without fully covering my freckles and leaving my skin looking plump and healthy. I loved that it really didn't look like I was wearing makeup, that's a big win for me. It really was a clean look and if you weren't inspecting my face close up you would just think I had great skin. I was worried about the neutral shade, because IT Cosmetics can lean warm tone in my opinion, but I didn't have this issue at all. As a true cool skin tone I didn't get any orange or yellow tones showing through. 
What I didn't love: the amount of product you get. With only 0.63 oz this is around 25% less product than you get with most foundations. I have been using this for about a month and I'm going through it faster than I would like.
Overall if you are good with the price point for the amount of product you get, then I would highly recommend. It really is an amazing product, especially if you have any fine lines or skin texture. I was blown away at how well this product preformed. I will likely buy it again for this reason, but I would use it for more special times that I wanted to look nice.

author: Chantelle
headline: The Ultimate "Your Skin But Better" Glow (Just Watch the Do
comment:
I've been trying out this tinted serum lately, and I'm honestly impressed by how natural it looks. If you look at my side-by-side photos, the one where I'm wearing it (the closer shot!) just looks like my skin but a lot more hydrated and "awake". It doesn't heavy-handedly cover everything up; it just blurs the redness and gives me a nice, healthy dewiness.
​My biggest takeaway? Put the brushes away. I found it applies way better when I just use my fingers—the warmth makes it sink right in instead of just sitting on top of my skin.
​One word of caution: It is super easy to overdo it! I included a photo of what "too much" looks like on my fingers. That amount was way more than I actually needed for my whole face. A tiny bit goes a long way, so start small and build it up if you want more coverage.
​Overall, if you're into the "no-makeup" look, this is definitely worth a try. Just remember: less is definitely more!

author: Cindy
headline: The Bomb of all Face Balms!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm truly surprised me on many levels! It felt like a balm, very light and soothing. It was buildable and I was able to get the needed coverage for my hyperpigmentation. As you can see it did not fully cover it but gave my skin a lightly filtered look. I did use a light finishing powder and was pleased with how well it set. I also used it under my eyes instead of concealer. After 5 hours, it looked just as it did when I first applied it. I am finding myself reaching for this product instead of my high end holy grail foundation! For reference, I am wearing the color Fair Cool 125.

author: Kim
headline: Greasy!
comment: I don't think I've ever had a product make me as oily as this did.  Within two hours of applying I looked like I'd covered myself in Crisco, which is really odd because my skin has been a bit dry lately.  I had to blot my face twice throughout the course of the day.  I also couldn't get it to set, even though I applied both setting powder and setting spray.  It came off on my sunglasses and anything else that touched my face, and by the end of the day it was pretty much gone.  No thanks, hard pass.

author: Cynthia
headline: Silky smooth for a natural look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I enjoy using this balm. It's very silky and smooth as I apply it. You don't need a ton of it. I apply it old school and use my fingers but if they would include a specific type of brush to apply it, I'd probably use the brush. I apply it like I would my face cream. It's a light coverage  that gives your skin a natural no make up look. It isn't long lasting but perhaps if you apply a setting spray it can last all day. author: Emily
headline: A great, natural-looking sheer tint face balm
comment:
This has quickly become one of my favorite everyday complexion products. I have very dry, sensitive skin, and I'm always looking for something that gives a little coverage without emphasizing dryness, texture, or fine lines. This face balm is exactly that.

The texture is creamy, balmy, and incredibly comfortable on the skin. It melts in easily and feels more like skincare than makeup. It lightly covers my redness and hyperpigmentation without completely obscuring them. My skin looks more even and healthy, but still very natural — it doesn't look like I'm wearing foundation. It's perfect for days when I want to look more put together without doing a full face.

What I really love is how hydrating it feels. My skin stays comfortable and doesn't get tight or flaky throughout the day, which is huge for me. I would say that the look is more natural skin to slightly matte, that makes my skin look smoother and more refreshed, and it doesn't settle into fine lines or cling to dry patches. This is definitely not a radiant or dewy look though. 

The sheer tint is very forgiving and easy to blend, making it great for quick application with fingers. It also layers beautifully with concealer where needed without looking cakey.

Overall, this is a great option if you have dry or sensitive skin and want light coverage that smooths and evens out your complexion while still feeling like skincare. It's easy, flattering, and makes my skin look healthier with minimal effort.

이것은 제가 가장 좋아하는 일상용 안색 제품 중 하나가 되었습니다. 저는 굉장히 건조하고 민감한 피부인데, 건조함이나 질감, 잔주름을 강조하지 않고 살짝 커버해주는 제품을 항상 찾고 있어요. 이 페이스 밤이 바로 그것입니다.

질감은 크리미하고 상쾌하며 피부에 매우 편안합니다. 쉽게 녹아들어 메이크업보다는 스킨케어에 가까운 느낌을 줍니다. 붉은기와 색소침착을 완전히 가리지 않으면서도 가볍게 커버해줍니다. 내 피부는 더욱 균일하고 건강해 보이지만 여전히 매우 자연스럽습니다. 파운데이션을 바르고 있는 것처럼 보이지 않습니다. 풀페이스를 하지 않고도 좀 더 뭉쳐 보이고 싶은 날에 딱이네요.

제가 정말 좋아하는 점은 수분 공급 느낌입니다. 내 피부는 편안하게 유지되고 하루 종일 팽팽해지거나 벗겨지지 않습니다. 이는 나에게 큰 도움이 됩니다. 약간 매트한 느낌에서 더 자연스러운 피부로 표현되어 피부가 더 매끄럽고 산뜻해 보이고, 잔주름이 뭉치거나 건조한 부분에 달라붙지 않는 것 같아요. 그러나 이것은 확실히 빛나거나 이슬 맺힌 모습은 아닙니다. 

쉬어 틴트는 매우 관대하고 블렌딩이 쉬우므로 손가락으로 빠르게 바르기에 좋습니다. 또한 뭉치지 않고 필요한 곳에 컨실러와 함께 아름답게 레이어링됩니다.

전반적으로, 이것은 건조하거나 민감한 피부를 가지고 있고 스킨케어 같은 느낌을 주면서 안색을 매끄럽고 균일하게 해주는 가벼운 커버리지를 원하는 경우 훌륭한 선택입니다. 쉽고, 마음에 들며, 최소한의 노력으로 피부를 더욱 건강하게 만들어줍니다.
text_for_model: This has quickly become one of my favorite everyday complexion products. I have very dry, sensitive skin, and I'm always looking for something that gives a little coverage without emphasizing dryness, texture, or fine lines. This face balm is exactly that. The texture is creamy, balmy, and incredibly comfortable on the skin. It melts in easily and feels more like skincare than makeup. It lightly covers my redness and hyperpigmentation without completely obscuring them. My skin looks more even and healthy, but still very natural — it doesn't look like I'm wearing foundation. It's perfect for days when I want to look more put together without doing a full face. What I really love is how hydrating it feels. My skin stays comfortable and doesn't get tight or flaky throughout the day, which is huge for me. I would say that the look is more natural skin to slightly matte, that makes my skin look smoother and more refreshed, and it doesn't settle into fine lines or cling to dry patches. This is definitely not a radiant or dewy look though. The sheer tint is very forgiving and easy to blend, making it great for quick application with fingers. It also layers beautifully with concealer where needed without looking cakey. Overall, this is a great option if you have dry or sensitive skin and want light coverage that smooths and evens out your complexion while still feeling like skincare. It's easy, flattering, and makes my skin look healthier with minimal effort.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics products are always a good blend of skincare and makeup. The Sheer Tint Face Balm is exactly this. author: Aida
headline: Mrs. Do it all
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] We are entering a new skincare meets makeup era, and this is a great example. It has the texture of a balm but it feels wet on the skin, dries out with a balanced sensation of matteness but it still looks glowy on the high point of the face, wow! TBH, It took me one or two trial-and-error tests to figure out I had to simplify my skin care routine to get the benefits of this product, and to balance out my powder placement on my combination skin. I think this simple, minimalist routine with just a few steps could be perfect for someone who likes to keep things quick and easy, especially when they're in a hurry or on the go, rushed mornings, traveling or quick makeup in the car. The balm format works great for all this type of situations, no worries about spills or wondering how many ounces on the plane, again? The color match worked really well too, since it doesn't try to be full coverage shades are flexible and easy to work with. Its so hydrating that I even tried it under my dry under eye as concealer. I got to admit it wasn't the best concealer work I had seen but it worked great for the morning hours and it would save me time and products to use in a real life rush situation. It's an overall great product with numerous and versatile uses. It's easy to work with and carry around, so give it a try.

author: Ruby
headline: Not for me
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this face tint balm since I recently turned 37 and have had some skin changes, especially in winter time. A little goes a long way. This pot is small enough to take with you or just store wherever. This is not thick at all. My preferred method of application was with my It Cosmetics foundation brush. You really don't need to pick up much at all. It swipes on the skin easily and blends out pretty good.  It's also scent free. The whole application process was pretty easy.  For wear tests, the color pay of was great expect for when you have the wrong tone. The color I got was medium cool. I tend to run cool/ neutral. This was very cool and made me look somewhat grey. I did fix this by bronzing. This did make my skin look pretty and dewy initially but by the end of the day, some of the product was broken up around my mouth and nose. I also did have some clinging on dry spots that did enhance them. This is one of those products that you have to play with more and be cautious setting too heavily with powder or it will ruin your make up and make it look cakey as well. On a positive note, this works well as an under eye concealer but again, doesn't play well with setting powders.

text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this face tint balm since I recently turned 37 and have had some skin changes, especially in winter time. A little goes a long way. This pot is small enough to take with you or just store wherever. This is not thick at all. My preferred method of application was with my It Cosmetics foundation brush. You really don't need to pick up much at all. It swipes on the skin easily and blends out pretty good. It's also scent free. The whole application process was pretty easy. For wear tests, the color pay of was great expect for when you have the wrong tone. The color I got was medium cool. I tend to run cool/ neutral. This was very cool and made me look somewhat grey. I did fix this by bronzing. This did make my skin look pretty and dewy initially but by the end of the day, some of the product was broken up around my mouth and nose. I also did have some clinging on dry spots that did enhance them. This is one of those products that you have to play with more and be cautious setting too heavily with powder or it will ruin your make up and make it look cakey as well. headline: Decent coverage sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately the color I chose wasn't a match so l wasn't able to wear this out but I did wear it in my house to see if I would love it. I have to start by saying that I have dry sensitive skin so my face tends to dislike a lot of products. This product seemed like it would be a great match for me but unfortunately I didn't love it. I didn't have any reaction to it so that's a good thing, like it didn't irritate my skin so that's a plus. Although it is advertised as having skincare ingredients and more like a tinted moisturizer I still had to use a moisturizer before hand because the time I didn't, it emphasized my dry patches and held on for dear life as the day progressed. author: Regina
headline: lightweight, dewy and perfect for mature skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm really pleased with this product. I don't normally wear foundation because as a woman in my 50s I find most foundations tend to age me. This tinted face balm is completely different.
I was unsure at first because it looks like a traditional foundation, but it absolutely isn't! It didn't clog my pores, didn't settle into fine lines or wrinkles, and I didn't have to worry about it transferring onto my clothes. It gave my skin a beautiful dewy finish, which I love!
You could apply it with your fingers or a brush, I used to brush for more even application and it worked perfectly. The only thing worth noting is that the shade I chose is a little dark for me right now, but that's just my winter skin versus summer skin.
Overall, this is something I'll definitely be adding to my make up routine on the days. I will just want light and natural coverage.

headline: A little goes a long way!

I learned the hard way that you pat or tap this on your face, do not rub or glide your fingers over your face until this has set up otherwise roll up your sleeves and prepare to wash your face, the rolling mess not to mention the way it makes your pores look. I have learned to use this in the evening after I take all my makeup off as the balm seems to help my skin care routine or rather I feel like I'm benefiting from having this balm over it. I like this product,  not crazy about the price point but I like and will buy it. No break outs but I could see if you attempted to "build" coverage becoming oily thus break outs. A little goes a long way.

author: Cosima
headline: Barely there even complexion
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This balm is exactly what it promises - a lightly tinted, sheer balm. The texture melts into the skin immediately and spreads easily with your fingers. Overall, on its own this does not have any noticeable coverage. However, paired with a concealer and a light powder, the effect is a more even complexion without looking heavy. It does need to be said that it does not have buildable coverage. Applying too much actually results in the shade looking off while applied in a single layer it appears as a perfect match. Unfortunately my biggest issue is that the balm texture does not play well with my combo oily skin type. It is perfect for a day when I don't wear my makeup all day but it does not have longevity. But if you have dry skin or don't need 12 hour lasting power, this could be perfect.

author: Amanda
headline: Oh, how I love a good Skin Tint! ✨
comment:
As I've gotten older, finding the right makeup is a struggle. It's not just about the shade—it's finding a formula that doesn't crease, cake, settle, or flake.
​I have some sensory issues with heavy products, so I always prefer something light and sheer. I just want an even skin tone without feeling the makeup on my face. This IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm absolutely hits the mark! 🙌
​It feels weightless. I love that I can forget it's even there, but then I do a random mirror check and think... "Oh, lovely!" 🤩 It evens everything out, doesn't clog my pores, and lasts all day.
​If you want that "your skin but better" look, this is a good one to try!
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] ​

author: Ashley
headline: Meh
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I had high hopes for this product because I really love the IT Cosmetics CC Foundation, but this one just didn't quite win me over. The brand claims that with continued use, this balm can help improve the overall appearance of your skin; however, I didn't use it consistently enough to see any long-term results.

Although it's marketed as a balm, the texture feels much lighter than I expected, more like a serum than a traditional balm. I was also not a fan of the packaging, as the container didn't feel very hygienic. Texture-wise, the best way I can describe it is… very wet.

The coverage is extremely sheer. Even after applying multiple layers with my fingers, a brush, and a sponge, it remained very light. As you can see in my photos, it didn't cover my freckles at all. Once applied, the product didn't sink into my skin the way I anticipated; instead, I could feel it sitting on top, which I personally don't prefer. I also felt the need to set it with powder.

That said, while the coverage is minimal, it did help even out my skin tone slightly and gave a nice luminous finish. I can see this working better for someone with drier skin who prefers very light coverage. Overall, though, there weren't enough benefits for me to repurchase this product.

author: Dana
headline: Great lightweight dewy coverage
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was so excited to try this product created by IT Cosmetics with Jennie Garth (hello 90210 days!) since it's formulated for more mature skin I was even more excited. At 38 my skin has its fine line, plus I still suffer from acne and rosacea. The texture was different than any product I've used before. It's cool feeling on the skin to apply and blended in with my skin tone without turning orange by the end of the day. It felt lightweight and dewy, definitely moisturizing without settling into my lines and pores. I did feel like I needed to set with some sort of setting powder for it to stay. I tried one day without and it seemed to disappear rather quickly, versus putting my setting powder over top it stayed on a lot longer. I did find it covered my redness but wasn't a full coverage foundation. More of a sheer finish Ike my skin but better. I also love that it's a serum and makeup combined.. I love all in one type of products. Lower stars for longevity, or lack thereof. Great if I want a minimal luck to run errands without doing a full face.

headline: Foundation balm

I received this product for free Thank you for giving me this opportunity to try this amazing product.  It cosmetic Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a lightweight, radiant-finish tinted moisturizer and foundation balm in one. Powered by a 92% skincare base with collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E, IT delivers sheer, buildable coverage. Visibly smoother, firmer, more hydrated, and subtly blurred. Its ultra-blendable solid-serum texture melts on contact for effortless application, making it as easy to use as it is beautiful on the skin. Makeup and skincare routine all in one!

author: LeeLee
headline: Fabulous Face
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm has a mousse-like texture and is very light on the skin. It covers my redness nicely, as well as any bumps, all while looking natural. It does not pill when put on over my moisturizer or SPF. I used a dense bristle foundation brush and it worked well. It was not bad using a makeup sponge application either, but I preferred using a brush. The skin balm lasted pretty well on me, (8 hours) but did break up in my oily spots later in the day. This did not settle into fine lines for me like some other skin tints do. The skin balm also did not make my dryer areas look flaky or dry at all! I'd say it's a complete winner for me! I will just add powder to my oily areas as usual. I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea. There's no scent, and it feels good on my face and looks good in photos and in real life as well. I'd recommend it highly for an everyday natural look.

author: Victoria
headline: Buildable but Amplifies Texture
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I had really high hopes for this face balm, as I love skincare products and light facial color so a light, buildable color that firms and minimizes lines sounded like a winner. 

I did like the amount of moisture in the balm, and found that it was truly light and buildable while being hydrating. I could spot correct and blend without using a ton of product, and the balm melted into my skin.

However, I did not find that the balm minimized lines or texture on my face. You can see in the photo - the top is my regular skin, and the bottom is the balm in action and the lines and bumps on my skin are actually emphasized.

I will be mixing this into my regular SPF for a bit of color, but as-is this balm didn't work for me and my textured skin.

나는 솔직한 리뷰를 대가로 이 제품을 받았습니다.

나는 스킨케어 제품과 밝은 페이셜 컬러를 좋아하기 때문에 이 페이스 밤에 대한 기대가 정말 컸습니다. 그래서 주름을 단단하게 하고 최소화하는 가볍고 만들기 쉬운 컬러가 승자처럼 들렸습니다. 

나는 밤의 수분 함량이 마음에 들었고 수분을 공급하면서도 정말 가볍고 바르기 쉽다는 것을 알았습니다. 많은 양의 제품을 사용하지 않고도 코렉팅과 블렌딩이 가능했고, 밤이 피부에 사르르 녹아들었어요.

그러나 나는 밤이 내 얼굴의 주름이나 결을 최소화한다는 것을 발견하지 못했습니다. 사진을 보시면 아시겠지만 위쪽이 일반 피부, 아래쪽이 밤이 발랐을 때 피부의 주름과 요철이 좀 더 강조된 느낌이에요.

나는 약간의 색상을 위해 이것을 일반 SPF에 혼합할 예정이지만, 이 밤은 나와 내 피부 질감에 효과가 없었습니다.

headline: This product is exactly what the name says.

Powered by a 92% skincare base—featuring collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E—IT gives you sheer, buildable coverage that looks like your skin but is visibly smoother, more hydrated, and firmer. author: MeoMotMui
headline: Lightweight, it doesn't dry my skin out
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]   
 Unlike CC+ cream or foundation, which tend to feel heavier (to cover an uneven skin tone), this one is really lightweight compared to anything else I have used. I love how sheer it is on the skin, and it doesn't make me look like I am wearing heavy makeup at all.

   I love light makeup, so this works perfectly for me. Of course, this is not full coverage like a foundation (my dark freckles area need stronger option but the rest of the skin love this tint balm), because it's a tint. For a tint, the result is actually way better than I expected.

   I have dry skin, and this doesn't dry my skin out. When I check the ingredients, it contains peptides, hyaluronic acid, etc, so this is more like makeup with skincare benefit. And I enjoy it because it helps me save a lot of steps in my morning routine.

   The finish is radiant btw.

    In short, I'm definitely adding this to my make up list. This is a new happy discovery for me, so thank you so much for the opportunity to try it.

author: Debbie
headline: Great for mature skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm in love with this base product! I have mature, combination skin. I have so much trouble finding something that looks and feels good but lasts. I hate the feel of heavy products and most settle into wrinkles and look awful by mid day. I used my finger to apply and it melted into my skin beautifully. I have a very fair neutral skin tone but my freckles are very warm. This blended into just the right shade. I'm willing to spend a little more if it's worth it, and It is for sure! There doesn't seem to be any scent and blends I to a satin finish.

author: Karen
headline: Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm - This is "iT"...
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was lucky enough to be gifted "iT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm" for my honest review.  Upon opening the glass jar, I immediately swatched the "Light Warm - 215" balm on my arm and it was a perfect match for me!  Next came the fragrance check...  No fragrance!  We were off to a great start!  Then it was time to try the balm on my face...  I applied half of my face with my fingers and the other half with a brush.  Both techniques worked well and the balm blended into my skin nicely.  I really like that it has a sheer, yet buildable formula.  It allowed me to put a little extra on my melasma while allowing it to peek through a bit so it doesn't look like I'm wearing anything.  I love that the balm provides a natural looking radiance...  I don't want anything on my skin that makes it look drier cakey. Most of all it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin! I've been using this for several weeks now and I have to say that I am pleasantly pleased with "iT Cosmetics lDo It All Sheer Tint Face Balm"!  When I run out I will definitely get another jar!

headline: New holy grail!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I hate cakey makeup.. and as you'll see from my pics, my skin is far from perfect. I had flashbacks of L'Oréal dream matte mousse. This formula was soooo different than that! It melts like butter and goes on so smoothly whether using a brush or just your fingers. I was so excited to try it when I received it, what you're seeing is the makeup on my unprepped adult breakout skin, same lighting before/after and taken just seconds later. Just one layer looked nice and a couple layers later your skin still feels like it can breath. It gets a little shiny so needed some powder but did amazing after a long day of work. I received this free for testing, but will repurchase as soon as this hits pan!

It blends in easily (I use my fingers) and has no smell at all. Perfect!

author: Tina
headline: No Breakouts!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Been using this serum for the past few weeks, and I'm very surprised by this product. I'm 52, with normal, acne-sensitive skin. I usually wear tinted sunscreens or CC creams for my foundation, and this worked just like them. I got the perfect tone, and it absorbed into my skin effortlessly . I didn't use a moisturizer while trying this serum, and my face doesn't seem dry. We even got rare cold weather with low humidity the past couple of weeks, and I don't have any dryness around my nose like I often get in this weather. I can't speak for dry peeps, but this kept my normal (formerly oily) skin hydrated during winter. It did NOT cause any breakout. It's not expensive. It played well with my other serums. The only reason I don't see myself purchasing this in the future is that it doesn't have SPF in it. A lot of SPFs break me out, so I prefer to continue using a moisturizer with my tinted SPF. That is the only negative I found with this item. I can definitely recommend this serum, though.

author: Bickell
headline: Goes on dewey

It goes on really Dewey almost like a moisturizer and feels like you're wearing no makeup at all.  It does a decent job at covering redness. It is also very blend bowl and you could use under full foundation if you wanted. I like to wear it on my no make up days because it does feel really moisturizing. Also, I have sensitive skin and have had zero negative reaction to this product in fact, I think it's actually reduced my redness.

headline: I like it.
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this in the shade Light Neutral  210.  I think it leans slightly warm.  Though, it still works for me because this a sheer formula that gives light coverage.  It does feel like a thin balm.  I found that it will stick to dry spots.  So it's important to hydrate your skin well and maybe exfoliate if you need it.  With my moisturizer on, I found that applying this with my fingers, it looked best.  I tried applying it with a brush and it gave more coverage but literally just sat on my skin and I could just barely touch my face and it would wipe off.  So I don't recommend that.  It did work well with both cream and powder blushes.  Overall, I think this is a nice skin tint.

headline: Must have!
comment:

Perfect for everyday wear when I want a natural "your skin but better" look. Definitely a new staple in my routine.

author: Traci
headline: Do It All Face Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have mixed feelings about this face balm. It seems to have the potential to be a great product - lightweight buildable sheer coverage, blends easily, skincare benefits. However, it's not compatible with my oily skin so it never fully sets and just enhances my shine. I tried it with a setting powder but since it stays so wet the powder just tends to soak into the product instead of setting it. Based on the other reviews, it seems to be a good product for people with normal/dry skin but I personally wouldn't recommend it for combo/oily skin types. I would prefer this type of product for daily wear but it's so hard to find anything that's compatible with oily skin. I would love to see some brands come out with a mattifying version!

comment:

The only minus I would say is I did request one of their neutral tones and it is warmer than I feel a neutral tone should be, but seeing that it's lightweight once it is blended in it does not appear to be as warm as it looks when you swatch it. It is buildable. It works well with powders. It doesn't look cakey and keeps my aging skin looking youthful.

author: Blythe
headline: Great formula with an imperfect shade range!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This foundation balm really is quite sheer and flattering. Excellent for those of us who want a healthy, natural looking finish. The texture definitely fits the term "balm" almost to the point of being mousse-like. It blends out very well, but manages to even out my complexion and cover any pigment discrepancies. Fortunately, it isn't heavy or cakey the way a lot of solid foundations are! It doesn't cling to my dry patches. 

That said, finding a shade match may prove to be a challenge. IT Cosmetics undertones are not the best. They lean a bit too yellow or peach. Since this product is so sheer, it's easy to get away with it, but it definitely isn't ideal.

author: Kim
headline: A true "do-it-all" product
comment:
I honestly haven't tried anything quite like this. The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Face Balm truly lives up to its name—and then some. From the first application, it melts into the skin and delivers the most natural, healthy glow without feeling heavy, greasy, or overly shiny.

I've tried several IT Cosmetics products before and while they've been good, this one really stands out. The formula is sheer yet smoothing, evens out my complexion just enough, and somehow makes my skin look better the longer I wear it. It's effortless in the best way.

What really sold me is the versatility. I can wear it alone for a fresh, no-makeup look or layer it under makeup and it still plays beautifully—no pilling, no texture issues, just skin-but-better.

This balm has quickly become a go-to and a definite repeat purchase. If you love easy, flattering products that actually do what they promise, this one is absolutely worth trying.

In fact, the makeup looked better after a few hours of wear then  when I first applied it. It's creamy and when applied to your face has a nice cooling effect. Make up layered fairly well on top of it. It dried down to a semi matte finish, but had a hint of moisturized glow. No fragrance. It is a great foundation to wear for daily, on the go use. I would purchase this product.

author: Keisha
headline: IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm: Skincare Formulation
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a creamy, lightweight consistency which absorbs easily onto the skin. The balmy texture is emollient with a smoothness to apply softly onto the skin which gives a natural, blurred finish which evens out the skin tone. IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm indicated this product has 92% Skincare Serum. Prior to application of IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm, I prepared my skin with cleansing, toning and sealing the skin with hydration. Then I applied the Sheer Tint Face Balm with my fingertips in sections and concentrated in the area instead of applying the product all over the face at once. I noticed that it makes a difference to work in sections to ensure that you are slowly building up the product onto your skin for coverage. This formula reminds me of a hybrid cream to powder. It applies like a cream but smoothies out to almost a powdery soft substance onto the skin. In addition the finish has a similarity of a demi-matte on my skin. There are ingredients which assist with anti-aging, softening and smoothing, hydrating and plumping of the skin with a peptide formulation.

The IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm is a sheer to light coverage but it will give an even out appearance on the skin. I really enjoy that it evens out my skin tone and gives a radiant, natural look to my face. This balm enhances my skin with a natural, soft look. During the application, I needed only a small amount for coverage in each section of my face. I pressed the product into my skin in certain places for extra coverage such as areas of my face with dryness. I have normal to dry skin. I do have some dry areas such as T-zone, jaw and chin on my face. If you have any dry skin on certain areas of your face, this balm will attach to those areas of dryness and minimally shows on the skin. It is not as obvious unless you are clearly focusing on the absorbency of the balm of your face. You may need to exfoliate the skin on your face to assist with additional smoothness and reduction of any dry textures on the skin.

The packaging is sustainable and clearly visible for product in glass jar. It has airtight lid which one must make sure to place on fully closed. You will want to be careful with storage of this product especially in a cosmetic bag, pouch or travel, carry on compartments. There is no fragrance detected during application or wear time throughout the day.

Duration of time, I have worn the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm for approximately 10 hours and still looks very nice on my skin. The balm does lightly transfer from the skin onto any facial protective gear such as a mask. I really appreciate a tinted face balm that stays mostly on the skin throughout the day. It means less touch ups and a beautiful finish throughout the day. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is ideal for anyone with normal to dry skin, mature, seeking a smooth, even out skin finish. I think it is a universal face balm for any skin types but the concern for combination, oily may need to reapply this product due to capabilities of transfer. The skin enhancing formulation is great for skincare benefits with anti-aging properties and keeping healthier skin with a beautiful face.
headline_ko: IT 코스메틱 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤: 스킨케어 제형
comment_ko:
나는 솔직한 리뷰를 대가로 이 제품을 받았습니다. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm은 크림 같고 가벼운 질감으로 피부에 쉽게 흡수됩니다. 산뜻한 텍스처가 피부에 부드럽게 발리며 피부에 부드럽게 발리고, 피부톤을 균일하게 만들어주어 자연스럽고 흐릿한 마무리감을 선사합니다. IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm indicated this product has 92% Skincare Serum. IT 코스메틱 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 바르기 전, 클렌징과 토닝, 수분 공급으로 피부를 정돈해주었습니다. 그런 다음 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 얼굴 전체에 한꺼번에 바르기보다는 손끝으로 나누어 부분적으로 집중적으로 발라주었어요. 나는 커버리지를 위해 제품을 피부에 천천히 쌓아 올리기 위해 섹션별로 작업하는 것이 차이를 만든다는 것을 알았습니다. 이 포뮬러는 하이브리드 크림 투 파우더를 생각나게 합니다. 크림처럼 바르지만 피부에 거의 가루처럼 부드러운 물질로 스무딩됩니다. 게다가 마무리감은 내 피부에 딱 맞는 데미매트 느낌이에요. 펩타이드 제형으로 피부의 노화 방지, 부드러움 및 매끄러움, 수분 공급 및 통통을 돕는 성분이 있습니다.

IT Cosmetics의 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤은 투명하고 가벼운 커버력을 제공하지만 피부에 균일한 느낌을 줍니다. 피부톤이 균일해지고 얼굴이 화사하고 자연스러워 보이는 게 정말 마음에 듭니다. 이 밤은 자연스럽고 부드러운 모습으로 피부를 향상시킵니다. 바르는 동안 얼굴의 각 부분을 커버하기 위해 소량만 필요했습니다. 얼굴의 건조함이 심한 부분 등 특정 부위에 제품을 눌러 밀착시켜 커버해주었습니다. I have normal to dry skin. 얼굴에 T존, 턱, 턱 등 건조한 부위가 있어요. 얼굴의 특정 부위에 건조한 피부가 있는 경우, 이 밤은 건조한 부위에 부착되어 피부에 최소한으로 나타납니다. 얼굴 크림의 흡수력에 명확하게 초점을 맞추지 않는 한 이는 그다지 명확하지 않습니다. 피부를 더욱 매끄러워지게 하고 피부의 건조한 질감을 줄이기 위해 얼굴의 각질을 제거해야 할 수도 있습니다.

포장은 지속 가능하며 유리병에 담긴 제품이 명확하게 보입니다. 밀폐형 뚜껑이 있어 완전히 닫혀야 합니다. 특히 화장품 가방, 파우치 또는 여행용 수납칸에 이 제품을 보관할 때 주의하시기 바랍니다. There is no fragrance detected during application or wear time throughout the day.

나는 IT Cosmetics의 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 약 10시간 동안 착용했는데 여전히 피부가 매우 좋아 보입니다. 밤은 피부에서 마스크와 같은 안면 보호 장비로 가볍게 전달됩니다. 나는 하루 종일 피부에 주로 머무르는 착색 된 얼굴 밤을 정말 좋아합니다. 이는 손질이 적고 하루 종일 아름다운 마무리를 의미합니다. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm은 중건성 피부, 성숙 피부, 부드럽고 균일한 피부 마무리를 원하는 모든 사람에게 이상적입니다. 모든 피부 타입에 사용 가능한 보편적인 페이스 밤이라고 생각하지만 복합성, 지성인 경우 전달 능력으로 인해 이 제품을 다시 발라야 할 수도 있습니다. 피부 강화 포뮬러는 노화 방지 효과가 있어 피부 관리 효과가 뛰어나며 아름다운 얼굴과 함께 건강한 피부를 유지해줍니다.

author: Keisha
headline: IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm: Skincare Formulation
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a creamy, lightweight consistency which absorbs easily onto the skin. The balmy texture is emollient with a smoothness to apply softly onto the skin which gives a natural, blurred finish which evens out the skin tone. IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm indicated this product has 92% Skincare Serum. Prior to the application of IT Sheer Tint Face Balm, I prepared my skin with cleansing, toning and sealing my skin with hydration. Then I applied the Sheer Tint Face Balm with my fingertips in sections and concentrated in the area instead of applying the product all over the face at once. I noticed that it makes a difference to work in sections to ensure that you are slowly building up the product onto your skin for coverage. This formula reminds me of a hybrid cream to powder. It applies like a cream but smoothies out to almost a powdery soft substance onto the skin. In addition the finish has a similarity of a demi-matte on my skin. There are ingredients which assists with anti-aging, softening and smoothing, hydrating and plumping of the skin with a peptide formulation.

The IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm is a sheer to light coverage but it will give an even out appearance on the skin. I noticed that it does not conceal any blemishes or marks on the skin. I really enjoy that it evens out my skin tone and gives a radiant, natural look to my face. This balm enhances my skin with a natural, soft look. During the application, I needed only a small amount for coverage in each section of my face. I pressed the product into my skin in certain places for extra coverage such as areas of my face with dryness. I have normal to dry skin. I do have some dry areas such as T-zone, jaw and chin on my face. If you have any dry skin on certain areas of your face, this balm will attach to those areas of dryness and minimally shows on the skin. It is not as obvious unless you are clearly focusing on the absorbency of the balm of your face. You may need to exfoliate the skin on your face to assist with additional smoothness and reduction of any dry textures on the skin. 

The packaging is sustainable and clearly visible for product in glass jar. It has airtight lid which one must make sure to place on fully closed. You will want to be careful with storage of this product especially in a cosmetic bag, pouch or travel, carry on compartments. There is no fragrance detected during application or wear time throughout the day.

Duration of time, I have worn the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for approximately 10 hours and still looks very nice on my skin. The balm does lightly transfer from skin onto any facial protective gear such as a mask. I really appreciate a tinted face balm that stays mostly on the skin throughout the day. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is ideal for anyone with normal to dry skin, mature, seeking a smooth, even out skin finish. I think it is an universal face balm for any skin types but the concern for combination, oily may need to reapply this product due to capabilities of transfer. The skin enhancing formulation is great for skincare benefits with anti-aging properties and keeping healthier skin with a beautiful face.

IT 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 바르기 전, 클렌징과 토닝, 수분 공급으로 피부를 정돈해주었습니다. 그런 다음 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 얼굴 전체에 한꺼번에 바르기보다는 손끝으로 나누어 부분적으로 집중적으로 발라주었어요. 나는 커버리지를 위해 제품을 피부에 천천히 쌓아 올리기 위해 섹션별로 작업하는 것이 차이를 만든다는 것을 알았습니다. 이 포뮬러는 하이브리드 크림 투 파우더를 생각나게 합니다. 크림처럼 바르지만 피부에 거의 가루처럼 부드러운 물질로 스무딩됩니다. 게다가 마무리감은 내 피부에 딱 맞는 데미매트 느낌이에요. 펩타이드 제형으로 피부의 노화 방지, 부드러움 및 매끄러움, 수분 공급 및 플럼핑에 도움을 주는 성분이 있습니다.

IT Cosmetics의 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤은 투명하고 가벼운 커버력을 제공하지만 피부에 균일한 느낌을 줍니다. 나는 그것이 피부의 결점이나 흔적을 숨기지 않는다는 것을 알았습니다. 피부톤이 균일해지고 얼굴이 화사하고 자연스러워 보이는 게 정말 마음에 듭니다. 이 밤은 자연스럽고 부드러운 모습으로 피부를 향상시킵니다. 바르는 동안 얼굴의 각 부분을 커버하기 위해 소량만 필요했습니다. 얼굴의 건조함이 심한 부분 등 특정 부위에 제품을 눌러 밀착시켜 커버해주었습니다. 나는 중건성 피부를 가지고 있습니다. 얼굴에 T존, 턱, 턱 등 건조한 부위가 있어요. 얼굴의 특정 부위에 건조한 피부가 있는 경우, 이 밤은 건조한 부위에 부착되어 피부에 최소한으로 나타납니다. 얼굴 크림의 흡수력에 명확하게 초점을 맞추지 않는 한 이는 그다지 명확하지 않습니다. 피부를 더욱 매끄러워지게 하고 피부의 건조한 질감을 줄이기 위해 얼굴의 각질을 제거해야 할 수도 있습니다. 

포장은 지속 가능하며 유리병에 담긴 제품이 명확하게 보입니다. 밀폐형 뚜껑이 있어 완전히 닫혀 있어야 합니다. 특히 화장품 가방, 파우치 또는 여행용 수납칸에 이 제품을 보관할 때 주의하시기 바랍니다. 하루 종일 적용 또는 착용 시간 동안 향기가 감지되지 않습니다.

나는 IT Cosmetics의 Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm을 약 10시간 동안 착용했는데 여전히 내 피부가 매우 좋아 보입니다. 밤은 피부에서 마스크와 같은 안면 보호 장비로 가볍게 전달됩니다. 나는 하루 종일 피부에 주로 머무르는 착색 된 얼굴 밤을 정말 좋아합니다. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm은 중건성 피부, 성숙 피부, 부드럽고 균일한 피부 마무리를 원하는 모든 사람에게 이상적입니다. 모든 피부 타입에 사용 가능한 보편적인 페이스 밤이라고 생각하지만 복합성, 지성인 경우 전달 능력으로 인해 이 제품을 다시 발라야 할 수도 있습니다. 피부 강화 포뮬러는 노화 방지 효과가 있어 피부 관리 효과가 뛰어나며 아름다운 얼굴과 함께 건강한 피부를 유지해줍니다.
text_for_model: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a creamy, lightweight consistency which absorbs easily onto the skin. The balmy texture is emollient with a smoothness to apply softly onto the skin which gives a natural, blurred finish which evens out the skin tone. IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm indicated this product has 92% Skincare Serum. Prior to the application of IT Sheer Tint Face Balm, I prepared my skin with cleansing, toning and sealing my skin with hydration. Then I applied the Sheer Tint Face Balm with my fingertips in sections and concentrated in the area instead of applying the product all over the face at once. I noticed that it makes a difference to work in sections to ensure that you are slowly building up the product onto your skin for coverage. This formula reminds me of a hybrid cream to powder. It applies like a cream but smoothies out to almost a powdery soft substance onto the skin. In addition the finish has a similarity of a demi-matte on my skin. There are ingredients which assists with anti-aging, softening and smoothing, hydrating and plumping of the skin with a peptide formulation. The IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Face Balm is a sheer to light coverage but it will give an even out appearance on the skin. I noticed that it does not conceal any blemishes or marks on the skin. I really enjoy that it evens out my skin tone and gives a radiant, natural look to my face. This balm enhances my skin with a natural, soft look. During the application, I needed only a small amount for coverage in each section of my face. I pressed the product into my skin in certain places for extra coverage such as areas of my face with dryness. I have normal to dry skin. I do have some dry areas such as T-zone, jaw and chin on my face. If you have any dry skin on certain areas of your face, this balm will attach to those areas of dryness and minimally shows on the skin. It is not as obvious unless you are clearly focusing on the absorbency of the balm of your face. You may need to exfoliate the skin on your face to assist with additional smoothness and reduction of any dry textures on the skin. The packaging is sustainable and clearly visible for product in glass jar. It has airtight lid which one must make sure to place on fully closed. You will want to be careful with storage of this product especially in a cosmetic bag, pouch or travel, carry on compartments. There is no fragrance detected during application or wear time throughout the day. Duration of time, I have worn the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for approximately 10 hours and still looks very nice on my skin. The balm does lightly transfer from skin onto any facial protective gear such as a mask. I really appreciate a tinted face balm that stays mostly on the skin throughout the day. IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is ideal for anyone with normal to dry skin, mature, seeking a smooth, even out skin finish. I think it is an universal face balm for any skin types but the concern for combination, oily may need to reapply this product due to capabilities of transfer. The skin enhancing formulation is great for skincare benefits with anti-aging properties and keeping healthier skin with a beautiful face.

headline: Great premise, but a total miss for me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was really excited to try this because I love a good makeup-meets-skincare product, but this one just didn't work for me. The formula felt less like a balm and more like a cream-to-liquid sheer foundation with an odd texture that separated easily. Almost like water was added to it.
It did have a nice cooling effect on the skin, but I didn't notice any real skincare benefits. I used Light Neutral 210, and unfortunately it wasn't an exact match. Regardless, it didn't do much for me.
For reference, I'm 49, and I wouldn't recommend this for well-cared for-mature skin unless you already have very even tone and texture. I love the concept and had high hopes, but this one was a miss for me.

headline: Interesting
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tint comes in the form of a solid in a glass jar. It's small enough for travel. I found the shade range limited, but was lucky I chose the correct shade. I'm a light medium neutral, right now I would say I'm a light neutral because it is winter. The shade I chose was Fair Cool 125. My skin prep is very simple, I don't use a ton of skincare nor a primer. My skin type is normal at the moment but sometimes can be combination. author: Ann
headline: Creamy, truly sheer face balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Light Neutral 210 blew my mind!! I was super impressed at the look, feel and overall claims of this face balm. The texture is like creamy butter that literally and I mean Literally melts into your skin -so good. Which in turn makes blending into the skin a dream.  The shade and pigment are pretty spot on so this truly makes it a 'sheer tint' as it claims. I can't speak too much to its skincare claims other then its moisturizing enough to leave the skin looking refreshed and not oily or shiny. 
I really like using this face balm for everyday use when you want to just touch up dark circles or to smooth uneven skin texture or shade. It can be worn for a simple look or a full face. My only complaint as with most mainstream makeup is the ingredients. Id love to see this with cleaner more natural ingredients.

author: Amy
headline: Makes skin look like skin but better
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.  It's thin and kind of melts into my skin, which is exactly what I want.  Many foundations look terrible on my dry skin.

A little goes a long way and spreads evenly with very little effort.  The coverage is light, like almost not there.  It evens things out and just makes my skin look and feel like… skin.  

It doesn't last all day, but that doesn't really matter to me.  My make up doesn't need to last all day and I'd rather it fade naturally than get weird and patchy.

author: Fio
headline: Sheer finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This tinted balm is all I want for the coldest days in the city. I need continuous hydration and nourishment on the skin but I want it to have a nice appearance as well. It's great when I don't want real foundation but still want my skin to look more alive. The coverage is very light, it just softly evens things out instead of hiding everything, which I actually love for a natural look.
It feels also very nourishing, like skincare with a tint. My skin feels comfortable and hydrated all day, not tight or dry. Fine lines look a bit smoother just because my skin looks more plump and fresh. It's perfect for no-makeup makeup days, or when I want my skin to breathe but still look polished.

틴트를 바른 스킨케어처럼 영양감도 아주 풍부해요. 피부가 당기거나 건조하지 않고 하루종일 편안하고 촉촉한 느낌이에요. 피부가 좀 더 통통하고 산뜻해 보이기 때문에 잔주름이 조금 더 매끄러워 보입니다. 메이크업을 하지 않은 날이나 피부가 숨 쉬고 싶지만 여전히 윤기 있는 것처럼 보일 때 딱 맞습니다.

author: Oksana
headline: Good , but not perfect
comment:
The tint face balm is not bad overall, but the effect feels a bit weak. The application is easy and smooth, and the texture is comfortable on the skin. The scent is light and pleasant, which I appreciate.

However, the coverage is quite light — I can still clearly see skin imperfections underneath. In terms of suitability, it works better for those who prefer a very natural look rather than full coverage. The longevity is average; it stays on for a while but doesn't last all day without touch-ups.

Overall, it's a decent product for light use, but not ideal if you're looking to fully hide skin imperfections.

author: Vanessa
headline: Smooth and radiant, but not a true sheer tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
Packaging: weighty glass with a screw top, 0.63 oz/18 g
Formula: solid but is easy to pick up on brush or sponge, or scoop with spatula for finger application. 
Shade: Light Warm LW215
Photos: natural light (mid bright), warm indoor lighting (least bright), cool indoor lighting (brightest
Comparison (top to bottom): IT Cosmetics CC+ in Light (applied and blended), Tinted Balm (applied, blended, and sheered out), Wet n Wild Tinted Hydrator in Fair (applied and blended). Note: the two IT products are too dark for my winter skin, obviously, but would match well with a self-tan.
Review: the solid formula has no discernible scent and is very emollient, almost melting if you rub between fingers and onto your face. I felt it was easiest to apply with a sponge because I prefer a sponge to a brush, but both applications are easy. My skin is dry, but my skincare prep means it's properly moisturized, so I didn't have dry patches to note whether this would stick. The final result is a radiant finish, which is accurate to the product description. The reason I rated it 3 of 5 stars is that it is not truly sheer to my expectation of what a sheer product can be. The coverage is more light (very sheered out) to medium as it completely blocked out the redness from rosacea on my cheeks. Swatches shown in photos compare to the sheerness of the WnW tinted coverage (a popular product to put it in perspective), which is hopefully clear despite the shade differences. The tinted balm shade in Light Warm is nearly identical to the classic IT CC+ in Light (see photos). IT products run yellow in my experience, but to be fair, this shade is called "warm."
It lasted in normal wear for me and didn't lift or break up with toner, serum, and SPF underneath. It is overall good, but I would not consider it sheer, which lowered my rating based on how it's marketed.
comment_ko:
[본 제품은 솔직한 리뷰를 대가로 제공받았습니다.] 
포장: 나사 상단이 있는 무거운 유리, 0.63oz/18g
포뮬러: 단단하지만 브러시나 스펀지로 쉽게 잡을 수 있고, 손가락으로 바르려면 주걱으로 떠서 사용하세요. 
색상: 라이트 웜 LW215
사진: 자연광(중간 밝기), 따뜻한 실내 조명(가장 밝음), 시원한 실내 조명(가장 밝음)
비교(위에서 아래로): IT Cosmetics CC+ in Light(적용 및 블렌드), Tinted Balm(적용, 블렌드 및 시어링), Wet n Wild Tinted Hydrator in Fair(적용 및 블렌드). 참고: IT 제품 두 개는 겨울 피부에 너무 어둡긴 하지만, 셀프 태닝에는 잘 어울릴 것 같아요.
리뷰: 고체 포뮬러는 눈에 띄는 향이 없으며 매우 유연하며 손가락 사이와 얼굴에 문지르면 거의 녹습니다. 저는 브러쉬보다 스펀지를 선호해서 스펀지로 바르는 게 가장 쉽다고 느꼈는데, 둘 다 간편해요. 내 피부는 건조하지만 스킨 케어 준비를 통해 적절하게 수분을 공급 받았으므로 이것이 붙는지 확인할 건조 패치가 없었습니다. 최종 결과는 제품 설명과 정확히 일치하는 빛나는 마감 처리입니다. 제가 별 5개 중 3개로 평가한 이유는 순전한 제품이 무엇인지에 대한 제 기대에 미치지 못하기 때문입니다. 내 뺨의 장미증으로 인한 발적을 완전히 차단했기 때문에 적용 범위는 더 가볍습니다 (매우 투명함)에서 중간 정도입니다. 사진에 표시된 견본은 WnW 틴티드 커버리지(시각적으로 볼 때 인기 있는 제품)의 투명함과 비교되는데, 이는 색상 차이에도 불구하고 선명하기를 바랍니다. Light Warm의 틴티드 밤 셰이드는 Light의 클래식 IT CC+와 거의 동일합니다(사진 참조). 제 경험상 IT 제품은 노란색을 띠는데, 공평하게 말하면 이 색상을 '따뜻함'이라고 부릅니다.
그것은 나에게 정상적인 마모로 지속되었으며 아래에 토너, 세럼 및 SPF가 들어 있거나 부서지지 않았습니다. It is overall good, but I would not consider it sheer, which lowered my rating based on how it's marketed.

headline: Love
comment:
I really love this face balm. It feels more like skincare than makeup and gives my skin a healthy, natural glow without looking heavy or fake. The texture is super smooth and melts right into my skin, evening out my tone while still letting my natural skin show through.

It's perfect for everyday wear or "no-makeup" makeup days. My skin feels hydrated all day, and it never settles into lines or looks cakey. I also love how easy it is to apply — fingers or a brush both work great.

If you want light, sheer coverage that makes your skin look fresh, radiant, and still like you, this is definitely worth trying. I reach for this way more than traditional foundation now.

author: Ruby
headline: Feels so nice!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have mixed feelings about this so far.  I am 47 going through some hard hormonal changes and my skin is not happy about it.  My skin tends to be oily, sensitive, and acne prone most of the time. Now recently it's fairly dry and a vitamin c cream has left me with a dry red irritation.  
This skin tint goes on pretty wet and I felt like it applied better with my It Cosmetics flat foundation brush than with fingers or beauty blender.  I did not notice much of a scent, feels nice on the skin, causes zero irritation,  and dries down to a nice finish.  Almost feels like it's cooling.  There is little to no real coverage but it definitely evened out my skin tone.  It does though sink into my wrinkles and clings to dry patches (I did not use any concealer or primer underneath) I did powder the wrinkles and my tzone.  This would be nice in summer.  Wear time is average for a skin tint on me 6-8hours.  Love the glass jar and should last me awhile.  I received the shade light neutral

author: Tracy
headline: It Cosmetics Do it All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the Bomb!
comment:
I received this product for my honest review and Wow!  This isn't really makeup. It's skincare that happens to make your skin look better.
The It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is 92% skincare serum, and you can feel the difference the moment you apply it. It melts into the skin, feels light and nourishing, and doesn't sit on top like traditional foundation.
Coverage is sheer and forgiving, just enough to even things out, soften redness, and give that healthy, rested look. No heaviness. No creasing. No dry patches showing up by lunchtime.
What I appreciate most is how comfortable it is. You can apply it with your fingers, skip primer, skip powder, and your skin still looks natural and hydrated. It's especially great for dry, sensitive, or mature skin that doesn't love full-coverage makeup anymore.
This is a true "your skin but better" product. If you want something quick, breathable, and skin-first, this is an easy yes.

제가 가장 높이 평가하는 점은 그것이 얼마나 편안하다는 것입니다. 손가락으로 바르고, 프라이머를 건너뛰고, 파우더를 건너뛰어도 피부는 여전히 자연스럽고 촉촉해 보입니다. 더 이상 풀 커버 메이크업을 좋아하지 않는 건조하고 민감한 피부 또는 성숙한 피부에 특히 좋습니다.
이것은 진정한 "피부가 좋아지는" 제품입니다. 빠르고 통기성이 뛰어나며 피부를 최우선으로 생각하는 제품을 원한다면 그렇게 할 수 있습니다.
text_for_model: I received this product for my honest review and Wow! This isn't really makeup. It's skincare that happens to make your skin look better. The It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is 92% skincare serum, and you can feel the difference the moment you apply it. It melts into the skin, feels light and nourishing, and doesn't sit on top like traditional foundation. Coverage is sheer and forgiving, just enough to even things out, soften redness, and give that healthy, rested look. No heaviness. No creasing. No dry patches showing up by lunchtime. What I appreciate most is how comfortable it is. You can apply it with your fingers, skip primer, skip powder, and your skin still looks natural and hydrated. It's especially great for dry, sensitive, or mature skin that doesn't love full-coverage makeup anymore. This is a true "your skin but better" product. If you want something quick, breathable, and skin-first, this is an easy yes.

comment:

comment:
It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer tint Face Balm is such a holy grail for makeup! It's very lightweight, sheer and great coverage. This face balm melts quickly and blends on skin so beautifully. Gives my skin a soft, smooth and natural look. It covers up all the pores and redness on my skin, as well as hides and minimizes the wrinkles and acnes. It doesn't crease or makes my skin feel cakey at all. The skincare ingredients in this product, make my skin feel so healthier and hydrated all day long. You can apply this face balm on your skin easily, using a Brush or fingers. I'm so surprised to see how the shade is so perfectly goes with my skin tone. It doesn't have any artificial scent to it. Also can be removed easily using a makeup wipes or remover. Love the heavy glass packaging, looks very luxurious. I do wish it would have came with an applicator or a sponge with it, which is more hygienic. This is my first time using this brand and I feel extremely happy trying out this product.
This will be a great addition to my everyday go to makeup from now on. Definitely buying more!

headline: Good coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a solid tinted moisturizer/skin tint. It contains skincare beneficial ingredients such as Hyaluronic Acid, peptides and Vitamin E.
It feels comfortable on the skin and is lightweight. It is quite pigmented so it does even skin out well once blended but I found it hard to get a color match and It products tend to look quite orange on me. However if you can work with the color range I think it's a great skincare/makeup hybrid. It's unscented and the packaging is compact.

headline: Hydrating, Radiant, Long Wearing Makeup Results.
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this product complimentary from It Cosmetics and Influencer in exchange for my honest review.
Very nice tinted moisturizer that gives radiant results and is so convenient and easy to apply.
If you are looking for a product that will give your skin a glowing, hydrated appearance with very little effort this is for you.
I easily applied it just like I would my regular moisturizer (with my fingers) and followed with my regular makeup products most of which are powder based (cream concealer being the only exception). I do not wear any foundation, I normally use my sunscreen as my base.
This balm gave me a really nice hint of base color (Fair Cool 125) and worked beautifully with the rest of my makeup products.
My results were long lasting, stay in place makeup wear with hydrated glowing skin.
The texture of this balm feels very lightweight and there is no notable scent.
Highly Recommended!

author: SunnyBunny1177
headline: Winter Skin Savior
comment: I was intrigued by this product when I saw it in-store but was unsure due to the crazy amount of paid-reviews here. I decided to swatch it (found the perfect shade match it's insane) and buy it anyway. Despite being in CA, my skin was already on the leaning-dry side but winter is truly here because my skin has been more dry. It's hard to deal with makeup when it wants to cling to dry patches or feels like all the moisture is sucked out no matter the skincare underneath. However, this product looks soo good. Can build (slightly, still sheer) the coverage more than an actual skintint without feeling like you have a mask. It feels lightweight and my husband even commented on my skin lol. So you can wear this on low-effort, no makeup-makeup days or add in some fuller coverage concealer to small areas and amp up the coverage without sacrificing your skin. I think i will also love this for summer. Also, feels like this product will last a long time and not run out quick like others.

I definitely loved this product and I'll likely repurchase!

author: Carolina
headline: Great for a natural, glowy look, but the texture is quite th
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really like the idea of this product and the natural look it gives to the skin. The coverage is sheer but helps even out the complexion and leaves a healthy, glowy finish. It feels comfortable on the skin once applied and works well for a quick, everyday makeup. However, the texture is very thick and balmy, almost too pasty, which can make it a bit tricky to blend if you use too much product. Using a small amount and warming it up first definitely helps. Overall, it's a good option if you enjoy very natural, skin-like makeup and don't mind a heavier balm texture.

author: Amaris
headline: Going to have to pickup a spare for my purse too!
comment:
I was a bit skeptical when I tried It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. (I used Fair Cool 125)I have very dry skin and foundations tend to look cakey or flaky (or both at the same time.) I have this a shot after thoroughly moisturizing my face in the morning. 

The good? No flakes!! While I originally thought the color wasn't quite a match, after applying, it blended beautifully with my natural skin tone and it filled in my fine lines nicely. It also significantly toned down my rosacea!! Quite a feat for a tinted balm. I am impressed. It felt light while still having good coverage, and feels velvety soft when applying. It didn't take much to get great coverage and lasted all day, which makes this little pot worth the price. 

The bad? I'm really not seeing much bad here. The initial cost could be a factor for some, but the quality if excellent. If you have dry skin I do strongly suggest using a good gel moisturizer first! I also wish it included a SPF. 
This one is a keeper! I'm excited about finally enjoying a smoothed complexion and not having to worry about flakes! [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

headline: Foundation and Moisturizer in One
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] They weren't kidding when they named this product; it really does Do It All. 

I'm usually a liquid foundation user, but this balm has me as a convert. It really does moisturize and made my skin softer. It has collagen peptides and hyaluronic acid, which made my skin look better. And these are hot ingredients right now! 

I love that this is a buildable foundation. Sometimes I need more in some areas, so buildable is a big priority.

It was easy to apply, blend, and build. And I love that it lasts all day and doesn't make me break out or my skin feel very oily.

author: Vanessa
headline: Effective and Quick Foundation and/or Concealer Alternative
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

This product's consistency is somewhere between a concealer and a foundation, as if you mixed the two. I love that it's 92% skincare serum (though serum is a misleading label given the thick and creamy consistency). 

I found my typical serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen were still needed prior to application of this for enough moisturizing so it's not really a one and done skincare and makeup product, at least for me. As with concealer or foundation, primer definitely made it look better, though I wonder how many skin care benefits are possible with all those layers and barriers to reach the skin. 

The color match was pretty close, not quite exact for me, but close enough to work if I didn't have time for my typical makeup routine. If you find a perfect match this would be an amazing product. 

I found that application was very quick using fingers to tap and blend, much faster than my typical makeup routine. I also found that simply using this product, setting powder, blush, and light eye, brow and lip makeup looked nearly as good as my typical routine in a third of the time, so this is fantastic if you're limited on time and looks almost as good. I typically swear by my beauty blender for concealer and foundation application but avoided using it with this product given the thick consistency, which I expect would simply lock into the sponge and be impossible to wash out.  Would definitely highly recommend if there's a shade match for you!
headline_ko: 효과적이고 빠른 파운데이션 및/또는 컨실러 대안
comment_ko:
[본 상품은 제공받아 솔직하게 작성한 리뷰입니다.] 

이 제품의 농도는 컨실러와 파운데이션의 중간쯤으로 마치 두 가지를 섞은 듯한 느낌입니다. 나는 그것이 92% 스킨케어 세럼이라는 점을 좋아합니다(세럼은 두껍고 크리미한 농도를 고려하면 오해의 소지가 있는 라벨이지만). 

나는 충분한 보습을 위해 이 제품을 바르기 전에 일반적인 세럼, 보습제, 자외선 차단제가 여전히 필요하다는 것을 알았기 때문에 적어도 나에게는 실제로 하나의 완성된 스킨케어 및 메이크업 제품이 아닙니다. 컨실러나 파운데이션과 마찬가지로 프라이머도 확실히 피부를 더 좋아 보이게 만들어 주지만, 피부에 닿는 모든 층과 장벽이 얼마나 많은 피부 관리 이점을 얻을 수 있는지 궁금합니다. 

컬러 매치는 꽤 비슷했고 나에게는 정확하지는 않았지만 일반적인 메이크업 루틴을 할 시간이 없었다면 작업할 수 있을 만큼 가까웠습니다. 완벽한 일치를 찾으면 이것은 놀라운 제품이 될 것입니다. 

나는 일반적인 메이크업 루틴보다 손가락을 사용하여 탭하고 블렌딩하는 것이 매우 빠르다는 것을 알았습니다. 나는 또한 단순히 이 제품을 사용하여 세팅 파우더, 블러셔, 밝은 눈, 눈썹 및 입술 메이크업이 3분의 1의 시간 동안 나의 일반적인 루틴과 거의 비슷해 보였다는 것을 알았습니다. 따라서 시간이 제한되어 있고 거의 비슷하게 보이는 경우 이것은 환상적입니다. 나는 일반적으로 컨실러와 파운데이션 적용을 위해 뷰티 블렌더를 사용한다고 맹세하지만 두꺼운 일관성을 고려하여 이 제품과 함께 사용하는 것을 피했습니다. 이는 단순히 스펀지에 고정되어 씻어낼 수 없을 것으로 예상됩니다.  당신에게 맞는 색상이 있다면 강력히 추천해 드립니다!

headline: Healthy glow
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is the perfect hybrid for anyone who wants hydration + a hint of coverage.
• The Vibe: Ultra-dewy and effortless. It feels like a high-end serum but looks like your skin on its best day.
• Best For: "No-makeup" makeup days. It blurs redness and pores without feeling heavy or cakey.
• Keep in Mind: It's very sheer; it won't hide major blemishes, and oily skin types might need a light powder to settle the shine.
Final Word: A must-have for a quick, healthy glow

comment:

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer skin tint is unlike anything I've ever experienced. It's not just a foundation, skincare serum, or skin tint, it can be used for all of those. The only thing that is missing is spf. It acts as a lotion type product at first. Blending into my skin beautifully and evenly. If you're wanting a light coverage this is what you want. I used it as a base after my spf then built on it to achieve the look I wanted. It takes a bit to set because of the deep hydration but setting powder helped. Overall, this is a great product that has many uses.
