author: Mic
headline: A surprise hit, cool texture, impressive coverage
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] What a surprising treat! This face balm turned out to be nothing like I expected, but everything I needed. It appears initially like it would be a thicker, "solid" cream texture. But, it really quickly turns into a soft, very blendable, almost melted texture. Really cool. This balm is lightweight on the skin, very buildable. I would say that cuts light-medium coverage. It doesn't look or feel heavy on the skin. A surprise in that it's like second skin, yet it gives coverage for redness and Imperfections. It blends like a dream, with long wear durability. After 12+ hours of wear, there was zero caking or settling into fine lines. And it removed with any standard makeup removal process, leaving no trace behind. 
I applied this both by hand and with a sponge. I thought I would need to warm up the balm with my fingers, but it "melts" upon contact with the sponge too for easy application. I really love this balm, and it does "do it all". My only concern is that it's in a pot style. So I wonder if it will dry out over time. But, it is an impressive product!

author: Yamamah
headline: Easy and smooth
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I recently tried the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm from IT Cosmetics and really enjoyed the formula. The consistency is smooth and very easy to work with, and application is easy whether you use a brush or your fingers. It blends nicely into the skin without feeling heavy. The shade came out a little darker than I expected, but it actually works great for contouring. I've been using it to add dimension to my face on days when I want lighter, natural-looking makeup. It feels lightweight and comfortable, and you can build it up where you want more definition. Overall, it's a versatile product for simple, everyday looks.

author: Gisselle
headline: Sheer Tint Face Balm
comment:
I received this "Do It All" Sheer Tint Face Balm  as a complimentary for my honest opinion, this is a win for anyone wanting a super quick and easy base. I love it for that "no makeup vibe" because it evens out skin tone without feeling heavy or looking cakey. It's also got some skincare benefits with the oils and butters, so it's like you're moisturizing while adding a bit of color.
If you're looking for serious coverage, this isn't it. It's sheer, as the name suggests. Also, if you you have very oily skin it might be a bit too dewy on its own, but that's easily fixed with a bit of powder.
Overall, it seems like a solid choice if you're into the natural look and want something quick to throw on! It's so easy to remove with makeup remover wipes, or any kind of makeup remover.

저는 이 "Do It All" 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤을 제 솔직한 의견에 대한 보상으로 받았습니다. 이것은 매우 빠르고 쉬운 베이스를 원하는 누구에게나 승리입니다. 무겁거나 칙칙해 보이지 않고 피부톤을 균일하게 만들어주기 때문에 "노메이크업 분위기"를 좋아합니다. 오일과 버터가 함유되어 있어 스킨케어 효과도 있어서 약간의 컬러를 더하면서 보습을 주는 듯한 효과도 있습니다.
진지한 보장을 찾고 있다면 이것이 아닙니다. 이름에서 알 수 있듯이 투명합니다. 또한 지성 피부의 경우 자체적으로 약간 촉촉한 느낌이 들 수 있지만 약간의 파우더로 쉽게 고칠 수 있습니다.

author: Allyson
headline: Beautiful coverage with great skin care
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The It Cosmetics "Do it All" Sheer Tint Face Balm is such a new and unique makeup product! It's high quality facial skincare with a beautiful tint that blends to perfection to give you light, yet buildable coverage, in a shade that is super forgiving.

As you can tell from the pictures, I'm a light to medium shade. I'm 44, so I'm dealing with discoloration, dark spots, redness, uneven tone, large pores in certain areas (hello perimenopause!). I look for base makeup that not only looks good, but it needs to feel good as well!  This product really does it all! A super quick application with clean fingers gave me perfect light coverage in order to look finished and polished to take my daughter to play group. I don't typically have time to apply makeup on playgroup days, but this was so quick and easy to apply! You can layer it with sunscreen, finishing powders, set, but I found it looked beautiful on its own. I paired it with a neutral lip gloss and neutral blush for a fun and quick look.

Unlike most foundation makeup, this is lightweight and you can't even feel it! If you are neurodivergent like me, this may just be the perfect foundation for you. There's no cakey feel, and the finish is absolutely perfect! It's not fully matte, yet not at all shiny like many foundations. I didn't feel like I needed face powder to cover shiny areas.

The only thing I would change is that I wish it had a flip top cap with an applicator. I don't particularly like touching my makeup and an applicator would be an awesome addition. Otherwise, this product is perfect for anyone looking for lightweight makeup coverage that is perfect on its own or paired with your favorite color cosmetics. It's definitely a product I plan to keep on hand because of how great the coverage is for a lightweight foundation and how good it feels on your skin. Nourishing, yet undetectable! This would also be a great product to give a younger person a chance to try a foundation product that looks natural and appropriate for anyone of any age who wants to look a little fancy while taking great care of their skin.
comment_ko:
[본 제품은 솔직한 리뷰를 대가로 제공받았습니다] 잇코스메틱의 '두 잇 올' 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤은 정말 새롭고 독특한 메이크업 제품이에요! 완벽한 블렌딩을 선사하는 아름다운 틴트를 갖춘 고품질 페이셜 스킨케어로, 매우 관대하고 가벼우면서도 지속력 있는 커버력을 제공합니다.

사진에서 알 수 있듯이 저는 밝은색에서 중간색이에요. 저는 44세이므로 변색, 검은 반점, 발적, 고르지 못한 톤, 특정 부위의 큰 모공(안녕 폐경기 주변기!)을 다루고 있습니다. 보기에도 좋고 느낌도 좋아야 하는 베이스 메이크업을 찾아요!  이 제품은 정말 모든 것을 다 해줍니다! 깨끗한 손가락으로 매우 빠르게 적용하면 딸아이를 그룹 놀이에 데리고 갈 수 있을 정도로 마무리되고 광택이 나는 것처럼 보일 수 있도록 완벽한 빛 커버리지를 얻을 수 있었습니다. 평소 플레이그룹 데이에는 메이크업을 할 시간이 없는데, 이건 너무 빠르고 쉽게 메이크업을 할 수 있었어요! 자외선 차단제, 마무리 파우더, 세트와 함께 레이어링할 수 있지만 그 자체만으로도 아름다워 보였습니다. 뉴트럴 립글로스와 뉴트럴 블러셔를 조합해 재미있고 발랄한 룩을 연출했습니다.

대부분의 파운데이션 메이크업과 달리 가벼워서 전혀 느껴지지 않아요! 당신이 나처럼 신경이 다양한 사람이라면 이것이 당신에게 완벽한 기반이 될 수 있습니다. 퍽퍽한 느낌도 없고 마무리감이 정말 완벽해요! 완전히 매트하지는 않지만, 여느 파운데이션처럼 전혀 윤기가 나지 않습니다. 빛나는 부분을 커버하기 위해 페이스 파우더가 필요하다고 느끼지 않았습니다.

내가 바꾸고 싶은 유일한 점은 어플리케이터가 달린 플립 탑 캡이 있었으면 좋겠다는 것입니다. 저는 특히 메이크업을 만지는 것을 좋아하지 않는데 어플리케이터가 있으면 정말 좋을 것 같아요. 그렇지 않으면, 이 제품은 단독으로 완벽하거나 좋아하는 색조 화장품과 짝을 이루는 가벼운 메이크업 커버리지를 찾는 모든 사람에게 적합합니다. 가벼운 파운데이션인데 커버력도 좋고 피부에 닿는 느낌도 좋아서 꼭 소장하고 싶은 제품이에요. 영양이 있으면서도 눈에 띄지 않습니다! 피부를 관리하면서도 조금은 화려해 보이고 싶은 남녀노소 누구에게나 자연스럽고 어울리는 파운데이션을 젊은 층에게 사용해 볼 수 있는 기회를 주기에도 좋은 제품이 될 것입니다.

author: Nicole
headline: Needs better color range
comment: I have mature combination skin. I am usually a true light neutral. I received the light neutral 210 for free in exchange for my honest review. Right away I noticed the color in the pot was much darker than a normal "light." I applied the product with my fingers, as I plan to use this for quick makeup looks when I want to get out the door. The color pulls very orange on me. I would step down one shade, but the next neutral is fair and their lightest shade. I am ghosty, but not that fair. I do wish Benefit would expand their color range. As for coverage, it was exactly as I expected for a sheer tint. I found it to absorb quickly into my skin with all the skincare ingredients. It's light and buildable to a degree. It does not set right away, and I don't care for that feeling. Setting powder helped some but it still felt like lotion on. All in all, I would most likely recommend another tint instead of the Do-It-All Sheer Tint Face Balm until they extend the color selection.

author: Desirae
headline: Best foundation I've used in a long time.
comment: I always have a hard time finding a good foundation for my fair and sensitive skin with rosacea. When I first received the product from influencer I didn't think it would work because of the shade. I was so surprised at how well it blended into my skin. It didn't make me look like a ghost and it wasn't dark. The texture is so smooth and light, it feels like water and so refreshing. I didn't even need powder to set it. I wore it while exposed to water, and although not perfect, it did last a long time. It lasted all day very nicely and didn't flake or clump off, but was so easy to remove with my normal double cleanse routine. I will definitely be purchasing this product again and I do highly recommend this product. After trying numerous foundations and mainly sticking with a skin tint, I've finally found a foundation for my skin!

headline: Light coverage with skincare
comment:
After testing this sheer tint face balm for a couple of weeks, I can honestly say that I love it! I've tried so many different foundations and had given up on finding one that helped even out my skin tone without looking cakey and settling into my pores. I'm in my 40's and have combination skin. 

The balm is easy to apply with clean fingers and is very buildable. I use a light layer and can add a touch more to areas that need more coverage without any issue. 

I like that there are so many awesome skincare ingredients as well. I have noticed that my skin feels softer and more hydrated even after I've washed my face at the end of the day. 

The packaging is simply and sturdy and easy to use. I will absolutely be purchasing this face balm again. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

author: Stephanie
headline: Low effort makeup
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I stared at this face balm for a solid minute trying to figure out how it wanted to be applied. Fingers? Sponge? Moon ritual? I gave up and used a brush. Turns out, that worked just fine.

It went on smoothly, evened things out, and gave me that "my skin but slightly more put together" look. Not full coverage, not magic — just an easy, sheer tint that doesn't feel heavy or greasy.

Once I stopped overthinking it, I actually liked it. This is a good option if you want low effort makeup that doesn't scream I tried too hard.

저는 이 스킨 틴트 밤을 좋아하고 보통 중간 정도의 커버력을 갖고 있습니다. 다른 제품과도 잘 어울립니다. 설정은 선택 사항이었습니다.
text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm very grateful for the opportunity to try out the it cosmetics Do IT ALL skin tint balm. The skin tint balm is a sheer to build able coverage without any sents, it's also pretty quick and easy to use and wear. I am truly amazed by the way that it blended into my skin really well. Like a weightless moisturizer in my perfect complexion shade match. It has a great longevity wear time because it's a sheer complexion product that appears to improve the look of your skins appearance overall. I noticed my skins natural radiance while wearing the product. I'm enjoying it 10/10 would definitely purchase it for backup. I'm in love with this skin tint balm and I'm usually into medium buildable coverage. It works great with other products also. Setting it was optional for me.

author: Rachel
headline: Almost perfect
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] One light layer later this is very sheer and lightweight. Doesn't cover much. However, if I warm another small amount between my fingers and apply the second layer, that's where the difference is. Then it covers (still sheer) but in a natural diffused kind of way. 
It's almost perfect-except it can cling to dry patches and lines if not buffed out enough. A little bit goes a long way though-it's unscented and the shades are super flexible. It lasts for about 6-8 hours and kind of melts in my skin. No major irritation or breakouts noticed. Solid 4.5 stars

거의 완벽합니다. 충분히 버핑하지 않으면 건조한 패치와 라인에 달라붙을 수 있다는 점만 제외하면 됩니다. 약간의 효과는 있지만 무향이며 색상이 매우 유연합니다. 그것은 약 6-8 시간 동안 지속되며 내 피부에서 녹습니다. 큰 자극이나 발진은 발견되지 않았습니다. 솔리드 4.5성급

author: Veronica
headline: First Time Using A Skin Tint That Was A Balm…
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've never tried a sheer face tint balm that has a 92% skincare serum in it as well. I have used skin tints but in a liquid form. This was buttery soft for the texture and light weight on the skin. I used my fingers to apply it on my face and then used a brush to blend it out (which was quite easy to do). The color was a good match this time (Light Neutral 210) and thankfully I didn't have to use color correction!  It has lasted me throughout the day fairly well (I also used a setting powder).  There isn't a residue to me, plus I love the skincare serum being in it.

author: Handbaglove
headline: Fantastic skin tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've never used a base product like this but I'm honestly pleasantly surprised . It was so easy to dip my brush into the pot and apply it. It spreads easily and seems to sink into the skin. It feels like you are applying a light lotion to the skin. It gives light coverage and leaves a very glowy, skin-like finish. It is too glowy to leave unpowered so I always set it with powder. Other products layer well on top and it wears well throughout the day (not as long lasting a matte foundation for very well for tinted balm). I do get some shine breakout towards the end of the day but it can easily be touched up with blotting paper or some powder. I think this product is perfect for someone who wants light coverage, hydration and a glowy finish.

author: Anna
headline: Natural, Flawless, Everyday: IT Cosmetics Tint Face Balm
comment:
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm comes in a sleek and practical round glass compact. I have oily skin, and the creamy texture glides on effortlessly and blends beautifully without feeling heavy. It works as both a tinting cream to even out skin tone and imperfections and a serum that helps firm and nourish the skin. You can apply it with a brush or your fingers — whichever you prefer.

It gives light-to-medium coverage with a natural finish, perfect for everyday "no-makeup" makeup or subtle evening touch-ups. The formula feels comfortable, breathable, and long-lasting, enhancing your skin without masking it.

This is a high-quality product from the trusted L'Oréal brand, and I confidently recommend it to women of all ages. If you're looking for heavy coverage, it might feel a bit sheer, but it's perfect for achieving effortless, natural beauty.

author: bnimc
headline: Natural everyday look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] A great everyday skin tint when you don't want to look like you're wearing makeup but you want to even out any redness or minimize the appearance of blemishes. It's lightweight, comfortable, and not oily or heavy. Sheer coverage gives flexible shade matching, and the finish is very natural and skin-like…not matte or glowy. Packaging is substantial in a glass jar but makes it so that you may need to consider using a brush or makeup spatula to get product out without dirtying unused product. Mild natural scent from the skincare ingredients itself, not fragranced.

author: Daman
headline: It's good if you have good skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint in Light Neutral and it didn't quite work for me. The shade wasn't very neutral on my skin and pulled more orangey-pink than expected, which made it hard to wear on its own. The coverage is also extremely light, so it didn't really even out my skin or cover redness at all. That said, the finish is actually really nice — very natural, skin-like, and comfortable, almost like a lightweight skincare product. It feels good on the skin and doesn't look heavy or cakey. I think this could work well for someone who already has pretty even skin and just wants a hint of tint, but if you're looking for true neutral tones or noticeable coverage, this probably won't be enough.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am very happy I tried this product. It's super lightweight and sheer. I don't feel it sitting on the skin at all. It's unlike any skin tint or color enhancing product I've tried before. A goes a long way. I apply it with a foundation brush and softly blend it across my face. Longevity isn't the best, it starts fading out after being at the office for about 4-5 hours. I recommend it more for in the go (daily use, running errands and going out to grab coffee or casual brunch). The shade I got does run a bit warm on me, so I'll be picking up a more neutral shade next, but overall I'm really impressed.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was gifted the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm by IT Cosmetics in exchange for my honest review. I really like this product! It's very lightweight and comfortable after application. The texture is smooth and almost serum-like…yet its form is solid in the container. It applies very smoothly, and the finish is natural looking. It's a sheer balm, so the coverage is on the lighter side. I've noticed no negative skin reactions, and fragrance is basically nonexistent. For reference, I have mature, combination skin (leaning dry). I've been applying it with my fingertips, and finishing with a beauty blender. I use a lightweight finishing powder afterwards, as I have noticed it collect slightly within my fine forehead lines. author: Beatriz
headline: Perfect glow for skin
comment:
I've been really enjoying this sheer tint face balm from IT Cosmetics. It's perfect for days when I want my skin to look fresh and even without wearing a full foundation. The texture is super lightweight and melts right into the skin, giving a natural, healthy glow rather than a heavy or cakey finish.

I love that it feels more like skincare than makeup — knowing it's 92% skincare serum really shows. My skin feels hydrated and comfortable all day, and it doesn't settle into fine lines. Coverage is sheer but enough to blur redness and even out my complexion for that "no-makeup makeup" look.

This has quickly become my go-to for busy mornings, errands, or casual outings when I want something quick, easy, and skin-friendly. Definitely a win if you like effortless beauty with skincare benefits 💕

author: Tiffany
headline: Perfect for those "no makeup" makeup days
comment: This is the perfect product for that "no makeup" makeup look or if you need to get out of the house quick, but still want to look put together. I find It Cosmetic complexion products tend to run darker,  so the shade fair cool that I picked  matched me perfectly even though I always wear shades from the light lines. The product is sheer at first, but you can absolutely build the coverage up. It blends out so easily whether you are using a brush, sponge, or your fingers. Even with just one layer, it does a great job at evening my skin tone and minimizing the redness in my cheeks. It leaves me with a gorgeous and hydrated glow. Powders and creams applied beautifully over this and my base held up nicely throughout the day. I love that it is primarily created with skincare ingredients that benefit your skin over time. I will definitely continue to use this product on a regular basis.

author: Gabrielle
headline: Really double up on the hydrating moisturizer first!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This reminds me of the L'Oréal age perfect 4 in 1  tinted balm that's been discontinued but that was more hydrating. I have sensitive skin that is rosacea prone and dry, in saying that I look for products that are geared for sensitive skin that pack a ton of moisture and are fragrance free. I was very excited to try out this new IT cosmetics Do it all sheer tint 4 in 1 face balm, now the claims are true it absolutely is a sheer wash of color which I generally like and it's very lightweight but I felt like it was lacking in the hydrating department even though it's packed with Vitamin E, Hyaluronic acid and Collagen peptides. It blended in with ease but clung to some of my dry spots, which I didn't love. It also really stuck onto my fingers as I rubbed it in ( I lotion them constantly it's just freezing and dry outside ), I found that strange. I appreciate the small jar as I can throw it in my bag when I want a little balance in my complexion but without having to do a full face. All in all I think the product has potential but you have to apply it to a fresh moisture surged skin prepped face, go heavy on the moisturizer first if you have dry skin! I was sent this item complimentary in exchange for my honest and unbiased opinion.
headline_ko: 먼저 수분 공급을 두 배로 늘리세요!

Do it all sheer Tint 4 in 1 페이스 밤, 이제 그 주장은 사실입니다. 이것은 제가 일반적으로 좋아하는 쉬어한 색상의 워시이며 매우 가볍지만 비타민 E, 히알루론산 및 콜라겐 펩타이드가 들어 있음에도 불구하고 수분 공급 부서가 부족한 느낌이 들었습니다. 그것은 쉽게 섞였지만 내가 좋아하지 않는 건조한 부분에 달라 붙었습니다. 또한 문지르면서 손가락에 달라붙는 경우가 많았습니다(계속 로션을 바르는데 바깥이 꽁꽁 얼고 건조해졌습니다). 그게 이상하다는 걸 알았습니다. 얼굴 전체를 바르지 않고도 안색의 균형을 조금이라도 맞추고 싶을 때 가방에 넣을 수 있는 작은 병이 고맙습니다. 전체적으로 이 제품은 잠재력이 있다고 생각하지만 산뜻한 수분이 솟아오르는 피부를 준비한 얼굴에 바르고, 건성 피부라면 먼저 보습제를 듬뿍 바르세요! 솔직하고 편견 없는 의견을 대가로 이 제품을 무료로 보냈습니다.
text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This reminds me of the L'Oréal age perfect 4 in 1 tinted balm that's been discontinued but that was more hydrating. I have sensitive skin that is rosacea prone and dry, in saying that I look for products that are geared for sensitive skin that pack a ton of moisture and are fragrance free. I was very excited to try out this new IT cosmetics Do it all sheer tint 4 in 1 face balm, now the claims are true it absolutely is a sheer wash of color which I generally like and it's very lightweight but I felt like it was lacking in the hydrating department even though it's packed with Vitamin E, Hyaluronic acid and Collagen peptides. It blended in with ease but clung to some of my dry spots, which I didn't love. It also really stuck onto my fingers as I rubbed it in ( I lotion them constantly it's just freezing and dry outside ), I found that strange. I appreciate the small jar as I can throw it in my bag when I want a little balance in my complexion but without having to do a full face. All in all I think the product has potential but you have to apply it to a fresh moisture surged skin prepped face, go heavy on the moisturizer first if you have dry skin! I was sent this item complimentary in exchange for my honest and unbiased opinion.

author: Beebs
headline: Really comfortable tinted balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer face balm feels light to the touch and blends in seamlessly. As I get older I want less coverage and more skin care: this fits the bill. On my combination skin, it feels soothing without being greasy. It evens out uneven pigmentation but    won't cover dark sports or melasma. I like the wide opening and tried using a sponge and brush but actually prefer using my fingers. This works nicely over both my mineral and chemical sunscreens.
comment_ko: [본 제품은 솔직한 후기를 대가로 제공받았습니다.] 사용감이 가볍고 끈적임 없이 밀착되는 쉬어 페이스 밤입니다. 나이가 들수록 커버력은 덜하고 피부 관리는 더 많이 하고 싶어요. 이것이 딱 맞습니다. 복합성 피부에는 끈적임 없이 진정되는 느낌이 들더라구요. 고르지 못한 색소 침착을 균일하게 해주지만 어두운 스포츠나 기미는 커버하지 못합니다. 입구가 넓어서 스펀지와 브러시를 사용해 보았지만 실제로는 손가락을 사용하는 것이 더 좋습니다. 이것은 미네랄 및 화학적 자외선 차단제 모두에 잘 작용합니다.

author: Anastasia
headline: Makes my tired skin look healthy
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love it cosmetics face cream and have been using it for years, so I was very excited to try their sheer tinted balm. First things first, the packaging, It comes in a glass jar not plastic has nice weight to it. Even though designed is simple, it looks quality unlike plastic does. The jar opening is kinda small though. My foundation brush has no extra wiggle room and it can get a bit of a mess. This by far is my biggest complaint about this product. Next, the application, It was very easy to apply and blend it on my skin. I used a foundation brush as mentioned before, dipped it directly into the pot and then onto my face. Took me like 10 seconds from start to finish. I have not tried it with a beauty blender yet but see no need since the brush works so well. Anyways, the application is very fast and effortless. Love it. It feels hydrating and cooling when applying. This balm looks very skin like, you can't even tell I wear something yet my skin looks evened out. You can see it on the picture, or can you?! ;) It makes my skin looks healthy and glowy as well but never greasy. Just the right amount of glow. I find, it also makes my dull, tired and frankly, aging (sigh!) skin look fresh. And now that we are in winter and all summer sun glow long gone, I especially need it! It is a sheer balm, so it does not cover blemishes but it makes them look less angry less visible anyway and does not cling to the dry patches. And has no scent btw. 
It does not claim to hide dark circles either, yet it makes a significant difference for me without settling into fine lines, awesome!  I think, It is perfect for when you do not want to wear make up but still want to have more even skin tone, perfect to wear on its own and by itself with nothing else. Perfect for mature skin, it smoothes, hydrates the dry texture, does not settle into fine lines and pores and does not add grease to oily areas. Also, I use both powder and cream blushes and bronzers. Powders goes on top of it diffused not clinging in patches. When I used it with creams, the colors blended easy, melted right into the balm,l which did not lift. Since it is sheer and hydrating, it won't give you 24 hour wear, it's just not the type of product that does it. But it still lasted on me pretty much all day. Some did wore off especially around nose/ mouth area but it wasn't noticeable. There was no visible line and somehow still looked good overall. Overall, I am very happy with this tinted balm. It is a perfect effortless easy every day and day time wear which is what I need most of the time. For evenings and special occasions, I will use something with more coverage. But for every day wear, this is IT! Pun intended.
comment_ko:
[솔직한 리뷰 대가로 이 제품을 받았습니다.] 저는 이 화장품 페이스 크림을 정말 좋아하고 수년 동안 사용해 왔기 때문에 쉬어 틴티드 밤을 사용해보고 매우 기뻤습니다. 먼저, 포장은 플라스틱이 아닌 유리병에 들어있어 무게감이 좋습니다. 디자인은 단순하지만 플라스틱과는 다르게 고급스러워 보입니다. 그런데 항아리 입구가 좀 작네요. 내 파운데이션 브러시에는 흔들림 공간이 없어서 약간 엉망이 될 수 있습니다. 이것이 이 제품에 대한 나의 가장 큰 불만입니다. 다음으로 도포는 피부에 바르고 블렌딩하는 것이 매우 쉬웠습니다. 저는 아까 말씀드렸던 파운데이션 브러쉬를 사용해서 냄비에 직접 담근 뒤 얼굴에 발라줬어요. 처음부터 끝까지 10초 정도 걸렸어요. 아직 뷰티블렌더로 사용해본 적은 없지만 브러쉬 효과가 너무 좋아서 굳이 필요 없을 것 같아요. 어쨌든, 응용 프로그램은 매우 빠르고 쉽습니다. 정말 좋아요. 바르면 수분감과 쿨링감이 느껴져요. 이 밤은 매우 피부처럼 보입니다. 제가 무엇을 입었는지조차 알 수 없을 정도로 피부가 고르게 보입니다. 사진에서 보이시나요, 아니면 보이시나요?! ;) 피부를 건강하고 윤기나게 보이게 해주지만 결코 기름지지 않습니다. Just the right amount of glow. 나는 그것이 또한 나의 칙칙하고 피곤하며 솔직히 노화된 (한숨!) 피부를 신선하게 보이게 만든다는 것을 알았습니다. 그리고 이제 우리는 겨울이고 여름 내내 햇빛이 사라진 지 오래이므로 특히 필요합니다! 순한 밤이라 잡티를 커버해주지는 못하지만 그래도 화사해 보이지 않게 해주고, 마른 패치에도 달라붙지 않아요. 그리고 냄새가 없습니다. 
다크서클을 숨긴다고 주장하지도 않지만 잔주름에 안주하지 않고도 나에게는 상당한 차이를 만들어줍니다. 정말 대단합니다!  메이크업을 하기 싫지만 그래도 피부톤을 좀 더 균일하게 하고 싶을 때, 단독으로 바르기에도 딱 좋고, 다른 것 없이 단독으로 바르기에도 딱인 것 같아요. 성숙한 피부에 적합하며 건조한 피부결을 매끄럽게 하고 수분을 공급하며 잔주름과 모공에 자리잡지 않으며 지성 부위에 기름을 추가하지 않습니다. 또한 저는 파우더와 크림 블러셔, 브론저를 모두 사용합니다. 그 위에 파우더가 뭉치지 않고 분산되어 흩어집니다. 크림과 함께 사용해보니 컬러가 쉽게 블렌딩되고, 밤에 바로 녹으면서 들뜨지 않더군요. 투명하고 수분을 공급하기 때문에 24시간 착용할 수는 없으며, 그렇게 하는 제품 유형이 아닙니다. 그러나 그것은 여전히 ​​하루 종일 나에게 지속되었습니다. 특히 코/입 주변이 일부 벗겨졌으나 눈에 띄지는 않았습니다. 눈에 띄는 라인도 없었고 전체적으로 그래도 괜찮아 보였습니다. 전반적으로, 나는 이 착색 밤에 매우 만족합니다. 그것은 나에게 대부분의 시간을 필요로 하는 완벽하고 손쉬운 매일매일 착용할 수 있는 제품입니다. 저녁이나 특별한 날에는 커버력이 더 좋은 제품을 사용하겠습니다. 하지만 데일리로 입기에는 이게 IT! 말장난 의도.

author: Rania
headline: Awesome
comment:
The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a total win for anyone craving that effortless, glowing "no-makeup makeup" look—especially if you like products that double as skincare. I've been using it daily since it launched, and it lives up to the hype as a 4-in-1 hybrid: tinted balm, hydrating serum, subtle firming treatment, and radiant skin perfector.
The texture is genius—it starts as a solid balm but melts into an ultra-lightweight, serum-like feel that blends seamlessly with fingers or a brush (no patches or streaks). It delivers buildable sheer coverage that evens out tone, blurs fine lines, and gives this natural, plump, dewy glow without ever feeling heavy, greasy, or cakey. author: Courtlandt
headline: Light & hydrating
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This "Do It All" Sheer Tint Face Balm from It Cosmetics is a great product for those who enjoy a lightweight base product with a little coverage but who don't want to wear a lot of makeup. It does build in coverage some if you add a second layer where needed. I find that on my combo skin, this product gets shiny after a few hours on my T-zone (but the product did not break down). I tested it with a sticky primer, and that worked great! It's nice, especially for dry skin or during the cold months to have a product with additional hydration, and my skin responded well to this product. It is unscented, doesn't texturize my skin, and doesn't cause breakouts. I also enjoyed the glass jar packaging. A great product!

author: Carolina
headline: A lightweight, sheer tint balm that evens skin tone, feels c
comment: I really like the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. The coverage is light but effective, helping to even out my skin tone and reduce redness for a natural look. It blends easily into the skin and feels very comfortable, almost like skincare rather than makeup. The finish is smooth and radiant, not greasy, and it adapts well to my skin throughout the day. It has little to no noticeable scent, which I appreciate, especially for sensitive skin. Overall, it's perfect for everyday wear when you want a fresh, effortless finish.

author: Heidi
headline: A Great Sheer Tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm is super lightweight and feels natural. It does exactly what it says, "a sheer tint" meaning that it is not a full coverage product. This is a great option for those days when you do not want to put on a full face of makeup. It doesn't cover imperfections but,  it does blur some of them making them less noticeable. It feels good on the skin, it is not drying,  and it didn't make my face oily even after several hours of wear. It blends easily because it is so light and sheer. I don't have the best skin and I am somewhat self conscious so, I prefer full coverage but, on days that my skin is clearer and I just need something that looks natural and blurs a bit this will be a great option. The packaging was secure, safe, and practical.

author: Jaimee
headline: Great coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm! I would not say it is sheer, however. You can definitely see a difference in the way it covers my skin. I applied it using a foundation brush. Personally I prefer a full coverage foundation, which is why I really like this product. But if you are really hoping for a sheer tinted cream/balm, this may be too much for you. With that said, it doesn't feel heavy to me. It does offer a bit of a glow/shine, if that's your thing. It hasn't separated, caked up, or increased in shininess, which are all pluses! I would buy this product again and again! I think it may replace my usual tinted face SPF (I use SPF moisturizer anyway). I just love the coverage of this face balm and the way it feels on my skin!

author: Michael
headline: Great for skin, but no SPF
comment: I received this product free to try for my honest opinion. When I first applied it, I hadn't really paid attention to what benefits it offered, I just assumed it was a light/medium coverage makeup product that I was being asked to try. I like the way it went on, it felt light like I wasn't wearing anything, yet my face felt soft. Even though I'm quite red and I'm getting to the age where I have lines on my face, I still like to have a more natural look with my makeup. I definitely feel like this checked that box. There's still some of my natural redness and lines visible, but it's not as bad. After looking up the benefits of using this makeup, I was pleasantly surprised by all that it's supposed to help with...however, I really wish it also offered some SPF in with all those skin care benefits. It's something very important to me. So, I will continue to use this, but I'll save it for when I'm out at night. My skin is typically very dry so before applying this I did apply my moisturizer, then later in the evening my T-zone will sometimes get oily or shiny, I do think this helped keep that at bay or at least hidden for the day.

author: Tina
headline: Coverage, but natural looking coverage
comment:
I received the IT Do-It-All Tinted Face Balm free of charge in return for my honest and unbiased review. 

This face balm is very moist, creamy, and smooth. It doesn't have an off-putting scent. It did not leave my face feeling greasy. It dried quickly, but my skin did not feel as if it was tight or suffocating. It evened out my skin tone, but it still looked natural.  It gave my skin a more youthful glow. It didn't settle into my fine lines. It also stayed put for the rest of the day. It did not accentuate my pores, which is fantastic. There is no need to scoop it out or go overboard with the amount you use during application, because it does a great job evening out your skin tone. It is buildable where you need it. This container of IT Do-It-All Tinted Face Balm should last a good amount of time, since you do not need a lot to make your skin look great. I definitely recommend this tinted face balm to family, friends, and the public in general.

author: Meenakshi
headline: Lightweight no makeup makeup looks
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lightweight, hydrating, perfect for everyday use
I really love the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for everyday wear. It's super lightweight and melts into the skin beautifully, giving a natural, healthy glow without looking heavy or cakey. The coverage is sheer but buildable, perfect for evening out skin tone while still looking like skin.
It feels very hydrating and comfortable throughout the day, and I like that it's made with skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid and vitamin E. My skin feels moisturized, not dry or greasy. I usually apply it with my fingers, and it blends effortlessly in seconds.
This is a great option if you don't want a full foundation and prefer a quick, no-makeup makeup look. Ideal for daily use, work, or casual outings. Definitely recommend if you like light coverage with skincare benefits.

It stays dewy and the sheer coverage looks so natural on my skin but yet covers imperfections and discoloration to give a more even looking skin tone. I also like that it's buildable because I have one darker age spot on my cheek and I can use a little more there for more coverage. 

It is going to be my new daily wear makeup for my face not only for the natural, sheer coverage but the moisturizing properties.

author: Heidi
headline: A Great Sheer Tint Balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  This sheer tint balm is super lightweight and feels natural. It does exactly what it says, "a sheer tint" meaning that it is not a full coverage product. This is a great option for those days when you do not want to put on a full face of makeup. It doesn't cover imperfections but,  it does blur some of them making them less noticeable. It feels good on the skin, it is not drying,  and it didn't make my face oily even after several hours of wear. It blends easily because it is so light and sheer. I don't have the best skin and I am somewhat self conscious so, I prefer full coverage but, on days that my skin is clearer and I just need something that looks natural and blurs a bit this will be a great option. The packaging was secure, safe, and practical.

author: Jo Anne
headline: Buildable Coverage Makes this a Winner!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've always wanted to try a tinted moisturizer in place of foundation but have been hesitant because my uneven skin tone requires coverage I didn't think I could get from anything but a heavier foundation or concealer. Enter IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm 92% Skincare Serum in Medium Tan Warm 320. The ingredient list reads like a combo of products I use daily: Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen Peptide, and Vitamin E among others. The balm comes in a small jar with a screw top lid. It's compact enough to keep in a small bag for touch ups. I used my fingers initially but have since switched to a sponge to keep from adding oils from my fingers. The balm is very lightweight. I felt like I used a lot of product to ensure I got enough coverage but my first day using barely made a dent, and now even weeks in of using this multiple times a day, I still have a full jar. It goes on so light but offers buildable coverage so I am able to get the level of coverage that makes my skin look more even. I still use a moisturizer before applying this balm but my skin is very dry and it's winter so I need all the moisture my skin can get! But in the summer, this tint may be plenty on its own. The only downside to the balm is that I don't feel it is long-lasting so I reapply at least once a day. Otherwise, I'm happy with this tinted moisturizer. It hasn't cause any breakouts or irritation and the buildable coverage is exactly what I needed!

author: Jenny
headline: Great sheer, everyday tint!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've been a long time user of IT Cosmetics, and was very excited to try the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. 
Balm sounded a little scary to me, but the product is definitely more creamy, it doesn't have the waxiness that I associate with the term balm. 
I'm used to full coverage products from IT Cosmetics, but this one is more sheer. It's a your skin but better tint. I was able to build it up a bit with a foundation brush and it covered most of my redness although I would probably go back over with concealer to cover the stubborn red spots. I have shade Fair Warm 120 and it was a great shade match. 
I find it has a natural finish, and it feels like skincare vs makeup on the skin. With setting spray it lasted all day!

headline: Buildable balm
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was skeptical of the packaging at first, luckily my brush fit nicely but I can imagine the pot being a nuisance if the brush didn't fit. I dabbed my brush and it picked up quite amount of product. To my surprise it was pretty light medium coverage after one layer and it being labeled as "sheer". I put on about two layers and had almost med-full coverage. It made my skin look pretty smooth but not skin like, and noticeable I had makeup on. Just not as natural as my usual foundation. The color matched my skin pretty well, a hint more orange than my usual color. I do like the pot because it's more compact when traveling. The texture of the balm is a bit thick but easily blends. author: Nadia
headline: If you love makeup that actually feels good for your skin
comment:
IT Cosmetics Do IT All Sheer Tint Face Balm – Light Neutral 210

I've been loving the IT Cosmetics Do IT All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Light Neutral 210. It applies like a lightweight serum and melts right into the skin, giving just a hint of coverage while still letting my natural skin shine through. The finish is fresh and glowy—perfect for that healthy, effortless look.

What I really appreciate is that it feels like skincare first and makeup second. My skin feels hydrated and comfortable all day, not heavy or cakey. This is my go-to for low-key days like the beach, running errands, or even the gym when I want a little something without feeling fully "done up."

If you love makeup that actually feels good for your skin and gives a natural, your-skin-but-better glow, this one's a win.

author: Brooke
headline: My skin but better tint that lasts
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been really impressed with the it Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It goes on like a dream—silky, smooth, and easy to blend out with fingers or a brush. The finish is that perfect "my face but better" glow: a soft, natural radiance without looking greasy or heavy.

It wore well on me all day without caking, settling into lines, or clinging to texture. My skin actually felt soft and comfortable underneath, even after hours of wear. It also layers beautifully with both skincare and other makeup; I've had no issues adding blush, bronzer, or highlighter on top.

The shade I chose was an excellent color match, which helped it disappear into my skin in the best possible way. Overall, this has become an easy, everyday base product for me—quick to apply, forgiving, and flattering.

headline: Yessss

author: Holly
headline: Good coverage and lightweight
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This face balm is creamy and goes on well. I really like the application of it and how it feels on my skin. It's lightweight and gives medium coverage. It does pill up on my skin in certain places. I always wear moisturizer under it. I tried it with primer and without, but it does it both ways. If I our setting powder over it, it does it worse than without. It lasts most of the day on my oily forehead and all day on the rest of my face. It's very simple to remove. I could probably just use water and a wash rag, but I use makeup remover, and it wipes right off. I would recommend this product and hopefully I'll find a way it doesn't pill up on my skin

author: Selena
headline: Effortless Glow
comment: Okay, let's be real—IT Cosmetics' Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is giving me life right now. If you want something light, glowy, and actually hydrating, this is it. It melts into your skin like a dream—no streaks, no cakey mess. I love that it has hyaluronic acid and collagen peptides, so my skin feels nourished, not just "covered." Coverage? It's sheer and buildable, so don't expect to hide all your blemishes, but your skin will look flawless and natural. Perfect for no-makeup makeup days or when you're rushing out the door. Downsides? Shade range could be better, and there's no SPF, so don't skip sunscreen. Overall, it's a hydrating, effortless glow in a stick.

author: bk
headline: Wish There Was More Product For the Price
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was hesitant to try the balm in 120 W since I usually lean more neutral, but I tan easily and use self-tanner, so I took the risk. I'm glad I did. The balm melted seamlessly into my skin and ended up being a surprisingly good color match. The texture is smooth, creamy, and genuinely comfortable to wear.

The packaging is sleek and substantial. The glass jar has a nice weight to it, and the compact screw-top design makes it easy to travel with. My main hesitation is the size. At 0.63 oz, you have to hunt a bit to even find that detail on the Ulta site, and I do wish you got more product for the price. That said, the formula won me over enough that I'm already curious about trying additional shades.

Bottom line
Beautiful texture, easy wear, and a flexible shade match, just wish the jar held a bit more

I have oily skin with large pores and some fine lines, This really emphasizes them especially on my forehead. The neutral shade also pulls warm on me and looks a bit orange. I do like how easily it applies, and right after I set it with powder it looks nice. author: Amy
headline: This balm is the balm!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My first impression when I unboxed the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm was that the shade looked too dark for me. However, once I applied it, it matched my skin tone perfectly. It doesn't come with an applicator, so I use either my fingers or a makeup sponge to apply it. Even though it's a solid balm, it feels soft like butter and melts right into my skin. The texture is lightweight and easy to build.

My skin is usually a bit dull, and this product gives me a vibrant, healthy radiance that makes me look less tired and more refreshed. It's also super hydrating. I usually apply moisturizer before I put on any type of makeup, and I don't need to with this product. 

I have fine lines and I love that this product doesn't settle into them. I also have some hyperpigmentation and it covers those areas nicely. 

I love that this balm doesn't have any unnecessary synthetic fragrance. It is very gentle on my skin and didn't irritate it. Some makeup and skinscare products cause me to break out, but I feel that this product actually improves my skin. 

Overall, this product is certainly in my list of top makeup picks! It's a great value because you get a hydrating, skin-improving, natural looking tint, all-in-one!

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review.  O! M! G!  I Looove this product! The under eye coverage is amazing especially considering how light and melty it is when you apply it! Try it- you won't be disappointed!

"접촉시 녹는 울트라 블렌드 가능한 솔리드 세럼 텍스처"라고 거짓말 탐지기 테스트 결과 그것이 사실로 판명되었습니다! 이것이 얼마나 부드럽고 가벼운지 말할 수 없습니다. 정말 피부가 너무 부드러워지는 느낌이에요! 짧은 테스트 기간으로 인해 장기적인 보습 및 피부 타이트닝에 대해 말할 수는 없지만 앞으로 메이크업 루틴의 필수품으로 이것을 구입할 계획이므로 시간이 말해 줄 것입니다. But in terms of application, it couldn't be smoother and more blurring! 유일한 단점은 내 T존을 지성으로 만든다는 것입니다. 그러나 저는 이 폐경 전후 피부가 그 자체의 마음을 가지고 있으며 이전에 한 번도 직면한 적이 없는 지성 피부와의 힘든 싸움이었다는 것을 명심합니다.  그래서 나는 그것을 이 제품에만 국한시킬 수 없습니다.  프라이머로도 꽤 괜찮은 것 같습니다.  특히 발랐을 때 가볍고 녹는 듯한 발림성을 고려하면 눈 밑 커버력이 굉장해요! 시도해 보세요. 실망하지 않을 것입니다!
text_for_model: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review. O! M! G! I Looove this product! I honestly could have done a shade darker because this blends out so smoothly it's insane! It touts it to be a "tinted moisturizer and foundation balm all in one," and they ain't lying! When they say it's an "ultra-blendable solid-serum texture that melts on contact" the lie detector test determined that was the truth! I can't tell you how smooth and light this goes on. It really makes your skin feel so soft! I can't speak to the long term moisture and skin tightening due to the short testing window, but I definitely plan to purchase this as a staple in my makeup routine for the future, so time will tell. But in terms of application, it couldn't be smoother and more blurring! The only little bit of negative is that it does make my T-zone a little for oily- but I keep in mind that this perimenopause skin of mine has a mind of its own and it's been an uphill battle with oily skin that I've never had to face before. So I can't attribute that solely to this product. It seems to do quite well as a primer as well. The under eye coverage is amazing especially considering how light and melty it is when you apply it! Try it- you won't be disappointed!

author: Lawden
headline: Perfect no makeup makeup look
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was very excited to try this skin tint out since I have loved so many products from It Cosmetics! I tried this out for a few days and the first day was without any primer. I loved how it looked when I first applied it and how silky smooth it made my skin look! Unfortunately it didn't last long and wore off after a few hours. The next day I tried it with primer first and then I added setting powder and spray. I still loved how it looked and it lasted much longer! It still wore off  after little by the end of the day but I do touch my face a lot and I do sweat and have combo skin so I am used to that happening with foundations that aren't full coverage and transfer proof. I think this would be a great option for a no makeup makeup look day or a day at the pool or beach or gym for me. I think it will be great anytime for people with dry skin who like light coverage. I am very happy I tried it and will definitely continue to use on those certain days.

comment:
IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm Shade Light Warm 215 is the perfect shade for me. This sheer tinted balm is easy to apply, blends in nicely, is not greasy and minimized any minor imperfections had.

truly feel that this product does what it is suppose to do.

author: Tina
headline: Perfect coverage!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Cool Ivory, and it's quickly become a go-to for easy, natural makeup days. The texture is smooth and lightweight, blending effortlessly into the skin and giving just the right amount of sheer coverage to even out my complexion without looking heavy. The Cool Ivory shade matches beautifully and leaves a healthy, fresh finish that looks like real skin. I also love that it feels hydrating and comfortable all day, making it perfect for everyday wear when I want something quick, flattering, and low-maintenance. Very impressed with this, it provides just the right amount of coverage I need.

author: Cris
headline: Not for oily skin
comment: I received my sheer tint face balm from IT Cosmetics as a free gift in exchange for my honest review. I received the shade light neutral 210 and it's way too dark. Feel more like a light medium in my opinion. It doesn't show up in pictures, but it's a little "orangey" to me. I thought it would at least even me out since my neck is darker than my face, but it's actually darker than my neck. I applied just sunscreen underneath and on top applied a little concealer to my undereyes, blush, and set it all with powder. It isn't very flattering. It accentuates all my bumps and texture. I will say it was very easy to apply. It's more like a cream and less like a balm. It's very nourishing and dewy. My recommendation is stay away from this if you're very oily like me. Dry skin people will love this, just pick a shade lighter than your usual.

author: Angie
headline: Sheer tint
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] If you want a light, hydrating tint that enhances your natural complexion, this balm is a lovely everyday option. It feels more like skincare than heavy makeup, gives a healthy radiant finish, and is easy to use—even on low-effort days. The light coverage and comfortable texture make it ideal for those who want natural beauty with a boost rather than full foundation coverage. The balm is great for the winter months and it's unscented. I recommend if you're looking for moisture and a light weight tinted option.

headline: Lightweight, blends out so nicely!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am very disappointed because the color i received is not the right color for me. I'm sad because this Tint Face Balm is bomb! It feels so light on the skin, it melts into your skin and blends out beautifully! I was able to make this color work with using a lighter tint product over it which just means that you can layer other products nicely over it! It lasts all day without smudging off, it doesn't have a scent (that I can pickup) and it doesn't hug texture (my skin is very dry this time of year). I would definitely recommend this product and will look into finding the right tone for me in the future.

headline: Flat & Dull
comment: I love IT Cosmetics and I had high hopes for this face balm.  I really don't like the weight or consistency of it.  It's almost like a creamy sand texture and for me, it's too heavy.  When I was younger, I'd have loved everything about it.  It's a dull matte on me and as I'm 52-almost 53, I want something more radiant and luminous.  Just not for me.

author: Yulia
headline: Melts into the skin!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm feels like a balm in the jar, but the moment it touches my face it literally melts into my skin and turns into a thin, weightless veil. It doesn't sit on top like a heavy foundation - there's no "mask" feeling -  just a smooth, comfortable finish. The coverage is sheer but surprisingly effective: it evens out my overall tone and softens redness/unevenness while still letting real skin show through. What I love most is how it seems to adjust and blend into my natural skin tone, so it looks very seamless and natural in daylight. This is the kind of product that makes you look more rested and polished without looking like you're wearing much makeup.

author: Gabby
headline: Easy, Natural Coverage — With One Packaging Flaw
comment:
I've been really enjoying the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in shade 315 (medium cool). It gives light, even coverage with a natural, skin-like finish and feels comfortable all day. It's perfect for quick makeup days when I want my skin to look smoother and more balanced without feeling heavy.

The only downside for me is the packaging. Since it comes in a jar, it's not the most hygienic — brushes can contaminate the product if they're not perfectly clean, and using fingers isn't very practical either. I've been using a small spatula to scoop it out, but I really think this would work much better in a stick format for easier, cleaner application.

author: Sara
headline: Does what it says
comment: I recieved this product for free in exchage for my honest review. I have been enjoying this IT Cosmetics Do It All face tint. The texture is light and creamy with a wet serum like consistency. The coverage is sheer but buildable. I like to wear it on more natural days, where I just want a barely there look. I have also used it as a concealer over my other foundations, which is my favorite way to utilize this product. I have more normal skin leaning a little drier during the winter months. Due to it light coverage and serum consistency it smooth over my pores and give me a very natural look. I would say the only down fall of this product is that it does transfer quite a bit and for that reason doesn't last very long on my skin even setting it with powder. I think it will be really nice though during the summer months and beach days. I have the shade light warm and I tend to lean more light neutral but I can make it work.

author: Rya.
headline: Glow, glow, glow.
comment:
Initially I thought the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm would be getting, at best, 2 stars for effort. Before that first application I watched a tutorial to make sure I gave the product the best chance at working how it's supposed to (as I do with all items I'm sent to test) and that wound up being a huge mistake. This tutorial instructed me to use a brush, and while that may work for some people I found the finish it left to be an oily/caked mess, not at all something I would leave the house wearing.

But then I tried using just my fingers, and it's perfect. When applied correctly this balm leaves a gorgeous and natural finish, truly a "your skin, but better" vibe. You can up the glow, but not the coverage (as seen in the included single freckle coverage test.) so less is more.

The only downside I can think of is that, on the areas of my skin that do have some fine lines, the glowy sheen does draw attention to it a bit - so if your skin is textured in a way you'd rather not highlight this may not be for you.
comment_ko:
처음에는 Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm이 노력에 비해 기껏해야 별 2개를 받을 것이라고 생각했습니다. 첫 번째 응용 프로그램을 사용하기 전에 제품이 예상대로 작동할 수 있는 최고의 기회를 제공했는지 확인하기 위해 튜토리얼을 시청했습니다(테스트를 위해 보낸 모든 항목에 대해 수행하는 것처럼). 결과적으로는 큰 실수가 되었습니다. 이 튜토리얼에서는 브러시를 사용하라고 지시했는데, 어떤 사람들에게는 그것이 효과가 있을 수도 있지만 나는 마무리가 기름지고 굳은 엉망으로 남아 있다는 것을 알았습니다. 집에서 나가고 나갈 만한 것이 전혀 아닙니다.

그런데 손가락만 사용해 봤는데 완벽했어요. 이 밤을 올바르게 바르면 화려하고 자연스러운 마무리가 되어 진정한 "피부가 더 좋아지는" 느낌을 받게 됩니다. 광채를 더할 수는 있지만 커버력은 높을 수 없습니다(포함된 단일 주근깨 커버리지 테스트에서 볼 수 있듯이). 적은 것이 더 좋습니다.

제가 생각할 수 있는 유일한 단점은 잔주름이 있는 피부 부위에 빛나는 광택이 약간 주목을 끈다는 것입니다. 따라서 피부가 강조 표시를 원하지 않는 방식으로 질감이 있는 경우에는 이것이 적합하지 않을 수 있습니다.

author: Cary
headline: Very glowy
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] At first application, this face balm looks really pretty. It goes on smoothly, evens out the skin tone, and gives that fresh, hydrated glow that feels effortless and skin-friendly. The sheer to light coverage is great if you want a natural look and something quick to apply.

However, after about 30 minutes, the shine really starts to come through. What initially looks like a healthy glow quickly turns into an overly shiny finish, especially in areas prone to oil. I found myself wishing it had more oil control or a more satin finish to keep it looking polished throughout the day.

Overall, it's a nice product for short wear or very dry skin types, but if you tend to get oily or want longer-lasting balance, this may require blotting or setting to maintain the look.

[본 상품을 제공받아 솔직하게 작성한 리뷰입니다] 처음 바르면 이 페이스밤이 정말 예뻐요. 부드럽게 발리고, 피부 톤을 고르게 해주고, 피부에 부담 없이 산뜻하고 촉촉한 광채를 선사합니다. 자연스러운 룩을 원하고 빠르게 바르고 싶다면 투명하고 가벼운 커버력이 좋습니다.

그런데 30분 정도 지나면 정말 빛이 나기 시작합니다. 처음에는 건강한 광채처럼 보였지만 특히 기름이 많이 묻은 부위에서는 지나치게 빛나는 마무리로 변합니다. 나는 하루 종일 광택을 유지하기 위해 더 많은 오일 제어 또는 더 많은 새틴 마감 처리가 있었으면 좋겠다는 것을 깨달았습니다.

전반적으로 사용 시간이 짧거나 매우 건조한 피부 타입에게 좋은 제품이지만, 지성 경향이 있거나 오래 지속되는 밸런스를 원하는 경우 모양을 유지하기 위해 블로팅이나 세팅이 필요할 수 있습니다.

author: Priscilla
headline: Love!!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This skin tint is freaking gorgeous!! I typically hate this type of product because of my textured skin and large pores so I stick to liquid foundations. But I'm seriously impressed. This is sheer but buildable and has no scent. It's has a really nice cooling effect when putting on. I used a soft dense brush to put it on and it just melts into my skin. Just for reference I have combo skin with dry cheeks and a very oily t-zone. This skin tint also very glowy but not greasy at all. I set my t-zone with powder and then lightly set the rest of my face so it can last longer on me. Wear time is great. I started to see it wearing off around the 10 hour mark so that's pretty good for this type of product. Also it never settle into my pores! I normally have trouble with that. I think the shade range is also pretty good. The color I got I thought might be a little too yellow but it matched my skin tone perfectly. I think this product is perfect for those cold drier days because it's got skincare in it and is very moisturizing. Very highly recommend.

author: Lauren
headline: Flawless skin and long lasting results!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am so impressed with this tinted face balm!! I got shade Fair Cool 125, and it was a perfect match! It added a nice sun-kissed glow, that made my skin radiant! I think applying with a makeup brush will give the best results. It is very silky, and with the added moisturizer, making sure to get it to spread evenly and in a thin layer, helps prevent it from becoming caked up, or being too heavy. I got a perfect spread, with even coverage, that stayed perfectly moisturized all day! It never felt too heavy, and if anything it just felt natural.  I finally was able to wear it during some warm weather, and even spent time jumping on trampoline. And I am happy to report that it did not sweat off, smear or anything, it just stayed put! All the while allowed my skin to breathe. I applied while my skin was slightly damp, with no other products underneath or added. It really made my skin flawless!!

author: Alina
headline: Natural Radiance and Hydration in One Balm
comment:
I really like IT Cosmetics — their products always impress me. This Sheer Tint Face Balm has a balm-like texture that melts into the skin, feels super lightweight, and is barely noticeable once applied. It's not a foundation and doesn't cover blemishes or unevenness, but it gives the skin an almost sheer, natural glow while providing hydration and skincare benefits thanks to 92% nourishing ingredients like collagen, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin E.
It has no scent and doesn't leave any greasiness on the skin. The packaging is a beautiful, high-quality glass jar with a secure lid.
I use it after my serum, like a moisturizer, and set it with a bit of loose powder on top. My skin looks healthy and glowing all day.

author: KaytS
headline: Looks, feels, and applies beautiful(ly)
comment:
I adore the texture and feel of IT! Cosmetics foundations, and this is completely different but absolutely nails the sheer tint promised- and it feels fantastic on the skin. It's super light, thin, and on first glance I thought the size of the product was small given the price point, but the consistency of it means that a little goes a long way and I can see this lasting me multiple months of applications. I have dryer skin, so I am totally on board with the 92% skincare serum take; it makes my skin look natural, and doesn't leave the obvious dry patches that some similar products do on me. My face feels moisturized while it's on, and it comes right off with my normal cleanser. It smells almost like nothing- just some earthy/light scent that's barely perceptible imo.
It can be applied in layers to cover redness etc if desired. I love this because it covered the red but still let the freckles show.

My only problem, as is with all IT! Cosmetics foundations, it doesn't come quite light enough for my skin- which is an absolute shame because this and their CC creams would be my HG if it did offer pale enough shades.
headline_ko: 보기도 좋고, 느껴지고, 바르는 것도 아름답게(ly)

author: Jackie
headline: Eh...Product is having an identity crisis!
comment:
Eh...To be honest I was really looking forward to testing this product for my honest opinion.

The Good: Nice texture, smooth, silky, not tacky at all. No fragrance. Some skin care ingredients (Vitamin E/HA/Collagen). Did not settle or cake.

The Bad: No longevity. It really is for almost perfect skin to appear fresh for the grocery store/quick outing. It's applied best with clean fingers. My real beef with the product is it's small size and lack of quality skin care ingredients. I pay for less than an ounce for great skincare products all the time. But this isn't great skincare or great makeup. For me it just missed the mark. Either improve the ingredients (sunscreen, vitamin c, ferments, etc) or make it bigger/better coverage like competition.

author: T
headline: Wonderful Texture
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]
 I was really excited to try the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, especially since my mature skin doesn't tolerate heavy makeup very well — it tends to age me fast. I have normal to combination skin, so I'm always looking for lightweight, skin-like products.
First off, I love the packaging. It feels sturdy and luxe, and the balm texture is beautiful. Once warmed up, it melts into the skin easily and blends without much effort. I also appreciate that it's buildable, which is great if you want a little extra coverage in certain areas.
From a distance, my skin looks really nice — smooth with a soft, blurred effect. However, up close, I did notice that it settles and gives a slightly cakey or chalky look, which unfortunately makes my skin look more aged rather than fresh. That part was a bit disappointing for me personally.
Overall, it's a good product at a good price point, and I think it could work well for others, especially if mature skin texture isn't a big concern. For me, it's a bit hit or miss depending on how close you're looking.

This product was received in exchange for my honest review.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am loving the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm!! I prefer a more natural looking makeup. I don't like makeup that is thicker or is full coverage. So this tinted face balm is perfect for me!! It is so lightweight and glides on effortlessly. It blends into my skin really beautifully and gives my skin tone a more polished look. If you prefer a foundation or cream that hides everything, this is not for you. It simply evens things out and makes you look your best but in a more natural way. It lasted throughout the day and didn't have any buildup in places that have more movement. It isn't a very big container, but it will last a long time since you don't need a whole lot. The compactness actually makes it easier to throw in your purse. Overall, loving this IT cosmetics tinted face balm!

author: Alexandra
headline: Great for busy moms who don't need a ton of coverage
comment: As a new mom to a relatively clingy baby, this looked to be exactly what I needed - all my skincare in one plus a tint for my tired eyes and acne-prone skin? Sign me up! I chose the lightest color but it was still a little dark for my fair skin, but not in a bad way - just add bronzer to the endless list of things this does! The coverage wasnt much, as expected of a balm like this, but it was decent enough in a pinch (see before vs after). My oily skin absorbed the product really quickly, which was good and bad - good because it means skincare benefits, bad because it took awhile to spread it all - it isn't the most spreadable formula but it's definitely going to last me! It's the perfect size - since it's a balm, it would probably be long expired before I run out of it, so it's compact enough to travel with easily but not so small that it seems like a joke or a "deluxe sample". Overall I like the product, if I could change it I'd make it have more coverage and be a lot more spreadable, but it leaves my skin dewy without feeling greasy and has okay coverage so that I could apply it with my fingers on the go without worrying about streaking. Overall a great product for a busy mom like me, though it does take longer than expected to apply.
headline_ko: 커버력이 많이 필요하지 않은 바쁜 엄마에게 적합합니다.
comment_ko: 상대적으로 집착하는 아기의 초보 엄마로서 이것이 바로 나에게 필요한 것 같았습니다. 피곤한 눈과 여드름이 나는 피부를 위한 모든 스킨케어와 틴트가 하나로 통합되어 있습니까? 가입하세요! 가장 밝은 색상을 선택했지만 흰 피부에 비해 여전히 약간 어두웠지만 나쁘지는 않았습니다. 이 기능의 끝없는 목록에 브론저를 추가하기만 하면 됩니다! 커버력은 이런 밤에 비해 그리 크지는 않았지만, 살짝 발라도 괜찮았습니다(전후 비교 참고). 내 지성 피부는 제품을 정말 빨리 흡수했는데, 그것은 좋고 나빴습니다. 스킨케어 이점을 의미하기 때문에 좋았고, 모두 바르는 데 시간이 걸렸기 때문에 나빴습니다. 가장 잘 퍼지는 포뮬러는 아니지만 확실히 오래 지속될 것입니다! 완벽한 크기입니다. 밤이기 때문에 다 떨어지기 전에 유효 기간이 오래 걸릴 수 있으므로 쉽게 휴대할 수 있을 만큼 컴팩트하지만 농담이나 "디럭스 샘플"처럼 보일 정도로 작지는 않습니다. 전체적으로 마음에 드는 제품입니다. 바꿔준다면 커버력도 더 좋고 발림성도 훨씬 더 좋겠지만 번들거림 없이 촉촉하게 발리고, 커버력도 괜찮아서 이동 중에도 줄무늬 걱정 없이 손가락으로 바를 수 있을 것 같아요. 저처럼 바쁜 엄마에게는 전반적으로 훌륭한 제품이지만 적용하는 데 예상보다 시간이 오래 걸립니다.

author: Jeanie
headline: Great Multitasking everyday make-up
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I chose the shade light neutral and it is just a little too dark for me right now but will be perfect this summer. This face balm is 92% skincare and it's very moisturizing you definitely do not feel like you have any make up on. This is somewhat buildable but it's not meant to be full coverage. It is a little shiny but in a good glowing way but if you prefer a more matte look you can just use powder to tone it down. 
This is perfect for everyday looks and going to the beach/travel (the size is very compact, perfect for travel) although I don't see any sunscreen in it so don't forget that. 
This does stay on all day and did not settle into my wrinkles. I would probably use a setting spray in the summer but you may not need one. Highly recommend.

author: Christie
headline: I had blending issues
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I was eager to try a tint that has collagen peptide, hyaluronic acid, and Vitamin E. I have been using a tinted moisturizer from a well-known department store brand in a plastic tube, but I like the idea of a more beneficial balm from a glass jar instead. 

First impressions: I chose the best I could, and I had the whole range to choose from. The Light Neutral 210 seemed like a good match via online since I normally like my foundation to be slightly lighter. I thought it was going to blend into my skin, but it did not blend consistently. My hope was just to make my dark spots
less noticeable like my normal tinted moisturizer, which was achieved. 

Initial test (right side of my face): My first test was trying to use it without a moisturizing base since it already has a hydration component. What I noticed was that it blended into my skin in some areas and not in others. When it did not blend in, it was very noticeable, especially my forehead. The picture focusing on my forehead shows the balm not blending into my skin after spending some time blending it in. Notice the pooling on my skin (compared to the left side sans balm). 

Second type of test (left side of my face): So, the next attempt, I added a moisturizer underneath, and the
balm blended better than without the moisturizer. I still spend a good amount of time blending it in. 

Third type of test: I took everything off and put a moisturizer on my entire face. Then, I started from the top of my face, and blended as much into my forehead and then spread the excess elsewhere. This seems to work, but this took some effort. As a person who uses a richer moisturizer twice per day, this shouldn't be an
Issue. 

The Outcome: The balm is lighter than my tinted moisturizer. As soon as I learned how to apply it with a moisturizer first, starting from my forehead down, I am enjoying the result. I don't advise buying this without going into a retail store and having it match to your skin. In fact, the next time I am at a store with a cosmetic representative, I will ask to see which one is actually my shade and then test it in the store to see if
it blends any better. 

Value: This is less expensive than my Department store tinted moisturizer. Even though the jar has only .63
ounces (18 g) of balm, it will last a long time. This has better value if it could blend better.

author: Lacey
headline: Gorgeous no makeup look, just need some lighter shades
comment:
I got this balm in the shade "fair cool," which is the lightest shade they offer. Full disclosure, I am a very pale redhead so it can be challenging to get a product that is light enough, and this falls into that category. In my swatch photo you can see it is quite dark upon initial application. Once rubbed in it does not look as dark, but it is still not light enough for me. It also on the yellow side of things, which is odd for a cool shade.

With all that said, I love everything else about it! It is so easy to apply just with my fingers, it gives me the perfect no-makeup coverage that I love, without settling into fine lines. It is hydrating but not greasy, and has a satin finish bordering on matte but not too matte because my skin looks great in it! 

Overall, I would happily purchase again, just need it in a lighter shade with the correct tone. 

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my review.

author: Lilly
headline: Great formula
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm.  I love a good sling tint that has a little bit of coverage but also feels like skincare and doesn't transfer and last all day, is that too much to ask? Maybe, that said I think I've found my HG in this skin tint.  
The formula feels like a balm/ rich moisturizer to the touch, it applies and blends very easy either with a brush or with your finger tips. It absorbed fairly well into my skin and worked really well over my current spf. That alone is a plus for me because a lot of foundations, skin tints and such won't sit well with with my spf and spf is a must for me. 
This skin  tint blended very easy and looks beautiful. I say it has a light coverage and makes you look like your skin but better. 
I have dry skin and the skin tint gave my skin a very healthy and natural look, it worked well with my cream blush and concealer. I set my makeup with setting spray and that was about it. 
It last fairly well and doesn't transfer much, just the area around my glasses but I say that's normal since I don't like to set my face with powder I expect a little burofax transfer from any skin product I wear. 
The formula feels rich and emollient all while absorbing into the skin and giving me a healthy and plump look to my face. 
At first I thought it would break up easy or just wouldn't hold as long as my go to bb cream but I was wrong.  I tested it for over a week with my normal daily routine and I have to say I truly love it! Oh one more thing, a little bit goes a long way, no need to swirl the brush into the jar to pick up a lot of product and is also buildable so if you want to have a bit more coverage in a specific area just apply the fiat layer, give it a bit to dry and then lightly pat over it to apply more product to achieve a bit of more coverage.

author: Kaci
headline: Perfect for "no makeup" makeup days.
comment:
This face balm really surprised me in the best way. The texture is super velvety and smooth, and it glides onto the skin so smoothly. Once it's on, it settles into a soft matte finish that feels comfortable, not dry, and helps keep shine under control without looking flat or powdery.
The coverage is light and sheer, just enough to even out my skin tone and blur a bit of redness while still looking like skin. It won't cover everything, but that's not what it's meant to do. What I love most is how it feels lightweight, breathable, and easy to wear all day without feeling heavy or cakey. Even with the matte finish, it doesn't cling to texture or settle into lines.
It lasts well for everyday wear and layers nicely with concealer if I want a little extra coverage in certain spots. Overall, it's a great "throw it on and go" product for when I want my skin to look naturally polished with a velvety, matte feel.

author: Joni
headline: Great light weight foundation
comment:
I have been really impressed with this sheer tint face balm and have been reaching for it almost daily. The texture is smooth and balmy without feeling heavy or greasy, and it melts into the skin beautifully. It blended effortlessly with both my fingers and a sponge, leaving no streaks or patchiness. The coverage is light, which I personally love. It evens out my skin tone and softens redness without looking like makeup, making it perfect for a natural everyday look.

One of the biggest highlights for me is how well it lasted throughout the day. I applied it in the morning and it still looked fresh hours later with no settling into fine lines or breaking apart. My skin stayed comfortable and hydrated, which is impressive for a product that feels so lightweight. It truly feels more like skincare than makeup, and my skin looked healthy and glowy rather than flat.

I was also pleasantly surprised by how much product comes in the container. It is filled to the brim, which makes it feel like a great value for the price. A little goes a long way, so I know this will last me quite a while. Overall, this is a fantastic option for anyone who wants light coverage, easy application, and long lasting wear. It is ideal for no makeup makeup days and for those who want their skin to look like skin, just better.

저는 이 투명한 틴트 페이스 밤에 정말 감동받았고 거의 매일 사용하고 있습니다. 무겁거나 기름진 느낌 없이 부드럽고 상쾌한 질감이 피부에 아름답게 녹아듭니다. 손가락과 스펀지로 자연스럽게 블렌딩되어 줄무늬나 뭉침 현상이 남지 않았습니다. 커버력이 은은해서 개인적으로 맘에 들어요. 메이크업을 하지 않고도 피부톤을 균일하게 정돈하고 붉은기를 완화시켜 자연스러운 데일리룩으로 연출하기 딱 좋아요.

comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's a thin balm with light foundation coverage. I love the coverage, a no makeup makeup must.

Even tho this is a balm
It clung to my dry patches, which is a bummer. 

Initially I was horrified when it highlighted my pores but after going over it with my fingers, it melted better into my skin. 

Besides it clinging to dry patches, my other bummer was the tone, I selected a neutral under tone and yet it turned out very very orange. I would recommend going down a shade to counteract that. 

Overall I would recommend if you like the no makeup look and to try it out in store for a better shade match.

comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
I really wanted to love this one 

First off — the packaging is adorable. A thick glass jar, heavy, luxe, and packed with product. Definitely gives "high-end skincare-meets-makeup" vibes.

After trying every application method imaginable, I finally cracked the code finger tapping ONLY. If you rub it in… it literally disappears. Gone. Vanished. 

At this point I'm thinking, okay what's not to love?

Well… here's where it lost me a bit. The product transfers — a lot. Even after letting it sit for 20 minutes, it was still transferable.

I did a full side-by-side test — forehead fine lines, freckles, the whole shabang 
✔️ Coverage was actually really nice if your going for natural definitely not full

✔️ Didn't make fine lines look worse
❌Transfer Proof

So overall? It's pretty, lightweight, and natural — but the transfer issue keeps it from being a holy grail for me.

Ill be replenishing my supply as soon as im done with this jar!

author: Britany
headline: Great, Innovative Face Balm!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have really been enjoying using the It Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. I chose the shade Fair Cool 125. I have mature, combination skin. The shade matched my skin perfectly. It applies beautifully and doesn't settle into fine lines or wrinkles. It feels very lightweight yet hides all your imperfections while moisturizing the skin. It's not buildable—layering doesn't add coverage—but it looks very natural. Applying with my fingers worked best as brushes seemed to waste product. I also set it with a small amount of loose powder. I didn't experience any pilling, and it wore well throughout the day. I really appreciate this balm because it acts as skincare and foundation together. Plus, there is little to no scent, so it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, and it removes just as easily as it applies. I love the glass packaging; it feels elevated and well-made. The formula contains 92% skincare ingredients, including Hyaluronic Acid, collagen peptides, and Vitamin E. Overall, this is an easy, everyday "no-makeup makeup" option if you don't have much to cover. I would recommend and repurchase this.

author: Linda
headline: A Whisper in Tint
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review As someone with aging skin, I'm always on the lookout for a face tint that feels light yet gives me a bit of coverage. The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm definitely delivers on the sensory experience , applying it feels like tiny droplets of rain landing on your skin.  I didn't really like the skin feeling wet but the texture is refreshing, and the adorable little pot makes it easy to toss into a bag without taking up space. I also love the subtle scent, which adds a nice touch without being overwhelming.  Application is simple, you can use your fingers or a brush. I prefer starting with my fingers and then blending with a cream brush for a more even finish. The formula is very sheer , almost too sheer for my taste. I picked up the shade Warm Natural, which usually matches my skin tone well, but the tint here is extremely light. If you're looking for noticeable coverage or a thicker consistency, this may not be the best match.  While I appreciate the chance to try it, I'm not entirely sure I'd purchase it again. It's lovely in feel and packaging, but I personally prefer a tint with more coverage and a bit more substance.
