author: Kristina
headline: this is a great multitasking product for a natural
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm and I really love how easy and natural it is. The application is effortless - it glides smoothly over the skin and blends quickly with fingers or a sponge, with no streaks or patchiness. It's perfect for quick, everyday makeup.

The packaging is compact and practical. I like that it's sturdy and travel-friendly, and the product inside feels well protected. It's easy to throw into a bag without worrying about mess.

There is little to no scent, which I really appreciate. It doesn't irritate my skin at all and feels comfortable even on sensitive days.

The effect is exactly what I want from a sheer tint. It evens out my skin tone, softens redness, and gives a healthy, natural-looking finish without feeling heavy or cakey. My skin still looks like skin, just more polished.

In terms of wear, it holds up very well throughout the day. It stays comfortable, doesn't settle into fine lines, and fades evenly without breaking apart. Overall, this is a great multitasking product for a natural, fresh look, and I would definitely repurchase it.

author: Autumn
headline: Everything and more
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am obsessed! This sheer tint face balm is beyond amazing. A beautiful color match that was so simple to apply. It leaves a nice silky satin finish. Zero scent or irritation to my dry sensitive skin. From what I understand skincare and makeup with built in skin care is going to take the lead in trends for this end of the 20s. This wears like a dream. Not full coverage but instantly evens out skin tone letting the skin peak through while leaving a natural healthy glow. It removes as easily as it blends revealing healthy skin underneath. I'll be reaching for this for my everyday look. Perfect for dry and/mature skin as it didn't settle into line or crease. Such a cool concept for skin coverage. I highly recommend it. Find your shade and try it out. I literally have nothing but love for this skin tint!

author: Angel
headline: Love it
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Texture and Finish: Many reviewers commented on the unique texture of the product, describing it as mousse-like but lightweight, melting easily into the skin and providing a dewy, naturally radiant finish. This product does not cake and effectively evens out skin longevity tone .
Coverage: Despite the name "sheer," the coverage is described as light to medium and buildable, sufficient to cover redness from rosacea or other imperfections.
Skincare Benefits: The formula contains 92% skincare ingredients, including Hyaluronic Acid, collagen peptides, and Vitamin E, providing 24-hour hydration, firmer skin, and reduced appearance of wrinkles, according to consumer studies.

author: Destiny
headline: A Light Balm Foundation
comment: This balm foundation was a very interesting concept. I used the faintest neutral 110 shade. It goes on creamy like a balm that keeps your face nice and moisturized but also works as a light foundation. It is really a light colored balm but it did blend into my skin so some of my imperfections were hidden while moisturizing my face. I don't wear foundation sometimes so this is a nice alternative to give my skin a little extra something without applying heavy makeup. It left my face with a velvet feeling! The picture shows the bottom part of my face using the balm and the top without it. There is definitely a difference. I received this for free for my honest review. I highly recommend!

author: Amy
headline: The best product for every day natural healthy skin look
comment:
The @IT Cosmetics #DoItAllSheerTintFaceBalm was sent to me , in exchange for my honest true review. 
This product was wonderfully created and prepared for us that have been seeking out , that truly healthy lightweight glow , without all the unnecessary and heavy products. That clog and unpureify our pores . It feels so light on the face , goes on so easily with just your fingers and the the healthy skincare ingredients goes in so smoothly and cleanly absorbed.  It leaves a beautiful blurred glow behind. Without the extras just a little touch of tint. It also builds up so nicely and evenly. It doesn't even carry a scent. Perfect for that no makeup looked or if you don't wear foundation. But needing something to create a canvas for your makeup. I found the product works best with no primer at all . Just a little makeup. I am excited to experiment with it. I want to see all the looks I can create. And this also has something I'm loving is it easily cleanse with a face wipe then a quick wash . This is something I have been wanting to be created . And so glad that @IT cosmetics has it now. I myself have not seen something like it before. I definitely recommend the @IT cosmetics #DoItAll Sheer Face Balm . 
Thank you @IT Cosmetics and @Influenster #FaceBalm ##SheerTint

author: Libby
headline: Great coverage
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. IT Cosmetics CC cream has been a favorite for years so I felt confident and excited to try the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm because I trust IT Cosmetics to offer a great buildable coverage that allows me to shift between my everyday no makeup make up look to looking polished and photo ready for special occasions. Once again, IT developed a product that does just that and of course sneaks in some skin care. I applied the balm with a brush and it beautifully melted into my skin. I went for a light look but tested the buildable coverage on my arm and it covered by sun damage easily. I also liked that this balm wore well throughout the day. I had no need to reapply.  I think I may have found a new favorite!

author: Nhi
headline: Fresh faced
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been really enjoying using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm as my everyday base. It really feels like one of the skincare products in here with 92 percent skincare ingredients like hyaluronic acid, collagen peptide, and vitamin E, so I get to enjoy the skin benefits of being hydrated and plumped as I go about my day. It comes as a solid serum but turns to liquid in the skin, with just the mere touch of the fingertips.
The coverage is just sheer but buildable, creating a smooth, radiant finish for my skin without making it heavy or greasy. The product balances my skin tone, blurs my fine lines, and ensures my skin stays moisturized throughout the day. Indeed, this is one of the best products to use if I want to go natural when I want my skin to look healthy and glowing, not covered up. Highly recommend!

author: Dharti
headline: Blends really well into the skin
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried the balm in Light Medium Warm 225 shade and was impressed with how my skin looked, healthy and even without any additional make up. The balm melts effortlessly into my skin and gives light, sheer coverage that softens uneven tone while still letting my natural skin show through. The shade blends in nicely with my warm undertones and doesn't look heavy or mask-like. author: Kristen
headline: Nice lightweight skin tint
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I do really enjoy this skin tint. For reference, since there are pictures, I got the shade "fair cool." I feel like the color match is great for me. This balm blends easily into the skin and creates a seamless look.
 I'm not someone who usually wears a full coverage foundation, so this is perfect to just even out my skin tone. If I do have any redness or spots that need extra covering, i find it's easy to just get a little extra and cover what needs covering. have used a brush to apply this, and i think that method works great. I hate having stuff on my hands. So, rather than having to go wash my hands after I apply this, i think it's way easier to use a brush. Plus, I found the coverage to be really good and what I wanted with the brush, so there is no need to try another method when the brush works great. 
After you first apply this, you definitely can still feel it on your skin for the first five or so minutes, kind of like a serum/slick feel. But the balm does sink in, and I did not find a need to apply powder. I don't like powering my whole face since my skin is on the dry side powder can make it look/feel dryer. My skin did feel nice throughout the day using this product. I didn't notice any dryness or uncomfortable feeling when I wore the skin tint. 
This does include a lot of skincare ingredients, which is great. I do have a dedicated skincare regimen which includes some of the ingredients in the skin tint (hyaluronic acid, etc.) So I don't imagine this product would make huge improvements in my skin versus what I already do. But if you were someone who didn't use much skincare, I could see it possibly improving your skin.
 Overall, i think this is a nice product. It could even be a one and done on days when you don't feel like doing your skincare. Well, almost, there's no sunscreen in here, so please add that. But this is a great lightweight skin tint, lots of good ingredients, and nice light buildable coverage. I like it a lot.
comment_ko:
[본 제품은 솔직한 리뷰로 대가로 제공되었습니다.] 이 스킨 틴트는 정말 마음에 듭니다. 참고로 사진이 있어서 "그냥 멋있다"라는 색상이 나왔네요. 컬러 매치가 저한테는 참 잘 어울리는 것 같아요. 이 밤은 피부에 쉽게 스며들어 매끄러운 룩을 연출합니다.
 평소 풀커버 파운데이션을 바르는 편이 아닌데, 피부톤을 균일하게 정돈하는데 딱이네요. 추가 커버가 필요한 발적이나 반점이 있는 경우 약간의 추가 커버가 필요한 부분을 덮는 것이 쉽다는 것을 알았습니다. 이것을 적용하기 위해 브러시를 사용했는데 이 방법이 효과가 좋다고 생각합니다. 나는 손에 물건을 쥐는 것을 싫어한다. 그래서 바르고 손을 씻으러 가는 것보다 브러쉬를 사용하는 것이 훨씬 편한 것 같아요. 게다가 커버력도 정말 좋고 제가 원하는 브러쉬도 있어서 브러쉬가 잘 나오면 굳이 다른 방법을 쓸 필요가 없더라고요. 
After you first apply this, you definitely can still feel it on your skin for the first five or so minutes, kind of like a serum/slick feel. 하지만 밤이 스며들어서 파우더를 바를 필요는 없었습니다. 나는 피부가 건조한 부분에 있기 때문에 얼굴 전체에 힘을 가하는 것을 좋아하지 않습니다. 파우더로 인해 건조해 보이거나 느껴질 수 있습니다. 이 제품을 사용하면서 하루종일 피부가 좋아졌어요. 스킨틴트를 발랐을 때 건조함이나 불편한 느낌은 없었어요. 
여기에는 많은 스킨 케어 성분이 포함되어 있습니다. 나는 피부 색조의 일부 성분(히알루론산 등)을 포함하는 전용 스킨케어 요법을 가지고 있습니다. 따라서 이 제품이 내가 이미 사용하고 있는 제품에 비해 내 피부를 크게 개선할 것이라고는 상상하지 않습니다. 하지만 스킨케어를 많이 사용하지 않는 사람이라면 피부가 좋아질 수도 있겠다는 생각이 들었어요.
 전반적으로 이 제품은 좋은 제품이라고 생각합니다. 스킨케어를 하고 싶지 않은 날에도 한번 해볼 수도 있습니다. 글쎄요, 여기는 자외선 차단제가 거의 없으니 추가해 주세요. 그러나 이것은 매우 가벼운 피부 색조이며, 좋은 성분이 많이 함유되어 있으며, 가볍고 빌드 가능한 커버력이 좋습니다. 나는 그것을 많이 좋아한다.

author: Marium
headline: Balm
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 
This is one of those products I reach for when I want my skin to look healthy without feeling like I'm wearing makeup. The balm texture feels rich at first, but it melts instantly into the skin and becomes lightweight once blended. It doesn't sit on top or feel greasy, which surprised me for a balm formula.

The coverage is very sheer and natural. It doesn't hide imperfections completely, but it softens redness and evens out my skin tone just enough to give that "your skin but better" look. I love this for casual days or when I want a fresh, minimal base that still looks polished.

What really stands out is the finish. It gives a smooth, hydrated glow that makes my skin look plump and comfortable throughout the day. My skin never feels tight or dry while wearing it, and it layers well with concealer and cream products without breaking apart.

This isn't for full coverage lovers, but if you enjoy lightweight, skin-focused makeup that blurs the line between skincare and makeup, this balm does exactly what it promises. It's easy, effortless, and perfect for everyday wear when you want your skin to breathe while still looking put together.

author: Amy
headline: Does not settle in fine lines and wrinkles
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] 

As a beauty enthusiast, I'm always on the lookout for products that multitask and deliver. This face balm is a gem. It's a lightweight, hydrating balm that provides sheer coverage, perfect for those days when you want to look like yourself, just a little bit polished.
The formula is creamy and blendable, and it melts into the skin, leaving a healthy, radiant glow. I love that it's packed with nourishing ingredients like hyaluronic acid and antioxidants, which help to hydrate and protect the skin.
I've been using this balm as a primer, moisturizer, and tinted balm all in one, and it's been a game-changer. The coverage is perfect for everyday wear - it's enough to even out my skin tone, but still looks natural.
One of the things that sets IT Cosmetics apart is their commitment to creating products that are good for the skin, not just good for looks. The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is no exception, and I appreciate that it's free from harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances.
Overall, I'm a big fan of the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It's a versatile product that I reach for again and  again.

author: Maria
headline: Good But Dark On Me
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]

This product has a soft, buttery feel upon application, it glides easily on my face. It's infused with skin care so it's supposed to make your skin look and feel better over time. I like that it's light weight and it gives a radiant finish. However, since the shade Tan Warm is darker on me, I had to set it with a white setting powder to balance the color. I made it work but it also made my makeup cakey even after applying setting spray. I'll try this again in Summer. I think this is better if you don't set it too much, it would give you a radiant dewy finish which I prefer my makeup to be.

author: Steph
headline: It really does it all!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Balm in exchange for my opinion, but I have been considering getting a product like this for a month. I actually love using the IT cosmetics CC cream because they provide a sheer yet beautiful coverage that feels lightweight and natural to your skin. And I must say this product is even better! I am so excited to have tried this because I will definitely purchase this come this summer when I'm looking for a lightweight option and a subtle glow. The product comes in a simple round container which I found a perfect size for dipping my blending brush in. It is extremely creamy and hydrating and feels more like a skin treatment than a makeup. It blends so wonderfully into the skin and gives surprising amount of coverage for how sheer it actually is. I tried this just using my fingers and applying like a sunscreen and just rubbed it into my skin and it was fantastic for just a little bit of coverage. I also tried using it with a beauty blender and a brush and layering it for better coverage. It is truly one of those products you can build and create custom finishes with. Some product claim to be buildable, but they still cake on the skin, which makes you look like you're wearing make up.  This however even as I found that I was adding more and more, it still maintained a soft dewy finish. This product also claims to have skin improving benefits which I absolutely adore. Why not improve your skin while you're wearing make up? I definitely would recommend this because it's extremely versatile and does not clog pores or settle into fine line. Also this brand is cruelty free which is an absolute must for me. They've totally won me over with this test and I'll be getting this product this summer.

author: Katisa
headline: Your skin, but with a healthier glow
comment: What truly sets this product apart is its practicality and lightweight feel. It instantly revives dull skin, giving it a much more supple and revitalized appearance. Unlike other tinted products that can accentuate dry patches, this balm glides on like a moisturizer, making it the perfect "emergency" product to keep in your bag and reapply without worrying about it looking heavy. It's a fantastic option for those who prioritize skin barrier health, because although its ability to conceal blemishes is minimal, its blurring effect and satin finish make the skin look flawless in a very natural and effortless way.

author: D
headline: Lightweight with a beautiful, natural finish
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used the IT Cosmetics CC cream for years. It's great, but it can be a little too full-coverage. This balm has just enough coverage to even out skin tone, but it feels like nothing on the skin. It's like a tinted moisturizer with a little more oomph in the color. Since it's a balm, you only need the tiniest amount so it doesn't have the tackiness a moisturizer formula can sometimes have. It's so lightweight, it doesn't build up in pores or fine lines. There's no noticeable scent unless you really put your nose right over the container, then it has kind of a medicinal scent. I prefer unscented foundations, so this is great. 
I applied this with the same IT cosmetics foundation brush I use for the cc cream. I just tapped it in the pot and it blended out flawlessly. You can build it up a little, but it's perfect for light coverage. I had to apply it three times on my hand to build it up enough for a noticeable swatch. I usually get Fair-Light in the CC cream, and I got Fair Cool in the balm. I was concerned it may be too light, but there's a lot of flexibility in the shade since it's more sheer. I was able to apply both a cream contour and a powder blush over the top without pulling up the balm at all. It leaves a beautiful, natural finish.

author: DrKay
headline: Sheer blurring coverage with gorgeous feel AND serum benefit
comment:
I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review. Of note, it is light warm and I am a fair neutral, so slight yellowy look where my skin sags a bit, but with how sheer, still workable, great for my dark circles, and probably for summer!

Overall, I love it. It is VERY sheer, but blurring. It has a tiny amount of glitter in it which I am not a fan of, yet has a very light natural finish/feel. If you have very dry skin, it may stick to patches more, but only an issue if you don't moisturize first or isn't shade matched, and with its serum benefits will likely help resolve them. It did not feel greasy or oxidize through the day, and my sensitive skin has not broken out!

I will be purchasing in a better winter shade as I just love how it feels on my skin, that it offers actual skincare benefits, and gives a no effort no makeup look with gentle tone evening which I need. 

It Cosmetica is also known for using sensitive-friendly ingredients and natural mineral colorants, so I can trust my sensitive skin to the brand. Absolutely recommend.

author: Amanda
headline: Definitely a staple for me now
comment:
I've been using the IT Cosmetics Do It All Balm for several days now and I'm honestly impressed. It's one of those products that actually lives up to the "multi-use" claim.

The texture is super creamy and melts into the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. I use it mostly on dry areas, cuticles, lips, and even lightly under my eyes when my skin feels tight — especially on trentinoin nights when everything feels extra dry. It gives instant comfort and makes my skin look healthier right away. The coverage is great and it's easy to wash away. 

What I love most is that it doesn't just sit on top of the skin. It actually absorbs and leaves my skin soft and hydrated for hours. A little goes a long way, and it layers well over skincare without pilling.

Perfect to keep in your bag for dry winter skin, post-handwashing dryness, or anytime your skin needs a quick refresh. The packaging is perfect for on the go! Definitely a staple for me now.

author: CC
headline: Would repurchase!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] So, you will receive this product and you will notice it is in a glass jar that feels nice and easy to open.  When you first open the lid, some oxidation of color may be apparent, but that disappears after first use.  My first swatch the color seems a bit off, though I suspect it is anyway because I did not go into store to color match which I think is the consumers responsibility, however, the brand should be held accountable to getting the undertones correct!  I have had some from other purchases that were way off.  This is not the case here.  I have light-OLIVE- Neutral skin tone and usually purchase neutral shades because my skin tone is typically impossible to match due to the olive.  I will say this light neutral shade in this sheer tint face balm is pretty close.  Now, outside of the shade, the product feels sooooo silky, but not greasy.  I do not typically use powder over my base because I have pretty dry skin, and so far I have no creases, and it feels amazing on my skin!  I set it with a bit of setting spray, and it has lasted pretty well throughout the day. Again, I do not set with powder, so the lasting power with just setting spray was pretty incredible for my dry skin.  I typically start to get the "dry" feeling on my face mid day, but not so far with this product!  From a coverage perspective, it covered my redness, but did not fully cover my dark spots, which I am not dissatisfied because this is a SKIN TINT.  Furthermore, it did layer well and was buildable to do a better job of covering that up.  I did not smell any fragrance with this product naturally sitting on my skin. Over all I am very very very pleased with this product and the way my skin looks after applying.

comment:

author: McKenzie
headline: Smooth Application
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm 39 and have combination skin with occasional acne. I liked the balm, it matched my skin color perfectly. The texture is smooth and silky. The packaging is nice too. It went on pretty smoothly just with my fingers. I did moisturized my skin before applying. It didn't make my skin texture look worse which a lot of these balms do by forming those flaky balls. I would say the coverage is very sheer, maybe a slight noticeable difference when I have it on vs bare skin. It doesn't cover skin texture but has a very slight smoothing effect. It can cover up very slight discoloration under the eyes. Does not cover acne.  I wore it for about 4-5 hours and it still looked good, no pilling and my skin still looked hydrated. It's suppose to visibly firm lines and minimize their look, I don't think I have deep enough ones to say. I would be slightly afraid it might settle in them. It would look really pretty on a 20 something face with minimal texture. But I would still recommend it and I'll will keep using it along with some concealer on days I want more coverage.

headline: Perfect for natural, every day wear!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is great for days when I want light coverage with a healthy glow. The texture is creamy but lightweight and blends effortlessly with fingers or a sponge. It evens out redness and smooths the skin without feeling heavy or cakey.

Overall, this is a solid choice if you prefer a "your skin but better" look that's comfortable for all day wear.

Just like the name, it is very sheer and weightless on the skin. A little bit goes a long way and it is buildable. I like how this is a skin care product with some color built-in. I tried the shaded light neutral 210. Because this is a balm, the packaging makes it a little challenging to get the product out because you either have to dip your finger into the product or use a brush. I used my finger to warm up the product a bit. I could see myself using this a-lot in the summer to give my skin some life while not feeling weighed down by heavy products.

author: Naty
headline: My skin is glowing!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This sheer tint balm does it all! It provides a buildable coverage and contains 92% skincare ingredients. It has the consistency of a balm, but is not sticky and melts right into your skin. It can be applied with a brush or your fingers, and looks great both ways. I love that I can put the container in my handbag without worrying about it spilling. My skin has been dehydrated lately, and this feels so amazing and moisturizing without feeling oily. I have super sensitive skin and this does not irritate it one bit. It's excellent! When you're buying it just remember that it's sheer and buildable; which means it will look darker in the container than on your skin. I was worried when I first saw how dark it looked, but it's not too dark on my face at all.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have never used a tinted face balm, so I have little to compare it to in that specificity, but overall I would say this is a good product. author: Aim
headline: Nice creamy formula, great light coverag
comment: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I've using IT makeup for years, but I found a new favorite. This ultra-creamy balm looks like foundation in the container but feels like skincare. I applied it directly with my fingers (I usually use brushes) for a no-makeup makeup look. Then I added some under eye concealer, blush, tinted lip balm, and a light dusting of powder. I really like how it feels on my skin. Even when I removed it at night, my towelette wasn't orange all over, so I know it's lighter. For parties or more important events, I'll wear a greater coverage foundation for a more dramatic look, but this will be my go-to for looking fresh and feeling pretty on regular day.

headline: Interesting product, wears nicely
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like the effect of this IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm. It basically has the coverage of a tinted moisturizer, which is generally all I use for a base. It looks like it applies quite sheer, but once it's applied all over the face, you can certainly tell the difference in how it subtly evens out tone. It may just be that I'm not used to this specific type of product, but I do always find myself wishing it somehow came out of a tube instead, as I tend to apply it with my fingers and it takes a while to pick up enough of the product from the pot. Overall, I do like this product and the way it wears on my skin.

author: Michelle
headline: Skin-first Makeup!
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in Shade Fair Cool 125 has officially earned a permanent spot in my complexion routine.

As an aesthetic nurse with light skin, colder months are when I really notice makeup settling into fine lines more than I'd like (hello getting older meh). This is exactly why I've been gravitating toward tinted moisturizers and skin-first makeup, and this product is a total gem! The balm texture is buttery, lightweight, and the formula melts right into the skin as it transforms into a literal serum. It gives that fresh, healthy, radiant look and is buildable, without feeling heavy or cakey, it's super comfortable! It instantly evens out my complexion while still letting my skin look like my skin… just better. A more enhanced version of myself… A bonus is that it's unscented! 

What I love most is that it's doing more than just covering. It doesn't cling to dry patches, doesn't emphasize fine lines, and actually makes my combination skin look more youthful and plump with wear. Application with fingertips is suggested, but if you have the coveted Heavenly #7 brush… it blends like a dream! 

This is truly next-generation tinted moisturizer energy… makeup that enhances your skin and supports skin health. Perfect for everyday wear, no-makeup makeup days, or when you want to look polished without a full face.

If you're noticing makeup not sitting the way it used to and want something radiant, hydrating, and flattering, this is absolutely worth trying. Skin-first makeup is where it's at!

밝은 피부를 가진 미적 간호사로서, 추운 달에는 제가 원하는 것보다 메이크업이 잔주름으로 자리잡는 것을 더 많이 느낄 수 있습니다(안녕하세요, 나이가 들었습니다). 이것이 바로 제가 틴티드 모이스처라이저와 피부 우선 메이크업에 매력을 느낀 이유이며, 이 제품은 완전 보석입니다! 밤 질감은 버터처럼 가볍고 가벼우며 포뮬라는 피부에 바로 녹아 문자 그대로의 세럼으로 변합니다. 산뜻하고 건강하며 빛나는 룩을 선사하며 제작이 가능하고 무겁거나 뭉친 느낌 없이 매우 편안합니다! 내 피부가 내 피부처럼 보이도록 하면서 즉각적으로 안색을 고르게 만들어줍니다… 좀 더 강화된 나의 모습... 덤으로 무향이라는 점! 

제가 가장 좋아하는 점은 단순히 커버하는 것 이상의 역할을 한다는 것입니다. 건조한 부위에 달라붙지 않고, 잔주름을 강조하지 않으며, 착용할수록 복합성 피부를 더욱 젊고 통통하게 만들어줍니다. 손끝으로 바르는 걸 추천하지만, 탐나는 헤븐리 #7 브러시가 있다면… 꿈처럼 블렌딩됩니다! 

피부를 건강하게 가꾸어주는 진정한 차세대 틴티드 모이스처라이저 에너지 메이크업입니다. 데일리룩으로, 노메이크업 메이크업을 하는 날, 풀페이스 없이도 세련되게 보이고 싶을 때 딱 맞습니다.

메이크업이 예전 방식대로 진행되지 않고 빛나고 수분을 공급하며 매력적인 메이크업을 원한다면 이 제품을 시도해 볼 가치가 있습니다. 피부 우선 메이크업이 바로 그 곳입니다!

author: Lala
headline: Good with cautions
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I received the new it cosmetics Do It all Sheer Tint Balm in Light warm 02 for review.  This is a very lightweight sheer skin tint that acts more like skin care than makeup.  Initially I swatched it on my finger and was immediately concerned with the level of sheerness wondering if it would do anything.  I was amazed as I put it on that it actually went on the skin very dry feeling and covered more than I expected.  I have a lot of redness on my cheek area and the pictures show it evened my skin tone nicely.  It is matte, not dewy as I expected.  In fact it did tend to highlight a few dry patches I had instead of smoothing them, so make sure you are well moisturized. I have oily skin and did not need to apply any powder on top of this product, but did notice oil breaking through about 5 hours later on my T-zone. I was concerned about some quality control issues with the packaging, one was the label on the top was off center and had bubbling under it as if it was hastily applied.  The other was immediately after swiping the top layer off the product, there was a large uneven pocket of product underneath as if it had a large bubble in the actual product.  You can see this in the picture.  I'm concerned this means the product was hastily packaged and worried about quicker spoilage of the product due to air bubbles, so I will monitor this.  Another thing I noticed as with other it cosmetic products is oxidation.  The top layer of the product was a completely different color than the product underneath but it did not seem to oxidize and turn orange on the skin after had a day of wear, likely because the product is so thinly applied. Overall I think this is a good product for skin care with a bit more or everyday makeup looks.  I think dry skin will be an issue for this product.  I received this item in exchange for an honest review.
comment_ko: [본 상품을 제공받은 솔직후기] 잇화장품 두잇올 쉬어 틴트밤 라이트웜02를 리뷰용으로 받았습니다.  메이크업이라기보다는 스킨케어에 가까운 느낌을 주는 매우 가벼운 쉬어 스킨 틴트입니다.  처음에 나는 그것을 손가락으로 견본을 보았고 그것이 무엇을 할 것인지 궁금해하면서 즉시 투명도 수준에 관심을 가졌습니다.  실제로 바르고 보니 피부에 굉장히 건조한 느낌이 들고 생각보다 커버력이 좋아서 놀랐어요.  볼 부분에 붉은기가 많이 있는데 사진을 보니 피부톤이 고르게 잘 나온 것 같아요.  생각보다 촉촉하지 않고 매트해요.  실제로 제가 가지고 있던 몇 개의 마른 패치를 부드럽게 하는 대신 강조하는 경향이 있었으므로 수분이 잘 공급되었는지 확인하세요. 저는 지성 피부라서 이 제품 위에 파우더를 바를 필요가 없었는데, 약 5시간 후에 T존 부위에 오일이 스며드는 것을 느꼈습니다. 포장의 일부 품질 관리 문제가 걱정되었습니다. 하나는 상단의 라벨이 중앙에서 벗어나 급하게 붙인 것처럼 그 아래에 거품이 있다는 것이었습니다.  다른 하나는 제품의 윗부분을 닦아낸 직후인데, 실제 제품에 큰 기포가 있는 것처럼 아래쪽에 커다란 고르지 못한 제품 주머니가 있었습니다.  이것을 사진에서 볼 수 있습니다.  급하게 포장해서 기포로 인해 제품이 더 빨리 변질될까봐 걱정이 되니 모니터링 하도록 하겠습니다.  다른 IT 화장품과 마찬가지로 제가 주목한 또 다른 점은 산화입니다.  윗부분의 색은 아랫부분의 색과 전혀 다르지만 너무 얇게 발랐기 때문에 하루 사용 후에도 피부가 산화되거나 오렌지색으로 변하는 현상은 없는 것 같았습니다. 전체적으로 좀 더 과한 스킨케어나 데일리 메이크업에 활용하기 좋은 제품인 것 같아요.  이 제품은 건성 피부가 문제가 될 것 같아요.  이 상품을 제공받아 솔직한 리뷰를 작성했습니다.

You can see this in the picture. I'm concerned this means the product was hastily packaged and worried about quicker spoilage of the product due to air bubbles, so I will monitor this. Another thing I noticed as with other it cosmetic products is oxidation. The top layer of the product was a completely different color than the product underneath but it did not seem to oxidize and turn orange on the skin after had a day of wear, likely because the product is so thinly applied. Overall I think this is a good product for skin care with a bit more or everyday makeup looks. I think dry skin will be an issue for this product. I received this item in exchange for an honest review.

comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a nice creamy skin tint balm. It's presented in a glass jar. It feels silky and creamy and dries down to a powdery finish. I tried it on one side of my face with no prep and then I did prep the other side. On the not prepped side, it was smooth but overall a tad dry feeling for me. On the prepped side, where my skin was super moisturized, it glided so well and looked at lot better. For someone who has very dry skin, especially now in the winter, it wasn't as hydrating as I would've preferred. It's still a nice skin tint balm but for me, I need a lot of hydration. I would recommend it to people. It's great for those who are not super dry and if you are super dry, I would definitely recommend prepping your skin first which is not a deal breaker for me.

comment: I received the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for free in exchange for my honest review. author: Laura
headline: Innovative, unique, essential!
comment:
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is my first time using a balm foundation, so I had no expectations. I chose shade 120 Fair Warm, which matches my skin flawlessly. 

The balm is wet and thick, but blends into my skin so easily. Just a little bit is all you need, and I just used my fingers to apply. It even covers my acne from "that time of the month." I appreciate that the balm doesn't settle in fine lines, it just kind of sits on top and hides them seamlessly.

From the looks of it in the jar, I expected the finish of the balm to be dewy…and it turned out to be quite the opposite. While it's not a matte or even a dewy finish, it's kind of somewhere in between. I absolutely love it, and for the first time didn't have the urge to set foundation with powder, which is a big deal.

It lasts ALL day (and into the night!), yet comes off easily with micellar water and a cotton ball. 

The 4-in-1 skincare aspect is especially awesome in the winter, you can essentially skip your moisturizer. This could save you a decent amount of money, as you technically don't need to apply your serum or moisturizer on the days you wear the balm.

This balm's consistency is so innovative, the finish is beautiful, and my skin feels light and looks flawless yet natural. I'm a new super-fan.

밤은 촉촉하고 두껍지만 피부에 너무 쉽게 섞입니다. 조금만 있으면 됩니다. 저는 손가락을 사용해서만 발라줬어요. "그 달의 그 시간"부터 내 여드름까지 커버해 줍니다. 나는 밤이 미세한 선으로 정착되지 않고 단지 위에 앉아서 매끄럽게 숨겨지는 것을 고맙게 생각합니다.

겉모습만 봤을 때 밤의 마무리감은 촉촉할 거라고 예상했는데... 오히려 그 반대였어요. 매트하거나 촉촉한 마무리는 아니지만 그 중간 정도의 느낌이에요. 나는 그것을 정말 좋아하고 처음으로 파우더로 파운데이션을 설정하고 싶은 충동이 없었는데 이는 큰 일이었습니다.

하루종일(그리고 밤까지!) 지속되지만, 미셀라 워터와 면봉을 사용하면 쉽게 지워집니다. 

4-in-1 스킨케어 측면은 겨울에 특히 훌륭합니다. 기본적으로 모이스처라이저를 건너뛸 수 있습니다. 엄밀히 말하면 밤을 바르는 날 세럼이나 모이스처라이저를 바르지 않아도 되기 때문에 상당한 비용을 절약할 수 있습니다.

이 밤의 지속력은 혁신적이며, 마무리감도 아름답고, 피부가 가볍고 결점 없이 자연스러워 보입니다. 나는 새로운 슈퍼 팬입니다.
text_for_model: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is my first time using a balm foundation, so I had no expectations. I chose shade 120 Fair Warm, which matches my skin flawlessly. The balm is wet and thick, but blends into my skin so easily. Just a little bit is all you need, and I just used my fingers to apply. It even covers my acne from "that time of the month." I appreciate that the balm doesn't settle in fine lines, it just kind of sits on top and hides them seamlessly. From the looks of it in the jar, I expected the finish of the balm to be dewy…and it turned out to be quite the opposite. While it's not a matte or even a dewy finish, it's kind of somewhere in between. I absolutely love it, and for the first time didn't have the urge to set foundation with powder, which is a big deal. It lasts ALL day (and into the night!), yet comes off easily with micellar water and a cotton ball. The 4-in-1 skincare aspect is especially awesome in the winter, you can essentially skip your moisturizer. This could save you a decent amount of money, as you technically don't need to apply your serum or moisturizer on the days you wear the balm. This balm's consistency is so innovative, the finish is beautiful, and my skin feels light and looks flawless yet natural. I'm a new super-fan.

headline: Wonderful makeup for dry mature skin
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review]  I'm loving the It Cosmetics Face Balm for my mature skin—it covers redness beautifully with light, buildable coverage that doesn't cake up. Wasn't sure I'd like it at first, but it's a winner, especially set with a little powder on top. 

It feels more like a face serum than a makeup. I might even say it is a tinted face serum. It's buttery smooth and I prefer to apply it with a brush over my fingers. Patting motion, not smearing. All in all I probably wouldn't have thought to try this but I am pleasantly surprised.

Highly recommend!

author: Michelle
headline: Amazing product for even tone, healthy skin!
comment:
I was gifted this product and was able to test this before launching through Gloss Angeles Confidential. This is my first impression and introduction into the IT Cosmetics brand, and I must say I am impressed! This product is marketed as a sheer tint face balm that enhances your skin to provide a naturally flawless look. In terms of delivering on their claims, this definitely does deliver and gives a moisturized, bouncy, fresh look to the skin. It is a sheer complexion product, but does layer well with concealer to deliver fuller coverage. The finish is a radiant and glowy which is perfect for drier to normal skin types. I have extremely oily skin and the finish is a bit to glowy for my skin type. Throughout wearing this product, the finish turned into a shiny, oily look if I did not properly set it with powder which is why I deducted one star. Despite this I think this is a great product to use in winter time to combat the dry look. Due to the climate I live in, I don't think I would recommend wearing this in the summer as it would not last and feel like too much on my skin. In terms of shade range, I do think that IT Cosmetics did a great job in catering to all skin tones and undertones. The great thing about this product is that it is sheer and flexible so the product adapts to you for a perfect match. 

Details worth mentioning...I have an oily skin type, medium skin tone with neutral undertones. My perfect match of this product is 320 Medium Tan Warm

author: Sally
headline: Just what I was looking for!
comment:
I was invited to use IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm in exchange for my honest review.

I've been searching for a while for a product like this! Something that truly enhances my aging skin, with its fine lines and uneven tone. I strive for a very natural look with a healthy glow and truly dislike a face that looks like it might crack when you smile! I chose a shade to review that matches my natural coloring.

I applied IT Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm to half of my face to really compare the results. This luxurious product is a solid, but as soon as I  applied it, it almost melted into my skin, because it's SUPER blended and gives an ultra-smooth appearance. I was amazed how quickly and easily it went on and immediately gave me a balanced look, with a nice glow. Some areas of my face required a little more than others, because of my aging skin, which is understandable. 

I have very high cheekbones and almost instantly I could see a big difference on the half of my face with the balm, as compared to the other half. My high cheekbone was so noticeably and beautifully enhanced and my treated face looked smooth, hydrated and had a balanced look compared to the other side. Fine lines were still there, but much less noticeable. My eye area looked brighter, more awake and more healthy . . . And this was BEFORE applying any other make-up. 

I like the small container it comes in, because I travel extensively and it will easily pop into my cosmetic bag. The downside is that I'll need to buy it more often - does it come by the case? 😊

Overall, I'm very pleased with the results of this product and I'm so happy I had the opportunity to try it - it was a real find for me!

headline: Absolutely fantastic no-makeup foundation
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I think I found my favorite no-foundation foundation. This is a solid cream balm product that warms up quickly upon contact and creates sheer to medium coverage on the skin. Even though the balm doesn't quite match my face upon swatching, once applied and patted into the skin it becomes the same color as my face. It visibly covers redness and red-based imperfections. I have a healing scar that healed very red. One tiny dab of this product removed the redness making the spot less visible. On my face this balm gave me a little bit of coverage where my normally red face doesn't look red anymore. This helps even out my skin tone without looking like I'm wearing foundation. I love this! So much! My 42 year old skin looks amazing with this product. What's even more amazing is that the balm didn't react with any of my heavy duty skincare underneath. It didn't lift, it didn't pill. comment:
This balm did not disappoint.  As you can see in the video and photo, in comes in a compact glass case and has a creamy texture.
Application was seamless and easy.  While at first I thought that maybe I had gone a shade too dark, it blended perfectly.  As you can see in the photos it hid any imperfections/discolorations, blurred visible pores, and added a delicate shine finish.  So light, despite excellent coverage, It feels a lot like a mineral-based sunscreen.
Aside from good performance, I love that there are a number of skincare ingredients meant to help nourish the skin like hyaluronic acid, vitamin E, and Collagen Peptide. 
This balm is definitely going into frequent rotation.

headline: Love it
comment: I did my makeup at noon and kept it on until 8:30 p.m. There was no oxidation, and the makeup stayed intact the entire time. For oily skin, it works well when paired with loose powder and a setting spray. Using less loose powder gives a healthy, luminous finish, and it didn't feel suffocating or cause breakouts on my face today. The finish is very refined and smooth. The only possible downside is that even when layered, it doesn't really increase the coverage. My skin does get oily, but this tinted cream doesn't seem to make it oilier.

author: Mi
headline: A great face balm tint for a natural look!
comment: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is my first time trying the it cosmetics 'do it all' sheer tint face balm. I have the shade 'fair warm 120' which is a good match for my nc25 Swinton. This face balm is derived from 92% of skincare ingredients and feels like a lightweight serum with some color. It is a liquid like cooling face tint that comes in a pot container so you can use your fingers or go in with a brush and sponge to spot cover. It is also a good product for a no makeup makeup look as your skin will look very natural with a light coverage to make skin look more even. As a person with combo-oily skin I think this product will be great for those days running errands to give that fresh face look. It is definitely not meant for full coverage.

author: Cay
headline: Beautiful hydrating finish sheer balm❤️
comment:
[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have this It cosmetics sheer tint face balm in 120 fair warm,this is a balm based product,it's smooth but thin and breathable,you can wear it very sheer or build it up.m,it isn't greasy at all,if you have tried RMS concealer in a pot the texture is similar but this one is non sticky and feels very hydrating,I find that I can wear it alone without setting powder it held up just fine,I applied it with a brush,it gives my skin a very healthy glow but not shiny,the longevity is ok,if you have a long day and need to wear a base makeup for over 8-9 hours I recommend you to use a regular foundation product,this face balm is beautiful and make your skin glow!the shade is leaning very warm ,it says fair warm but it's not fair at all I would say it's leaning towards little deeper end of fair shade with warm undertones.I recommend this product if you have dry skin or normal skin type,you may need to set it if your skin is on oilier side.
Ps:I received this free product in return for my honest review.

author: Paloma
headline: I liked this… but I didn't love it.
comment:
The coverage is actually really nice for something sheer, it evens things out without feeling heavy at all, and it feels super lightweight on the skin. Once it's on, it gives that natural, skin-like glow that looks effortless if everything underneath is cooperating.

That said, prep matters a lot with this one. If your skin isn't well hydrated, it will cling to dry patches sooo much. On days when I used good hydrators and moisturizer beforehand, it looked great. On days I didn't, it definitely emphasized texture and dryness.

I wouldn't rely on this as a true one-and-done tinted moisturizer, despite the claims. It works best when your skin is already in a good place and you don't mind putting in a little effort with prep.

Overall, it's good, but not something I would grab before their CC cream. 

This product was gifted to me by Gloss Angeles Confidential (thank you for the opportunity to try it).

author: Jessica
headline: Your skin but better!
comment:
I received this product to test through Gloss Angeles, and overall I've really enjoyed using it. The texture is lightweight and smooth, and perfect for quick, everyday makeup.

I don't love heavy foundation products and tend to prioritize skincare, so this felt ideal for me. It keeps my skin feeling like my skin, just a bit more glowy and hydrated. The coverage is very sheer, which I personally love, though while the product claims to be buildable, I didn't find that I could achieve much additional coverage with layering.

The product also claims to "transform skin instantly and over time." While I appreciate the instant hydrated, healthy look it gives, I haven't noticed a visible long-term change in my skin after about a month of use—though it may be something that takes more time. That said, this fits perfectly into my routine, and I would absolutely repurchase it.

headline: Perfect coverage and finish for no makeup-makeup
comment: The texture of this product is so unique, like if Glossier Stretch Concealer had a baby with a water cream. I did notice that when my picture was taken with a polaroid camera at my office's holiday party, my face looked flat and white (think Queen Elizabeth I), but how often do we take pictures on an old polaroid camera these days? author: Kristen
headline: Feels luxurious!
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential to review. This was my first time trying IT Cosmetics and a foundation/tint balm, so I wasn't sure what to expect, but it ended up being one of the best products I've tried in a while. I have sensitive, combo-to-oily skin with rosacea and usually struggle to find shades and formulas that work, but this one really checked a lot of boxes for me. The shades are surprisingly flexible! I used 110 Fairest Neutral and 125 Fair Cool, and both blended into my skin beautifully. It felt super lightweight, gave natural-looking coverage, and didn't cause any irritation at all. I wear a luminous sunscreen underneath, which worked well texture-wise but did make me look oilier faster. Setting powder helps, but the shine does come through as the day goes on and the balm can shift a bit. I think this would work even better on drier skin or with a light sunscreen or primer. I applied well using both my fingers and a brush, though the brush gave a little more coverage. Even with daily use, I can tell these balms will last me a while, and I'm excited to see the skincare benefits as time goes on.

author: Sofia
headline: A great do-it-all product for those with a minimal routine
comment:
I was very excited to test out the new IT cosmetics do it all balm with Gloss Angeles Confidential but unfortunately found it to not work for me. The balm itself is a super hydrating, serum-y consistency (almost mousse-like) and actually gave more coverage than expected (light to low-medium). It took some trial and error to find an application method that I liked but found that it applied best with a brush/sponge combo. Coverage was good, finish was beautiful!

The issue I kept running into is that it never fully absorbed into my skin (normal-dry) and continued to move around throughout the day. I found that the product worked best when I used minimal to no skincare in the mornings, allowing the balm to act as both skincare and makeup! Since that's the case, i do wish they had found a way to incorporate spf into the formula. I really did like the product but just wasn't a fit for me - however I passed it off to my (much lower-maintenance) mother and she loves it! While it didn't work for me, I'd still recommend for someone with a minimal routine looking for a do-it-all product.

author: Carinne
headline: New holy grail
comment:
I was gifted this product through gloss Angeles confidential and it did not disappoint. I work as an esthetician and don't like to wear a lot of makeup during the day (note: I can be acne prone and have some mild rosacea so I do like a little bit of coverage). This balm gave a nice sheer coverage for just a tiny bit of blurring and felt like all I had on my skin was some moisturizer. I also liked that it was buildable so in the event that I wanted a little more coverage, I had that option. I didn't notice anything substantial in terms of improvement in fine lines in my skin but I have been getting compliments from friends that my skin looks great!

If you're looking for something lightweight that keeps you feeling hydrated/dewy throughout the day, this is it. Will continue to purchase!

author: Madison
headline: Nice lightweight coverage but not great with dry patches
comment:
Overall: I like the texture, finish and color match. I would give it a 3.5/5 since I personally needed to ensure I do enough extra-hydrating skin prep ahead of time. I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for my honest review.

On first try, this balm noticeably clung to dry patches (though it did not highlight fine lines). Once I prepped my skin with extra hydration, I did like how the product blends without highlighting dryness. The color match is a perfect fit that really does seem to blend and adapt into my natural skin while still evening out redness. I typically applied with (clean!) fingers from the center of my face and worked outward.

While this balm does not moisturize enough on its own for me, I didn't notice my face feeling dry or tight throughout the day. I needed an occasional touch up just because I have a bad subconscious habit of touching my face, but touch ups blended smoothly with product applied earlier in the day. Basically, it stays "flexible" on my face but isn't sliding around, which is great!

첫 번째 시도에서 이 밤은 마른 패치에 눈에 띄게 달라붙었습니다(가는 선을 강조하지는 않았지만). 충분한 수분 공급으로 피부를 준비한 후에는 제품이 건조함을 강조하지 않고 블렌딩하는 방식이 마음에 들었습니다. 컬러 매치는 붉은기를 완화하면서도 내 자연스러운 피부에 자연스럽게 녹아 적응하는 것처럼 보이는 완벽한 핏입니다. 나는 일반적으로 (깨끗한!) 손가락을 사용하여 얼굴 중앙에서 바깥쪽으로 작업했습니다.

이 밤 자체로는 수분 공급이 충분하지 않지만, 하루 종일 얼굴이 건조하거나 당기는 느낌을 받지 못했습니다. 얼굴을 만지는 나쁜 무의식 습관이 있어서 가끔 수정이 필요했는데, 오전에 바른 제품과 부드럽게 블렌딩이 되었습니다. 기본적으로, 그것은 내 얼굴에 "유연"하게 유지되지만 미끄러지지는 않습니다. 정말 좋습니다!

author: Katlyn
headline: Beautiful...while it lasts
comment: I received this product to test via Gloss Angeles to test and was very excited to start using it as I usually use a different brand's skincare-containing complexion product.  Fair Neutral was a perfect match for my hard-to-match skin (so many brands miss us neutral toned super fair skinned folks) which I definitely appreciate.  I applied it with a BK beauty foundation brush and fell in love with the slight cooling sensation, your-skin-but-better light coverage, and natural finish.  Unfortunately, my love for the product was short lived as I could not get it to stay put or "set" for the life of me even with trying different primers, powder, and setting spray, product movement and transfer started happening after about 2 hours of wear. I tend to run oily but don't often run into this problem anymore.  It's really a shame because I loved everything else about it.  If a longer-lasting vetsion was released I would buy it in a heartbeat.

BK 뷰티 파운데이션 브러쉬로 발랐더니 은은한 쿨링감과 피부에 닿는 듯한 가벼운 커버력, 자연스러운 마무리감에 반했어요.  불행하게도, 다른 프라이머, 파우더, 세팅 스프레이를 사용해도 제품을 그대로 두거나 "설정"할 수 없었기 때문에 제품에 대한 나의 사랑은 오래가지 못했습니다. 착용 후 약 2시간 후에 제품 이동 및 이동이 일어나기 시작했습니다. 나는 기름진 경향이 있지만 더 이상 이 문제에 자주 직면하지 않습니다.  나는 그것에 관한 다른 모든 것을 좋아했기 때문에 정말 부끄러운 일입니다.  오래 지속되는 버전이 출시된다면 즉시 구매할 것입니다.

author: Katie
headline: Light coverage
comment:
I recently had a laser treatment done and it helped clear up a lot of my dark spots that I was using a medium or full foundation to cover.  I was looking for something that would be lighter and just help with overall color evening.  I was so happy when I was able to try Do it all sheer tint face balm from It Cosmetics.  I already use a lot of It cosmetics products and love the CC cream.  This balm was a perfect transition for a sheet coverage product.  It helps for my fine lines to be minimized and to smooth out my skin tone.  I also really like that it has skin care ingredients as well, so my skin is also hydrated while improving my overall look.  It was easy to apply with a brush and was buildable if I need more coverage in areas.  I would use more of a flat brush to apply onto my face and get the amount over coverage I wanted.  Then I would blend out with a larger lighter brush, and my final look was very natural.  If I was particularly red in an area or had a pimple, I would apply a bit of concealer just in that area but overall, I think it gives good coverage for a uniform look.  I have combination skin and I am in my 40s. 
 
I was gifted this product from gloss angels confidential.

author: Kellyn
headline: Pleasantly surprised!
comment: To preface, I received this product as a gift from Gloss Angeles Confidential. It's not something I would typically purchase on my own, but I was genuinely blown away by it. The balm offers impressive coverage and is highly buildable—much more so than the average tinted moisturizer. author: Amanda
headline: My new favorite go to
comment: I have been using this for almost 1 month, courtesy of Gloss Angeles. I'm new to trying balms and my 40 year old, oily skin loved it! I was gifted 2 shades and both worked with my medium, olive/neutral skin tone. I set it with powder for extra longevity but don't need to. It plays well with other creams and powders. It looks beautiful sheer, for a no makeup makeup look and is buildable for when I want more coverage. I work from home and it looks good on camera and IRL. What I love most about it is, it is so lightweight, it feels like nothing on my skin. My skin has been looking more hydrated without makeup since I've been using this. For cold, windy, December it's amazing.

headline: Actually love it
comment: Balm foundations aren't typically my go to for my combo skin, but I do enjoy a skincare meshed, sheer product, so I was happy to give it a try. Turns out, I actually love it! I used the fair neutral shade (mont blanc is my perfect match) and it blended into my skin tone nicely. I do have redness, and that showed through so on days when I wanted less, I used a color corrector and the balm worked perfectly with it. I think the radiant finish is accurate, if it were more dewy, I wouldn't use it. Not sure if I noticed any help with fine lines, but it certainly was hydrating and felt really nice on the skin even after a long day. Overall great product, I'll keep using it and purchase when the time comes! Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for sending and allowing me to try.

author: Jenny
headline: great tinted balm for dehydrated skin
comment:
**Nonspon review purchased with my own money** 

In my early 40s with oily but dehydrated skin, very minimal lines, mild hyperpigmentation. Let me tell you - if you're after a sheer wash of coverage that provides hydration and glow (and/or have more mature skin) this is the base for you.

I use my danessa blurring balm (universal) directly underneath. then this balm, then VERY lightly set, then blush/bronzer, then a dusting of finishing powder. I get a solid 6-8 hours of good wear time assuming I blot around the 4 hr mark. If you'e dry skinned obviously you will prep/set differently. My advice is for how oily skinned people can use this product despite it being a balm.

Since this is a balm, it looks considerably darker in the pot than on your face. So even though im a light-med tone, i went with med-cool which is a good match to my deeper body & neck. It has no spf so oxidation is little to none.

I wfh and this is perfect for my minimal makeup looks while being good for my skin. Would recommend you try!
comment_ko:
**내 돈으로 구매한 비대면 리뷰** 

지성이지만 수분이 부족한 피부, 아주 최소한의 주름, 경미한 과다색소침착이 있는 40대 초반입니다. 말씀드리고 싶은 점은 수분 공급과 광채를 제공하는(그리고/또는 더욱 성숙한 피부를 갖고 있는) 순전한 커버력을 추구하는 분이라면 이것이 바로 여러분을 위한 베이스입니다.

저는 다네사 블러링 밤(유니버설)을 바로 아래에 사용합니다. 그런 다음 이 밤을 바르고 아주 가볍게 세팅한 다음 블러셔/브론저를 바르고 피니싱 파우더를 뿌립니다. 4시간 정도를 닦아낸다고 가정하면 6~8시간의 양호한 착용 시간을 얻을 수 있습니다. 당신이 건성 피부라면 분명히 다르게 준비/설정할 것입니다. 내 조언은 이 제품이 밤임에도 불구하고 지성 피부를 가진 사람들이 얼마나 사용할 수 있는지에 대한 것입니다.

이것은 밤이기 때문에 얼굴보다 냄비에서 훨씬 더 어둡게 보입니다. 그래서 저는 라이트-메디컬 톤이지만 깊은 바디와 넥에 잘 어울리는 med-cool을 선택했어요. spf가 없으므로 산화가 거의 없습니다.

나는 WFH이고 이것은 내 피부에 좋으면서 최소한의 메이크업 룩에 딱 맞습니다. 시도해 보는 것이 좋습니다!

author: Megm
headline: luminous foundation with a luxurious feel✨
comment: The new IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a beautiful, skincare-infused tint that delivers a natural, radiant glow with ease. Its lightweight, balm-like texture feels silky and smooth upon application, melting seamlessly into the skin without any greasy residue. The formula is incredibly buildable, allowing you to customize your coverage from sheer to medium. It has a soft, thin, balmy consistency that transforms effortlessly as you blend, whether you use your fingers, brush, or sponge. I typically like to warm the product up on the back of my hand and apply with a sponge for everyday. If I want to achieve a more glam look, I'll typically start out the same but I'll blend it out with a brush instead. Honestly, any way you use it, it comes out flawless. This balm is excellent at smoothing, by softly blurring imperfections without settling into fine lines or pores. It feels comfortable-hydrating, evens the skin, smooths, and blurs, thanks to its soft-focus properties. It has a natural-luminous finish. The glow is subtle, it just enhances your complexion without emphasizing texture or imperfections. I got a good 5-7 hours of wear each time I used it. The days it lasted 7 hours I did apply powder. I did not on the 5 hour days, but it still held up nicely without settling, (FYI I do have combo skin that's more dry leaning in the winter). Overall, the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is a sophisticated choice for those seeking a nourishing, luminous foundation with a luxurious feel and impeccable blendability. It's perfect for achieving a natural, radiant look with added skin benefits.
comment_ko: 새로운 IT 코스메틱스의 두 잇 올 쉬어 틴트 페이스 밤은 자연스럽고 빛나는 광채를 쉽게 전달하는 아름다운 스킨케어 틴트입니다. 가볍고 밤 같은 질감으로 바르는 순간 매끄럽고 매끄러워지며, 기름진 잔여물 없이 피부에 매끄럽게 녹아듭니다. 이 포뮬라는 믿을 수 없을 정도로 구성이 가능하여 투명에서 중간까지 적용 범위를 맞춤 설정할 수 있습니다. 손가락, 브러시, 스펀지를 사용하여 블렌딩할 때 부드럽고 얇으며 상쾌한 질감이 쉽게 변합니다. 저는 보통 손등에 제품을 데워서 스펀지로 바르는 걸 좋아해요. 좀 더 글래머러스한 룩을 연출하고 싶다면 일반적으로 동일하게 시작하지만 대신 브러시를 사용하여 블렌딩합니다. 솔직히 어떤 방식으로 사용해도 흠잡을 데가 없습니다. 잔주름이나 모공에 뭉침 없이 결점을 부드럽게 블러링하여 스무딩 효과가 뛰어난 밤입니다. 소프트 포커스 특성 덕분에 편안하게 수분을 공급하고 피부를 균일하게 하며 매끄럽고 흐릿하게 해줍니다. 자연스러운 광채가 나는 마무리감이에요. 빛은 미묘하며 질감이나 결점을 강조하지 않고 안색을 향상시킵니다. 매번 사용할 때마다 5~7시간 정도 착용할 수 있었습니다. 7시간 지속되는 날에는 파우더를 발랐습니다. 5시간 동안은 그렇지 않았지만 여전히 가라앉지 않고 잘 유지되었습니다. author: Dailey
headline: 5 star sheer coverage product
comment: I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles Confidential to review. I am very much a sheer coverage girl - I love a skin tint or a very light weight foundation. This product definitely fell into this category, but is so unique from other skin tints I've tried. The formula was so smooth and melted into my skin with minimal blending. It looked great if I put it all over, and it also looked great if I just do spot coverage on redness. You can build if you want more coverage, and it still blends well. I also loved that it didn't separate in my oily spots as the day went on, and it didnt settle into fine lines. It really did melt all the way in. It felt light weight on, like I was wearing no makeup, which is a must for me. On a personal note, I found this easier to apply with my fingers as opposed to a brush. If you like sheer coverage products, I really don't think there is anything better or more comfortable out there. I will repurchase when I run out.

author: Michelle
headline: This is a must have!
comment: I am definitely an It Cosmetics girl and have lots of favorites from their line. Now I've found my ultimate favorite with this face balm. Its an innovative makeup and skincare product in one with the most unique texture that starts as a balm and proceeds to melt into skin flawlessly. This tinted moisturizer has 92% skincare ingredients to nourish and hydrate skin as it provides buildable, sheer coverage with a radiant finish. Let me tell you, my skin has never looked better! Its as if I put a filter on as my fine lines are blurred, imperfections covered and my skin looks so supple and healthy. Once again, It Cosmetics has created a winner and this one just might be one of the top products of the year. Do not hesitate to try it. Gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential

author: J
headline: Nice light skin tint
comment: I really liked this skin tint. It is very light coverage but worked great for no-makeup days and I can see using it a lot in summer when I want an even skin tone but dont want to feel like im wearing makeup. It layered well over serum, moisturizer and suncreen on my normal but mature skin. There were a few spots where it clung to dry patches from my retinol but no more than the other skin tints I use. It will be great for travel since its not a liquid! I also liked the cooling sensation I got when applying it.

Not cakey at all and really helps you look put together, but still natural looking. Thanks Gloss Angeles for the opportunity to test this product, I will definitely purchase with my own money ☺️

author: Allie Wilson
headline: Wanted to love this, but it's a bit finicky!
comment: I have mixed feelings about this product! I loved the idea of a serum foundation that was sheer and easy to apply. I do agree that it's very easy to apply, which is great as I have a toddler and not a ton of time to get ready! I use a brush. I did find it to be a bit finicky depending on my skincare routine. For example, I noticed the product would break up depending on which sunscreen I used. I also noticed it clung to dry patches, which seems to go against some of their claims about it being hydrating. The product claims to "visibly firm" but I can't say I noticed any difference in my skin related to that. Overall, I think this product would work for you if you use minimal skincare underneath and don't have any skin issues. I received this product as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Kalynn
headline: No makeup makeup
comment: I have to admit at first I was very flummoxed by this product.  Is it skincare?  Is it makeup?  As someone that does not have flawless skin, I cannot use this as my everyday complexion product.  However, on days when my skin is feeling good, I do reach for it.  Sometimes all add some concealer to round it out or if I'm looming for a little extra coverage.  I find that even though it doesnt cover much, it does have a blurring effect.  Because of the sheerness, the shades are forgiving.  Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential, for the opportunity to try this product.  I look forward to continuing to experiement with it!

author: Bethany
headline: Low effort, high impact
comment: This tint truly lived up to its name. I was genuinely surprised by how much coverage it provided—so much so that I didn't even need a separate primer for it to last all day. It applies incredibly smoothly, and the texture feels lightweight yet nourishing on the skin. The shade match was spot-on for my skin tone, and I also loved the sleek, practical packaging. Overall, this is a versatile, easy-to-wear product that delivers far more than I expected.

author: Melaney
headline: Amazing skin tint for a glowing appearance
comment: I have used this product for about a month and will purchase again! I received as part of Gloss Angeles confidential. I preferred using a brush to apply and found the coverage adequate and slightly buildable to cover unevenness (I still needed concealer for covering red spots). The color blends well into your skin and looks natural. The finish feels hydrating and provides a illuminating finish and wears well through the day. I had no reaction with my skin and even traveled with the product to wear on vacation! I had never using any products from it before or a balm for complexion and this was a great introduction to the brand.

author: Cat Kim
headline: Just what I've been looking for!
comment: I've been searching for a product that has the light coverage, but also has great skin care benefits. A tinted moisturizer never had the coverage that I was looking for, however, this product is beautifully formulated and gives just the right amount of coverage so that I don't have to wear a foundation, but I feel confident enough to be out in the world And it evens out my complexion so beautifully. The skin care benefits are definitely a huge plus. I would still purchase this product even if the benefits weren't included just because it sits so beautifully on my skin. I use a foundation brush to apply the bomb and it drives pretty quickly and I can put my whole contour blush highlighter situation, and lightly powder my tea zone and I'm set for the day. I am so shocked at how long the product stayed on my face throughout the day, this would be a perfect my skin, but better found foundation for the summer when you just wanna have a light layer of coverage. Huge fan! I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential but will purchase once I'm finished with this jar.

headline: Smooth as butter

author: Fawn
headline: I would purchase this!
comment:
I received this product via Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for an honest review. I'm in my early 40s with combination skin and minimal fine lines. I received the shades Fair Cool and Light Warm, and Fair Cool ended up being the best match for my skin, which surprised me since I usually consider myself light with neutral undertones. I plan to try Light Neutral as well, as that may be an even better match.

The formula sinks into the skin easily and has a lightweight, glowy finish with very sheer coverage that softly blurs discoloration and imperfections. It's not buildable—layering doesn't add coverage—but it looks very natural. Applying with my fingers worked best; brushes seemed to waste product, though I lightly tapped with one at the end and set with a small amount of loose powder.

There's a subtle cooling effect on application (not menthol-like). I didn't experience any pilling, and it wore well throughout the day. I noticed minor caking around my nose once due to dryness, which improved with light exfoliation and less product in that area.

I love the glass packaging, it feels elevated and well-made. Overall, this is an easy, everyday "no-makeup makeup" option if you don't have much to cover. I would recommend and purchase this.
comment_ko:
나는 솔직한 리뷰를 대가로 Gloss Angeles Confidential을 통해 이 제품을 받았습니다. 저는 복합성 피부에 잔주름이 최소화된 40대 초반입니다. 페어 쿨(Fair Cool)과 라이트 웜(Light Warm) 색상을 받았는데, 페어 쿨(Fair Cool)이 제 피부에 가장 잘 맞아서 놀랐습니다. 평소 자신을 밝은 톤으로 생각하는 뉴트럴 톤이라 놀랐습니다. 나는 Light Neutral도 시도해 볼 계획입니다. 그것이 더 나은 일치일 수 있기 때문입니다.

피부에 쉽게 스며드는 포뮬러는 가볍고 윤기 있는 마무리감을 선사하며, 매우 투명한 커버력으로 변색과 결점을 부드럽게 가려줍니다. 레이어링으로 커버리지가 추가되지는 않지만 구축 가능하지는 않지만 매우 자연스러워 보입니다. 손가락으로 바르는 것이 가장 효과적이었습니다. 브러시는 낭비되는 것처럼 보였지만 끝에 브러시로 가볍게 두드리고 소량의 루스 파우더로 고정했습니다.

바르면 미묘한 냉각 효과가 있습니다(멘톨 같은 느낌은 아님). 보풀이 전혀 느껴지지 않았고, 하루종일 잘 발려요. 건조함으로 인해 코 주위에 약간의 각질이 생긴 것을 한 번 발견했는데, 이는 가벼운 각질 제거와 해당 부위의 제품 감소로 개선되었습니다.

나는 유리 포장을 좋아합니다. 고급스럽고 잘 만들어진 느낌입니다. 전반적으로, 이것은 커버할 것이 많지 않은 경우 쉽고 일상적인 "노 메이크업 메이크업" 옵션입니다. 나는 이것을 추천하고 구매할 것이다.

author: Maddie L.
headline: Great hydrating sheer coverage balm!
comment: I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential for review. I have been testing this product for the past few weeks, and have really enjoyed it! This product is a lightweight, sheer, hydrating balm foundation. As someone with dry skin, even more so in the winter, I was pleasantly surprised by how well this foundation hydrated my skin. One day my skin felt a bit tight, even after applying my moisturizer, so I tried the balm without any additional hydrating products to really test how well it hydrated. I was pleasantly surprised to find that after application my skin no longer felt tight and it appeared plump and hydrated as well. Because of the products lightweight texture and hydrating formula I found that it helped to minimize the appearance of fine lines I have on my forehead, where drier foundations can sink into and exaggerate them. The coverage on the product is relatively low. I think it can be built up to somewhere in the light (maybe verging on a light medium coverage) range, but I believe its intent is to be a sheer layer of color and coverage, which it achieves. I did notice that the hydrating nature of this product meant that it never fully set and could potentially transfer if I touched my face with my hands or had foundation on my neck that got onto my shirt. That being said, a layer of powder will help midigate the transfer (albeit taking away the hydrated appearance on the skin). My only other critique comes for the shade range. The range is described as flexible (likely due to how sheer it is) and while I could absolutely wear the light warm shade without it appearing completely off it did look a bit warm on my light olive skintone. Overall, I think you'll really enjoy this product if you're looking for something sheer and hydrating!
comment_ko: 나는 리뷰를 위해 Gloss Angeles Confidential로부터 이 제품을 선물 받았습니다. 나는 지난 몇 주 동안 이 제품을 테스트해 왔고 정말 즐거웠습니다! 이 제품은 가볍고 투명하며 수분을 공급하는 밤 파운데이션입니다. 건조한 피부를 가진 사람으로서, 겨울에는 더욱 그렇습니다. 이 파운데이션이 피부에 얼마나 수분을 공급하는지 보고 기분 좋게 놀랐습니다. 어느 날 보습제를 바르고도 피부가 좀 당기는 느낌이 들어서, 별도의 수분 제품 없이 밤만 사용해서 수분이 얼마나 잘 공급되는지 테스트해봤습니다. 바르고 난 후 피부가 더 이상 당김을 느끼지 않고 통통하고 촉촉해 보이는 것을 보고 기분 좋게 놀랐습니다. 제품의 가벼운 질감과 수분 공급 포뮬러 덕분에 건조한 파운데이션이 가라앉아 과장될 수 있는 이마의 잔주름을 최소화하는 데 도움이 된다는 것을 알았습니다. 제품에 대한 커버력은 상대적으로 낮습니다. 나는 그것이 밝은 범위(어쩌면 가벼운 중간 범위에 가까울 수도 있음)까지 구축될 수 있다고 생각하지만, 그 의도는 그것이 달성하는 색상과 범위의 순수한 레이어라고 믿습니다. 저는 이 제품의 수분 공급 특성으로 인해 완전히 굳지 않으며 손으로 얼굴을 만지거나 목에 파운데이션을 바르면 셔츠에 묻어날 수 있다는 것을 알았습니다. 즉, 파우더 층이 이동을 완화하는 데 도움이 될 것입니다(비록 피부의 촉촉한 모습은 사라지지만). 나의 유일한 다른 비평은 그늘 범위에 관한 것입니다. 범위는 유연하다고 설명되며 (얇기 때문에) 완전히 벗겨지지 않고 밝고 따뜻한 색조를 절대적으로 입을 수 있지만 밝은 올리브색 피부색에서는 약간 따뜻해 보였습니다. 전반적으로 투명하고 촉촉한 제품을 찾으신다면 이 제품이 정말 마음에 드실 것 같아요!

I did find woth my oily skin that I did have control that throughout the day but overall happy with the coverage and wear. One down side is i feel like my blush doesnt apply and look as pigmented as it should. While I do like the coverage not sure if I'll repurchase due to the oilyness of my skin. 

Thanks Gloss Angeles Confidential and IT cosmetics for the opportunity to try this product out.

comment: This was gifted to me by Gloss Angeles Confidential for my honest review. The coverage is sheer and slightly buildable to a light coverage, not medium. I found this really enjoyable but would not expect medium or high coverage from it. it is a really nice base layer to a light makeup day, and I like it best when I add a little concealer after using it.

headline: Amazing, no notes !
comment: I was fortunate enough to try this product ahead of launch through Gloss Angeles confidential and wow am i impressed. I have used it cosmetics since I was in high school and I'll be 30 this year. This product is super moisturizing, I was even able to wear it post micro needling with dry,flaky skin and it still looked really great hours after application. The shade range and cosistency makes the producy very forgiving. My skin looked great with two different shades. Throughout the entire testing time, multiple people commented on my skin and asked me what I was has done differently because they couldn't believe I had nothing but just a little bit of coverage. They all thought I wasn't wearing any makeup so it truly is the perfect natural everyday product. Having used it every day since I received it with touchups throughout the day, there is still a ton of product left. I think this is a product everybody would benefit from especially for the price. It'll last you a very long time. I would highly recommend trying if you've tried other cosmetic products of them or if you've never tried the product line at all. Cant wait tobtry the othwr products in the line and will be repurchasing

author: CamCoo
headline: Balm with a Beautiful Finish
comment:
I was sent the IT Cosmetics Sheer Tint Balm for my honest review as an esthetician. I swapped my usual skin tint out for this product, and kept my skincare routine the same otherwise.

From a skin professional's standpoint, this is a complexion product designed to enhance—not mask—your natural skin. The coverage is buildable from sheer to semi-sheer, making it ideal for clients who want a "your skin but better" finish rather than full coverage. Even when layered, your natural skin still shines through, which I personally appreciate for a more realistic, healthy-looking complexion.

The texture is especially noteworthy. It starts as a semi-solid, almost butter-like consistency, and melts effortlessly into the skin upon application. It's very user-friendly and can be applied with fingers, a brush, or a sponge; however, I achieved the most seamless finish using a sponge.

In terms of wear, it performs reasonably well throughout the day. I did notice some breakdown by midday in my oilier areas—around the nose and between the brows. For reference, my skin is combination, leaning normal to dry with a few oil-prone zones. Because of its dewy finish, I don't think this formula will be a good choice for very oily or oil-dominant combination skin types.

While I appreciate the inclusion of skincare benefits, I didn't notice any significant improvement in my skin over time. That said, as someone with rosacea and eczema-prone skin, the formula was gentle. I experienced no irritation, sensitivities, or flare-ups, which speaks highly to its formulation.

Overall, this is a beautiful option for normal to dry skin types or anyone seeking a radiant, skin-first complexion product that prioritizes skin health and a natural glow over heavy coverage.

에스테티션으로서 아이티 코스메틱 쉬어 틴트밤을 보내드린 솔직한 후기입니다. 평소 사용하던 피부 틴트를 이 제품으로 바꾸고, 그 외에는 스킨케어 루틴을 동일하게 유지했습니다.

피부 전문가의 입장에서 본 피부를 마스크가 아닌 본연의 피부로 가꾸어주는 안색 제품입니다. 커버력은 투명한 것부터 반투명한 것까지 구성 가능하므로 전체 커버리지보다는 "피부는 좋지만 더 나은" 마무리를 원하는 고객에게 이상적입니다. 레이어링을 하여도 본연의 피부가 그대로 빛나며, 더욱 현실감 있고 건강해 보이는 피부가 개인적으로 높이 평가됩니다.

특히 질감이 주목할 만하다. 거의 버터와 같은 반고형의 농도로 시작하여 바르는 순간 피부에 쉽게 녹습니다. 매우 사용자 친화적이며 손가락, 브러시 또는 스폰지를 사용하여 적용할 수 있습니다. 하지만 스펀지를 사용하여 가장 매끄러운 마무리를 구현했습니다.

착용 측면에서 하루 종일 합리적으로 좋은 성능을 발휘합니다. 나는 정오쯤에 코 주위와 눈썹 사이의 기름진 부분이 약간 무너지는 것을 발견했습니다. 참고로 제 피부는 지성 피부가 몇 군데 있는 복합성 피부입니다. 촉촉한 마무리감 때문에 이 포뮬러는 지성이 많거나 지성 복합성 피부 타입에는 좋은 선택이 될 것이라고 생각하지 않습니다.

스킨케어 혜택이 포함된 점은 감사하지만 시간이 지나도 피부가 크게 개선되는 점은 느끼지 못했습니다. 즉, 장미증과 습진이 발생하기 쉬운 피부를 가진 사람으로서 포뮬러는 부드럽습니다. 나는 자극, 민감성 또는 발적을 경험하지 않았는데, 이는 그 제형에 큰 영향을 미칩니다.

전반적으로, 이것은 중성 및 건성 피부 타입 또는 무거운 커버력보다 피부 건강과 자연스러운 광채를 우선시하는 빛나는 피부 우선 안색 제품을 찾는 모든 사람에게 아름다운 선택입니다.

headline: Looks great on skin!
comment:
This product was a gift from Gloss Angeles.

This is a great balm. As promised, its sheer and flexible to skin tone. So many products fail at this. At first, looking at it in the jar, I thought it would be too dark. After applying moisturizer I used a good amount of balm. It needs a minute to blend into your skin. The coverage is definitely sheer and it looks more natural than any other product I have used. I would prefer not to use any complexion makeup, but I have melasma that needs to be softened out. This face balm isn't trying to hide anything. Nice and natural. I don't believe it has changed my skin in any way. It does contain hydrating ingredients which makes it a great choice for my dry skin. The balm did feel good at the end of the day and didn't look or feel cakey even after applying sunscreen multiple times a day. That's amazing! I have a few tinted moisturizers that I will no longer use as this balm is so much better.

text_for_model: I'm so happy to have had the chance to test out this tinted face balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential. I've used and loved IT Cosmetics's CC cream in the past, but lately I've been gravitating towards lower coverage complexion products. It's been years since I've consistently used an all-over product like foundation, opting instead for spot coverage with concealer, but sometimes I still want a little something more. This balm checks off all the boxes for me! It's lightweight with sheer, yet buildable, coverage. author: Lindsay
headline: Miracle in a Jar!
comment:
I trialed this product for 4 weeks as part of Gloss Angeles Confidential. 

I was happy to see the packaging was a jar for ease of use and I don't feel I am leaving any product behind. I will be honest at first I found it challenging to use and get the right coverage. But patience is a virtue and I quickly learned that letting it settle on your skin before applying more is the best route. The lightweight formula goes on with ease and don't feel heavy. About week 3.5 I started to notice my skin look and feel firmer. I was happy with the buildable coverage and the finish was very natural.

author: Shay
headline: Amazing everyday balm
comment:
I got the opportunity to try this beautiful balm recently. I took it with me during my holiday travels as a replacement for my moisturizer and foundation. It looked great all day and night, both in person and in photos, every single day. 
The texture of this balm is silky and sheer with a little going a long way on application. It evens skin tone while beautifully masking texture, pores and slight imperfections. The skin loving addition of Hyaluronic acid, collagen and vitamin E keep it from settling in fine lines-regardless of if it's set or not- while also hydrating and plumping them. It blends perfectly with both cream and powder products without becoming cakey, separating or pilling. I absolutely loved this product and formula on my skin in the winter months and I'm excited to see how well it does during the summer!
