author: Jess
headline: your skin but better vibes
comment:
I was gifted this product via Gloss Angeles Confidential to test pre-launch. and honestly I didn't expect to love this product as much as I do

It's called a balm but it's extremely lightweight and skin-like. It meshes into the skin really well and you can barely tell it's makeup it just makes the overall appearance if your skin look nicer. It's the type of product you can wear with a face full of other makeup or even as the only makeup on your face (like sometimes wearing a base with more coverage and then no othe rmakeup looks weird on me lol)

It's lower coverage and somewhat buildable but don't expect medium/high coverage out of this. I typically only wear lighter coverage base products and concealers layered over it really nicely so I had zero issues with this. also for me it lasted longer than most light coverage base products but thinking maybe because it kind of sets down into the skinlike finish?

this is incredibly random and maybe niche but it sat on my nose well. many times base products look weird on my nose but this one truly just evened out the tone without looking like makeup (which i loved since i'm blowing my nose every 2 seconds this winter)

tldr; super lightweight and skinlike tint with a natural finish

headline: User Friendly, Incredibly Smooth!
comment:
I was lucky enough to use this product through the Gloss Angeles Confidential program, and am truly so impressed with this product! 

I am not a foundation wearer, I typically use a tinted sunscreen, so the idea of a coverage product had me slightly intimidated. However, from the first application alone, I realized this product was perfect for my light coverage, glowy look. I used a foundation brush to glide the product over my skin and automatically noticed a soft layer of product that enhanced my skins natural color while taking away any redness and discoloration. I first wore this product at night, and even in the dark there was a pretty sheen present on my face all night. Additionally, this product came off super easily upon removal with a cleansing balm. I will definitely be repurchasing for when I want to have a little extra coverage and softer looking skin!

저는 파운데이션을 바르는 사람이 아니고 주로 착색된 선크림을 사용하기 때문에 커버 제품에 대한 아이디어가 약간 겁이 났습니다. 하지만 첫 번째 사용만으로도 이 제품은 가벼운 커버력과 글로시한 룩에 딱 맞는 제품이라는 생각이 들었습니다. 파운데이션 브러시를 사용하여 피부 위에 제품을 미끄러지듯 바르자 부드러운 제품 층이 자동으로 발견되어 붉은기와 변색을 없애고 피부의 자연스러운 색상을 향상시켰습니다. 처음 이 제품을 밤에 착용했는데, 어두운 밤에도 밤새도록 얼굴에 예쁜 광채가 맴돌았습니다. 게다가 이 제품은 클렌징 밤으로 지울 때 아주 쉽게 벗겨졌습니다. 좀 더 커버력있고 촉촉한 피부를 원할 때 재구매 의사 있어요!

author: Kristen
headline: Found My New Complexion Product
comment:
As a busy mom who only has time for a very minimal face, I'm so happy this product exists! It's like nothing I've ever tried before. Goes on light, blends into your skin seamlessly and feels hydrating without being dewy (sorry not sorry, but I cannot pull off that look). It's definitely light coverage, but for me it's just the right amount. It took me a few tries to figure out application, but what works for me is picking up the product with a flat brush to apply, and then blending it with a sponge or foundation brush. It's just easy, effortless and wears great all day long. I'm obsessed. 

I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential for my honest review.

author: heike
headline: My new favorite
comment:
I absolutely love this product! I'm a huge skin tint lover and have tried so many over the years...I always found myself going back to my tried-and-true Glossier Skin Tint. But let me tell you, this sheer tint face balm is now my holy grail. The texture, the wear, and the way it looks and feels on my skin are pure perfection. I've never used anything quite like it. It's incredibly easy to apply and gives me just enough coverage for a healthy glow while evening out my redness...yet it still looks like my skin. It feels light and airy and lasts all day.
I truly can't say enough good things about this product. I'm obsessed, and this tint will forever be a staple in my makeup collection. Thank you so much, Gloss Angeles Confidential, for this opportunity!

author: Carolina
headline: Pleasantly surprised!
comment: I tried this product for over 30 days and did not use any other foundation or skin tint to see if the skincare benefits would be noticeable. I was skeptical when I saw the jar packaging because all other balms in jars I've tried in the past have all been disappointing - either too balmy and greasy, or too dry-looking and chalky. I was pleasantly surprised at how amazing this felt on my skin upon first application - very cooling and soothing, like a water cream. The coverage was not too sheer and not heavy. I was able to get a medium coverage using a brush and only needed to build it up with a second layer on my cheeks where I have some redness. For full glam days, I added some concealer and set lighly with powder (for the record, I'm 52 with combo skin). For everyday, I mainly just set my T-zone with powder. This skin tint worked well with both cream products layered on top as well as powder products. I noticed that my skin looked smoother and more radiant over the course of the month and looked forward to putting this product on my skin daily. I also noticed that when I took this makeup off, I saw a lot less clogged pores on my chin and nose, which are problem areas. I'm happy to have found a new favorite complexion product and will definitely re-purchase, though it seems that this jar will last me a very long time. I'm not sure that it would work on a very oily complexion due to the balmy feel and radiant finish. The only con is the glass packaging. I probably wouldn't travel with it.

author: Olivia
headline: Not for me, but for someone
comment: The idea behind this product got me really excited, but the execution just didn't do anything I needed. author: Veronika
headline: This product SHOCKED me
comment:
I received this product as part if Gloss Angeles Confidential. 

This product really shocked me! I was expecting it to transfer easily and not last all day because I have oily skin. But this balm went on so beautifully, and stayed put! When I hear the word 'balm' I tend to think of something thick that doesn't stay on the skin easily. But this product was thin (in a good way) and kept my skin hydrated all day without moving around.

As far as coverage, I was also very impressed! I would say this product gives light to medium coverage, dependent  on how much you use. I didn't expect that from something so thin and silky.

Regarding application, I found that the best way to apply to my face, was to use my fingers to pick it up and cover my face, and the news of beauty blender to even it out and give it a blurred look. 

Overall, I really loved this product and I will definitely buy when I run out!

author: Rachael
headline: Great for Sheer Coverage!
comment: I got to test out the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm, thanks to Gloss Angeles, and would recommend this to anyone who likes a sheer to light coverage finish.  This balm blends into the skin seamlessly and leaves a radiant finish that lasts all day.  I was very impressed with the wear!  I do have a lot of hyperpigmentation that I like to cover up, so this was a little too sheer for my everyday wear, which is why I only gave it 4 stars.  Also, because this balm does have a lot of skincare and is hydrating, you want to make sure you don't prep your skin with too many hydrating products beforehand, or it won't wear as well.  Overall, I do like how my complexion looked while wearing this product on days that I wanted a natural finish.  It's too soon to say if this balm has improved my skin with daily wear, but I do like the hydrating feel.  Although this won't be my go-to as I'll stick with my IT Cosmetics CC Cream, I will be recommending this to my friends who do love a sheer to light finish!

author: Kari
headline: Just the coverage i've been looking for
comment:
I'm so happy I had the opportunity to test this tinted face balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential - I LOVE it!! I previously used the CC+ cream for many years, but as I got older, the finish was heavier than I wanted for daily use. This new sheer tinted face balm is the perfect replacement - light coverage that felt fresh throughout the day, and still allowed my skin to shine through. I'm in my early 40s with combo, sensitive, acne-prone skin I found this product to be moisturizing without being too heavy, and it left a dewy finish. You can apply with your fingers or a brush (i preferred the brush), and a little goes a long way.

The flexible shade ranges worked well - both the lighter and darker shades blended in nicely and disappeared into my skin with no noticeable lines, which was surprising based on what the product looks like in the pot. I've tried a lot of tinted moisturizers in my search for lighter, sheer coverage that doesn't irritate my skin, and this is a new winner for me. I will definitely repurchase when I run out!

headline: Such a versatile product!
comment:
I was gifted this product by Gloss Angeles Confidential to review. 

This is my first product I've tried from It Cosmetics and it did not disappoint. This honestly feels like I'm putting on a moisturizer that just so happens to have pigment. I got to select 2 shades for my review: 110 Neutral and 125 Cool. I've played around with both in different ways. 110N is pretty close to a perfect shade match for me in the winter and 125C will be great for me in the summer. I've used 110N all over a few times and while a touch too light, it looked great with concealer, blush, bronzer etc. I've mixed the 2 shades to make a closer match to my neck and chest and it looked great that way as well. I've also used the light in the center of my face and the darker shade in the places I would use contour/bronzer and that also looked wonderful. 

While sheer is in the name, I found that it's more light instead of sheer in the coverage department and i could build it up in places I needed a little more coverage on the days my rosacea was flaring up, and it evened my skin out with no issues. I was also able to layer products on top with no pilling or texture issues with my skincare and sunscreen underneath. I have found that I like it best with a primer, setting powder and spray. But when it's set, it's not moving. I've loved the way my makeup has turned out using this as my base product every time I've used it. I didn't experience any skin sensitivities, breakouts, or reactions of any kind. And it really does play well with concealer and cream products. This product does remind me of the Loreal 4-in-1 tinted face balm, but I found that product didn't hold up as well on my combo skin even with primer and setting powder + spray. I did however notice that my skin was less redder than usual over time as I used this product and it didn't sink into fine lines or make them more pronounced. Will definitely be buying once I run out!

Background on my skin: I'm 35 with combo (normal/oily) and sensitive skin. I was diagnosed with rosacea a few years that I treat with maintenance IPL laser every year. I still can experience redness flares when I get overheated or eat overly spicy foods, and sometimes it'll just be that time of the month.
comment_ko:
나는 리뷰를 위해 Gloss Angeles Confidential로부터 이 제품을 선물 받았습니다. 

이것은 It Cosmetics에서 처음 사용해 본 제품인데 실망하지 않았습니다. 솔직히 말해서 우연히 색소가 있는 보습제를 바르는 것 같은 느낌이 듭니다. 저는 리뷰를 위해 110 Neutral과 125 Cool의 2가지 색상을 선택했습니다. 나는 두 가지를 다른 방식으로 가지고 놀았습니다. 110N은 겨울에 제게 완벽한 색상 매치에 꽤 가깝고, 125C는 여름에 제게 아주 좋을 것 같아요. 110N을 몇번 써봤는데 촉감이 너무 가벼워서 컨실러, 블러셔, 브론저 등과 잘 어울렸어요. 목과 가슴에 좀 더 잘 어울리도록 2가지 색상을 섞어서 사용해도 너무 좋았어요. 또한 얼굴 중앙에는 밝은 색상을 사용하고 컨투어/브론저를 사용할 부분에는 더 어두운 색상을 사용했는데 그것도 멋져 보였습니다. 

이름에는 쉬어(Sheer)가 있지만 커버력 부분에서는 쉬어(Sheer)보다는 더 가벼운 느낌이 들었고 주사비가 심한 날 좀 더 커버력이 필요한 부위에 바르면 문제 없이 피부가 균일해졌습니다. 또한 아래에 스킨케어와 자외선 차단제를 바르면 보풀이나 질감 문제 없이 제품을 위에 겹칠 수 있었습니다. 나는 프라이머, 세팅 파우더, 스프레이를 사용하는 것이 가장 좋다고 생각했습니다. 하지만 설정되면 움직이지 않습니다. 나는 그것을 사용할 때마다 이것을 기본 제품으로 사용하여 내 메이크업이 밝혀진 방식을 좋아했습니다. 나는 피부 민감성, 발진 또는 어떤 종류의 반응도 경험하지 못했습니다. 그리고 컨실러와 크림 제품과 정말 잘 어울립니다. 이 제품은 로레알 4-in-1 틴티드 페이스 밤이 생각나는데, 콤보 피부에는 프라이머와 세팅 파우더+스프레이를 사용해도 제품이 잘 견디지 못하는 것 같았습니다. 하지만 이 제품을 사용하면서 시간이 지나면서 피부가 평소보다 덜 붉어지고 잔주름이 옅어지거나 더 뚜렷해지지 않는다는 것을 알았습니다. 다 떨어지면 꼭 구매하겠습니다!

내 피부의 배경: 저는 35세 복합성(중성/지성) 피부와 민감한 피부를 가지고 있습니다. 저는 몇 년 동안 주사비 진단을 받았고 매년 유지관리 IPL 레이저로 치료했습니다. 과열되거나 지나치게 매운 음식을 먹으면 여전히 발적을 경험할 수 있으며 때로는 그 달의 시간이 될 것입니다.

author: Christina
headline: A natural finish option
comment: I received this product to try from Gloss Angeles but all reviews are my own. The IT Cosemetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm is the complete opposite of their famous bb and cc products. This product is exactly what the name says. It goes on very sheer and provides a light tint in a balmy formula. I would use this one when you want a very natural finish. It feels very lightweight and the color does a nice job of blending into your skintone without needing to be a perfect match in the jar. I would describe this as a glowy finish. I didn't want to put my brush into the jar so I used a makeup spatula to scoop some out on the lid and then used a brush to apply. I appreciate the 92% skincare ingredients but I wonder how much product you need to apply to receive enough of the skincare ingredients to make a difference . I have dry skin that turns oily as the day progresses. My usual multiple step skincare routine would cause this product to slip off my skin my mid-day even with setting powder or spray. In my opinion it lays best on skin skin with minimal product underneath. Unfortunately I did not notice any changes to my skin using this product. Overall this is a good product and nice option to have in IT Cosemetics foundation line.

author: Alyssa
headline: Obsessed!!

The texture makes it really easy to use and feels so innovative, making my skin look like its best self. author: ES
headline: skin care or makeup?
comment: I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles Confidential. I really enjoyed testing the product. I have fair/medium skin depending on the season. I tried fair warm 120 and light neutral 210. author: Princess3
headline: Soft Balm/Skin Tint
comment: At first the texture feels like a less dense and firm version of the Makeup by Mario Skin Enhancer, but once you apply it almost feels cool when it breaks on the skin and then acts more like the thin liquid skin tints on the market. I havent come across anything similar in this format. Much like other skin tints, applying with a brush can leave streaks from the brush strokes and can sit on top of the skin if you look closely, but it blends easily w/ fingers. I do wish this was packaged like a cushion compact so that it could be applied more seamlessly. The coverage is light, so you'll need concealer if you want to cover any darker spots, but would be fine on it's own otherwise. I like how moisturizing it feels, but because I use a lot of skincare for my dry skin, I noticed my makeup didn't always apply as nicely or wear as well. I suspect it would hold up well on it's own or with just a lightweight moisturizer or suncreen. While I won't reach for this on a night out, I will continue to use it for day-to-day as I enjoy the texture and easy application.  Full disclosure: this product was gifted to me from Gloss Angeles

author: Lauren
headline: Obsessed with this product!
comment: I was able to test out this product for the past month thanks to Gloss Angeles. I absolutely fell in love with this balm, and it has now become an everyday go-to that I wear by itself or layer with concealer when wanting more of a full coverage face. I love that it adds a sheer tint to even out my complexion and gives some coverage without feeling heavy. I didn't see a huge difference in any fine lines or wrinkles in terms of long-term skincare benefits, but it does give a smoother look when wearing the product. I have combo skin, and I loved that it was a hydrating formula and it didn't cling to any dry spots on my face, but I did have to add a bit of setting powder to my t-zone area. The only downside of this is the packaging and having to use your fingers to apply the product. I ended up using a beauty spatula to grab some out, and then applied it with a brush, and then blended with a sponge. I highly recommend this if you are looking for something new to try out for everyday wear that is lightweight still with coverage.

author: Marina
headline: It's fantabulous
comment: This product was gifted to me by It Cosmetics through Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for an honest review. I must say when I first read the description of this skin tint, I wasn't thrilled. I immediately thought it wouldn't work for me due to my oily skin. Well, the first time I wore it I was pleasantly surprised. I went in first with a thin spatula brush to apply it, which left the lightest of coverage I have ever used. That wasnt my favorite, so I added another thin layer and while still sheer coverage it was absolutely beautiful. Yes, it is very hydrating and did leave me shiny, but powdered down, left the most beautiful finish on my skin. And to my surprise, it held up all day! I thought that due to the texture and the skin care ingredients it might break down at some point, but no, it looked beautiful for 10+ hours. Now this may very well be due to it being winter time and even my very oily skin is a bit drier so I am curious to see how this will perform in the summer time. The only con for me is that I sometimes like to apply my foundation with my fingers and therefore the packaging is not my favorite as I have to dip my fingers in the tub. I did also pick up th product with a denser foundation brush and that gave me excellent medium almost full coverage. Honestly, I really do like this product as a foundation, HOWEVER, personally I didn't see much benefit in regards to the skin care claims. But considering I do not rely on make up/skin care hybrid products for the skin care benefits, even that doesn't knock a star off my review. I try to be very critical of the things I receive for free to review, and I very rarely give the free products five stars, but what can I say? IT Cosmetics really knocked it out of the park with this product. I will absolutely buy this once I run out. Though that may be a while as they so graciously gave us two shades to try and seeing as how the coverage is so sheer, the shades are very flexible and both worked for me.

IT Cosmetics는 이 제품으로 정말 획기적인 제품을 선보였습니다. 다 떨어지면 이거 꼭 사야겠습니다. 그들이 우리에게 두 가지 색상을 친절하게 제공하여 적용 범위가 얼마나 얇은 지 확인하기 때문에 시간이 좀 걸릴 수 있지만 색상은 매우 유연하고 둘 다 나에게 효과적이었습니다.
text_for_model: This product was gifted to me by It Cosmetics through Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for an honest review. I must say when I first read the description of this skin tint, I wasn't thrilled. I immediately thought it wouldn't work for me due to my oily skin. Well, the first time I wore it I was pleasantly surprised. I went in first with a thin spatula brush to apply it, which left the lightest of coverage I have ever used. That wasnt my favorite, so I added another thin layer and while still sheer coverage it was absolutely beautiful. Yes, it is very hydrating and did leave me shiny, but powdered down, left the most beautiful finish on my skin. And to my surprise, it held up all day! I thought that due to the texture and the skin care ingredients it might break down at some point, but no, it looked beautiful for 10+ hours. Now this may very well be due to it being winter time and even my very oily skin is a bit drier so I am curious to see how this will perform in the summer time. The only con for me is that I sometimes like to apply my foundation with my fingers and therefore the packaging is not my favorite as I have to dip my fingers in the tub. I did also pick up th product with a denser foundation brush and that gave me excellent medium almost full coverage. Honestly, I really do like this product as a foundation, HOWEVER, personally I didn't see much benefit in regards to the skin care claims. But considering I do not rely on make up/skin care hybrid products for the skin care benefits, even that doesn't knock a star off my review. I try to be very critical of the things I receive for free to review, and I very rarely give the free products five stars, but what can I say? IT Cosmetics really knocked it out of the park with this product. I will absolutely buy this once I run out. Though that may be a while as they so graciously gave us two shades to try and seeing as how the coverage is so sheer, the shades are very flexible and both worked for me.

headline: Nice product, but not great for my skin type
comment:
I was gifted this product as a power of Gloss Angeles and tested it over a few weeks. I liked it, but I didn't totally love it for my skin. My skin is fairly normal but slightly on the oily side but really temperamental. 

It looks really nice when you first apply it and blends easily, but on me it tended to slip around a bit and didn't last as long as I need it to throughout the day. I found myself needing touch-ups sooner than I'd like.

That said, I love the blush and bronzer from this same range and use both regularly, which is why I was excited to try this. Unfortunately, this one just wasn't quite right for me.

I think it could work well for someone with drier skin or if you're looking for something more lightweight for shorter wear days. Just not my favorite from the line, but still a nice formula overall! 

Thanks for the opportunity, Gloss Angeles!

author: Melody
headline: Pleasantly Surprised!
comment:
I was gifted the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential and got the chance to try out two shades, Fair Cool which was a perfect match and Light Neutral which was close and totally workable but is better suited to my summer skin tone. 

The balm is creamy and feels very hydrating before drying down nicely to a satiny finish with light/almost medium coverage. I can't say I noticed any obvious improvements in my bare skin, but when I was wearing the balm, my skin definitely looked smoother and plumper which seemed to hide some of my finer wrinkles. When I first started using the balm, I was worried that it wasn't for me because as much as I liked the smooth and even appearance after the immediate application, I found that it was slipping and sliding all over the place within an hour or two. Once I figured out the best application method for me (less is more…one or two swipes of a foundation brush to get it out of the pot, dab it on each area in my t-zone, then buff it out with a beauty blender),it applied beautifully and melted right in. I followed up with some setting powder/spray and it lasted all day with just a light touch up in the afternoon. 

My overall impression ended up being very positive and while I'm not sure that this will replace my "go to" foundation, I can honestly say that I've found myself reaching for it much more often than I expected. That being said, if I could change one thing, it would be the packaging…a pump or tube would be my preference as I really dislike having to dip brushes or my fingers in a pot of product.
comment_ko:
나는 Gloss Angeles Confidential을 통해 IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm을 선물로 받았고 두 가지 색상을 시험해 볼 기회를 얻었습니다. 완벽한 조화를 이루는 Fair Cool과 거의 완벽하게 사용 가능하지만 내 여름 피부 톤에 더 적합한 Light Neutral입니다. 

밤은 크리미하고 매우 수분을 공급하는 느낌이 들지만 가볍게/거의 중간 정도의 커버력으로 매끄럽게 마무리됩니다. 맨살에 눈에 띄는 개선이 있었다고는 말할 수 없지만, 밤을 바르고 나니 피부가 확실히 더 매끄러워지고 탱탱해져서 미세한 주름도 가려지는 것 같았습니다. 처음 밤을 사용하기 시작했을 땐 바르는 즉시 부드럽고 균일한 느낌이 마음에 들었으나 1~2시간 만에 여기저기 미끄러지며 미끄러지는 느낌이 들어서 제게 맞지 않을까 걱정이 되었습니다. 나에게 가장 적합한 적용 방법을 알아낸 후(적은 것이 더 중요합니다… 파운데이션 브러시를 한두 번 쓸어 냄비에서 꺼내어 T존의 각 부위에 두드린 다음 뷰티 블렌더로 닦아냅니다.) 아름답게 도포되고 바로 녹았습니다. 이어서 세팅 파우더/스프레이를 약간 발랐고 오후에 가볍게 터치하면 하루 종일 지속되었습니다. 

전체적인 인상은 매우 긍정적이었으며 이것이 나의 "go to" 파운데이션을 대체할지는 확신할 수 없지만, 예상했던 것보다 훨씬 더 자주 파운데이션을 찾았다고 솔직하게 말할 수 있습니다. 즉, 한 가지를 바꿀 수 있다면 포장이 될 것입니다. 제품 냄비에 브러시나 손가락을 담그는 것을 정말 싫어하기 때문에 펌프나 튜브를 선호할 것입니다.
text_for_model: I was gifted the IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential and got the chance to try out two shades, Fair Cool which was a perfect match and Light Neutral which was close and totally workable but is better suited to my summer skin tone. The balm is creamy and feels very hydrating before drying down nicely to a satiny finish with light/almost medium coverage. I can't say I noticed any obvious improvements in my bare skin, but when I was wearing the balm, my skin definitely looked smoother and plumper which seemed to hide some of my finer wrinkles. When I first started using the balm, I was worried that it wasn't for me because as much as I liked the smooth and even appearance after the immediate application, I found that it was slipping and sliding all over the place within an hour or two. Once I figured out the best application method for me (less is more…one or two swipes of a foundation brush to get it out of the pot, dab it on each area in my t-zone, then buff it out with a beauty blender),it applied beautifully and melted right in. I followed up with some setting powder/spray and it lasted all day with just a light touch up in the afternoon. My overall impression ended up being very positive and while I'm not sure that this will replace my "go to" foundation, I can honestly say that I've found myself reaching for it much more often than I expected. That being said, if I could change one thing, it would be the packaging…a pump or tube would be my preference as I really dislike having to dip brushes or my fingers in a pot of product.

author: taylor
headline: truly sheer
comment:
I'm not a huge fan of the tub packaging, but given the balm-like consistency, it makes sense. The texture is actually one of my favorite things about this product - it's whipped, glides beautifully on the skin, and feels very hydrating. It's not drying at all and gives a natural, healthy glow. If you apply too much, though, you might get shiny after a few hours of wear. 

That said, this is not a coverage product. If you're looking to cover blemishes or hyperpigmentation, you'll definitely need to pair it with a concealer. It provides essentially zero coverage, which is why the shades are very forgiving. The color looked like it wouldn't match me at all in the tub, but once blended out, it melted into my skin and looked good.

I do wish it included SPF, but that's not a dealbreaker. Overall, I'd recommend this to those with drier or more mature skin and minimal blemishes or pigmentation. For someone like me with combination, acne-prone skin and some scarring, it gives a nice glow, but it's not enough to be my everyday product.

This product was gifted to me by Gloss Angeles Confidential.
comment_ko:
나는 욕조 포장의 열렬한 팬은 아니지만 밤과 같은 일관성을 고려하면 의미가 있습니다. 질감은 실제로 이 제품에서 제가 가장 좋아하는 점 중 하나입니다. 휘핑되어 있고, 피부에 아름답게 미끄러지며, 매우 수분을 공급하는 느낌입니다. 전혀 건조하지 않고 자연스럽고 건강한 광채를 선사합니다. 하지만 너무 많이 바르면 몇 시간 착용 후 윤기가 날 수 있습니다. 

즉, 이 제품은 커버리지 제품이 아닙니다. 잡티나 과다색소침착을 커버하고 싶다면 반드시 컨실러와 함께 사용해야 합니다. 본질적으로 커버리지가 전혀 없기 때문에 색상이 매우 관대합니다. 욕조에 발랐을 때 전혀 안 어울릴 것 같은 컬러였는데, 바르고 나니 피부에 사르르 녹아서 좋았어요.

SPF가 포함되었으면 좋겠지만 그게 문제가 되는 것은 아닙니다. 전반적으로 피부가 더 건조하거나 성숙한 피부를 갖고 잡티나 색소 침착이 적은 분들에게 추천합니다. 나처럼 복합성, 여드름성 피부, 약간의 흉터가 있는 사람에게는 좋은 광채를 주지만 매일 사용하기에는 부족합니다.

이 제품은 Gloss Angeles Confidential에서 나에게 선물로 제공되었습니다.

author: Anne
headline: The Jury is still out
comment:
Thank you so much to the ladies at Gloss Angeles and iT Cosmetics for the opportunity to try this new launch. 
After first application I liked the product. It left my skin looking dewy. The coverage was nice and did cover what I wanted it too. I really liked how my skin looked. I did feel like it exasperated the wrinkles on my forehead, however.
 It makes my skin look healthy. I was also very lucky with the shade match. 125 Fair Cool was perfect for my light, pink undertone complexion.
I am really torn here, as much as I like how it looks on my skin, I don't feel like the balm ever dries down. Even with a bit of setting powder. If I touch my face, it wears off. It also moves with other makeup application like cream blush. It definitely transfers. I can see it getting on my clothes if I'm not super careful. Even blowing my nose removes the product. Setting spray did not keep it in place. 

 I like this to film content. It looks good on camera. I do not see me wearing it in other situations unfortunately. It also feels heavy on my skin. Not drying down significantly impacts wear time. Improving transfer resistance would make this product much stronger.

I like a lot about it, but I also dislike some things. I am going to keep using it, trying different setting powders could be an option. I have adjusted the amount I use and am still getting the transfer. It is a work in progress. I do think it is a great product to try. So, I would recommend it for that reason
comment_ko:
이번 신제품 출시를 체험할 수 있는 기회를 주신 Gloss Angeles와 iT Cosmetics의 직원분들께 진심으로 감사드립니다. 
첫 번째 적용 후 제품이 마음에 들었습니다. 그것은 내 피부를 이슬처럼 보이게 만들었습니다. 커버력도 좋았고 제가 원하는 부분도 커버해줬어요. 나는 내 피부가 어떻게 보이는지 정말 좋아했습니다. 하지만 이마의 주름이 더욱 심해지는 것 같은 느낌이 들었습니다.
 피부가 건강해 보이더라구요. 나는 또한 그늘 일치에 매우 운이 좋았습니다. 125 페어쿨은 밝은 핑크빛 언더톤인 제 피부에 딱 맞았습니다.
나는 이것이 내 피부에 어떻게 보이는지 좋아하는만큼 여기에서 정말 찢어졌습니다. 밤이 마르는 느낌이 들지 않습니다. 약간의 세팅 파우더를 사용해도. 얼굴에 닿으면 벗겨지더라구요. 또한 크림 블러셔와 같은 다른 메이크업 응용 프로그램과도 함께 움직입니다. 확실히 이전됩니다. 매우 조심하지 않으면 옷에 묻은 것을 볼 수 있습니다. 코를 풀기만 해도 제품이 제거됩니다. 스프레이를 설정해도 제자리에 유지되지 않았습니다. 

 나는 이것을 영화 콘텐츠로 좋아한다. 카메라에 잘 나오네요. 아쉽게도 다른 상황에서는 착용하는 모습을 볼 수 없습니다. 피부에도 무겁게 느껴지네요. 건조되지 않으면 착용 시간에 큰 영향을 미칩니다. 전사 저항을 개선하면 이 제품이 훨씬 더 강력해질 것입니다.

나는 그것에 대해 많은 것을 좋아하지만 어떤 점은 싫어합니다. 계속 사용할 예정인데, 다른 세팅 파우더를 사용해 보는 것도 하나의 선택이 될 수 있습니다. 사용금액을 조정했는데 아직도 이체중이네요. 진행중인 작업입니다. 한번 사용해볼만한 좋은 제품인 것 같아요. 그래서 그런 이유로 추천하고 싶습니다

author: Kristin
headline: A little goes a long way!
comment:
This product took me by surprise. Once I figured out the best way, for me, to apply it (with my fingers and buffed out with a foundation brush), I fell in love! I appreciated the flexible shade; I thought the color looked too warm in the jar but it ended up being a perfect match on the skin. The texture of the skin balm is so light and feels almost undetectable. It has a light, buildable coverage that evens out the skin with a natural finish. I have to keep testing longer to see if the skin claims are true, but my overall appearance looked healthy and radiant while wearing it.

I was gifted this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential.

author: Meg
headline: Interesting and Innovative Face Balm
comment:
I've been loving this Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for easy, low-effort days. The shades are adaptable and blend seamlessly into my skin for a natural, even look without feeling heavy. What really stands out is the cooling, balmy texture as it feels refreshing going on and melts right in, making it perfect when I want to get ready fast, cover redness, and keep my routine simple.

I was given the opportunity to test this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential and tested this during the winter and really liked how comfortable and hydrating it felt. I'm curious to see how it will perform once the hot, humid summer weather hits. That said, the lightweight feel makes me hope it won't look greasy or slick. I just require a light application of setting powder.

For the price, quality, and ingredient list, this feels like a great value, especially if you're into multitasking products that blur the line between skincare and makeup.
comment_ko:
저는 쉽고 간편한 일상을 위해 이 Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm을 좋아했습니다. 색상은 적응 가능하며 피부에 매끄럽게 혼합되어 무거운 느낌 없이 자연스럽고 균일한 룩을 연출합니다. 쿨링감과 산뜻한 텍스처가 눈에 띄는 점은 산뜻한 사용감과 바르자마자 녹아들어 빠르게 준비하고 싶고, 홍조를 커버하고, 일상을 심플하게 하고 싶을 때 딱이에요.

Gloss Angeles Confidential을 통해 이 제품을 테스트할 기회가 주어졌고, 겨울 동안 이 제품을 테스트해 보았는데, 편안하고 촉촉한 느낌이 정말 마음에 들었습니다. 덥고 습한 여름 날씨가 오면 어떤 성능을 발휘할지 궁금합니다. 즉, 가벼운 느낌 덕분에 기름지거나 미끄럽지 않을 것으로 기대됩니다. 저는 세팅 파우더를 가볍게 바르기만 하면 됩니다.

가격, 품질, 성분 목록에 있어서 이것은 매우 가치 있다고 느껴집니다. 특히 스킨케어와 메이크업 사이의 경계를 모호하게 만드는 멀티태스킹 제품을 사용하는 경우 더욱 그렇습니다.

author: Dakota
headline: Nice but not for me
comment: I was gifted the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential. I have normal to dry skin, and while the formula is lightweight, I found that it clings to texture and facial hairs no matter how I applied it—fingers, brushes, or a beauty blender. author: Bayleigh
headline: The perfect work from home makeup
comment:
I really liked this one. It goes on super easily, especially with a dense foundation brush, and gives a smooth, natural-looking finish.
That said—this is makeup, not skincare. Yes, it has skincare ingredients, and that's great, but let's be real: you're wearing this for light coverage, not as your main skincare step. I still want my vitamin C and sunscreen underneath. This is perfect for no-makeup makeup days, work-from-home life, or those "camera on, but keep it chill" moments. It evens things out just enough without looking heavy.
One thing to note, if you have very dry patches, it can cling to them a bit, so prep is key. On well-moisturized skin, though, it looks fresh and effortless.

I was gifted this product via Gloss Angeles and IT Cosmetics for my honest review of the product without any influence or bias.

The finish is worth it to overlook this!

author: Jennifer
headline: Your Skin, But Better!
comment: I really enjoyed this product. I really loved how easy it was to apply this, and the fact that there were several options to do so.  For the sheerest and most natural looking coverage, I opted to apply this with my fingers.  Coverage is buildable, so you can easily apply more in areas that may need a little extra coverage, with just a bit more product.  To start with a bit more coverage, but still a natural look, applying it with a foundation brush (one with loose bristles, not one that is too dense) worked very well.  I have been looking for an every day tint that does not contain sunscreen, and that doesn't require a ton of product.  This may just be the answer - I can easily apply with my fingers or a brush (for no mess) and get a very even application in no time.  This product was very creamy and moisturizing, which is great for my skin, which tends to be a bit more on the dry side.  The price point on this product is also great, especially given that you don't need a lot of product for your entire face.  I can't wait to tell my friends about this one.  Gifted by Gloss Angeles.

For the sheerest and most natural looking coverage, I opted to apply this with my fingers. Coverage is buildable, so you can easily apply more in areas that may need a little extra coverage, with just a bit more product. To start with a bit more coverage, but still a natural look, applying it with a foundation brush (one with loose bristles, not one that is too dense) worked very well. I have been looking for an every day tint that does not contain sunscreen, and that doesn't require a ton of product. This may just be the answer - I can easily apply with my fingers or a brush (for no mess) and get a very even application in no time. This product was very creamy and moisturizing, which is great for my skin, which tends to be a bit more on the dry side. The price point on this product is also great, especially given that you don't need a lot of product for your entire face. I can't wait to tell my friends about this one. Gifted by Gloss Angeles.

author: Nancy
headline: Fantastic Coverage Product
comment: I was a tester thru Gloss Angeles. I received two different colors. From the moment I put this on I loved everything about it. I used the lighter color for my under-eye area as a concealer. It goes on as smooth as a moisturizer. The coverage leaves a nice glow but not too shiny.  I am not 100% it is helping my fine lines but it definitely diminishes them when using. This product lives up to everything it claims to do. The product goes a long way when used with a brush. I found using fingers works well. Just use a little spatula so you don't contaminate product. I give it a 9 out of 10.

author: Kateryna
headline: Love it!

It looks like my skin but better and feels so hydrating on the face. It quickly became my favorite everyday foundation. I also like added skincare's ingredients. It's truly skincare and makeup innovation.

author: Rebecca
headline: Gorgeous texture and finish
comment: This is the perfect product for days I don't want a full face of makeup, but also want to look like I didn't just roll out of bed. I'm 50 with combo oily skin and the texture this has is unreal on my skin. It feels light and fluffy like whipped cream. It makes my skin look smooth and even with a really light coverage (it is buildable). I do feel like my skin texture and tone have been looking better since using this.

author: Laura
headline: I've Come Back To IT Cosmetics!
comment:
I used to wear IT Cosmetics all the time, but for some reason as I entered my 50's my skin changed and my trusted CC didn't look right. But this new Balm has brought me back!

I have normal/dry skin, texture, hyperpigmentation, redness…this Balm makes my skin look like my skin but GORGEOUS. Fresh and radiant- like I drank all the water and got all the sleep! 

I love that it has skincare in the formula, frankly for mature skin that is the gold standard.

For me, the best application is to use a compact kabuki brush and stipple into the skin. I don't need to set it, it stays put and doesn't crease. 

I highly recommend this if you love a natural finish to your makeup. I am thrilled to rediscover IT Cosmetics again!

*gifted by Gloss Angeles Confidential (opinion entirely my own)

저는 정상/건성 피부, 질감, 과다색소침착, 홍조를 가지고 있습니다. 이 밤은 제 피부를 제 피부처럼 보이도록 만들어 주지만 화려합니다. 물을 다 마시고 잠을 다 잤던 것처럼 상쾌하고 빛나네요! 

나는 그것이 황금 표준인 성숙한 피부를 위한 공식에 스킨케어가 포함되어 있다는 것을 좋아합니다.

나에게 가장 좋은 적용 방법은 컴팩트한 가부키 브러시를 사용하여 피부에 점을 찍는 것입니다. 고정할 필요도 없고 그대로 고정되어 주름도 생기지 않습니다. 

자연스러운 마무리 메이크업을 좋아하신다면 적극 추천해드려요. IT코스메틱을 다시 발견하게 되어 정말 기쁩니다!

headline: A great light coverage option

I wish it had sunscreen included since it bills itself as skincare. Also, for me, the shades just don't work for my skin tone. I tried 2 shades and both just left me looking too grey. This is unfortunate becuase i did love the product, but i don't see myself wearing unless i can get the shade match right. However, it is a great product otherwise!

author: Jessica
headline: Hydrating, cooling, weightless!
comment:
I was given the opportunity to try this product before its release through Gloss Angeles Confidential - and let me tell you, this was the toughest one to keep secret because I LOVE IT! After testing it for almost a month, I can confidently say that this is my new favorite base product.
After trying a few different ways of application, I found I preferred using a makeup sponge over my fingers or a brush. The formula applies like a dream and sets into the most lovely natural-but-hydrated finish that is the closest thing to "weightless" I've ever felt. I have found that it is fairly buildable by applying a second layer after the first sets in order to get a little more coverage, but if I have an active breakout I still need to go in with a concealer. I can imagine I might need to powder-set it in the summer, but have found that unnecessary in the drier months of winter - it keeps my skin looking and feeling hydrated & comfortable all day.
Lastly, I'm really impressed by the shades I received - 110 and 125 are true neutral & cool toned shades! My past experiences with ItCosmetics were of products that all ran warm on me, so this was a pleasant development. I am light and cool toned and have mainly used 125, but at my palest the 110 would also work.

몇 가지 다른 적용 방법을 시도한 후 손가락이나 브러시보다 메이크업 스펀지를 사용하는 것이 더 좋다는 것을 알았습니다. 포뮬러는 꿈처럼 적용되어 제가 느껴본 "무중력"에 가장 가까운 가장 사랑스럽고 자연스러우면서도 촉촉한 마무리감을 선사합니다. 좀 더 커버력을 높이기 위해 첫 번째 세트 후에 두 번째 레이어를 적용하면 상당히 빌드업이 가능하다는 것을 알았습니다. 하지만 활성 발진이 있는 경우에는 여전히 컨실러를 사용해야 합니다. 여름에는 파우더 세트가 필요할 수도 있지만 겨울의 건조한 달에는 필요하지 않다는 것을 알게 되었습니다. 하루 종일 피부를 촉촉하고 편안하게 유지해 줍니다.
마지막으로, 제가 받은 색상에 정말 감동받았습니다. 110과 125는 진정한 뉴트럴 & 쿨톤 색상입니다! ItCosmetics에 대한 나의 과거 경험은 모두 나에게 따뜻함을 주는 제품이었기 때문에 이것은 즐거운 발전이었습니다. 저는 가볍고 쿨톤이고 주로 125를 사용했지만, 가장 창백한 경우에는 110도 괜찮을 것 같습니다.

author: Nikki's
headline: Amazing!
comment: I was given the opportunity to test this product through Gloss Angeles Confidential. All testers were provided 2 shades, and honestly both worked great for me, which really speaks to the shade adaptability! This product has a creamy texture and is buildable, which is great for someone like me who has aging/combination skin and doesn't like the look or feel of heavy foundation. This product sat well all day on my skin and never showed signs of patchiness or dryness. I can't speak to the skincare benefits as I already have a pretty extensive skin care regime, but I had no negative side effects, so I consider that an added benefit. Overall I think this is a great product for all skin types, and for those who prefer lighter coverage. This will definitely be a repurchase for me!

author: Sarah
headline: Very nice complexion product for drier skin types
comment: Loved this product on my winter dry skin. It helped minimize texture and covered my redness and discoloration without feeling heavy. I don't see performance from it as a skincare but as a makeup with skin benefits it's very nice. I'd recommend it for low key makeup days or people who like less makeup looking makeup. Thank you glossangeles for the chance to test this product out.

author: Paige
headline: I Will Buy This Product Again and Again!
comment: The IT Cosmetics Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm product has been such a treat to test over the past several weeks, thanks to the opportunity from Gloss Angeles Confidential! I need to preface this review with a disclaimer that I am not a daily foundation wearer. I don't like applying makeup all over my face, so I usually stick to concealer and a light powder and save foundation for special events. This product has made a daily wearer out of me. I love love love the light, skincare-like formula. It provides just enough coverage so imperfections are minimized and my skin still looks like my skin. It gives a wonderful radiance without looking oily (a regular skincare concern of mine,) and I experienced no breakouts or adverse effects from using this. I've been combining two colors and would recommend others try this. The price is extremely fair for what you get!

The price is extremely fair for what you get!

headline: Lightweight skin tint with unique formula
comment: I received this product to try through gloss Angeles. This skin tint is packaged in a jar and has a unique texture. It almost melts in your fingers, making it easy to apply on. author: Elena
headline: I would repurchase this balm.
comment: This balm feels like a hidden gem for dry skin. It's rare to find a product that delivers real hydration and visible results, but this one did both. My skin looked smoother, my fine lines were less noticeable, and the glow lasted well into the day. The color is gorgeous, and the finish is effortlessly fresh. Definitely a repurchase.

comment_ko: 이 밤은 건성 피부에 숨겨진 보석 같은 느낌을 줍니다. 진정한 수분 공급과 눈에 띄는 결과를 제공하는 제품을 찾는 경우는 드물지만 이 제품은 두 가지를 모두 수행했습니다. 피부가 더욱 매끄러워졌고, 잔주름이 눈에 띄지 않게 되었으며, 광채가 하루 종일 잘 지속되었습니다. 컬러도 화사하고 마무리감도 산뜻해요. 확실히 재구매입니다.

author: Margaret
headline: Good, Solid Product
comment: I was gifted this product to review for IT cosmetics. Initially, I thought it felt too greasy on my already oily skin, but I have grown to really like the balm. Easy to apply and spread. It feels nourishing and like my skin is benefiting while wearing this balm instead of being suffocated by a thick foundation. I have been trying 2 different shades, and I am very impressed that both shades match my skin well. I do think it helps improve the appearance of my fine lines (which I discover more of every day 😩). Good price point, I would purchase and use this again.

author: Andrea
headline: Whipped texture that moves with your skin
comment: Was gifted through Gloss Angeles Confidential.  I use a brush to take it out of jar, tap all over clean and moisturized face then take a fluffy firm brush and tap to blend it all in. I found I didn't need hardly any concealer under eye because this coverage is so nice, doesn't sit in creases or flake off.  Gives skin a smooth, glowy but not shiny, even coverage.  I had given up on foundation because of trying to color match, there are so many shades and it was easy to find my color.  Jar is heavy and luxe feeling.  The claim is that it helps skin look bouncy and firm and stay moisturized.  I would say it definitely gives that appearance.  I had never tired IT before and now I want to try all the products.

author: Tee
headline: I'm in LOVE with this product, def buying again!!
comment:
I was gifted this product from Gloss Angeles confidential and I'm so happy I got to try it!
I loved mixing the two shades I got (medium neutral & medium warm) and it lasts all day! I'm a minimal makeup kinda gal so I would just do my skincare, add blush, mascara and lip gloss and this product was a perfect addition as it helped even out my skin tone and tie it all together 🥰
Even after washing it off, my skin feels so nice and radiant- so the skincare ingredients in it are definitely working for me!! 
Also I find it best to apply using my fingers.

headline: My New Holy Grail Product
comment: I love using this sheer complexion balm!! I typically gravitate towards tinted moisturizers or BB/CC creams, so this is a product I would find myself using daily. This sheer tint face balm gave my skin a natural glow without making my face look too oily. I also noticed that it evens out my skin tone too! I only applied powder on my T-zone after applying the balm as my skin is dry combination. I notice that this product gives softens lines and texture in my skin. It also provides extra moisture without making my face look too dewy. I will continue to use this product on a daily basis. Thank you Gloss Angeles Confidential for the opportunity to try out this product!

headline: Lightweight, natural, and easy to wear
comment: I tested this product through Gloss Angeles. The Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm feels super comfortable on the skin and gives a healthy, evened-out look without feeling heavy. Coverage is definitely on the lighter side, but that's exactly what I wanted—it's perfect for "your skin but better" days. Great for quick application, no-makeup makeup, and keeping skin looking fresh and hydrated.

author: Andrea
headline: Perfect Product for Dry, Millennial Skin
comment:
I haven't used IT Cosmetics since college, but I got the opportunity to try this new tinted skin balm through Gloss Angeles Confidential and wow — what a cool new product! 

I have dry, neutral/cool skin and could never use any of the brand's CC creams, but I LOVE this tinted balm. It's hydrating, the color is really adaptable, it gives a very sheer bit of color that really looks like skin. I've been applying this all over my face with my fingers and then going in with concealer under my eyes when I need a bit more coverage. It's perfect for running errands, heading to the gym, when you have three seconds before a Zoom call starts, etc. I would compare it to a tinted moisturizer. 

I'm so excited to see what IT Cosmetics does next! It looks like they already have a blush/bronzer in this product line, and I need to try that ASAP. 

One more note — I have super sensitive, dry, acne- and rosacea-prone skin. Everything breaks me out. This did not!! Truly a miracle. 💖💖

author: Jennifer
headline: Perfect coverage
comment: I have been testing the Do It All Sheer Tint Face Balm for the past month through Gloss Angeles. I was gifted two shades and both match pretty well. I have really enjoyed this product because it is easy to apply and has a great amount of coverage. I usually find that tints are too sheer for my skin.  I want some coverage for blemishes, etc. I have been applying it with a brush by stippling it on my face. It is easy to apply and goes on quick. I will definitely be buying the balm after I have used up the two I have, but it seems like a long lasting product.

author: Olivia L
headline: Beautiful, innovative product!
comment:
I received this product from the brand through Gloss Angeles Confidential in exchange for my honest review. 

Thank you to the brand and Gloss Angeles! 

My current favorite holy grail foundation, for comparison, is Glossier's Stretch Foundation. I also often use Glossier's Stretch Concealer in addition. I have dry skin with minor redness and under eye circles. 

When I received the product and saw the pot it was in - immediate Dream Matte Mousse vibes for this millennial. Honestly I was terrified! But that stopped when I opened it. This formula is creamy and lightweight! I used a medium-sized brush to apply and my Makeup by Mario F4 brush to blend. I cannot believe how easily it blended! It's definitely a light coverage formula, but it is easily buildable. It also played beautifully with my Glossier or Fenty concealer (only used to cover undereye and a little redness around my nose). I always set with a little powder under my eyes. This product looked great on me and lasted all day. I am so so so so thrilled to find this product!!!!

author: AnnaMaria
headline: Gives A Lovely Lasting Glow
comment: I have really been enjoying using this skin balm!   I like to apply it with my fingers.  When I rub the product onto my finger in the jar it has a melting fluid-like consistency.  It is so easy to apply and blend with my fingers.  The shade adapts to match my skin tone nicely.  I love the light coverage that is easily buildable.  I also love the lightweight feel.  It does not have a balmy sticky texture. It gives me such a nice glow without being over the top.  The glow and the finish hold up well throughout the day.  It layers nicely with skincare, sunscreen and other makeup.  It never looks cakey and it does not settle into lines or pores.  I love this product and highly recommend!  I received a free product in exchange for my honest review.

author: Alissa
headline: Beautiful with minimal prep
comment:
I was gifted this skin tint by the Gloss Angeles podcast. This formula truly acts like skincare. When I used it over heavy skincare or skin flooding, it felt greasy and caused my makeup to slip.

With minimal prep and sunscreen as my only base, it absorbed beautifully and blended seamlessly into my skin. The finish looked natural and healthy. I do wish it included SPF, as it would be the perfect all in one step

최소한의 준비와 자외선 차단제를 유일한 베이스로 사용하여 피부에 아름답게 흡수되고 매끄럽게 블렌딩되었습니다. 마무리는 자연스럽고 건강해 보였습니다. 한 단계에 완벽한 올인원 기능인 SPF가 포함되어 있으면 좋겠습니다.

headline: Really nice!
comment: I was gifted this from Gloss Angeles Confidential and I really enjoyed this tinted balm. I always choose something with light to medium coverage and this is just that. It's dewy and light and layers nicely over my skincare. I use a flat foundation brush to apply and then blend with a fluffy foundation brush. headline: It's good but…
comment: I think this product could be incredible, depending on what you're looking for. If you have dry or ageing skin, I think you'll love this. It's sheer but buildable, goes on hydrating and leaves a nice glow to the skin. For me personally, as someone with combo skin, it breaks apart and becomes oily way too easily, even with a primer and setting powder/spray. But if your skin is dry, it may be perfect to give your skin that extra glow. I will say, it's super sheer, which isn't a problem for me just something to note. It also gave me slight comedomes, but I am someone that frequently reacts to product with dimethicone, which this product has in one of the first few ingredients. I was gifted this by Gloss Angeles for my review.

author: Emma
headline: No breakouts?!?
comment:
Ive been using these pore pads for about 2 months now (2-3x per week) and im pmeasantly surprised with results! For reference, my skincare routine is MINIMAL due to my skin being acne-prone and panicky when new ingredients are introduced. I use a fragrance free moisuizing bar soap for cleansing (yes I know thats terrible, but "cleansers" cause breakouts on me), these pore pads, and a ceramide moisturizer before bed (still searching for a good one for long term use itherwise I'd list it here). After 3 uses of these pore pads, me and my husband both noticed a reduction in the prominance of my nose blackheads. After 2 months, I still feel like the blackheads and pores are shrinking, albeit VERY slowly. This was not an overnight success so know that you should try it for a long period befoe making a judgement. 

One thing I wish Id realized before starting use was that it really does need a moisturizer to follow it. The first two times I used it I didnt follow with a moisturizer and it dried my skin WAY out. But after pausing use and moisturizing for the  next few days I was able to restart using the pads (+ a moisturizer) without dryness. 

I am extremely prone to breakouts (one day of foundation and my clear skin is toast) and so my biggest concern was that this would break me out. It didnt. In fact, I've been using it to help clear breakouts caused by occasional makeup use. I do believe I'll be purchasing again.
comment_ko:
저는 이 모공 패드를 약 2개월 동안(주당 2-3회) 사용해 왔고 결과에 정말 놀랐습니다! 참고로 내 피부는 여드름이 생기기 쉽고 새로운 성분이 도입되면 당황하기 때문에 내 스킨케어 루틴은 최소한입니다. 나는 클렌징을 위해 무향 모이스춰라이징 바 비누를 사용합니다(예, 그게 끔찍하다는 건 알지만 "클렌저"는 나에게 여드름을 유발합니다), 이 모공 패드, 그리고 잠자리에 들기 전에 세라마이드 모이스처라이저(여전히 장기간 사용하기에 좋은 제품을 찾고 있습니다. 그렇지 않으면 여기에 나열하겠습니다). 이 모공 패드를 3번 사용한 후, 나와 남편 모두 코 블랙헤드가 눈에 띄게 줄어드는 것을 느꼈습니다. 2개월이 지난 지금도 블랙헤드와 모공이 아주 천천히 줄어들고 있는 것 같은 느낌이 듭니다. 이것은 하룻밤 사이에 성공한 것이 아니므로 판단을 내리기 전에 오랜 기간 동안 시도해야 한다는 점을 알아 두십시오. 

사용을 시작하기 전에 제가 깨달았으면 좋았을 점 중 하나는 실제로 사용하려면 보습제가 필요하다는 것이었습니다. 처음 두 번 사용했을 때는 보습제를 바르지 않았고 피부가 건조해졌습니다. 하지만 며칠 동안 사용을 중단하고 보습을 한 후 건조함 없이 패드(+보습제)를 다시 사용할 수 있었습니다. 

나는 여드름이 생기기 매우 쉬우므로(하루는 파운데이션을 사용하고 깨끗한 피부는 토스트입니다) 그래서 가장 큰 걱정은 이것이 나를 깨뜨릴 것이라는 것이었습니다. 그렇지 않았습니다. 실제로 저는 가끔씩 화장을 해서 생긴 트러블을 없애는데 도움을 주기 위해 사용해 왔습니다. 나는 다시 구매할 것이라고 믿습니다.

author: Jade
headline: MAGIC ERASERS
comment: I am a dr dennis gross peel pad girl. They are amazing! The price is not.. so i only buy them when they're on sale. I recently got a zo skin care kit which contained a 30 count of zo complexion renewal pads. They are also fantastic, but expensive and i cant cut them in half bc there isn't enough product on them. I have been seeing these medicube pads all over tiktok and i have tried and loved the medicube vitamin c pads and pdrn pads. I had horrible hormonal acne all over ny jawline, upper neck and chin before i got my hormones balanced (alani nu balance ladies- look into it im 40 and this changed my life) the acne was gone but i have so many red spots left from the acne. I used one of these pads ONE TIME and the next morning the spots were like 4-5 shades lighter! Like pale pink. There is so much liquid on these you can definitely cut them in half to double them, thats what i did! I have so far used them twice and ran here to leave a review. I have very dry skin and these didnt dry me out, i didnt break out. My husband used them too and he did have 2 new breakouts but he never washes his face so its purging from either the pads or him just simply washing his face. If you have any dark spots, PIH/PIE.. buy these! They may not get as deep down as dr dennis gross pads or zo complexion renewal pads but for the price they are amazing!

author: Wrinklesbegone
headline: DO NOT USE DAILY
comment: Be sure to test on a small area if you have sensitive skin. This product works effectively when used correctly, but it's important to do thorough research before trying it. The instructions recommending daily use are misleading; your skin needs a natural barrier to stay healthy, which includes dead skin cells. Although it may sound counterintuitive, maintaining this balance is crucial. Over-exfoliating can cause significant damage to your skin and undo the benefits you're aiming for. Personally, I recommend using it every two to three nights to avoid irritation and support skin health.
comment_ko: 피부가 민감한 분은 반드시 작은 부위에 테스트해 보세요. 이 제품은 올바르게 사용하면 효과적으로 작동하지만, 사용하기 전에 철저히 조사하는 것이 중요합니다. 매일 사용을 권장하는 지침은 오해의 소지가 있습니다. 피부를 건강하게 유지하려면 죽은 피부 세포를 포함한 자연적인 장벽이 필요합니다. 반직관적으로 들릴 수도 있지만 이러한 균형을 유지하는 것이 중요합니다. 과도한 각질 제거는 피부에 심각한 손상을 초래할 수 있으며, 원하는 효과를 무효화할 수 있습니다. 개인적으로는 자극을 피하고 피부 건강을 돕기 위해 2~3일에 한 번씩 사용하는 것을 추천합니다.

author: Nina
headline: works great but beware if you have sensitive skin
comment:
I do think this product works as advertised and does clear up blackheads and exfoliates. However, I did not realize until after purchasing that this product contains 7 different flower extract oils which are essentially fragrance oils. I have rosacea and it caused a flare up.

I usually know to avoid anything that has "fragrance" listed as an ingredient but I did not realize until after buying this product that all of those flower and plant extract oils also have fragrance and can cause irritation if you have sensitive skin. I've given this to my mom to use and she thinks they work great, but she has normal mature skin. Sensitive skin friends please be careful!

author: Sophia
headline: The best chemical exfoliator I have ever used
comment: I used to have glass skin in previous years, but 2025 was my worst year yet. I am confident that this product will give me the glass skin I once used to have. I have tried many exfoliators: 2% bha bottles, mandelic acid, and some by mi pads. These pads are the best by far. The lactic acid in these medicube pads is extremely hydrating and gentle, and the bha percentage in these is at a low enough concentration to use more frequently than a 2% bha brand. headline: give it time!

I use these as a first step after cleaner every night. I really scrub with them. they leave a sticky residue behind, but after following it with my ampoule, acne treatment and moisturizer, that tacky feeling is gone. it does still leave me with a very shiny appearance, which is why I use these at night before bed. it's completely gone after washing my face next morning. though it's an exfoliant, it's incredibly gentle and I've never had any sensitivity to it. all in all, this product has given me so many benefits and I'll definitely be re-purchasing.

I have tried everything aside from going to a dermatologist, which I had planned to do in 2026, but I might not need to after using these! I use one every morning and every night after washing my face. My skin texture has become more smooth, the rosacea bumps are gone, and even my redness is going away. I don't want to say they are a miracle but after trying tons of products and nothing seems to work, they feel like one! I haven't experienced any sensitivity and it seems like my skin has been less oily too? Which is amazing! I don't experience any tacky or sticky feeling left over, just let your face dry for a few seconds after use and move to your next step. My routine is simple too, so I haven't had issues with product interaction. If you have skin like mine - very oily all year round with bumpy rosacea that can create dry patches or acne like bumps - I would give these a try. I genuinely feel so good in my skin and I haven't for so long.

headline: Acne prone girlies beware

I saw many online reviews for this saying its amazing for clearing acne. This did the OPPOSITE for me. 

I have sensitive, combo, acne prone skin and this breaks me out badly, not only on my face, but also my body. I'm a I fitzpatrick skin type. I cannot use this at all!

I did enjoy the packaging though. It comes with built in plastic tweezers to help you grab the pad which is a really nice touch!

Not perfect yet but I trust with continued use I am on my way. I was using the pore pads twice a day but I have scaled back to just once per day.

author: Wolfie
headline: Great as deodorant
comment: I use this on my face, bikini area, and underarms. I dont notice it doing much on my face, but its a great daily exfoliant after waxing. author: Terry
headline: Holy grail
comment:
I have mild to moderate keratosis pilaris (KP) on my thighs and upper arms, and The Ordinary's Glycolic Acid has honestly been amazing. I noticed improvement within 24 hours, which really surprised me. After about three applications over about 4 days, the texture and appearance on my thighs improved significantly. Since I see my thighs more often than my upper arms, the changes there were especially noticeable.

I almost never write reviews for products, but this one truly impressed me. It's quickly become a holy grail product in my routine. If you struggle with KP and are looking for something to help smooth the skin's texture and appearance, this has been a game changer for me.
comment_ko:
저는 허벅지와 팔뚝에 경증에서 중등도의 모공각화증(KP)이 있는데, The Ordinary의 Glycolic Acid는 솔직히 놀라웠습니다. 나는 24시간 이내에 개선을 느꼈고 정말 놀랐습니다. 약 4일에 걸쳐 3회 정도 도포한 후 허벅지의 질감과 모양이 크게 개선되었습니다. 저는 팔뚝보다 허벅지를 더 자주 보는 편이라 특히 허벅지의 변화가 눈에 띄더라구요.

나는 제품에 대한 리뷰를 거의 작성하지 않지만 이 리뷰는 정말 인상 깊었습니다. 그것은 내 일상에서 빠르게 성배 제품이 되었습니다. KP로 인해 어려움을 겪고 있고 피부의 질감과 외양을 부드럽게 만드는 데 도움이 되는 제품을 찾고 있다면 이 제품이 제게는 획기적인 변화가 되었습니다.

headline: Way too harsh
comment: This exfoliating toner is WAY too harsh for my fair, sensitive, so what pale skin. Applied via cotton round, IMMEDIATELY noticed redness and string stinging and burning. I was trying this out instead of ising their salicylic acid serum, which I like but was seeking something more effective to gently exfoliate; physical exfoliants are typically too harsh for my face.

I have had issues with alot of closed comedones around my chin; after consistently using this product it will open them up where I can clear the blackhead underneath, it also leaves my skin very soft. Do not overuse this as it can burn and damage your skin barrier but starting a few times a week and gradually increasing, my skin loves it and has grown very tolerant to it. Its a much more even exfoliation than a physical exfoliate. Would highly recommend. Even when having active breakouts, it seems to calm everything down when used in moderation. I can also use this on my elbows where I have KP and under my arms and it will keep my armpits from smelling. All in all a holy grail product for me.

author: msturtley
headline: Good product but please do some research
comment:
Hello Everyone! 
I don't write reviews often but love to read them. I felt compelled to write one on this product to add some information to be cautious of before using. 
I have combination dry skin and a bit of texture and hyperpigmentation (PIH). I wanted to start using this Glycolic Acid to help with that. 
The few things to understand, this is a very concentrated high percentage product and should be used in moderation and cautiously. 
Start with once a week for the first 3-4 weeks, then increase to twice a week (IF NECESSARY). Know that this product WILL cause purging (breakouts in certain areas), that can sometimes last from 2-8 weeks. Please do your research on the differences between purging and a skin reaction (purging is Usually localized to the areas you normally get acne and not all over your face/body part). Avoid contact with the eye area at all cause, by rinising your hands after. I like to apply eye cream before so i dont touch my eyes at all after. 
You MUST have a clean and completely dry skin before applying AND wait for it to fully dry down 15-30+ mins after. 
This product takes time to work and its not for everyone so please do some research and consult with a doctor if you are able. I am on week 9 and barely starting to see my skin calm down a bit. But ive seen it work wonders on my friends so i am sticking with it! Over all, i really do think it is workimg for me, hope this helps!
comment_ko:
안녕하세요 여러분! 
나는 리뷰를 자주 쓰지 않지만 읽는 것을 좋아합니다. 사용하기 전에 주의해야 할 몇 가지 정보를 추가하기 위해 이 제품에 대해 글을 써야겠다는 생각이 들었습니다. 
저는 건성 피부와 약간의 질감 및 과다 색소 침착 (PIH)이 복합되어 있습니다. 나는 이를 돕기 위해 이 글리콜산을 사용하기 시작하고 싶었습니다. 
이해해야 할 몇 가지 사항은 이 제품이 매우 농축된 높은 비율의 제품이므로 적당하고 조심스럽게 사용해야 한다는 것입니다. 
처음 3~4주 동안은 일주일에 한 번으로 시작한 다음 일주일에 두 번으로 늘립니다(필요한 경우). 이 제품은 퍼징(특정 부위에 발진)을 일으킬 수 있으며 때로는 2~8주 동안 지속될 수 있다는 점을 알아두세요. 퍼지와 피부 반응의 차이점에 대해 조사해 보십시오(퍼징은 일반적으로 얼굴/신체 부위 전체가 아닌 일반적으로 여드름이 발생하는 부위에 국한됩니다). 어떠한 경우에도 눈 부위와의 접촉을 피하고, 사용 후에는 손을 헹구십시오. 저는 아이크림을 바르기 전에 바르는 걸 좋아해서 후에는 눈을 전혀 만지지 않아요. 
적용하기 전에 깨끗하고 완전히 건조한 피부를 가져야 하며, 적용 후 15-30분 이상 완전히 마를 때까지 기다려야 합니다. 
이 제품은 작동하는 데 시간이 걸리며 모든 사람에게 적합한 것은 아니므로 조사를 해보고 가능하다면 의사와 상담하십시오. 저는 9주째인데 피부가 조금 진정되는 것을 거의 보기 시작하지 않았습니다. 하지만 내 친구들이 놀라워하는 걸 본 적이 있어서 계속 사용하고 있어요! 전반적으로, 나는 그것이 나에게 효과적이라고 생각합니다. 이것이 도움이 되기를 바랍니다!

author: Jalps
headline: works well, but be cautious
comment:
Pretty sure there is a warning on this bottle to patch test before lathering on your entire face. I have used multiple times behind my neck and it cleans out my skin. It is a bit sensitive on my face and neck. So you need to be careful with any products you use. The ingredient literally says ACID! What do people think, it is gentle? it has some type of active ingredients to fight what it is designed to do. a
And compared to what another glycolic acid wash this one is by far gentle. I have used some stuff given by my dermatologist that is very harsh and if not used properly can damage your skin. So read and do your research before applying any products. Just because things are OTC doesn't mean they cannot be just as strong as what a dermatologist can prescribe. Some of these reviews are shocking to see how people use it everyday...yeah maybe they can use it everyday. But each person is different, for me I would only use maybe 1 or 2 times a week and that too only on the back of my neck and under arms. Face and neck skin is super sensitive...so think before dumping the whole product onto your face. It is a solid product but needs to be used cautiously.

headline: Dry scalp/Dandruff

author: SkincareAddict
headline: Great for Seborrheic Dermatitis!
comment:
To remove most severe dandruff or SebDerm from scalp in one day: 

• Saturate your scalp with this 4-6 times in 24 hours, so your scalp and roots are constantly wet with toner

• Thoroughly scrub your scalp with lots of your strongest dandruff shampoo in the shower for several minutes

• Rinse well, condition, rinse. Ta-da!
comment_ko:
하루 만에 가장 심한 비듬이나 SebDerm을 두피에서 제거하려면: 

• 24시간 동안 4~6회 두피를 충분히 적셔주어 두피와 모근이 토너로 지속적으로 젖어 있도록 합니다.

• 몇 분 동안 샤워하면서 가장 강한 비듬용 샴푸를 듬뿍 사용하여 두피를 철저히 문지릅니다.

• 잘 헹구고, 컨디셔닝하고, 헹구십시오. 짜잔!

Ta-da!

author: Brooky
headline: Love!
comment: I've been using this product for at least five years now and I swear by it!  You have to start slow—especially if you have sensitive skin.  It can sting a little, depending so use with caution until you know how you react.  I had to build up a tolerance, but now I use it  daily.  It brightened my dark spots, smoothed uneven texture, and cleared my acne.  I also think its an anti-aging hero.  I'm 34 years old and my skin looks great without expensive treatments.  I highly recommend but again, start slow.  And wear SPF protection if you're going to be in the sun a lot.

author: BearyNice
headline: Sadly not for me
comment:
I have tan combination skin with an oily t-zone, and while it works slowly to smooth my skin it causes me postinflammatory hyperpigmentation. Causing my dark spots to turn bright red and become darker after using it. This was very discouraging and made me insecure. However another exfoliate by the Ordinary (aha 30%+BHA 2% peeling solution) worked for me. 
However all skins and bodies are different, and while this didnt work for me its may work for you, the products are cheap enough that it never hurts to experiment.

그러나 모든 피부와 신체는 다르며 이것이 나에게는 효과가 없었지만 귀하에게는 효과가 있을 수 있습니다. 제품은 실험해 보는 데 결코 해를 끼치지 않을 만큼 충분히 저렴합니다.

author: TyLa
headline: Using on my scalp!
comment:
I decided to do a little research and see if this product would be safe to use on my scalp.. 

I use a lot of medicated shampoos and lotion treatments because I have an overproduction of oil and yeast that will spread across my scalp and cause extreme dandruff. Absolutely giant flakes. 

I hop in the bathtub with dry hair, I massage it into my scalp and leave it for about 10 to 15 minutes. 
I rinse it out with cool water and then add my anti-dandrith over the counter Nizoral shampoo to my scalp and leave it for about another 15 minutes. 
"Really scrub the scalp with the shampoo" 

I condition the ends of my hair and brush the conditioner throughout but never letting the conditioner near my scalp I did this 3 times in two weeks to get control of my scalp and it has been a huge improvement! 

Going forward I may try this remedy once a week and see how it works. 

I would say this product is very versatile!
comment_ko:
이 제품이 제 두피에 사용해도 안전한지 조금 연구해 보기로 했어요.. 

나는 두피 전체에 퍼지고 극심한 비듬을 유발할 오일과 효모가 과잉 생산되어 있기 때문에 약용 샴푸와 로션 트리트먼트를 많이 사용합니다. 정말 거대한 조각입니다. 

마른 모발에 욕조에 뛰어들어 두피에 마사지하고 10~15분 정도 방치합니다. 
시원한 물로 헹구고 비듬방지제인 니조랄 샴푸를 두피에 바르고 15분 정도 더 방치합니다. 
"정말 샴푸로 두피를 문질러주세요" 

머리 끝 부분을 컨디셔닝하고 컨디셔너를 전체적으로 브러싱하지만 컨디셔너를 두피 근처에 두지 마십시오. 두피를 관리하기 위해 2주에 걸쳐 이 작업을 3번 수행했는데 엄청난 개선이 있었습니다! 

앞으로는 일주일에 한 번씩 이 치료법을 시도해 보고 효과가 있는지 살펴보겠습니다. 

이 제품은 정말 활용도가 높다고 할 수 있어요!
text_for_model: I decided to do a little research and see if this product would be safe to use on my scalp.. I use a lot of medicated shampoos and lotion treatments because I have an overproduction of oil and yeast that will spread across my scalp and cause extreme dandruff. Absolutely giant flakes. I hop in the bathtub with dry hair, I massage it into my scalp and leave it for about 10 to 15 minutes. I rinse it out with cool water and then add my anti-dandrith over the counter Nizoral shampoo to my scalp and leave it for about another 15 minutes. "Really scrub the scalp with the shampoo" I condition the ends of my hair and brush the conditioner throughout but never letting the conditioner near my scalp I did this 3 times in two weeks to get control of my scalp and it has been a huge improvement! Going forward I may try this remedy once a week and see how it works. I would say this product is very versatile!

headline: Worked great on my armpits & scalp!
comment:
I had a bottle of this forever, but it didn't do much for my face, so it kind of sat in the corner of my bathroom. 
Then I started using it after I shaved my armpits and it really helps keep ingrown hairs away and evened out my skin tone. My favorite use of this product though, came after finding out it can be used on the scalp. I have tried so many different products for YEARS to help my itchy scalp and this works wonders! author: Rachel
headline: Skin improved in just days!
comment:
I am a chronic picker and have KP on my arms. I've been picking and scratching at my arms for years which has caused some scarring and constant scabs/new bumps etc. I have tried everything from body washes, physical exfoliation, lotions, serums etc and barely see any results. In most cases it makes my KP worse and clogs my pores which just makes me pick even more.

I bought this since it was recommended to me sooo much online... I applied it on my arms after a shower and the next day saw IMMEDIATE improvement. Less red, no irritation, no new bumps... I've used this for almost a week now and I am EXTREMELY IMPRESSED!!!!

No new KP bumps, less redness, and even my pores look smaller. My arms almost look normal now 😭 I could cry with how happy I am with this product. I have never had anything work out this well and so fast before.

I haven't applied any lotion on my arms but they're baby smooth now and look moisturized. I cannot recommend this enough to chronic skin pickers like myself (see a bump, feel a bump, squeeze & pick)... there is nothing TO pick anymore. 

I use it once a night before I go to bed on clean skin with no other product.
comment_ko:
나는 만성적인 선택자이고 KP를 팔에 안고 있습니다. 나는 몇 년 동안 내 팔을 따고 긁어서 약간의 흉터와 지속적인 딱지/새로운 돌기 등을 일으켰습니다. 바디 워시, 물리적 각질 제거, 로션, 세럼 등 모든 것을 시도했지만 거의 결과를 보지 못했습니다. 대부분의 경우 이는 내 KP를 악화시키고 모공을 막아 더 많은 것을 선택하게 만듭니다.

온라인에서 너무 추천을 받아서 구매했습니다... 샤워 후 팔에 발랐더니 다음날 즉시 효과가 나타났습니다. 붉은기가 덜하고, 자극이 없고, 새로운 돌기가 없습니다... 저는 이것을 거의 일주일 동안 사용해 보았는데 정말 감동받았습니다!!!!

새로운 KP 돌기가 없고, 붉은기가 덜하며, 모공도 더 작아 보입니다. 이제 내 팔은 거의 정상처럼 보입니다. 😭 이 제품에 얼마나 만족하는지 눈물을 흘릴 수도 있습니다. 나는 이전에 이렇게 빠르고 잘 해결된 일을 본 적이 없습니다.

팔에 로션을 전혀 바르지 않았는데 지금은 아주 매끄럽고 촉촉해 보이네요. 나처럼 만성적인 피부 선택자(뭉침을 보고, 눌림을 느끼고, 쥐어짜고 따는 행위)에게는 이것을 충분히 추천할 수 없습니다... 더 이상 고를 것이 없습니다. 

다른 제품 없이 깨끗한 피부에 밤에 잠들기 전 1번만 사용하고 있어요.

headline: Holy Grail Toner.

After realizing my skin barrier was damaged and building a solid skincare routine, i finally decided to try it again. I use it 2-3x a week on my face while alternating days with a SA cleanser. author: Chelsea
headline: Unexpected deodorant alternative!
comment: I purchased this product about 2.5 years ago and only used about a 3rd of it. As far as a facial exfoliant, I personally find more success with physical exfoliants and BHAs. HOWEVER, I've struggled with strong body odor in my armpits most of my adult life. I really don't produce much sweat but it just always has a strong smell. If I don't put on deodorant after showering before bed, I'll wake up the next morning with my armpits smelling like I just finished a workout. I've heard about using AHAs as an alternative and I had this in my collection so I gave it a try. WOW what a difference! My armpits smell like nothing in the mornings now. I can't believe how well this works! Probably not the review you were looking for, but I'd highly recommend anyone struggling with body odor to give this a try! 100% I'll be repurchasing this when I run out.

author: Allie
headline: Irritated my sensitive skin/scalp
comment: Like most other people, I've seen this product all over my TikTok FYP and had to try it out for myself. I have dandruff on my scalp and textured skin on my face from years of acne (and prob my genetics as well). I've had great success from other AHAs before, and from so many good reviews of this product I figured it would be safe to try. I used it on my face and scalp, and unfortunately my skin didn't like it at all. It gave me some dry patches on my face particularly around my nose, cheeks, and mouth areas. It also made my dandruff significantly worse after applying it to my scalp, massaging it in for ~15 minutes, and thoroughly washing it out. If you have sensitive skin, this might not be the product for you.

author: Venus
headline: For the TikTok and curious Peeps!!
comment: I originally saw someone talking about this product on TikTok. They were saying how good it is for scars, strawberry legs, and dandruff, as well as acne. I have always been one to use ordinary products so I thought I would give it a shot because I have really bad strawberry legs and really pink scars on my legs as well. I have been using this for about 2 weeks everyday and I can already see my scars lifting and my red bumps are getting better! I have also been using it on my acne and it has helped it did break me out at first until my skin got use to it but my skin does that with every skincare product. I have lessened my skincare routine to simply washing and using this then putting moisturizer on and my skin looks so healthy!! I also add a shea butter lotion to my scars after the exfoliater dries down. I would highly suggest reading the description that Ordinary had for this product before buying it so you know if it will hurt your skin or help you. I wouldn't recommend this if you have sensitive skin as it will most likely burn, especially if you're not okay with that all the exfoliaters that I have tried have but this one didn't unless it was on freshly shaved skin with open cut. I still have a ton of product left and I use it daily so I would say that it's a good price and it's worked for me! So if you'd like to lighten scars or get rid of strawberry legs I def recommend this product!! But please do give it time to work they aren't instantly going to go away but they do start to lighten fast!!

author: Destiney
headline: PLEASE READ!!!
comment:
So I LOVE The Ordinary products! I use their puffy serum as well as the hair thickening and hyaluronic acid ones. Because of this I decided to get this glycolic acid and well let's just say…it makes my face very sticky no matter what I do. There is no direction on how to use this besides "use after cleansing" especially for those who use face serum and moisturizer like me!! My face is a neutral skin type. It has its days.. some days are more oily and some days it's just dry so I always use my ordinary face serum and my hydration cream. 
•First I cleaned my face, applied my moisturizer, then my serum, then this glycolic acid and it made my face STICKY. 
•Next day I tried something different. I cleaned my face, applied face serum, then the acid, then the moisturizer and my face was STICKY 
•Next day I tried cleaning my face, adding the acid, then my serums, then moisturizer and well…it was less sticky than before but still sticky. 
Idk if it is just my face type or the skin care products I use…but the ones I use are The Ordinary brands so… 
I'm just saying, before you buy this make sure you know the steps on what to apply first, how to apply it, and if the brands of serum, moisturizer, or whatever you use will mess with the results of this brand. 
*my face does feel super smooth in the morning after I was my face. It's just at night when I apply this on is when it gets very sticky
comment_ko:
그래서 저는 The Ordinary 제품을 좋아해요! 나는 퍼피 세럼뿐만 아니라 모발을 두껍게 하는 세럼과 히알루론산 세럼도 사용합니다. 이 때문에 나는 이 글리콜산을 구입하기로 결정했고, 뭐... 내가 무엇을 하든 내 얼굴을 매우 끈적하게 만듭니다. 특히 저처럼 세럼이나 보습제를 사용하시는 분들을 위해 "세안 후 사용" 외에는 사용법에 대한 안내가 없습니다!! 내 얼굴은 중성 피부 타입이에요. 그런날이 있더라구요.. 어떤날은 기름기가 많고 어떤날은 건조해서 항상 일반 세럼과 수분크림을 사용하고 있어요. 
•먼저 세수를 하고 모이스처라이저를 바르고 세럼을 바르고 글리콜산을 바르는데 얼굴이 끈적거렸습니다. 
•다음 날 나는 다른 것을 시도했습니다. 세수하고 세럼 바르고 산 바르고 보습제 바르고 얼굴이 끈적거렸어요 
•다음 날 세안을 하고 산, 세럼, 모이스처라이저를 바르고 음...전보다 덜 끈적였지만 여전히 끈적했습니다. 
제 얼굴형인지, 스킨케어 제품인지는 모르겠지만… 제가 쓰는 제품은 The Ordinary 브랜드라서… 
나는 단지 이것을 구입하기 전에 먼저 적용할 단계, 적용 방법, 그리고 세럼, 모이스처라이저 또는 사용하는 브랜드가 이 브랜드의 결과를 망칠 것인지에 대한 단계를 알고 있다는 것을 말하고 싶습니다. 
*얼굴을 바르고 나면 아침에 얼굴이 매우 매끄러워지는 느낌이 듭니다. 밤에 바르면 엄청 끈적거려요

headline: BUY!! BUY!! BUY!!
comment: I saw this product on a Tik Tok and the girl used it as deodorant. I thought no way but I'm so happy I was wrong. I was willing to test it because it is affordable and apparently useful for other skin issues so I'm sure it wasn't going to go to waste. I do recommend to exfoliate your under arms before completely cutting out deodorant. I use an antibacterial soap in the shower so I feel like that makes a huge difference. I saw a lot of comments from sensitive skin people saying they had issues and I too have sensitive skin (I can't use anything scented) but like I said I think the antibacterial soap is the key.

headline: Works for me!
comment: I am pretty pale naturally, so my skintone gets very red & uneven in the colder months when I dont have a more tan complexion. I used this product once one night before bed after my usual skin care routine & the next day I had already seen a difference in the complexion of my skin. It was very relaxed & rejuvenated looking. The only con for me was the dryness. I immediately use the Neutrogena hydro boost moisturizer after I apply before bedtime & that balances out the con of the product. I dont like how it applies to my cotton ball, you must be careful that the product goes directly onto the cotton ball otherwise you waste product bc it beads off quickly. I wish this product pumped out, but i will take my few cons for the pros! It's affordable as well. I will be using this product in my routine every night.
