author: Xanna
headline: My holy grail
comment:
I LOVE this product. I dont know what I would do without her!! I am 21 years old, I have skin that is easily allergic to a lot of products, and have rosacea. I also get extremely dry skin year round that cracks and starts to burn. I have tried lathering myself in aquaphor and many different moisturizers but nothing works like this product. I put her on and she is ready to put makeup over in less than 3 minutes, and she doesn't cause my makeup to pill, which I love because both this moisturizer and my bb cream are water based. On my no makeup days, I only need to apply her once in the morning, and in the past I would need to reapply moisturizers almost 3 times a day. Like I mentioned above, I struggle with redness in the cheek area from rosacea and have noticed that going down signifigantly since I started using this product. It is so calming, hydrating, easy to use, and really lives up to its name. The only con is how expensive it is but it is definently worth it to claim any sales going on to give her a try! 
I don't know how my skin lived before this product!!

author: JazzyP
headline: Over hyped pore clogger

I'm not sure what the hype is about. There's nothing hydrating about this for me. Just pimples. I would recommend the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion+ or Dramatically Different Hydrating Jelly. These feel way more natural, hydrating and my skin isn't gross after using them.

author: Emily with Eczema
headline: NEVER STOP SELLING THIS!!!!
comment: Best moisturizer I've ever used in my entire life. I've been putting this on twice a day for about 2 years now, once before doing my makeup in the morning and once after washing my face at night. My (previously) dry, eczema-prone skin feels as though it has been magically healed and my skin has never looked, or felt, better than it does now! The formula soaks in so nicely, it does not feel thick or sticky (some of the other Clinique products do feel sticky, but not this one!). Clinique, there have been other products of yours that I loved, and to my devastation you've discontinued them (RIP perfectly real foundation - I miss you!) so PLEASE do not discontinue this product. I haven't found anything else like it. Even the other "moisture surge" products aren't as good - the overnight mask is sticky and the spray smells weird. THIS particular formula though, I LOVE. I've spent a lot of money on this product, for myself and as gifts for my friends, and will continue to do so as long as you keep offering it.

(이전에) 건조하고 습진이 생기기 쉬운 피부가 마법처럼 치유된 것처럼 느껴지고 피부가 지금보다 좋아 보이거나 느껴진 적이 없습니다! 포뮬러가 너무 잘 흡수되어 두껍거나 끈적이는 느낌이 들지 않습니다(다른 크리니크 제품 중 일부는 끈적이는 느낌이 들지만 이 제품은 그렇지 않습니다!). 크리니크, 제가 좋아했던 다른 제품이 있었는데 안타깝게도 귀하는 그 제품을 단종했습니다(완벽하게 진짜 파운데이션을 찢으세요 - 보고 싶어요!). 그러므로 이 제품을 단종하지 마십시오. 나는 그것과 같은 다른 것을 찾지 못했습니다. 다른 "습기 급증" 제품도 그다지 좋지 않습니다. 오버나이트 마스크는 끈적거리고 스프레이 냄새가 이상합니다. 하지만 이 특별한 공식은 정말 마음에 듭니다. 나는 이 제품을 위해 나 자신을 위해 그리고 친구들을 위한 선물로 많은 돈을 썼고, 여러분이 이 제품을 계속 제공하는 한 계속해서 그렇게 할 것입니다.

author: ChaosButCute
headline: Favorite Moisturizer
comment:
If you're considering this moisturizer, get it now and let your skin thank me later! This is my essential, go to moisturizer. I've tried tons (I do a lot of product testing) of products, and this one has remained my favorite. My skin loves it. It's softer, smoother, and overall more vibrant when I use this. 

This is non-greasy, doesn't cause shine, and is lightweight. It doesn't clog my pores. I don't have acne prone skin; however, the wrong moisturizer definitely causes my skin to breakout. It's one of the only things that does this to me. Whenever I try a new moisturizer and start to have a break out, I switch back to this one from Clinique, and within days my breakout clears up. 

I have combination skin, with typically more dry skin around my cheeks and chin, and oily in my t-zone. 

There is no heavy fragrance in this. I find it quite pleasant actually. I'm extremely hyper-sensitve to smells, so I'm very picky about it. 

More recently, my husband ran out of his moisturizer so he tried mine. He has acne prone sensitive skin. After a couple days he asked me to buy him some because his skin felt so much better after using this moisturizer. It's worth every cent, and for a quality moisturizer, it's pretty reasonably priced compared to similar options. 

I highly recommend this moisturizer!
comment_ko:
이 보습제를 고려 중이시라면 지금 구매하시고 나중에 피부에 감사 인사를 전하세요! 이것이 나의 필수품입니다. 보습제를 사용하세요. 나는 수많은 제품을 시험해 보았지만(많은 제품 테스트를 수행함) 이 제품이 여전히 내가 가장 좋아하는 제품입니다. 내 피부는 그것을 좋아합니다. 이것을 사용하면 더 부드럽고 매끄러워지며 전체적으로 더 생기가 넘칩니다. 

끈적임이 없고 윤기가 나지 않으며 가볍습니다. 그것은 내 모공을 막지 않습니다. 나는 여드름이 나는 피부가 없습니다. 그러나 잘못된 보습제를 사용하면 확실히 피부가 트러블이 생길 수 있습니다. 그것은 나에게 이런 일을 하는 유일한 일 중 하나입니다. 새로운 모이스처라이저를 사용하다가 트러블이 생기기 시작할 때마다 크리니크에서 이 제품으로 다시 바꾸면 며칠 내에 트러블이 사라집니다. 

저는 복합성 피부인데, 일반적으로 볼과 턱 주변은 더 건조하고 T존은 지성입니다. 

여기에는 무거운 향기가 없습니다. 실제로는 꽤 즐거운 일이라고 생각합니다. 저는 냄새에 굉장히 예민해서 냄새에 굉장히 까다롭거든요. 

최근에는 남편이 모이스처라이저가 다 떨어져서 제 제품을 사용해 봤습니다. 그는 여드름이 나기 쉬운 민감한 피부를 가지고 있습니다. 며칠 후 그는 이 보습제를 사용한 후 피부가 훨씬 좋아졌다고 해서 좀 사달라고 요청했습니다. 모든 센트의 가치가 있으며 고품질 보습제의 경우 유사한 옵션에 비해 가격이 상당히 합리적입니다. 

이 수분크림 정말 추천드려요!

author: Missanthrope
headline: Buyer beware
comment: While I tried the other moisture surge without aloe, I didnt have any reaction but a week after using this specific one, I started to have red, raw and itchy, dry flaky and scaly patches on my skin. Now about $200 and a dermatologist later, I found out this product gave me eczema on my eyes, cheek and jawline. I don't have a history of eczema in my family or myself and don't have sensitive skin so this reaction was a tough one. Not saying it won't work for everyone, judging by the reviews many people have success with it because everyones skin is different but just be super aware of your skin as it can take awhile for a rash to show up.
comment_ko: 알로에 없이 다른 수분 서지 제품을 사용해 보았지만 아무런 반응이 없었습니다. 그러나 이 특정 제품을 사용한 지 일주일 만에 피부에 붉고, 가렵고, 건조하고 벗겨지고 비늘 같은 반점이 생기기 시작했습니다. 지금 약 200달러 정도 하고 나중에 피부과 전문의에게 문의한 결과, 이 제품이 내 눈, 볼, 턱선에 습진을 일으켰다는 사실을 알게 되었습니다. 나는 가족이나 나 자신에게 습진 병력이 없으며 민감한 피부를 가지고 있지 않기 때문에 이러한 반응은 힘들었습니다. 모든 사람에게 효과가 없을 것이라는 말은 아니지만, 리뷰에 따르면 모든 사람의 피부가 다르기 때문에 많은 사람들이 성공했다고 판단하지만 발진이 나타나는 데 시간이 좀 걸릴 수 있으므로 피부에 대해 잘 알고 있어야 합니다.

author: Carrie
headline: My favorite moisturizer
comment:
Since moving to Arizona, and turning 30, my skin has become very dry. I was struggling with severe dry patches on my cheeks. I was on the hunt for a product that was heavy on the moisturizing but light and comfortable enough to wear during the daytime. It glides on easily and doesn't leave my face feeling greasy or sticky. It's not thick, so you can easily layer it with other skincare products, SPF or makeup. 

The moisture surge moisturizer has helped a lot with dryness. After a shower when the skin on my face is feeling tight and uncomfortable, the moisture surge moisturizer instantly soothes and refreshes my skin.  
My face becomes glowing and hydrated. 

I have noticed I occasionally still struggle with dryness in some stubborn small spots, but the overall appearance and feel of my skin is better after applying the moisture surge. 

I plan to try the moisture surge intense or the moisture surge concentrate for the extra dry patches I still struggle with.

애리조나로 이사오고 30살이 되면서 피부가 많이 건조해졌어요. 나는 뺨에 심한 건조 반점으로 어려움을 겪고있었습니다. 보습감은 무겁지만 낮에 바르기엔 가볍고 편안한 제품을 찾던 중이었어요. 쉽게 미끄러지며 얼굴이 기름지거나 끈적거리는 느낌을 남기지 않습니다. 두껍지 않아 다른 스킨케어 제품이나 SPF, 메이크업과 함께 레이어링하기 쉽습니다. 

수분 서지 모이스처라이저가 건조함에 많은 도움을 줬어요. 샤워 후 피부가 당김과 불편함을 느낄 때, 수분 서지 모이스처라이저가 피부를 즉각적으로 진정시키고 상쾌하게 해줍니다.  
내 얼굴이 빛나고 수분이 공급됩니다. 

가끔 완고한 작은 부분이 여전히 건조함으로 인해 어려움을 겪고 있다는 것을 알았습니다. 그러나 수분 급증을 적용한 후 피부의 전체적인 모양과 느낌이 더 좋아졌습니다. 

나는 여전히 어려움을 겪는 여분의 건조한 패치를 위해 수분 서지 인텐스 또는 수분 서지 농축물을 사용해 볼 계획입니다.

author: Bri
headline: Gave me whiteheads

After a year of trying to figure it out, I stopped using this product and immediately saw my skin get better... This gel was clogging my pores and I had no idea. I was a loyal customer but now I will never buy this product again.

author: AntyAcrylatesMom
headline: Beware Acrylates!
comment: Unbelievable this product is advertised as dermatologist recommended. My daughter was having eczema all over her face and we were told that Clinique is a great line. She splurged on Clinique and the problem was not resolved. We ended up doing the full panel of skin allergies and my daughter tested very positive for all acrylates on the test. author: JJ
headline: Not great for dry, sensitive skin
comment: I've been using retinol and salicylic acid for about a month to treat acne and fine lines, so my already dry skin is extra dry and a little flaky. I was layring my usual moisturizers with success, but I thought I would try this when it came bundled with the makeup remover I like. I used it last night layered under an occlusive. It seemed to soak in well and did not pill like their Redness Solutions moisturizer. However, I woke up with tight, dry, slightly itchy skin. As others have mentioned, it may not be good for sensitive skin, and I would not recommend it for extra dry skin.

author: Bronwyn
headline: Not moisturizing for very dry skin, caused rosacea flare
comment: I love Clinique and have been using them for 20 years, so when my old moisturizer was discontinued, I switched to this one without a second thought. I haven't changed any of my makeup or skincare products at all in the last 2-3 years, so I know it had to be this product. It's nowhere near as moisturizing as the old product, and has a strange jelly texture that doesn't feel nearly as moisturizing as a cream does, and has a cooling sensation similar to products with alcohol. This item might be fine for someone with normal or possibly oily skin but if you are very dry, I wouldn't recommend it. My rosacea flared up after years of calm, my cheeks are tender, my entire face peeled in tiny flakes the next day. and the lines under my eyes are much more crepey. I gave this two stars because I switched to using it on my neck and hands at night and that hasn't caused any issues, and it might just be an ingredient my skin doesn't agree with. For my face I switched to Paula's Choice skin recovery hydrating mask and it's been working better for very dry skin. I still recommend Clinique for their makeup and eye cream, though as that's never caused me any problems!

text_for_model: I love Clinique and have been using them for 20 years, so when my old moisturizer was discontinued, I switched to this one without a second thought. I haven't changed any of my makeup or skincare products at all in the last 2-3 years, so I know it had to be this product. It's nowhere near as moisturizing as the old product, and has a strange jelly texture that doesn't feel nearly as moisturizing as a cream does, and has a cooling sensation similar to products with alcohol. This item might be fine for someone with normal or possibly oily skin but if you are very dry, I wouldn't recommend it. My rosacea flared up after years of calm, my cheeks are tender, my entire face peeled in tiny flakes the next day. and the lines under my eyes are much more crepey. I gave this two stars because I switched to using it on my neck and hands at night and that hasn't caused any issues, and it might just be an ingredient my skin doesn't agree with. For my face I switched to Paula's Choice skin recovery hydrating mask and it's been working better for very dry skin. I still recommend Clinique for their makeup and eye cream, though as that's never caused me any problems!

author: K.S
headline: Do NOT purchase
comment:
Got this as a gift at Ulta for my birthday month. Unfortunately there was such a long line when i was choosing and i chose quickly. When i went home i noticed some bad ingredients. And then scanned the product with a skin care app. BHT is one of the ingredients and its an allergen, endocrine disruptor (on thyroid function also affects sex hormones and may affect fertility and development) , and pollutant. The ECHA also has reported toxicity to the liver, kidneys, lungs, and blood in rats. 
Could not return or exchange since i used it. 
But be aware!
comment_ko:
이것은 내 생일 달에 Ulta에서 선물로 받았습니다. 아쉽게도 선택할 때 줄이 너무 길어서 빨리 선택했어요. 집에 가보니 안 좋은 성분이 몇 개 있는 걸 발견했어요. 그런 다음 스킨 케어 앱으로 제품을 스캔했습니다. BHT는 성분 중 하나이며 알레르겐, 내분비 교란물질(갑상선 기능에 있어서 성호르몬에도 영향을 미치고 생식력과 발달에 영향을 미칠 수 있음) 및 오염물질입니다. ECHA는 또한 쥐의 간, 신장, 폐 및 혈액에 대한 독성을 보고했습니다. 
사용 후 반품이나 교환이 불가능합니다. 
하지만 알아두세요!

author: Aimee
headline: My skin loves it!
comment: I very seldom post any reviews but this product deserves all the credits.  I am post menopausal and dont enjoy makeup or lots of products on my skin and had not found any other product that would absorb quickly and show immediate relief to the dryness on my face. I have now used this product for over a year (got a sample from ulta which is why I tried it in the first place) and I absolutely love it.  People often ask me what have I done to my face because of less noticeable wrinkles and the skin looks supple. I hope they never change this product because it is just perfect.

author: Trina
headline: Good but doesn't work great with my other products
comment: Pros & Cons to this product. It does absorb well and feels great when proper amount is applied, however, be cautious about applying too much. Applying more to try to accomplish ultimate hydration will cause the product to feel greasy. Your skin only absorbs so much. Also, it does not work well with my "The Ordinary" serums. Not sure why but it tends to remove film after I've applied my serums even after giving time for my serums to absorb and because of that I stopped using it and won't purchase again. If it worked with my other products I would purchase again but my orher products work great and have to stick with them over this.

author: Sam H
headline: Surprised
comment: I'm 28, I think of clinique as an old lady brand. they don't really stick out to me EXCEPT the 100 hour moisture surge moisturizer. okay yall did something with this. I use cerave foaming cleanser for Oily skin and azelaic acid 15% and this moisturizer 2x a day. morning and night. this moisturizer gave my skin a nice glow and keeps it hydrated without being oily. I don't wear make up so I can't say how it sits under make up but I can say I experience no pilling. I have oily sensitive acne prone skin that also has rosacea and I feel like this has helped alot. if you're on the face I'd recommend the trial size but I truly think this is a moisturizer to try for combination/ oily skin types I find it's very light so dry skin types may not like it

author: Camila
headline: A Must-Have for Lasting Hydration
comment:
I've been a loyal Clinique customer for over 22 years, and without a doubt, the Moisture Surge 100H Auto-replenishing Hydrator is my absolute favorite product. As someone with a minimalistic skincare routine, I appreciate products that are both effective and easy to use, and this hydrator fits the bill perfectly.

Since incorporating Moisture Surge into my daily regimen, my skin has never looked better. It feels incredibly hydrated and looks healthy and radiant all day long. The lightweight gel-cream texture absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, making it perfect for layering under makeup or wearing alone.

This hydrator truly delivers on its promise of long-lasting moisture. I love that it not only provides immediate hydration but also helps my skin retain moisture throughout the day. It's a game-changer, especially for someone like me who prefers a straightforward, no-fuss approach to skincare.

Thank you, Clinique, for creating such a fantastic product. Moisture Surge 100H Auto-replenishing Hydrator has become an essential part of my skincare routine, and I can't recommend it enough!

저는 22년 넘게 Clinique의 충성스러운 고객이었으며, 의심할 여지 없이 Moisture Surge 100H Auto-replenishing Hydrator는 제가 가장 좋아하는 제품입니다. 최소한의 스킨케어 루틴을 따르는 사람으로서 저는 효과적이고 사용하기 쉬운 제품을 높이 평가하며, 이 하이드레이터는 딱 들어맞습니다.

Moisture Surge를 일상 생활에 적용한 이후로 피부가 좋아진 적은 단 한 번도 없습니다. 엄청나게 수분이 공급되어 하루 종일 건강하고 빛나게 보입니다. 가벼운 젤-크림 텍스처가 잔여감 없이 빠르게 흡수되어 메이크업 아래 레이어링하거나 단독으로 사용하기에도 좋습니다.

이 하이드레이터는 오래 지속되는 수분 공급을 약속합니다. 즉각적으로 수분을 공급할 뿐만 아니라, 피부가 하루 종일 수분을 유지하도록 도와주는 점이 마음에 듭니다. 이는 특히 스킨케어에 대해 간단하고 번거롭지 않은 접근 방식을 선호하는 저와 같은 사람에게는 획기적인 것입니다.

이런 환상적인 제품을 만들어주신 크리니크에 감사드립니다. 모이스처 서지 100H 자동 보충 하이드레이터는 내 스킨케어 루틴의 필수 부분이 되었고, 아무리 추천해도 지나치지 않습니다!

author: Nichole
headline: A Waste Of Money
comment: I had a small sample size container and months later purchased the full size tub. The sample was not used everyday and so I did not experience the same results as I did with the full size. I stopped using this because I began to experience a strange rash on my stomach that I wasn't sure what caused it. Since I use an exfoliating cloth everyday because I'm prone to breakouts on my chest and back, this cream left an heavy waxy film everywhere I applied it and it was very difficult to scrub off. When I got in the shower, the water was beading up on my legs because of the wax in this cream. I could not feel the waxy texture when I applied this so I was confused as to what was causing the rash. It smells good, rubs in well but it's not worth the price. The photos on the company website and Ulta are very misleading. Directional lighting and photos takes at different angles give the appearance of positive results. I don't recommend.

author: nds00
headline: Awful Company - Do Not Support
comment: I got the Maelys body butter in August after having a baby in July. I didn't realize that when you buy the product, it automatically signs you up for a monthly refill on the product which is ridiculous. I got charged another 55 dollars in September for the product without realizing. I reached out to Maelys customer service about it & they told me that I couldn't get refunded for it because their products ship pretty quickly but that they would cancel my monthly subscription so that I wouldn't get charged again or receive any more products. Come to find out, they didn't actually cancel my subscription and I got charged AGAIN for October for a product that I don't even need. I haven't even opened the 2nd one that I got in September & still have an abundance of product from the first one I originally got. Now customer service doesn't want to get back to me.. all I heard via email AGAIN was that they were sorry to see me go & they would cancel my subscription. Just to log into my account & still be subscribed. Really unprofessional & borderline fraudulent. They clearly do not care at all about their customers & are only looking to put money in their pockets. I get mistakes happen but don't tell your customers multiple times that their subscription will be canceled & then not actually do anything about it & keep charging them.. so disappointing & I'm honestly disgusted. & The only reaosn Im leaving this review on Ulta is because when I try to leave a review on their website, it gets deleted & all you see are the 5 star reviews. Product is okay at best, so not worth the headache.
comment_ko: 7월에 아이를 낳고 8월에 Maelys 바디버터를 받았습니다. 제품을 구매하면 해당 제품에 대한 월별 리필이 자동으로 등록된다는 사실을 몰랐습니다. 말도 안 되는 일이죠. 9월에 나도 모르게 해당 제품에 대해 55달러가 추가로 청구되었습니다. Maelys 고객 서비스에 연락했는데 제품이 꽤 빨리 배송되기 때문에 환불을 받을 수 없지만 다시 청구되거나 더 이상 제품을 받을 수 없도록 월간 구독을 취소하겠다고 말했습니다. 알고 보니 그들은 실제로 내 구독을 취소하지 않았으며 나에게 필요하지도 않은 제품에 대해 10월 요금이 다시 청구되었습니다. 9월에 받은 2번째 제품도 아직 개봉하지 않았는데, 처음 받은 제품이 아직 많이 남아있습니다. 이제 고객 서비스는 나에게 다시 연락하고 싶어하지 않습니다. 이메일을 통해 다시 들었던 것은 내가 가는 것을 보고 안타까워하며 내 구독을 취소하겠다는 것뿐이었습니다. 내 계정에 로그인하고 계속 구독하려면. 정말 비전문적이고 경계선에 가까운 사기 행위입니다. 그들은 분명히 고객에 대해 전혀 신경 쓰지 않고 단지 주머니에 돈을 넣기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 실수가 발생하는 경우가 있지만 고객에게 구독이 취소될 것이라고 여러 번 말한 다음 실제로 아무 조치도 취하지 않고 계속 요금을 청구하지 마세요.. 너무 실망스럽고 솔직히 역겹습니다. & 제가 Ulta에 이 리뷰를 남기는 유일한 이유는 제가 그들의 웹사이트에 리뷰를 남기려고 할 때 그것이 삭제되고 당신이 볼 수 있는 것은 별 5개 리뷰뿐이기 때문입니다. 제품은 기껏해야 괜찮으므로 두통을 겪을 가치가 없습니다.

author: Valerie
headline: Horrible Product and Company
comment:
I had a terrible experience with Maëlys. I requested a refund well within their 21-day money-back guarantee after having an allergic reaction, but their customer service delayed responses until the deadline passed and then denied my refund. They finally issued a return label after 10 PM on Memorial Day, when USPS was closed, making it impossible to meet their requirements. I returned the products in good faith but never received my money back.

I filed a complaint with the BBB and submitted clear evidence showing I contacted Maëlys multiple times within the refund period. Their response completely disregarded the documentation I provided, which seems to be part of a pattern. After looking into it, I saw that hundreds of other customers have reported similar experiences with delayed responses, poor communication, and difficulty obtaining refunds.

I will never purchase from this company again, and I strongly caution others to avoid them. Their return policy appears misleading and unfair, and their customer service is dismissive at best.
comment_ko:
나는 Maëlys에 대해 끔찍한 경험을 했습니다. 알레르기 반응이 발생한 후 21일 환불 보장 기간 내에 환불을 요청했지만 고객 서비스는 마감일이 지나갈 때까지 응답을 지연한 후 환불을 거부했습니다. 결국 USPS가 문을 닫는 현충일 오후 10시 이후에 반품 라벨을 발행하여 요구 사항을 충족할 수 없게 되었습니다. 선의로 제품을 반품했지만 돈을 돌려받지 못했습니다.

BBB에 불만 사항을 접수하고 환불 기간 내에 Maëlys에 여러 번 연락했음을 보여주는 명확한 증거를 제출했습니다. 그들의 반응은 내가 제공한 문서를 완전히 무시했는데, 이는 패턴의 일부인 것 같습니다. 조사한 결과, 수백 명의 다른 고객이 응답 지연, 의사소통 불량, 환불 받기 어려움 등 유사한 경험을 보고한 것을 확인했습니다.

나는 다시는 이 회사에서 제품을 구매하지 않을 것이며 다른 사람들에게도 이러한 제품을 구매하지 말라고 강력히 경고합니다. 그들의 반품 정책은 오해의 소지가 있고 불공평한 것처럼 보이며 고객 서비스는 기껏해야 무시적입니다.

author: Boo14
headline: On the Fence
comment:
I had hopes, despite very mixed reviews on all their products. Anything found on social with a subscription will get a double take from me and a ton of recs in order to purchase, especially at $50. 

Because I somehow got old, just wait, it happens and feels like you blinked and it's here....my skin has aged and I lost a chunk of weight fairly fast....left me with some sagging, crepey skin. 😫 I'll try anything that WORKS. Or helps. This did neither, just had a nice bedtime smell. On the fence to try another round. I see the Booty tight reviews are even worse. on the fence....
comment_ko:
모든 제품에 대한 매우 엇갈린 리뷰에도 불구하고 나는 희망을 품었습니다. 구독을 통해 소셜에서 찾은 모든 항목은 특히 50달러에 구매하기 위해 저와 수많은 추천을 받게 됩니다. 

왜냐면 내가 늙었으니까, 잠깐만요, 눈을 깜박이면 여기 있는 것 같은 느낌이 들죠.... 피부가 늙어가고 살이 상당히 빨리 빠졌어요.... 피부가 약간 처지고 주름진 느낌이 들었습니다. 😫 효과가 있는 것은 무엇이든 시도해 보겠습니다. 아니면 도움이 됩니다. 둘 다 그렇지 않았고 취침 시간에 좋은 냄새가났습니다. 또 다른 라운드를 시도하기 위해 울타리에. Booty의 타이트한 리뷰가 더욱 나쁘다는 것을 알았습니다. 울타리에....

author: Kerry
headline: Does what it says - minimize look of cellulite
comment: I did a lot of reading and reviews on numerous sites. I had AI compared it to other products I was considering purchasing and I finally decided to buy the serum, belly flat, and get-dreamy. I had very dry skin and lots of cellulite and was looking for new skincare to address my issues. I only bought the travel size serum from the company but found it not as moisturizing so I use a different serum. I have been using this at night and I cannot believe the look of my cellulite. I'm a big girl so I have massive amoubt of cellulite which I hate and I'm trying to lose the weight. However, in one week of using this I'm astonished by how much my cellulite has decreased and how smooth and soft my skin is. Its very moisturizing and really does what it says. I use it at night msinly and sometimes in the day. At night I apply my serum then I apply this after my shower. If I use it in the day, I apply my serum then this cream follow up with my body oil. I absolutely would recommend this. I actually bought abother night cream when I bought this to try both out and I'm returning the other and contemplating replacing my return with either another Get-Dreamy or the Belly-Flat as I've seen good results using these two products.

author: Jordan
headline: Ok. It FR work
comment:
Let me start by saying—I never leave reviews. If Ulta could track review stats, I'm sure they'd confirm that. And I'm definitely not one of those TikTok-hype chasers. In fact, I usually avoid anything that goes viral on TikTok or Facebook because it's mostly BS.

But this? This actually works. Like, really works. I'm not about to get up off the couch after submitting 32 assignments for school to show you before-and-afters—but just trust me, it works.

I paid over $100 for it directly from the website, and I'd do it again. Stomach, arms, legs—everything. It works. I don't even know how to make you believe me… but if you're on the fence, I'm telling you: it's worth it.

To be honest, it's literally probably the first thing in a long time that I've actually bought twice and fully used and scraped the tub, before doing so!
comment_ko:
먼저 말씀드리지만 저는 리뷰를 절대 남기지 않습니다. Ulta가 리뷰 통계를 추적할 수 있다면 이를 확인할 것이라고 확신합니다. 그리고 나는 확실히 TikTok의 과대 광고 추적자 중 하나가 아닙니다. 사실 저는 TikTok이나 Facebook에서 입소문이 나는 것은 대부분 BS이기 때문에 피합니다.

그런데 이거? 이것은 실제로 작동합니다. 정말 효과가 있어요. 저는 여러분에게 전후를 보여주기 위해 학교에 32개의 과제를 제출한 후 소파에서 일어날 생각이 없습니다. 하지만 제 말을 믿으세요. 효과가 있습니다.

저는 웹사이트에서 직접 100달러 이상을 지불했고, 다시 구매할 의향이 있습니다. 배, 팔, 다리 - 다요. 작동합니다. 나는 당신이 나를 믿게 만드는 방법조차 모릅니다… 하지만 당신이 울타리에 있다면, 나는 당신에게 말할 것입니다: 그것은 그만한 가치가 있습니다.

솔직히 말해서, 제가 실제로 두 번 구입하고 욕조를 완전히 사용하고 긁어낸 것은 말 그대로 오랜 시간 동안 처음 있는 일이었을 것입니다!

author: UltaChic73
headline: What the MAËLYS?
comment: I've read the countless reviews and don't disagree with the reviewers. The smell is awfully overpowering when I used it on the first night. Not only did I step into the shower the next morning, but had to launder my clothes and bedsheets as well. Since I didn't want such a pricey product to go to waste, I mixed a quarter part of the cream with a quarter part of unscented lotion to neutralize the strong scent in a separate cosmetic container and it worked. The formula may have changed some, but I still see firming results, especially on my upper arms and belly. I just don't think this product is for everyone, since results do vary. For the company, however. It's back to the drawing board. Whoever is suggesting these scents needs to resign from the job. MAËLYS needs to hire a qualified chemist if they continue to promote their products.

author: Areid314
headline: This is not it
comment:
I had really hoped to experience some tightening or firming of my skin. I'm petite, on the lower side of the normal weight range for my height, so I don't have an excessive amount of cellulite - just average really. I also exercise 5-6 days a week, nothing crazy / no gym, I just walk approximately 4 miles every day with my dog. 

I have used this product in combination with one other Maelly's product for well over 60 days now and I can tell you with absolute certainty that this product did NOT tighten, firm, or tone my skin at all. While it help to moisturize my skin, it was a total waste of money at these prices - a bottle of Aveeno Colloidal Oatmeal would have yielded the same results. 

I have never had any luck with any Maelly's products and certainly nothing like what they claim in their pictures. I don't recommend this brand. Save your money or try products from someone else because this is not it. I'm disappointed every time. Also this one smells extremely strong like baby powder, but not in a good way, so you won't want to wear it out.
comment_ko:
나는 피부가 어느 정도 조여지거나 탄력이 생기는 것을 경험하고 싶었습니다. 저는 몸집이 작고 키에 비해 정상 체중 범위보다 낮기 때문에 셀룰라이트가 과도하게 많지는 않습니다. 실제로는 평균 수준입니다. 나는 또한 일주일에 5-6일 운동하며, 체육관도 없고, 매일 개와 함께 약 4마일 정도 걷습니다. 

나는 이 제품을 다른 Maelly 제품과 함께 60일 넘게 사용해 왔으며 이 제품이 내 피부를 전혀 조여주거나 단단하게 해주거나 톤을 보정하지 않았다는 것을 절대적으로 확신할 수 있습니다. 피부에 수분을 공급하는 데 도움이 되기는 하지만, 이 가격으로는 완전히 돈 낭비였습니다. Aveeno 콜로이드 오트밀 한 병을 먹어도 같은 결과를 얻었을 것입니다. 

나는 Maelly의 제품을 구매한 적이 없으며 확실히 그들이 사진에서 주장하는 것과 같은 제품도 없었습니다. 나는 이 브랜드를 추천하지 않습니다. 이것이 아니기 때문에 돈을 절약하거나 다른 사람의 제품을 사용해보십시오. 매번 실망스럽습니다. 또한 이 제품은 베이비파우더처럼 향이 매우 강하지만 좋은 향은 아니어서 닳고 싶지 않을 것입니다.

author: Erin
headline: Smooth Skin & Subtle Firming!
comment: I've been using the GET-DREAMY Toning Whip for about six weeks now, and I'm pleasantly surprised by how much I like it. The first thing I noticed is the texture""it's incredibly lightweight and melts into the skin without leaving a greasy residue. It absorbs quickly, which is a huge plus when you're getting dressed in a hurry. The scent is soft and fresh, not overpowering""think light floral with a hint of citrus. It gives a bit of a spa-like experience during application, which I really enjoy. As for results, my skin feels more hydrated, smoother, and there's a subtle firming effect, especially on the my abdomen. It's not a miracle cream that will erase cellulite or drastically tighten loose skin overnight, but with consistent use, I can see and feel a difference in tone and texture. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is the packaging""it looks cute, but the jar is a bit bulky and not the most hygienic option since you're dipping your fingers in. A pump or tube might be more practical. Overall, I'd recommend the GET-DREAMY Toning Whip if you're looking for a luxurious-feeling body moisturizer with a light toning benefit. Great for anyone wanting to pamper their skin while gradually improving firmness and softness.

author: Chrystal W.
headline: Best sleep of my life
comment: I do feel like this is giving me better more toned skin, I do feel more confident, but I could care less if it tones my skin or not. I was on my way to having to see my doctor about starting to take sleep aids when I realized after the first two uses that I was no longer battling insomnia. I will be buying the stuff and using it on a nightly basis. I am unable to ingest melatonin, but I have never considered using a topically. I was unaware that the lotion had melatonin in it when I started using it. We will save the warning about knowing what you're putting on your body before you actually put it on your body. LOL I was using it for its toning properties. I did not realize it had melatonin and valerian root in it. It took two nights of the most blissful sleep I've ever had before I said "what on earth is in this stuff!" Maley has found a loyal customer. Thank you for giving me a restful night sleep!

author: Shaina W.
headline: Worth a try!
comment: Okay, I am a skeptic about anything that claims to change your appearance that isn't healthful eating, good sleep, water intake, and regular body movement. After reading reviews, I decided to give this a shot. I have only been using this product for about three weeks, but I definitely notice a difference. My stomach, thighs, and arms (problem areas in an aging woman), are tighter and more toned in the morning after wearing this overnight. It smells lovely, has the creamiest texture, and doesn't feel greasy at all when I apply. I will continue using this unless there comes a time when I feel it's no longer providing this effect.
comment_ko: 좋습니다. 저는 건강에 좋은 식사, 숙면, 수분 섭취, 규칙적인 신체 움직임이 아닌 외모를 변화시킨다고 주장하는 모든 것에 대해 회의적입니다. 리뷰를 읽은 후, 나는 이것을 한번 시도해 보기로 결정했습니다. 이 제품을 사용한 지 3주 정도 밖에 안 됐는데 확실히 달라진 점을 느꼈습니다. 배, 허벅지, 팔(노인 여성의 문제 부위)을 밤새 착용하고 나면 아침에 더 팽팽해지고 탄력이 더해집니다. 향도 좋고, 질감도 크리미하고, 바르고 나면 끈적임도 전혀 느껴지지 않습니다. 더 이상 이 효과를 제공하지 않는다고 생각되는 때가 오지 않는 한 나는 이것을 계속 사용할 것입니다.

author: Cyn
headline: The smell!
comment: I would never have bought this if I had been able to smell it first. It smells like my great grandmother's house in the 80s, a sickly flowery smell that seems to last forever (Gen X will feel me). I am very sensitive to smells and this gave me a migraine almost immediately. thought it might have been the weather (another trigger for me), but the same thing happened the second time I tried it. Seems to offer a temporary tightening, which is too bad, bc I'm putting it on at night. By midday the next day, the effects had worn off. Going to return for SDJ Bum Bum cream, bc at least I can smell that before trying.

author: Linnea W.
headline: Voodoo Magic
comment: OK so for starters, I'm not usually big on writing reviews. But this stuff is straight up voodoo magic y'all. It's pricey, but it WORKS. I think I speak for so many women when I say I've tried countless products in the $15-$30 price range that really don't produce results. That's wasting your money. Spending a little more on something that actually does what it says it does? PRICELESS. Even though it's a whipped texture (side note, feels divine), the product is still dense and lasts for a while. A little really does go a long way! It's helped tighten and smooth my skin, and as an added bonus has even helped with some flakey dry spots I've had for ages that I just assumed would never go away. I didn't expect this to fix all my skin annoyances, but for real it did. I love that I see results literally the next day, though there's also long term results as well. It's nice because the instant gratification keeps me accountable using it long term, where you just continue to see more and more improvement. My only complaint? It works TOO GOOD. Now that I know I'm basically addicted to this stuff (and this brand) for life. Thank goodness they have subscription discounts- it's like they know once you start using their products you just can't stop!

author: Brenda B.
headline: desperate seeking skin care that works
comment: So last week I received my products was very excited to try. Just within one day my skin feels amazing. I took a shower and First use the serum in circular motions all my target areas. Mind you I am 65 years old and my skin has changed dramatically over the last five years. It's very dry and starting to notice lots more lines. Then I applied the B-Tight it does have a tingle, but nothing too much bothersome. It went away within 5 to 10 minutes. in the evening, just before my nighttime routine, I applied in the get dreamy and used it all over my body. Even let my husband use it on his arms, elbows, legs, and knees, and even this morning we both noticed our skin feeling more hydrated and less dry. So far this stuff is amazing. I'm in love. And I have used over the years so many different products and excited to see what the next few weeks will bring.
headline_ko: 효과가 있는 피부 관리를 간절히 추구합니다.

author: Cristie C.
headline: So, I won't lie. I
comment: So, I won't lie. I bought this on a whim and wasn't expecting much. At first, I really just loved the smell. It's so light and pleasant, and it didn't trigger a migraine. It's a thick, but not obnoxious cream. It simply disappears into my skin perfectly. After a few days, I noticed how soft my skin was, even after a shower. I wore it a few times during the day, but I didn't get much done those days. I was so relaxed. Lol! It wasn't until my husband came home from being away for two weeks that I fell in love. After approximately 10 days, he saw a major difference in my neck, arms, thighs, b*tt, and belly. The appearance of my stretch marks had minimized, my b*tt looked firmer, my batwings were smaller, and my belly wasn't hanging over my c-section scar anymore. You may not notice the differences because you're looking at yourself every day, but take a "before" picture and see the change in 2 weeks. I didn't do this, but if it wasn't for my husband's reaction, I wouldn't have noticed the difference myself (I don't think). I've already received my second jar, and I'll be ordering more products soon.
comment_ko: 그러니 거짓말은 하지 않겠습니다. 충동구매로 구매했는데 별 기대는 안했어요. 처음에는 향이 정말 마음에 들었어요. 너무 가볍고 쾌적하며 편두통을 일으키지 않았습니다. 두껍지만 부담스럽지 않은 크림이에요. 그것은 단순히 내 피부에 완벽하게 사라집니다. 며칠 후, 샤워 후에도 피부가 얼마나 부드러워졌는지 느꼈습니다. 낮에도 몇 번 입었지만 그 당시에는 별로 일을 하지 않았습니다. 나는 너무 편안했다. ㅋㅋㅋ! 남편이 2주 동안 집을 비운 뒤 집에 돌아와서야 나는 사랑에 빠졌습니다. 약 10일 후, 그는 내 목, 팔, 허벅지, 엉덩이, 배에 큰 변화가 있는 것을 보았습니다. 내 튼살의 모양이 최소화되었고 내 b*tt가 더 단단해 보였고 내 배트윙이 더 작아졌으며 내 배가 더 이상 제왕절개 흉터 위에 매달려 있지 않았습니다. 매일 자기 자신을 보고 있기 때문에 차이를 느끼지 못할 수도 있지만, "전" 사진을 찍어 2주 후에 변화를 확인해보세요. 제가 이렇게 한 것은 아니지만, 남편의 반응이 아니었다면 저 자신도 그 차이를 느끼지 못했을 것입니다(없는 것 같아요). 이미 두 번째 병을 받았고 곧 더 많은 제품을 주문할 예정입니다.

author: taylor
headline: real review. bought myself, no affiliation.
comment:
1. the smell is good. its lavender, very boho insence shop (smells like the store earth bound ) 
2. the product works. i recently lost 70 pounds from 210-140 (24 f) so i have stretch marks, some sagging in my boobs and butt, and a very tiny bit of loose skin on my stomach. ive used it in all of those places the last week. ive noticed the biggest difference in my boobs and butt. they just appear smoother. my butt seems tighter. the loose skin on my stomach and the stretch marks on my stomach apeared more smoothed out. i know it takes a few months to fully work but ive seen results already. it does burn a little after about 10 minutes if you use too much. i usually wash my hands after applying it. 
3. the kicker that i have seen no one talking about? this is a night time cream with added ingredients to help you sleep and it actually does put you to sleep, keeps you asleep. a DEEP sleep. so deep that i have been having night mares and vivid dreams?? and then waking up very groggy after 9 hours of sleep. at first i thought it was just a weird night but it only happens when i use the cream lol and i dont use excessive amounts at all so imagine how strange that has been. 
the product is expensive but worth trying if you are okay with warm sensations and lavender scents.

author: Keeley
headline: Do not waste your money
comment:
They know their target audience and they just steal from the woman that is desperate for help. I have had 2 c sections and this is the second time I have given Maely's products a chance, as most of us want that c section area to tighten up. Keep in mind, I am not hoping for false results. I am a runner, been a runner/athlete for 20 plus years, just need help with some of the extra skin from 3 pregnancies / 2 c sections. I wanted this to work so bad. On top of the product not working, I tried to return (as the no satisfaction return guarantee) and with being a busy full-time working mom of 3, was just unfortunately not able able to get my refund email request in time (3 days short to be exact). Believe you me, no sympathy, no concern, no human, just an automated blanket email response each time asking for help, reconsideration, an exception. 

Never buying another Maely's product again. Ripped off again. To every woman out there hopeful and looking for help with toning/ tightening up extra skin, don't waste your time and money here.

그들은 목표 청중을 알고 있으며 도움이 절실히 필요한 여성에게서 훔칩니다. 나는 2개의 c 섹션을 갖고 있으며 Maely의 제품에 기회를 준 것은 이번이 두 번째입니다. 왜냐하면 우리 대부분은 C 섹션 영역이 더 조여지기를 원하기 때문입니다. 나는 잘못된 결과를 바라지 않는다는 것을 명심하십시오. 저는 20년 넘게 주자/운동선수로 활동하고 있는 주자입니다. 3번의 임신/2개의 C 섹션으로 인해 생긴 여분의 피부에 도움이 필요합니다. 나는 이것이 너무 나쁘게 작동하기를 원했습니다. 제품이 작동하지 않는 것 외에도 반품을 시도했지만(만족할 수 없는 반품 보장으로) 3명의 자녀를 둔 바쁜 풀타임 직장맘으로 안타깝게도 제 시간에 환불 이메일 요청을 받을 수 없었습니다(정확히 3일 부족). 저를 믿으세요. 동정심도 없고, 걱정도 없고, 사람도 없고, 도움, 재검토, 예외를 요청할 때마다 자동화된 포괄적 이메일 응답만 있을 뿐입니다. 

다시는 Maely의 다른 제품을 구매하지 마세요. 다시 찢어졌습니다. 희망을 갖고 피부 토닝/탄력 강화에 대한 도움을 찾고 있는 모든 여성 여러분, 여기에서 시간과 돈을 낭비하지 마십시오.

author: Missy
headline: Sleep well
comment:
I work in beauty and a client suggested it to me. The texture of the cream is soft and absorbing. I only use it in a target area (my abdomen), not everywhere.

I got a full nights sleep, with no interuptions. A rare occasion for me these days.

Just like facial skincare, serums always treat on a deeper level. If I was looking for stretch mark correction or true sagging skin. I would pair this with a firming body serum. Alternating with a retinol body treatment and cream.

저는 미용 분야에서 일하고 있는데 고객이 저에게 제안했습니다. 크림의 질감은 부드럽고 흡수력이 좋습니다. 저는 모든 부위가 아닌 대상 부위(복부)에만 사용합니다.

나는 방해받지 않고 밤새도록 잠을 잤습니다. 요즘 나에게는 드문 경우이다.

페이셜 스킨케어와 마찬가지로 세럼도 항상 더 깊은 수준에서 치료합니다. 튼살 교정이나 진짜 처진 피부를 찾고 있었다면. 나는 이것을 퍼밍 바디 세럼과 함께 사용하겠습니다. 레티놀 바디 트리트먼트와 크림을 번갈아 사용합니다.

author: Angel F.
headline: I love the scent & how moisturizing the cream is. . .
comment: Maely's has addressed that EVERY BODY TYPE MAY VARY when using this product. I can definitely say in a matter of 2. 5 wks, it has not done any change to my body. I believe the only thing it has done is made my under arms, inner thighs and stomach soft and the cream gives off a lovely scent. Other than that Maely's has addressed that some may experience "the change" in a matter of 6 to 8 wks or even longer to show tone in the body from this cream. So far it hasn't changed my body, I am a breast cancer survivor who has had major surgery in my breast and stomach, while I still have a belly (unfortunately) in the higher torso, I was hoping this cream can assist that. I also placed this cream under my arms and inner thighs, I hate how big they got since my 3 kids, who are all young adults now. I also attend the gym regularly. Still no muscle tone difference from the cream. I will keep using it though just because I love the scent, no stinging sensation and I enjoy how soft it makes my skin feel with a lovely scent it provides. I also love the texture of the cream. Its heavy but doesn't feel heavy or sticky upon applying to the skin. I would definitely say just buy the product when U can at Ulta versus the website. Unless U really need to due to low supply in store. But I wouldn't urgently buy this. Its more of a want than a need. If it did do what its supposed to then I'd definitely recommend ordering it constantly!

author: Erinn H.
headline: Heavenly scented silk in a jar
comment: This is heavenly. The texture is amazing. Light and silky, and absorbs instantly. My skin felt like satin. And the frangrance is incredible. I use a lot of patchouli and sandalwood based shower products and this cream compliments them perfectly. I would best describe the fragrance as a fresh lavender with a touch of smokiness. author: Ashley B.
headline: Not giving up yet!
comment: I am on my 2nd jar, and granted I'm not getting the quick fast results they seem to portray in the advertising, but there is a slight improvement so far and I'm not going to give up just yet. I don't quite agree with how amazing the smell is, it isn't horrible but it does give off that old ladies cheap perfume vibe. But you know what, you wear it at night and wash it off with your morning shower, so no big deal. I would say to anyone asking about it to at least try it out for a few months and see what results you get. Everyone is different so it may work quicker or slower depending on how your body reacts with it. One jar lasted me a month, so I believe the cost is worth it for the gradual results, just don't expect it to work magically overnight.

author: Darcel B.
headline: Yes, this is magic in
comment: Yes, this is magic in a jar; this old 65, soon to be 66-year-old body has been through it. With birthing four children and multiple abdominal surgeries, along with aging, gaining and losing weight, flab happens, then Vanity takes over, and all that comes with it. I have tried exercising, which works, but doesn't tighten me up as well. I have tried dieting, and it works to a point, too. Trying this cream and doing the other two is giving me the results I want. Thank You
comment_ko: 그렇습니다. 이것은 단지 속의 마법입니다. 이 65세, 곧 66세의 몸이 겪은 일이다. 네 명의 자녀를 낳고 여러 번의 복부 수술을 거치면서 노화, 체중 증가 및 감소와 함께 군살이 생기고 허영심이 그 자리를 대신하게 됩니다. 나는 운동을 시도해 보았으나 효과가 있었지만 몸을 조이지는 못했습니다. 다이어트도 해봤는데 어느 정도 효과가 있더라고요. 이 크림을 사용하고 나머지 두 가지를 사용하면 제가 원하는 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다. 감사합니다

author: Kristina S.
headline: Worth Every Penny with Consistency and Patience
comment: I'm on my second container, and I love it. I don't do well with fragrance, but this one is light and pleasant. You have to be consistent. I use it twice a day and massage in circles until it's absorbed. Don't be haphazard. I have gone from fat to thin so many times in my life that my elasticity is gone. This has improved the look of my once fat thighs in a way I've haven't seen since manic exercising in my late 20s. Even my brother in law noticed at the beach. As I'm no longer in my 30s and can only consume so much collagen and do so many hours of wall Pilates, the "˜battle scars' of a lifelong struggle of coping with eating disorders are changing as I sleep. Don't hesitate on this one! It's worth every penny and patience. Remember there's no miracle cream. Stubborn fat is clean eating and exercise. This takes a jar, consistency, and patience to start seeing results if you are in my age bracket 45+.
headline_ko: 일관성과 인내심으로 모든 페니의 가치가 있습니다.
comment_ko: 두 번째 용기를 사용하고 있는데 정말 마음에 듭니다. 저는 향을 잘 못 맡는데 이건 가볍고 기분 좋아요. 일관성을 유지해야 합니다. 하루에 두 번 사용하고 흡수될 때까지 원을 그리며 마사지합니다. 아무렇게나 하지 마십시오. 나는 내 인생에서 너무 여러 번 살이 찌고 말라서 탄력이 없어졌습니다. 이것은 내가 20대 후반에 미친 듯이 운동한 이후로 본 적이 없는 방식으로 한때 뚱뚱했던 허벅지의 모습을 개선했습니다. 내 처남도 해변에서 알아차렸어요. 나는 더 이상 30대가 아니고 콜라겐을 너무 많이 섭취하고 벽 필라테스를 너무 많이 할 수 있기 때문에 평생 동안 섭식 장애에 대처하면서 겪은 '전투 흉터'가 잠을 자면서 변하고 있습니다. 이것에 대해 주저하지 마십시오! 한 푼도 투자할 가치가 있습니다. 기적의 크림은 없다는 것을 기억하십시오. 완고한 지방은 깨끗한 식습관과 운동입니다. 내 연령층이 45세 이상이면 결과를 보기 시작하려면 병, 일관성 및 인내가 필요합니다.

headline: Great so far!!

I wake up in the morning and can really tell that I'm well moisturized and am extremely soft! We will see how it goes in the future, but I hope it continues to work its magic. If it helps tone me up, it is definitely worth the investment- especially if on the subscription plan! The only thing I would recommend to the company is to include a little spoon/spatula because it's currently impossible to not get the product stuck in my nails!

Only thing is I'm a slender person but have stretch marks and stretched skin because of pregnancy's. This was my last attempt before a tummy tuck but if the results continue this way I will not get the tummy tuck!

Only draw back is it is really warm on the belly, so if it's too much wipe it off after 20 minutes is what the directions say. I left it on though because I want the most bang for my buck.

headline: Just started, but dislike the smell
comment: I just started using this product a day ago, so I can't comment on results yet.  However, I very much dislike the smell. author: Vangee B.
headline: Great product
comment: I love Get Dreamy I have tried hundreds of projects over the years. This one is really great. I know you are supposed to just use it on the body parts you want to tone, however I use it all over because it doesn't leave my skin feeling oily and it lasts. Most oils leave your skin oily and most lotions are either oily or they say they hydrate but after a few hours my skin goes back to dry and flaky. I use it at night before bed after I take a shower. The next morning like all other products my skin is back to dry, with Get Dreamy it's still hydrated. I also suffer from eczema so I am very careful of what I put in my skin since it's so sensitive. It also smells fantastic. The next morning my skin is firm and soft.
comment_ko: 저는 Get Dreamy를 좋아합니다. 저는 수년에 걸쳐 수백 개의 프로젝트를 시도했습니다. 이건 정말 훌륭해요. 톤업하고 싶은 부위에만 사용하면 된다는 건 알지만, 피부가 번들거리지 않고 지속력도 좋아서 온몸에 사용하고 있어요. 대부분의 오일은 피부를 지성 상태로 만들고 대부분의 로션은 지성이거나 수분을 공급한다고 말하지만 몇 시간 후에 피부는 다시 건조하고 벗겨집니다. 밤에 자기 전 샤워 후 사용하고 있어요. 다음날 아침 다른 모든 제품과 마찬가지로 제 피부는 다시 건조해졌습니다. Get Dreamy를 사용하면 여전히 수분이 남아 있습니다. 저도 습진을 앓고 있어서 피부가 너무 예민해서 뭘 바르는 지 굉장히 조심해요. 냄새도 환상적이에요. 다음날 아침 피부가 탱탱하고 부드러워졌어요.

author: AK
headline: Scent too strong
comment:
I really had high hopes for this & bought 3 jars on sale to make sure I gave it enough time to show results. It goes on like a dream. It's not thick or greasy feeling. I could put leggings on immediately after without the skin being too damp. The smell really is nice and lasts for hours but its just too strong or floral or something. It has irritated my eyes and triggered an asthma attack. I had to shower to get it all off so it would stop causing issues. If you are sensitive to perfumes, this is probably not a good choice for you. 

If they'd release a fragrance free version I'd be first in line to give it a shot because it applies and absorbs nicely. As I couldn't get past one day using it, I can't speak for the toning effects. It does leave your skin feeling soft and hydrated though. 

The price point could be a bit better but if you can get it on sale, its not bad. Note thar per the manufacturer it can take 3 jars to see results when used daily as directed

author: Casey H.
headline: Works for me
comment: I am an athletic person and not overweight, but I have always had some cellulite on my thighs that nothing seems to help. The normal concept of "just reduce fat/ lose weight" wasn't helpful for me as I don't have a lot of weight to lose and even if I did lose 5lbs it didn't make a difference in cellulite. Super frustrating. I did some research and found it might have a lot to do with my skin needing more firmnesses/ tightening. So I first tried a cheap retinol body cream and it worked, but I didn't want to use retinol in high quantities long term due to side effects etc... so I tried this protect, and It took a few months but I noticed a difference, and after continued use I saw more results. I have been using it for about 8 months and use it once a day (at night) and like how it feels and smells/ light odor. And it goes on nice and smooth and is moisturizing. I also use the Re-Lure about 3-4 times a week in the morning. Once I added the whip to my nightly regime, I would say it reduced the appearance of my cellulite / increased skin tightening on the front of my thighs about 95%, and the back about 75%! Obviously that's not 100% but I didn't have that expectation to begin with. I will continue to use. Just wish it wasn't so expensive since it's a product I feel requires daily use for maintaining results. Still giving 5 stars as it has worked for me.

"그냥 지방만 빼자/체중 감량"이라는 일반적인 개념은 저에게 도움이 되지 않았습니다. 왜냐하면 저는 감량할 체중이 많지 않고, 5파운드를 감량하더라도 셀룰라이트에는 아무런 변화가 없었기 때문입니다. 매우 실망 스럽습니다. 나는 몇 가지 조사를 했고 이것이 내 피부에 더 많은 탄력/탄력이 필요한 것과 관련이 있을 수 있다는 것을 발견했습니다. 그래서 처음에는 저렴한 레티놀 바디크림을 써봤는데 효과가 있었지만 부작용 등으로 인해 레티놀을 다량으로 장기간 사용하고 싶지 않아서... 그래서 프로텍트를 써봤는데 몇 달이 걸렸지만 차이가 느껴지고 계속 사용해보니 더 많은 효과를 볼 수 있었습니다. 8개월 정도 사용했는데 하루에 한 번(밤에) 사용하고 있는데 사용감이나 향/옅은 냄새가 좋아요. 그리고 부드럽고 촉촉하게 발리고 촉촉해요. 저는 또한 일주일에 3-4번 정도 아침에 Re-Lure를 사용합니다. 야간 요법에 채찍을 추가하면 셀룰라이트가 감소하고 허벅지 앞쪽의 피부가 약 95%, 뒤쪽의 피부가 약 75% 조여지는 것으로 나타났습니다! 물론 100%는 아니지만 처음부터 그런 기대는 없었어요. 나는 계속 사용할 것이다. 효과를 유지하려면 매일 사용해야 한다고 생각하는 제품이기 때문에 너무 비싸지 않았으면 좋겠습니다. 그것이 나를 위해 일했기 때문에 여전히 별 5개를 제공합니다.

author: Cali girl 86
headline: Not for DRY SKIN
comment: I was skeptical when this said for alm skin types and i was right. It left cheeks under my eyes near my nose red like the skin was irritated. author: Steph MC
headline: Don't Sleep on This One
comment: Listen, this is the first time a Clinique foundation has worked for me after nearly 3 decades of wearing foundation. The brand used to be too pink/orange and didn't go light enough for me, but shade CN 02 Breeze  is PERFECT. The undertone is almost a greyish beige which is my holy grail and so hard to find. It balances the ruddiness in my face better than green color correcting products. The formula is really beautiful too; it's medium coverage, blends like a dream, doesn't crease or emphasize my large pores, and isn't overly matte or dewy. It's my ideal satin finish. Honestly I wouldn't have tried this foundation if it hadn't been offered as a free Diamond gift. I'm so glad I did, because I've been wearing it daily since I received it a couple of weeks ago. I'm ready to buy backups and look for my summer shade ahead of time.

author: Daisy
headline: Bring back the even better refresh foundation now
comment:
Clinique's decision to discontinue the Even Better Refresh foundation is honestly so disappointing. I find it almost ironic that it was replaced with the Even Better foundation and marketed as an improvement, because for me, it absolutely isn't. I have given the new version multiple chances, and I just cannot get into it.

What made the Even Better Refresh so special was how truly refreshing it felt on the skin. It did not feel like makeup at all and wore more like a light tinted serum. My skin looked natural, smooth, and comfortable all day. In contrast, the Even Better foundation with SPF 15 feels heavy and occlusive on my skin and actually accentuates my pores instead of smoothing them.

What is especially frustrating is being told by an associate that the formula was tweaked to be better, when the original Even Better Refresh was already done right the first time. The replacement does not replicate that lightweight, breathable feel at all.

Please bring back the Even Better Refresh foundation. It was truly unique, and the current version simply does not compare.
headline_ko: 더 좋은 리프레쉬 파운데이션을 지금 다시 만나보세요
comment_ko:
이븐 베터 리프레시(Even Better Refresh) 파운데이션을 중단하기로 한 크리니크의 결정은 솔직히 너무 실망스럽습니다. 나는 그것이 Even Better 파운데이션으로 대체되고 개선된 제품으로 판매된다는 것이 거의 아이러니하다고 생각합니다. 왜냐하면 나에게는 전혀 그렇지 않기 때문입니다. 새 버전에 여러 번 기회를 줬는데 들어갈 수가 없어요.

Even Better Refresh를 특별하게 만든 이유는 피부에 진정으로 상쾌한 느낌을 주었기 때문입니다. 전혀 메이크업 느낌이 나지 않고, 좀 더 밝은 틴트 세럼처럼 발려요. 내 피부는 하루 종일 자연스럽고 매끄럽고 편안해 보였습니다. 이와 대조적으로, SPF 15를 함유한 이븐 베터 파운데이션은 피부에 무겁고 막히는 느낌을 주며 모공을 부드럽게 해주는 대신 오히려 강조해 줍니다.

특히 실망스러운 점은 원본 Even Better Refresh가 이미 처음에 올바르게 수행되었는데도 공식이 더 좋게 조정되었다는 동료의 말을 듣는 것입니다. 교체품은 가볍고 통기성이 좋은 느낌을 전혀 재현하지 않습니다.

Even Better Refresh 파운데이션을 다시 가져오세요. 정말 독특했고 현재 버전은 단순히 비교할 수 없습니다.

author: Daisy
headline: Bring back the even better refresh foundation now
comment:
Clinique's decision to discontinue the Even Better Refresh foundation is honestly so disappointing. I find it almost ironic that it was replaced with the Even Better foundation and marketed as an improvement, because for me, it absolutely isn't. I have given the new version multiple chances, and I just cannot get into it.

What made the Even Better Refresh so special was how truly refreshing it felt on the skin. It did not feel like makeup at all and wore more like a light tinted serum. My skin looked natural, smooth, and comfortable all day. In contrast, the Even Better foundation with SPF 15 feels heavy and occlusive on my skin and actually accentuates my pores instead of smoothing them.

What is especially frustrating is being told by an associate that the formula was tweaked to be better, when the original Even Better Refresh was already done right the first time. The replacement does not replicate that lightweight, breathable feel at all.

Please bring back the Even Better Refresh foundation. It was truly unique, and the current version simply does not compare.

Even Better Refresh를 특별하게 만든 이유는 피부에 진정으로 상쾌한 느낌을 주었기 때문입니다. 전혀 메이크업 느낌이 나지 않고, 좀 더 밝은 틴트 세럼처럼 발려요. 내 피부는 하루 종일 자연스럽고 매끄럽고 편안해 보였습니다. 대조적으로, SPF 15를 함유한 이븐 베터 파운데이션은 피부에 무겁고 막히는 느낌을 주며 모공을 부드럽게 해주는 대신 오히려 강조해 줍니다.

특히 실망스러운 점은 원본 Even Better Refresh가 이미 처음에 올바르게 수행되었는데도 공식이 더 좋게 조정되었다는 동료의 말을 듣는 것입니다. 교체품은 가볍고 통기성이 좋은 느낌을 전혀 재현하지 않습니다.

Even Better Refresh 파운데이션을 다시 가져오세요. 정말 독특했고 현재 버전은 단순히 비교할 수 없습니다.

author: Bethany
headline: Don't buy if you have dry skin
comment: To start off with something good, this product does have a very smooth formula. But, if you have dry skin it will dry it out even more. Before applying the foundation I put aloe and moisturizer on my face and allowed that to somewhat dry (this is normal for me and is what I usually do before applying foundation). when I apply the foundation, I noticed that the consistency was runny (which is good for me) because that usually means it won't dry out my skin. However, it definitely did and more than my old foundation. to make sure this was a product issue and not user – error, I took off the foundation and restarted my makeup process with my old foundation. My skin was a lot less dry with my old foundation than this one. I would not recommend this product to someone who has dry skin.

headline: A decent skin tint

It does what a skin tint should, but not for the price point in my opinion.

author: Ti
headline: Great Medium Coverage Foundation!
comment:
Clinique was the first makeup I ever used and 20 years later I'm back!
Hope at the Ulta on Polaris in Columbus, Ohio did a great job in color matching me and guiding me through a few different options.  
The Even Better Broad Spectrum is a great medium coverage foundation.  I'm 41 with dry skin and old acne scars.  This does a great job hiding those old scars and covering my redness.  
I love the clean tip on the squeezable bottle, so I don't have a messy cap.  
It's easy to build up coverage with a brush, and it blends beautifully with a sponge.
comment_ko:
크리니크는 제가 처음으로 사용한 메이크업이었고 20년 후에 다시 돌아왔습니다!
오하이오 주 콜럼버스의 Polaris에 있는 Ulta의 Hope는 저와 색상을 일치시키고 몇 가지 다른 옵션을 안내하는 데 훌륭한 역할을 했습니다.  
Even Better Broad Spectrum은 훌륭한 미디엄 커버리지 기반입니다.  저는 피부가 건조하고 오래된 여드름 흉터가 있는 41세입니다.  이것은 오래된 흉터를 숨기고 붉은기를 가려주는 훌륭한 역할을 합니다.  
짜낼 수 있는 병의 끝 부분이 깔끔한 것이 마음에 들어서 캡이 지저분해지지 않습니다.  
브러쉬로 커버하기 쉽고, 스펀지와도 아름답게 블렌딩됩니다.

I love the clean tip on the squeezable bottle, so I don't have a messy cap. It's easy to build up coverage with a brush, and it blends beautifully with a sponge.

Ugh, I immediately broke out from it after using it one time. Now to be fair I have EXTREMELY sensitive skin so it's probably just me. 

It was light weight and easy to apply but will be returning just because of my sensitive skin.

휴가 중에 평소에 사용하던 크리니크 슈퍼 밸런스 파운데이션을 잊어버렸습니다. Quick은 Ulta를 만났고 이 매장에는 특정 파운데이션을 취급하지 않았기 때문에 Even Better 파운데이션을 사용해 보았습니다. 아, 한 번 사용하고 바로 끊었어요. 공평하게 말하면 저는 피부가 매우 민감해서 아마 저만 그런 것 같습니다. 

가볍고 바르기 쉬웠는데 피부가 예민해서 재방문할 예정이에요.

author: Jennifer
headline: Won't wash off
comment:
I love the color choices and coverage to this makeup. It makes dry skin dissappear and skin is glowing! I loved how I looked overall 
However, it tends to look oily unless you put press powder on top, and it NEVER washes off! This was the deal breaker for me. I washed my face 3 times first with a Wash cloth&face soap and then used my toner and I went through 5 cotton pads FULL of makeup STILL. I was so frustrated, it took way too long to remove.
I normally use Maybelline age rewind and never had that issue. Clinique is "long wear" okay great..but doesn't wash off?? So much effort??

headline: Almost perfect color match

Has good coverage, looks radiant over my moisturizer and lasts pretty well throughout the day/evening. Also it seems like there are a few color choices for fair, cool toned skin.
comment_ko: 나는 이것을 몇 년 전에 사용했지만 그다지 신경 쓰지 않았습니다.  67세의 피부가 더 건조해지고 민감해지고 등등 많이 변했기 때문에 다시 시도하기로 결정했습니다. 정말 마음에 듭니다.  커버력이 좋고, 모이스처라이저 위에 빛나는 광채가 나며, 낮/저녁 내내 꽤 잘 지속됩니다. 그리고 뽀얗고 쿨톤 피부에 어울리는 컬러도 몇 가지 있는 것 같아요.

author: K
headline: New Formula?
comment: Ive been Even Better Makeup Broad Spectrum SPF 15 Foundation - Nutty since 2009. The last two orders from Ulta I noticed a more orange tint. It doesn't last, very watery and the color is darker which turns my face a orangish brown. After a couple hours I have streaks on my face where the makeup has worn off. Ive never experienced this. When I reached out to customer service about this I was told it was nothing they could do and to contact the global customer care department. Ive been trying to find older batches but no luck.
comment_ko: 나는 훨씬 더 나은 메이크업 브로드 스펙트럼 SPF 15 파운데이션 - 2009년부터 Nutty였습니다. Ulta의 마지막 두 주문에서는 더 오렌지색 색조가 나타났습니다. 지속력이 좋지 않고 물기가 많고 색상이 더 어두워서 얼굴이 주황색 갈색으로 변합니다. 몇 시간 후에는 화장이 지워져서 얼굴에 줄무늬가 생겼습니다. 나는 이것을 경험한 적이 없습니다. 이에 대해 고객 서비스에 연락했을 때 그들이 할 수 있는 일은 없으며 글로벌 고객 관리 부서에 문의하라는 말을 들었습니다. 나는 오래된 배치를 찾으려고 노력했지만 운이 없었습니다.

headline: Fav foundation

author: Ethel
headline: THIS PRODUCT IS A GAME CHANGER
comment:
I suffered from hyperpigmentation and decolorization after taking an Iron infusion. While I spoke to the consultant at Ulta, she suggested I should use this foundation and guest what? THIS FOUNDATION IS A GAME CHANGER. It also clears fine lines and removes dark spots. My skin is as smooth as silk. 
A big thank you to Ulta and its highly professional staff.
comment_ko:
철분제를 복용한 후 과다색소침착과 탈색을 겪었습니다. 제가 Ulta의 컨설턴트와 이야기를 나누는 동안 그녀는 제가 이 파운데이션을 사용해야 한다고 제안했습니다. 게스트는 무엇을 해야 할까요? 이 재단은 게임 체인저입니다. 또한 잔주름을 제거하고 어두운 점을 제거합니다. 내 피부는 실크처럼 매끄러워요. 
Ulta와 고도로 전문적인 직원들에게 큰 감사를 드립니다.

author: Ru
headline: Was good only for 2 months or so
comment:
Brought this one in Ulta not so far ago. In store looked great, tried it on, got sample, was perfect. 
In few months I started to notice that I the shade of the same bottle got darker. I was surprised because it was during the winter, I'm staying home most of the time, keep it as it says on a package. Next thing I notice, it became more watery, the product would not get the same glow up effect as it did before. 

I was a good experience, I recored it for people who use a lot of product or use it really fast. So sad it happened, I loved it, it was my first foundation I got 😢

몇 달이 지나면서 나는 같은 병의 색상이 더 어두워지는 것을 느끼기 시작했습니다. 겨울이라 대부분 집에 있기 때문에 놀랐어요. 패키지에 적힌 대로 보관했어요. 다음으로 제가 느낀 점은 더 물기가 많아졌고 제품이 이전과 같은 글로우 업 효과를 얻지 못한다는 것입니다. 

좋은 경험이었는데, 제품을 많이 사용하시거나 정말 빠르게 사용하시는 분들을 위해 기록해 봤습니다. 너무 슬프고 마음에 들었고 처음으로 파운데이션을 받았어요 😢

author: Arierusan
headline: Easy, everyday, flexible finish foundation
comment: This is such an easy foundation. Its not picky how its applied and plays well with other products. I have oily, acne prone skin and it left my skin with a matte leaning, satin finish that lasted well all day without touch ups. It is easy to build up and feels like nothing on the skin. The finish is flexible depending on what you put underneath and how you set it. The shade range seems so weird and it was difficult to pick a shade. I ended up with CN02 Breeze which is a pretty good match. I wear Mont Blanc in NARS Light Reflecting, 1.5 in Armani Luminous Silk, and 125 in Fenty Soft n Lit.
comment_ko: 이것은 매우 쉬운 기초입니다. 적용 방식이 까다롭지 않고 다른 제품과 잘 어울립니다. 나는 지성, 여드름이 나는 피부를 가지고 있으며 피부에 매트한 느낌의 새틴 마감 처리가 되어 손질 없이 하루 종일 잘 지속되었습니다. 쌓이기 쉽고 피부에 아무것도 느껴지지 않습니다. 아래에 무엇을 놓느냐, 어떻게 세팅하느냐에 따라 마감이 유연해집니다. 색상의 범위가 너무 이상해 색상을 선택하기가 어려웠습니다. I ended up with CN02 Breeze which is a pretty good match. 저는 NARS Light Reflecting의 Mont Blanc, Armani Luminous Silk의 1.5, Fenty Soft n Lit의 125를 착용합니다.

author: khlo
headline: Will not buy again:(
comment: I really wanted to like this foundation but no matter how much I moisturize this foundation does not blend into my skin. I tend to have dry patches here and there and those spots are much more noticable when I use this foundation. If you have dry skin I would not recommend this product even if you keep up with moisturizing because after a short time the foundation WILL start cracking/creasing around your dry areas.  Even my more oily areas like my Tzone become dried out after using this foundation as if the foundation is sucking the moisture from my face.
comment_ko: 정말 갖고 싶었던 파운데이션인데, 아무리 보습을 줘도 피부에 묻어나지 않는 파운데이션이에요. 저는 여기저기 건조한 부분이 있는 편인데, 이 파운데이션을 사용하면 그 부분이 훨씬 더 눈에 띄더라구요. 건성 피부라면 보습을 계속 유지하더라도 이 제품을 권장하지 않습니다. 왜냐하면 짧은 시간이 지나면 파운데이션이 건조한 부위 주변에서 갈라지거나 주름지기 시작할 것이기 때문입니다.  T존처럼 유분기가 많은 부위도 이 파운데이션을 사용하면 마치 파운데이션이 얼굴의 수분을 빨아들이는 것처럼 건조해집니다.

author: auraliyah
headline: absolutely amazing!!
comment:
i typically don't wear foundation but when i do it's for a natural kind of look, and this foundation does just that! i would say overall it's medium coverage, but i always apply a very small amount because a little goes a long way. i assume if you apply more foundation it'll be better coverage. i also love the shades option! shade breeze looks exactly like my skin and im genuinely happy and impressed that i could find a shade exactly like my skin. 
however, beware when buying this, if you don't use a good skincare routine and wait at least a few minutes between each step, your foundation will look at least a little orange. 
overall, if you want a natural / semi natural makeup look, i'd definitely recommend this foundation! it's absolutely wonderful and i have had no issues with it. it lasts forever and leaves a poreless like appearance, i also have rosacea which this foundation does a good job at covering, plus the foundation is overall dewy and lasts all day, even if you're sweating and moving around a lot. i also lightly dot this underneath my eyes and use it in place of a concealer since it doesn't crease. if you want a full glam look i'd recommend buying another foundation.
comment_ko:
저는 평소에 파운데이션을 잘 안 바르는데, 바르면 자연스러운 느낌을 주려고 하는데 이 파운데이션이 딱 그렇더라고요! 전반적으로 커버력은 중간 정도라고 말하고 싶지만, 조금만 발라도 효과가 좋기 때문에 항상 아주 적은 양만 바르는 편이에요. 파운데이션을 많이 바르면 커버력이 더 좋아질 것 같아요. 나는 또한 음영 옵션을 좋아합니다! 셰이드 브리즈는 내 피부와 똑같고, 내 피부와 똑같은 셰이드를 찾을 수 있어서 진심으로 행복하고 감동받았습니다. 
하지만 이것을 구입할 때 주의하세요. 좋은 스킨케어 루틴을 사용하지 않고 각 단계 사이에 최소 몇 분 정도 기다리면 파운데이션이 약간 주황색으로 보일 것입니다. 
전체적으로 내추럴/세미 내추럴 메이크업을 원하신다면 이 파운데이션을 꼭 추천드려요! 그것은 정말 훌륭하고 나는 그것에 아무런 문제가 없었습니다. 그것은 영원히 지속되고 외관과 같은 모공을 남깁니다. 나는 또한이 파운데이션이 잘 커버하는 주사비를 가지고 있으며, 땀을 많이 흘리고 많이 움직여도 파운데이션이 전체적으로 촉촉하고 하루 종일 지속됩니다. 그리고 눈 밑에 살짝 점을 찍어 바르고도 주름이 지지 않아서 컨실러 대용으로 사용하고 있어요. 완전한 글램 룩을 원한다면 다른 파운데이션을 구입하는 것이 좋습니다.
text_for_model: i typically don't wear foundation but when i do it's for a natural kind of look, and this foundation does just that! i would say overall it's medium coverage, but i always apply a very small amount because a little goes a long way. i assume if you apply more foundation it'll be better coverage. i also love the shades option! shade breeze looks exactly like my skin and im genuinely happy and impressed that i could find a shade exactly like my skin. however, beware when buying this, if you don't use a good skincare routine and wait at least a few minutes between each step, your foundation will look at least a little orange. overall, if you want a natural / semi natural makeup look, i'd definitely recommend this foundation! it's absolutely wonderful and i have had no issues with it. it lasts forever and leaves a poreless like appearance, i also have rosacea which this foundation does a good job at covering, plus the foundation is overall dewy and lasts all day, even if you're sweating and moving around a lot. i also lightly dot this underneath my eyes and use it in place of a concealer since it doesn't crease. if you want a full glam look i'd recommend buying another foundation.

author: Mary
headline: I chose this foundation as my Diamond member gift
comment: Out of all the foundation gifts they offered, I chose this one because it had the best color selection for cool-neutral skin tones like mine. I'm a Bright Winter in color theory with light olive skin, brunette hair and blue eyes. Most foundation shades are too yellow, pink, gray, orange, chalky, or deep on me. For reference, I wear Mac NW20, Chanel B20 and Estee Lauer 3N1 shades. The associate matched me to CN 18 Cream Whip in this brand. I must say, it's a perfect match in daylight. I have occasional breakouts, so I'm glad this isn't greasy. It looks good on my mature skin. I took off one star because the SPF is so thick it's hard to blend without a moisture primer first. Even after it sets, the foundation is a bit white which will flashback on camera. This is a great foundation to wear outdoors when exercising because you're protected. Don't take a selfie with it unless you put bronzer on over it.

author: productlover52
headline: Perfect for me foundation
comment: I shopped Ulta for at least two hours last Saturday and tried pretty much every foundation available at my particular store. Key word "available" ...Including.. Nars, it, Tarte, Robane, Charlotte Tillbury, MAC,.BobbieBrown..and  others i can't remember. My primary complaint about most of the products I tried was the SMELL...or, more specifically the Odor of the products.  It's a similar kind of motor oil smell in many of the brands. Not pleasant... and actually kind of nauseating. Sorry. So, last but not least I ended up back at the Clinique area and tried this foundation. After I narrowed down the shade (there are many) and noticed the missing weird smell,..I discovered a nice,natural,buildable medium coverage and a luminous but not  shiny finish. Also, the  smallish squeeze bottle with the little tip dispenser makes for a very controllable delivery of product. Unlike what you get with a wand or worse, those squeezable tubes with the sponge! I hate those! Anyway I made my choice and my purchase and am very pleased. I would reccomend this product.

author: R
headline: Perfect natural dewy finish for acne prone skin
comment:
I have been using this foundation for over a year now and occasionally have tried others like lancome, fenty, covergirl, too faced, and neutrogena, and absolutely nothing compares to this foundation. 

It is the perfect natural finish coverage, with no patchiness. It allows your natural glow to shine through and leaves your skin looking very moisturized and healthy. It is soothing on my acne prone skin. It is buildable, from light to medium coverage, but always does a good job covering my acne without making it look crusty. I almost never use concealer. 

As someone with pale skin, it's hard to find a color match. Usually it either makes me look like a ghost, or it's too orange/peachy. The flax color is such a perfect match for me, and somehow blends with my skin when I'm paler in the winter and when I'm darker in the summer. 

I really hope they never change the formula because nothing else works for my skin the way this does.

끈적임 없이 완벽하게 자연스러운 마무리감을 선사합니다. 자연스러운 광채가 빛나고 피부가 매우 촉촉하고 건강해 보입니다. 여드름이 나는 피부를 진정시켜줍니다. 가벼운 커버리지에서 중간 커버리지까지 구성 가능하지만, 항상 여드름을 딱딱해 보이지 않게 커버하는 데 효과적입니다. 저는 컨실러를 거의 사용하지 않습니다.

author: Olivia
headline: Made me breakout after using it for 3 days
comment:
I do not have oily prone skin. I wash my face every morning and night with the same gentle cleanser I've used for years. My forehead is actually the driest part of my face and I broke out with 6 new little zits after a few days. I had switched from Too Faced Born This Way tinted moisturizer because they discontinued it. (I had never broken out from that.) I wish I had tried a tester of this foundation first. 

Really disappointed, as I haven't gotten acne in several years but now I gotta let my 6 new pimples heal because of whatever they put in this. After doing some research I found I'm not the only one dealing with this. And it's sad because a lot of people think their skin is the problem. But in reality it's just something to do with this formula. Clinique is trying to have a comeback and with this formula it just isn't working for me.

나는 지성 피부가 아니다. 나는 수년 동안 사용해 온 순한 클렌저로 매일 아침 저녁으로 세수를 합니다. 내 이마는 실제로 내 얼굴에서 가장 건조한 부분이고 며칠 후에 6개의 작은 여드름이 새로 생겼습니다. 나는 투페이스드 본 디스 웨이(Too Faced Born This Way) 틴티드 모이스처라이저가 단종되었기 때문에 이 제품으로 바꿨습니다. (저는 그 일에서 벗어나본 적이 없습니다.) 이 기초를 먼저 시험해 봤더라면 좋았을 텐데요.

author: Addy
headline: Only expensive makeup I can actually justify
comment:
This was reccomended to me by an ulta employee with a clinique badge, so i figured she got commission or worked directly with clinique but im too nice to say no. Plus when she did a color match on my and i tested the formula, i found it was just what i was looking for for casual day to day makeup. 
Ive always had a vendetta against clinique due to animal testing (not sure if they still do it tbh) but i gave it a chance- a very expensive chance when i normally refuse to spend more than $15 on makeup. 
I love it though, its a perfect shade match, its blends nicely under or over cream blush and contour. Its slightly dewy but sits well under pressed and loose powder for more sheen control. It covers redness and isn't patchy over my acne. Its very versatile with the amount of coverage you want. It really is worth the price, the only fancy product i use every day. 
4 stars because it does transfer very easily, and i do need to blot it throughout the day, i have everso slightly oily leaning skin and its pretty hot and humid. But if i get my fave close to ANYTHING it transfers over it it. If i touch my face while reading a book then the pages are covered in finger prints.
comment_ko:
이것은 크리니크 배지를 가진 ulta 직원이 나에게 추천했기 때문에 그녀가 커미션을 받았거나 크리니크와 직접 일했다고 생각했지만 거절하기에는 너무 친절했습니다. 게다가 그녀가 내 옷에 컬러 매치를 하고 내가 포뮬러를 테스트했을 때, 나는 그것이 내가 캐주얼한 일상 메이크업에서 찾고 있던 바로 그 것임을 알았습니다. 
나는 항상 동물 실험으로 인해 크리니크에 대해 복수심을 갖고 있었지만(아직도 그렇게 하는지 확실하지 않음) 기회를 주었습니다. 일반적으로 메이크업에 15달러 이상 지출을 거부하는 매우 비싼 기회였습니다. 
그래도 나는 그것을 좋아합니다. 완벽한 색상 일치이며 크림 블러셔와 윤곽선 아래 또는 위에 잘 혼합되어 있습니다. 약간 이슬이 맺혀 있지만 프레스드 파우더와 루스 파우더 아래에 잘 밀착되어 광택을 더 잘 조절합니다. 그것은 붉은기를 커버하고 내 여드름 위에 뾰루지가 나지 않습니다. 원하는 범위만큼 매우 다재다능합니다. 정말 가격 대비 가치가 있고 제가 매일 사용하는 유일한 멋진 제품입니다. 
별 4개는 매우 쉽게 전달되고 하루 종일 닦아내야 하기 때문입니다. 저는 피부가 약간 지성이고 꽤 덥고 습합니다. 하지만 내가 좋아하는 것을 무엇이든 가까이 가져가면 그 위에 이전됩니다. 책을 읽다가 얼굴을 만지면 페이지 전체가 지문으로 뒤덮이게 됩니다.

author: Erin
headline: I will never understand this product.
comment: For the life of me I will never be able to understand how a hyaluronic acid serum with ceramides is drying, but it is. this serum leaves my skin dry, tight and uncomfortable and causes the most atrocious pilling. Forget layering it with other products or makeup, this serum sabotages everything it touches. I've re purchased this so many times and it's the same result. Exfoliated and bare skinned or mixed with another serum or moisturizer, doesn't matter. Here come the gross little peeling pills with an awful drying sensation. for whatever reason it won't work with my skin, so beware, you may be the same way. doesn't matter how cheap it is if it's still a complete waste of money.
headline_ko: 나는 이 제품을 결코 이해하지 못할 것이다.
comment_ko: 저는 평생 동안 세라마이드가 함유된 히알루론산 세럼이 어떻게 건조해지는지 이해할 수 없을 것입니다. 하지만 그렇습니다. 이 세럼은 내 피부를 건조하고, 팽팽하고, 불편하게 만들고 가장 끔찍한 보풀을 유발합니다. 다른 제품이나 메이크업과 레이어링하는 것을 잊어버리세요. 이 세럼은 닿는 모든 것을 방해합니다. 여러번 재구매했는데 결과는 똑같네요. 각질을 제거하고 맨살을 바르거나 다른 세럼이나 보습제와 섞어도 상관없습니다. 끔찍한 건조감이 있는 역겹고 작은 필링 알약이 나왔습니다. 어떤 이유에서든 내 피부에는 맞지 않으니 여러분도 마찬가지일 수 있으니 주의하세요. 그것이 여전히 완전한 돈 낭비라면 그것이 얼마나 싼지는 중요하지 않습니다.

I start w/the ordinary Vitamin C serum then use this HA serum followed by moisturizer(+sunscreen in AM). KAPOW! Youthful, brighter skin after 2 weeks. Works like magic with Vitamin c. I've been using this consistently for a year and when I run out my skin is more dull. Stick with it-works like a charm

headline: I go through this like water

I love The Ordinary products and their straightforward formulations to keep skin reactions to a minimum. 

Apply this on slightly damp skin to maximize affectiveness.

Perfect to hydrate before makeup because moisturizers/lotions would interfere with makeup or make my skin greasy within a couple hours, especially paired with sunscreen.

author: MJ
headline: Amazing brand
comment:
The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 is truly one of the best hyaluronic acids I've ever used. It contains multi-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid for deep hydration and vitamin B5 to enhance surface moisture and support skin repair.

It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling plump and refreshed. I have mature, dry skin that used to look dull and tired. Since I started using this three years ago, my skin has transformed—my texture has improved, it looks fresher, and in my 40s, people never guess I'm older than 32. It's become my go-to product and my number one skincare essential.

On top of all that, it's incredibly affordable. For the results it delivers, The Ordinary is unmatched—proof that high-quality skincare doesn't have to come with a luxury price tag.
comment_ko:
디오디너리 히알루론산 2% + B5는 정말 제가 사용해 본 최고의 히알루론산 중 하나입니다. 깊은 수분 공급을 위한 다분자 히알루론산과 표면 수분을 강화하고 피부 회복을 돕는 비타민 B5가 함유되어 있습니다.

가볍고 빠르게 흡수되어 피부를 탱탱하고 상쾌하게 만들어줍니다. 칙칙하고 피곤해 보이던 피부가 성숙하고 건조해졌습니다. 3년 전에 이 제품을 사용하기 시작한 이후로 제 피부는 달라졌습니다. 피부결이 좋아지고, 더 산뜻해 보이고, 40대가 되어도 사람들은 제가 32세 이상인지 전혀 짐작하지 못할 것입니다. 이 제품은 제가 꼭 사용하는 제품이자 최고의 스킨케어 필수품이 되었습니다.

무엇보다도 가격이 매우 저렴합니다. 그것이 제공하는 결과에 있어서 The Ordinary는 타의 추종을 불허합니다. 이는 고품질 스킨케어가 반드시 사치스러운 가격표를 동반할 필요가 없다는 증거입니다.

author: Bryan
headline: It's growing on me
comment: I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. I combine The Ordinary with COSRX Snail Mucin products and a Mario Badescu toner for the best results. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. Don't know that this is necessary after the Snail Mucin Serum, but I feel like it adds moisture.

author: Kim
headline: Flakes and Doesn't Blend/Absorb
comment:
I don't know how this product is being used by everyone else but despite using with several different products, this serum will not absorb and will either clump or flake off.

If I use creams or an oil with it, the product will just clump up with the cream.
If I use with a lighter lotion/cream, the product will just flake off. 

It's definitely this product because just by itself, it will flake off and not absorb at all. IDK how to explain flake off, it's like the water residue from cooking rice and it becomes flaky/paper like??
comment_ko:
이 제품을 다른 분들은 어떻게 사용하시는지 모르겠지만, 여러 제품을 함께 사용해도 이 세럼은 흡수가 잘 되지 않고 뭉치거나 벗겨지는 현상이 발생합니다.

크림이나 오일을 함께 사용하면 제품이 크림과 뭉쳐지더라구요.
가벼운 로션/크림과 함께 사용하면 제품이 벗겨질 수 있습니다. 

확실히 이 제품은 그 자체로 벗겨지고 전혀 흡수되지 않기 때문에 확실히 이 제품입니다. IDK 부스러기가 벗겨지는 것을 설명하는 방법은 밥을 짓고 남은 물 잔여물과 같아서 벗겨지거나 종이처럼 됩니까??

author: Heather
headline: Formula change ruined this product
comment: It's rare I leave reviews, but this one felt important. I had been using this product pretty much as long as it had been around, and it was perfect. But about a year ago, my skin started breaking out in painful, cystic acne unlike anything I've ever experienced. I didn't think it could possibly be due to a product I had been using for years, so I continued using this serum. I could not figure out why my skin was the worst it had ever been in my life and tried just about everything to fix it. Recently, I ran out of this product and couldn't restock right away… and my skin cleared up almost over night. I thought it was a fluke, restocked, and my skin broke out almost immediately after starting this serum again. I stopped using it, and again, my skin cleared up almost immediately. What I wish I had known a year ago but found out today was that The Ordinary completely changed the formula. I had no idea, and the timing lines up to exactly when my skin problems started. I was buying a completely different product and had no clue. I'm so sad to say I will never buy this again, as it was a holy grail product for me a long time. If you've noticed the same issues I did, maybe try cutting this one out.

author: DMM
headline: They Changed their Formula
comment:
It would have been nice to know that they changed their formula. Who knows, maybe they did, but I sure did not know. I usually would buy 2-3 bottles at a time so when I finally went to buy this product, I had no clue what was about to happen. 

The skin on my eyes has been sensitive and peeling. I cut out so many different thibgs trying to figure it out. It was this product. 

So. Yes, it hydrates the rest of my skin nicely, but not the skin around my eyes. It's been months of misery. Not pleased.

그들이 공식을 바꿨다는 것을 알았더라면 좋았을 것입니다. 누가 알겠는가, 아마도 그랬을지 모르지만, 나는 확실히 몰랐다. 보통 한 번에 2~3병씩 사곤 했는데, 결국 이 제품을 사러 갔을 때는 무슨 일이 일어날지 전혀 알 수 없었습니다. 

눈가의 피부가 민감해지고 벗겨졌습니다. 나는 그것을 알아 내려고 노력하면서 너무 많은 다른 것들을 잘라 냈습니다. 바로 이 제품이었습니다.

headline: Amazing! Makes moisturizer work all the better
comment: I am 67 and have always had very dry skin. Thought I'd try this for the heck of it and was amazed! I still have wrinkles, of course. Give this a few weeks and you may see a nice difference from using just moisturizer.
