author: Ally
headline: Still works for me
comment: When I received the new formula, I was so afraid I'd have a bad experience. Like many others, I noticed the color difference right away. I did a quick research to see if it was a new formula or just a bad batch (it was a new formula), and I also looked at all the new reviews about the formula change - which was a mixture of good and bad. I was definitely afraid I'd break out or have rashes from the new formula like others, but so far....no negative experience. It's been a few months now, and I love how it's lightweight and absorbs quickly. It is ALOT leas sticky, and I love that. I'm just wondering if it's skin differences between customers or if I'm doing something different. It doesn't peel for me. This is the first product I use after cleansing my face and using a toner. I wait a minute or so for it to absorb, and then I follow up with my other serums, then lock it in with my red bean water gel moisturizer (mornings) & my cica gel cream (nights). my face has never felt more hydrated. So, although it's unfortunate for those affected by the formula change, I personally have had a rather positive experience with it. Always do a patch test with new products. That all being said, I adore this!

author: Cincimaddi
headline: No longer a trusted or transparent brand
comment: The Ordinary has always claimed to be a trustworthy, transparent company, and for many years I agreed. I've spent months getting my skin into a great condition in preparation for ny wedding in September. I have rosacea, and very sensitive skin. The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid was a staple in ny regime. A month ago, my skin that I've been meticulous about, suddenly became red and irritated, and burns from any product on it. I blamed everything except for this serum, until I finalky looked it up and found that my moat recent bottle was released with a new formulation. No warnings, no new label, nothing to indicate a formula change. I now have 2 months to try and repair my skin before my wedding. I'm disappointed in The Ordinary, and will no longer use any of their products. It's unfortunate, but I can't trust that it won't happen again.

author: Ames
headline: Why do they have to change a good thing!?
comment:
The Ordinary HA has always been one of my Holy Grail products. I use it twice a day on my face and in my hair and I HATE that they changed the formula. 

The new formula is not good. There is color inconsistencies in every bottle I have, after using my face feels tacky & sticky, & the worst thing...it causes pilling! Using my exact same products in the same order as before & now all of a sudden pilling is happening. I eliminated the new formula HA and guess what...no pilling. What a nightmare. I'm now stuck searching for a new HA product. 

Why change something that didn't need to be changed!? It was the perfect HA product. Simple HA that wasn't sticky, tacky, or causes pilling. I won't be buying this product again until the old formula returns.

새로운 공식은 좋지 않습니다. 제가 가지고 있는 모든 병에는 색상 불일치가 있습니다. 사용 후 얼굴이 끈적거리고 끈적거리는 느낌이 들며 최악의 경우는 보풀이 발생한다는 것입니다! 이전과 동일한 순서로 정확히 동일한 제품을 사용했는데 이제 갑자기 필링이 발생하고 있습니다. 나는 새로운 공식 HA를 제거하고 무엇을 추측합니다 ... 보풀이 없습니다. 정말 악몽이네요. 이제 새로운 HA 제품을 검색하는 중입니다. 

변경할 필요도 없는 것을 왜 변경합니까!? 완벽한 HA 제품이었습니다. 끈적임이나 끈적임, 보풀이 발생하지 않는 심플한 HA입니다. 나는 이전 공식이 돌아올 때까지 이 제품을 다시 구매하지 않을 것입니다.

I notice this doesn't pill/flake if you use too much like the other did. My skin has been noticeably softer & more even toned. This is the only thing diffent (updated) in my routine, so I'm guessing the new formula is actually making a difference. author: Despondent Consumer
headline: Reformation?!?!
comment:
Hoping Deciem is paying attention here. Like MANY MANY other reviews I had been using this product for YEARS and loved it.  I bought a replacement bottle and recently opened it only to find some yellow liquid masquerading as my beloved serum (which was perfectly clear previously, as it is still displayed in the pictures on the website).

So I took to the website to look for a way to contact Deciem about this issue figuring it was a fluke, only to check the reviews (to see if anyone else had this issue and how it was handled) and find that it's no fluke.  This is apparently the new 'formula'.  I did not realize it had been changed since the pictures were the same and the name was the same I assumed I was receiving the same product I've purchased previously. 

The number of recent reviews taking issue with this change is highly concerning.  Long term regular users (like myself) are not having breakouts and issues that we haven't faced in years since perfecting our individual regimens. As I am now out of the 'old' formula I will have to hunt down a new product or rethink my facial regimen.  Hoping and praying that Deciem will send out a mass message informing us they have decided to go back to the original and it will be available for purchase again ASAP.
comment_ko:
Deciem이 여기에 주목하길 바랍니다. 많은 다른 리뷰처럼 저는 이 제품을 수년 동안 사용해왔고 정말 좋아했습니다.  나는 교체용 병을 구입하고 최근에 그것을 열었는데 내가 사랑하는 혈청으로 가장한 노란색 액체가 발견되었습니다(웹사이트의 사진에 여전히 표시되어 있기 때문에 이전에는 완전히 투명했습니다).

그래서 나는 이 문제가 우연이라고 생각하고 Deciem에 연락할 수 있는 방법을 찾기 위해 웹사이트를 방문했고, 리뷰를 확인하여(다른 사람이 이 문제를 겪었는지, 어떻게 처리했는지 확인하기 위해) 우연이 아니라는 것을 확인했습니다.  이것은 분명히 새로운 '공식'입니다.  사진도 똑같고 이름도 똑같아서 바뀐줄도 모르고 예전에 구매했던 제품이랑 똑같은줄 알았네요. 

최근 이 변경 사항에 대해 문제를 제기하는 리뷰의 수가 매우 우려스럽습니다.  저와 같은 장기 일반 사용자는 개인 요법을 완성한 이후 몇 년 동안 직면하지 않은 돌발이나 문제를 겪고 있지 않습니다. 나는 이제 '기존' 공식에서 벗어났기 때문에 새로운 제품을 찾거나 얼굴 관리 방법을 다시 생각해 봐야 할 것입니다.  Deciem이 원본으로 돌아가기로 결정했으며 최대한 빨리 다시 구매할 수 있음을 알리는 대량 메시지를 보내길 기대하고 기도합니다.
text_for_model: Hoping Deciem is paying attention here. Like MANY MANY other reviews I had been using this product for YEARS and loved it. I bought a replacement bottle and recently opened it only to find some yellow liquid masquerading as my beloved serum (which was perfectly clear previously, as it is still displayed in the pictures on the website). So I took to the website to look for a way to contact Deciem about this issue figuring it was a fluke, only to check the reviews (to see if anyone else had this issue and how it was handled) and find that it's no fluke. This is apparently the new 'formula'. I did not realize it had been changed since the pictures were the same and the name was the same I assumed I was receiving the same product I've purchased previously. The number of recent reviews taking issue with this change is highly concerning. Long term regular users (like myself) are not having breakouts and issues that we haven't faced in years since perfecting our individual regimens. As I am now out of the 'old' formula I will have to hunt down a new product or rethink my facial regimen. Hoping and praying that Deciem will send out a mass message informing us they have decided to go back to the original and it will be available for purchase again ASAP.

headline: Allergic reaction after formula change

Note that I've used this product for two years and never had any issues before. Once I started seeing the comments about formula changing, I knew this had to be the issue.

headline: Sticky consistency is not for me
comment:
The Ordinary is decent for budget buys and has produced a few solid products that I have tried.
I read that 2% Hyaluronic Acid is high, making it feel sticky. The article suggested finding something with a little less HA like 1.5% if you prefer a less "sticky" feeling.  I am not taking off stars for this because it does what it says and the consistency is a personal preference. 
   Why I am deducting stars is because I believe this is breaking me out a little. I haven't really incorporated anything else new besides this product. 
*I do have acne prone skin.

The Ordinary는 저예산 구매에 적합하며 제가 사용해본 몇 가지 견고한 제품을 생산했습니다.
히알루론산이 2% 함유되어 있어 끈적이는 느낌이 든다고 하더군요. 기사에서는 덜 "끈적거리는" 느낌을 선호한다면 HA가 1.5% 정도 더 적은 제품을 찾는 것이 좋습니다.  나는 이것이 말하는 대로 작동하고 일관성은 개인적인 취향이기 때문에 별을 빼지 않을 것입니다. 
   별점을 차감하는 이유는 이것이 나를 조금 아프게 한다고 믿기 때문입니다. 이 제품 외에는 딱히 새로운 것을 추가한 적은 없습니다. 
*저는 여드름이 잘 나는 피부를 가지고 있습니다.

author: tientien0803
headline: Highly recommend !!
comment:
The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum is a game-changer in my skincare routine. From the moment I incorporated it into my daily regimen, I noticed a remarkable difference in the hydration levels of my skin. The lightweight texture makes it easy to apply, and it absorbs quickly without any greasy residue.

What sets this serum apart is its potent combination of hyaluronic acid and vitamin B5. Hyaluronic acid is a powerhouse ingredient known for its ability to attract and retain moisture, leaving my skin feeling plump and supple. The addition of vitamin B5 enhances hydration and helps to improve the skin's barrier function, leaving it feeling nourished and revitalized.

I've struggled with dry patches and dullness, but this serum has truly transformed my complexion. My skin looks and feels more hydrated, radiant, and youthful. Plus, the affordable price point makes it accessible to everyone.

Overall, The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum is a skincare essential for anyone looking to achieve hydrated, glowing skin. I highly recommend adding it to your routine—you won't be disappointed!
comment_ko:
디 오디너리(The Ordinary)의 히알루론산 2% + B5 세럼은 내 스킨케어 루틴에 획기적인 변화를 가져왔습니다. 그것을 매일의 요법에 포함시킨 순간부터, 나는 피부의 수분 수준에 현저한 차이를 느꼈습니다. 가벼운 질감으로 바르기 쉽고, 끈적임 없이 빠르게 흡수됩니다.

이 세럼을 차별화하는 점은 히알루론산과 비타민 B5의 강력한 조합입니다. 히알루론산은 수분을 끌어당기고 유지하는 능력으로 잘 알려진 강력한 성분으로, 피부를 탱탱하고 유연하게 만들어 줍니다. 비타민 B5의 첨가로 수분 공급을 강화하고 피부 장벽 기능을 향상시켜 영양을 공급하고 활력을 줍니다.

나는 건조한 반점과 칙칙함으로 인해 어려움을 겪었지만 이 세럼은 내 안색을 진정으로 변화시켰습니다. 내 피부는 더욱 촉촉하고 빛나며 젊어 보이고 느껴집니다. 게다가 합리적인 가격으로 누구나 쉽게 이용할 수 있습니다.

전반적으로 The Ordinary의 히알루론산 2% + B5 세럼은 촉촉하고 빛나는 피부를 원하는 모든 사람에게 필수적인 스킨케어입니다. 나는 그것을 당신의 일상에 추가할 것을 적극 권장합니다. 실망하지 않을 것입니다!
text_for_model: The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum is a game-changer in my skincare routine. From the moment I incorporated it into my daily regimen, I noticed a remarkable difference in the hydration levels of my skin. The lightweight texture makes it easy to apply, and it absorbs quickly without any greasy residue. What sets this serum apart is its potent combination of hyaluronic acid and vitamin B5. Hyaluronic acid is a powerhouse ingredient known for its ability to attract and retain moisture, leaving my skin feeling plump and supple. The addition of vitamin B5 enhances hydration and helps to improve the skin's barrier function, leaving it feeling nourished and revitalized. I've struggled with dry patches and dullness, but this serum has truly transformed my complexion. My skin looks and feels more hydrated, radiant, and youthful. Plus, the affordable price point makes it accessible to everyone. Overall, The Ordinary's Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 serum is a skincare essential for anyone looking to achieve hydrated, glowing skin. I highly recommend adding it to your routine—you won't be disappointed!

headline: broke me out
comment:
this serum started to break me out really bad on my cheeks, i stopped using it like 2 weeks ago and it's been going away. i'm pretty sure i bought this before they changed the formula and i don't have acne prone skin so i think it was this serum especially because i have a really simple makeup/skincare routine and my skin used to be so clear i didn't really care to wear concealer, but recently ive been dotting the nars one over my blemishes until they go away (yes i am using this to plug the nars concealer bc it is SO good 😭 seriously try it)
however i will give this serum credit because it really is hydrating and helped me relieve some of the dryness around my undereyes/eyelids because those areas used to be so dry the skin would fr flake off onto my glasses etc, so +1 star for that

author: Lexie
headline: Used to love, now I hate
comment: I have struggled with breakouts for years now and for the first time in my life I had been acne free for over a month… that was until I repurchased my Hyaluronic acid serum from the ordinary and it came in a yellowish tint I had never seen before. I went straight to the reviews and noticed that a lot of people were saying the new formula is causing breakouts for them and it did get me worried definitely but I persevered on hoping I would have different results because I bought the big bottle this time and well, I didn't. I didn't break out immediately but after 2/3 uses my typical acne started appearing again in full spirit and the only thing that has changed in my routine is the formula of this product. If the formula has been changed due to people not liking the tackiness of it (which is what I saw in the reviews) and this product is now working better for them great, however, the original formula, in my opinion, dried better as this formula is more oily/greasy and takes forever to absorb and if you're not willing to bring the old formula back for this product, the original formula should be brought back as a separate product (hyaluronic acid 1 and 2 or something) then so everyone can enjoy it. I will now be seeking an alternative brand to use for my hyaluronic acid, which is extremely frustrating to have to do when I had finally perfected my skincare routine.

author: lynnlan
headline: SHINEEEEE
comment: I have been looking for that glow from a product and was at a loss, probably hundreds of dollars and tens of products later, I got a chance to use this. People thing price defines a product, but it definitely doesn't. When I use this otra usually at night so no sunscreen is necessary as I'm usually head to bed. But let me say this has knocked out at least 3 expensive skincare products out of my daily rotation.  I tried it on my hair as recommended and it brought it back to life! Instant shine and my hair actually looks healthy, and not dry and brittle. I went through the first fairly quick since I use it for both my face and hair. I first tried it on the back of my head/hair in case I got a reaction, which not uncommon for me as I have very sensitive skin. Another plus is that it is fragrance free, which is rare for skin products.
comment_ko: 그 윤기있는 제품을 찾다가 헤매다가 아마 수백달러, 수십가지 제품을 하다가 우연히 이걸 써볼 기회가 생겼습니다. 사람의 가격은 제품을 정의하지만 확실히 그렇지 않습니다. 보통 밤에 이 오트라를 사용할 때는 보통 잠자리에 들기 때문에 자외선 차단제가 필요하지 않습니다. 하지만 이로 인해 내 일일 교체 목록에서 적어도 3개의 값비싼 스킨케어 제품이 제외되었다고 말씀드리고 싶습니다.  추천해주신대로 머리에 사용해봤는데 다시 살아나더라구요! 즉각적인 윤기와 내 머리카락은 실제로 건강해 보이고 건조하거나 부서지지 않습니다. 나는 얼굴과 머리카락 모두에 사용하기 때문에 첫 번째 과정을 상당히 빠르게 진행했습니다. 반응이 나타날 경우를 대비하여 머리/머리 뒤쪽에 먼저 사용해 보았는데, 피부가 매우 민감한 저에게는 드문 일이 아닙니다. 또 다른 장점은 스킨 제품에서는 보기 드문 무향료라는 점입니다.

headline: New Formula Great In Theory But...

author: themiamifoodgoddess
headline: This serum boasts a potent combination of hyaluronic acid...
comment:
Dreamy, lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly into the skin, making it perfect for layering with other products or for wearing under makeup. Upon application, my skin instantly feels quenched and supple, with a noticeable improvement in overall texture and elasticity.

One of the standout features of this serum is its ability to lock in moisture throughout the day. Thanks to the hyaluronic acid, which can hold up to 1000 times its weight in water, my skin stays hydrated and dewy from morning until night. Even in harsh weather conditions or during long flights, this serum keeps my skin looking fresh and plumped.

Additionally, the inclusion of vitamin B5 adds an extra layer of nourishment and helps to soothe and repair the skin's barrier. I've noticed a reduction in redness and irritation since incorporating this serum into my routine, making it ideal for those with sensitive or compromised skin.

Overall, the Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum is a skincare essential that delivers on its promises. Whether you're dealing with dryness, dullness, or simply want to give your skin a hydration boost, this serum is a must-have. Highly recommend adding it to your regimen – your skin will thank you!

author: lovesmakeup
headline: Drying, causes pimples
comment: I replaced my strawberry chapstick with the Creme Brulee version of this balm for the past 2 months, used it the same way I would the strawberry stick. I never had chapped lips using the strawberry stick, been using it for many years. This balm seems like it would be moisturizing as it is thick and stays on well. But over time, it has caused my lips to be drier and drier. It also gave me clogged pores around my lip line. It smells like burned sugar, which creme brulee is, so that's fine. I've gone back to my regular balm starting yesterday and my lips are already improving. Too expensive for something that makes lips worse over time.

author: Jordan
headline: BUCKLE UP.
comment:
I tried this lip treatment on a whim and I suddenly went from one to THREE. They stay on for HOURS. I'll put it on at the end of my skincare routine morning and night and it stays on when I eat and drink, and at night I'll even wake up with it still on my lips. 

Creme Brulee shimmer- very sheer nude with gold glitter, very subtle and gorgeous. 

Vanilla Bonbon - my go to at night and when I wear no make up. Smells so good, a forever repeat. 

Lingonberry Jam glimmer - the smell is not my favorite but the color is so pretty, I put it over a pink lip tint.

I'm obsessed with this brand now. My lips are so soft and haven't had a single crack in my lips all winter, even on the days I put it on once.

크림 브륄레 쉬머(Creme Brulee shimmer) - 골드 글리터가 있는 매우 투명한 누드로, 매우 미묘하고 화려합니다. 

바닐라 봉봉 - 밤에, 화장 안 할 때 꼭 가는 곳이에요. 냄새가 너무 좋아서 영원히 반복됩니다. 

링곤베리잼 글리머 향은 별로인데 색이 너무 예뻐서 핑크 립틴트 위에 발랐어요.

author: Alex
headline: Maybe not for sensitive skin?
comment: I'm prone to eczema when my skin gets dry, but I've only ever gotten a rash on my lips after eating a mango without rinsing my lips immediately after. After using this product for several days in a row, because it did make my lips look amazing, it gave me a deep, bumpy rash on my lips that stung and itched. It took over a week of applying a moisturizing petroleum based lip treatment multiple times a day for my lips to heal. If you have sensitive skin, I'd either not use this product at all, use this with caution, or at least not multiple days in a row.

headline: Holy grail

Citrus Sunshine is perfect when you just need moisture with no color. Crème Brûlée is nice and smells good, but the color barely shows (I have fair skin). Cocoa Creme and Lingonberry Jam Glitter are my favorite and the most effective when I want a little color with my lip balm.

author: Lucy
headline: Thick and Glossy
comment:
This is such a gorgeous lip balm! I picked it up on a whim and wasn't sure what to expect after feeling how thick it was in the store, but I ended up loving it. Usually, I prefer thinner glosses and balms because I like the smooth feel when I rub my lips together, but this one is still very smooth despite its thickness. It's much longer-lasting than most of my balms and has a beautiful, high-shine gloss finish. I have the shade Strawberry Sorbet, which is a soft, slightly warm pink tint. It smells like sweet strawberries, and I love the scent. As it wears throughout the day, my lips stay pretty moisturized, though the gloss wears off (as expected), and it doesn't feel quite as smooth for rubbing my lips together after a while. I probably wouldn't layer it over anything other than a tint or stain since it's on the thicker side.
The packaging also feels luxe and satisfying to use. Overall, this was a great purchase! If you're looking for a thick, glossy balm with staying power, this is definitely one to check out.

정말 화려한 립밤이에요! 충동적으로 집어들었고, 매장에서 두께감이 있어서 어떤 느낌일지 기대가 안 됐는데, 결국 마음에 들었습니다. 평소에 입술을 비비면 매끈한 느낌을 좋아해서 좀 더 얇은 글로스나 밤을 선호하는데, 이건 두툼한 제형임에도 불구하고 굉장히 부드럽습니다. 대부분의 밤보다 지속력이 훨씬 길고 아름답고 고광택 광택 마감 처리가 되어 있습니다. 나는 부드럽고 약간 따뜻한 핑크 색조의 딸기 셔벗 그늘을 가지고 있습니다. 달콤한 딸기향이 나는데 향이 너무 좋아요. 하루 종일 바르면 입술이 꽤 촉촉하게 유지되지만 (예상대로) 광택이 닳아 없어지고 잠시 후 입술을 문지르기에는 그다지 부드럽지 않습니다. 더 두꺼운쪽에 있기 때문에 색조 나 얼룩 이외의 다른 것 위에 겹쳐 쓰지 않을 것입니다.
포장도 고급스럽고 사용감도 만족스럽습니다. 전반적으로 이것은 훌륭한 구매였습니다! 지속력이 좋고 두껍고 글로시한 밤을 찾고 있다면 꼭 확인해 보세요.

headline: Thick & Long lasting

Take some sip of water 85% of your lip balm comes off, which makes you CONSTANTLY REAPPLY it. I haven't seen the benefits in a lip balm until my sister gave me this brand on a whim. 
It's thick, in which I absolutely adore & need !! I can drink water or eat & it barely leaves my lips. Lasts a good amount of hours for me. & yes you'd have to reapply but not constantly. I haven't had a problem with the smell as most people. I have crème brûlée & I also bought 2 strawberry sorbets. I plan on getting 2 more just cause. Great buy !

두꺼워서 제가 정말 좋아하고 필요해요!! 물을 마시거나 먹을 수 있는데 입술에서 거의 나오지 않습니다. 나에게는 꽤 많은 시간이 지속됩니다. & 네, 다시 신청해야 하지만 계속해서 신청할 수는 없습니다. 나는 대부분의 사람들처럼 냄새에 문제가 없었습니다. 저는 크렘 브륄레를 먹고 딸기 셔벗도 2개 샀어요. 정당한 이유로 2개를 더 얻을 계획입니다. 좋은 구매!

author: dani
headline: best on the go lip product that ive used
comment: highly recommend. i used to get the laneige ones, but their squeeze tube one isnt as good as the one in the jar. this one is. it honestly might be better. very similar consistency to the laneige lip mask. i work in the hospital so the air is really dry and i never have time to drink enough water. so my lips are always dry, peely and cracking, and i pick at them and bite them. this is the first product that ive found that holds up to the night shift hospital environment, and i can keep it in my pocket to reapply as needed without having to stick my finger in a jar and then touch my lips. i got the original clear citrus one and it smells so good. it doesnt just sit on my lips like most balms do, it soaks in and when that outer layer dries up my lips are still plump and hydrated. the picture is a ONE DAY difference from dry peeling lips. i do like to use the tatcha lip mask at before bed and first thing when i wake up, but it doesnt last throughout the shift. this stuff is exactly what ive been looking for! definitely worth the money.

author: Lip gloss queen
headline: The best high end lip balm
comment: I'm team Ole all the way. I think this is the best high end lip balm. The ingredients and formulation are amazing. Some how the texture is thick but not sticky. It feels plush and cushiony. Also its super hydrating. Great to use as a lip mask before bed but also works for lip combos. I have tried others and i dont think anything holds a candle to this formulation. This one feels like quality.  I think its worth the money. I have sensitive lips and sometimes get eczema on my lips and this products doesn't cause any irritation and it helps heals any irritation i get from other products. My only con is i dont love the crem brulee and cocoa creme scent. Not a deal breaker for me because the scent doesn't last long.
comment_ko: 저는 어디까지나 팀 올레입니다. 나는 이것이 최고의 고급 립밤이라고 생각합니다. 성분과 제형이 정말 놀랍습니다. 질감이 얼마나 두껍지 만 끈적 거리지 않습니다. 푹신하고 푹신한 느낌이 듭니다. 또한 슈퍼 수분 공급. 자기 전에 립 마스크로 사용하기 좋으며 립 콤보에도 좋습니다. 나는 다른 사람들을 시험해 보았지만 이 제제에 촛불을 붙일 수 있는 것은 아무것도 없다고 생각합니다. 이건 퀄리티가 느껴지네요.  나는 돈의 가치가 있다고 생각합니다. 저는 입술이 예민하고 가끔 입술에 습진이 생기기도 하는데 이 제품은 자극을 일으키지 않고 다른 제품을 사용할 때 받은 자극을 완화하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 내 유일한 단점은 크림 브륄레와 코코아 크림 향을 좋아하지 않는다는 것입니다. 향기가 오래 지속되지 않기 때문에 나에게는 거래 차단기가 아닙니다.

author: Abbey
headline: I don't know why I buy other lip products!
comment: This is my absolute holy grail lip product. I have the original Citrus Sunshine, Strawberry Sorbet, Blood Orange, and Lingonberry Jam glitter. This is the lip balm I will meticulously feel around for in my purse while driving, rejecting any other packaging I feel. I am a lip balm snob; I have Glossier, Laneige, Naturium, and Summer Fridays, and this kicks their butts, even though I prefer the color and scent of those. I have a Citrus Sunshine just for my bedside table that I apply every night before bed. It's thick, shiny, wears well, and it actually repairs my horribly dry lips like nothing else. Some qualms I have with this lip balm: it really irks me that the "clear" one has a stupid white cast (making it bad for POC), and the citrus scents are good but I would really LOVE a clear vanilla.

author: em
headline: new holy grail
comment: i have always, unfortunately, been a chronic lip biter.. my lips are always in shambles. but this balm has saved me! i can't pick at my lips with such a luxurious feeling treatment on! it's thick but not in an icky way, super glossy and supremely hydrating - i've used it as an overnight lip mask and woke up with the softest lips! i don't go anywhere without it. instantly blurs my cracked lip lines which i've always been so self conscious of. other lip products only emphasized it. the creme brulee color - the only one i've tried so far - does smell faintly of like, buttered caramel popcorn. not bad, not great. i'm very sensitive to fragrance, but it doesn't bother me at all. it's so faint and the results are so good i don't mind. as for the tint, it's very light. tiniest hint of color. like, it doesn't transfer when i take a sip of my drink. if you are looking for scent and tint, maybe look elsewhere. but for a REAL LIP BALM, BABY this is it! i'll be trying cocoa next. please make more colors and flavors, as long as the formula stays the same i'll BUY THEM ALL!
comment_ko: 저는 불행하게도 항상 입술을 깨무는 습관이 있었습니다.. 제 입술은 항상 엉망입니다. 하지만 이 밤이 나를 구해줬어요! 이렇게 고급스러운 느낌의 트리트먼트를 바르면 입술을 고를 수가 없어요! 두껍지만 칙칙하지 않고, 매우 윤기가 나고 보습력이 뛰어납니다. 하룻밤 동안 립 마스크로 사용했는데 아침에 일어나니 가장 부드러운 입술이 되었습니다! 나는 그것 없이는 아무데도 가지 않습니다. 내가 항상 자각하고 있던 갈라진 입술 라인을 즉시 흐리게 만듭니다. 다른 립 제품들은 그것만 강조했어요. 내가 지금까지 시도한 유일한 색상인 크림 브륄레 색상은 버터 카라멜 팝콘 냄새가 희미하게 나네요. 나쁘지 않아, 좋지 않아. 제가 향에 굉장히 민감한 편인데 전혀 거슬리지 않더라구요. 너무 희미하고 결과가 너무 좋아서 상관 없습니다. 틴트의 경우 매우 가볍습니다. 가장 작은 색상 힌트. 예를 들어, 음료수를 한 모금 마셔도 전달되지 않습니다. 향과 틴트를 찾고 있다면 다른 곳을 찾아보세요. 하지만 진짜 립밤은 바로 이것이에요! 다음엔 코코아를 먹어봐야겠다. 더 많은 색상과 맛을 만들어 주세요. 공식이 동일하다면 모두 구매하겠습니다!

author: ellie
headline: almost perfect lip balm, but pricey
comment:
love the thick texture and glossy shine. the staying power is better than any other lip treatments i've tried, and a little goes a long way. the smell is okay, not my favorite but tolerable. the tint is pretty, but it only lasts maybe 20 minutes while the product soaks into your lips (i've tried strawberry sorbet and cocoa creme with the same result). after that, it's basically clear. lip balms just aren't good for color on their own. 

if you want to invest in a nice glossy balm that really hydrates and lasts hours, nothing beats this imo. however, you can also find clear balms that are slightly thinner but look/feel similar (and smell better) under $10.

author: Logan
headline: Best lip product I've ever purchased
comment: I hope they never discontinue this product! Especially Strawberry Sorbet! I bought this because I needed a good everyday lip color, but lipsticks are too much on me and sooo drying. I also wanted something that would be hydrating. This lip treatment is PERFECT! I wear it everyday instead of using chapstick and lipstick. It's creamy but also light enough that it isn't sticky. There is a glossy feeling to it, but it isn't sticky like most lip products are. The hint of pink in Strawberry Sorbet adds the perfect amount of color for an effortless everyday look and it stays on for a very long time. I wore this to a festival this weekend and never had to reapply. I will be purchasing this for the rest of my life!

headline: Instant and long term suppleness!

This stuff. Wow. I used it every night before bed and would wake up to soft, smoother lips. With repeated use, my lips seemed just a touch fuller, smoother and moisturized throughout the day. so much so that I realized I wasn't grabbing for any other lip balm or stick! 

My lips are screaming for this right now because mine has gone missing after my son got a hold of it. I'm pregnant and everything is shriveling up and i know this will restore my lips! Even the left over laniege mask I have does NOTHING for me. 

I have to buy this again!

comment: I have tried so many lip balms and masks, from Too Faced, Laneige, Lanolips, Aquaphor, really anything. I waited 6 months before I caved to try it because most lip products really are the same for me. This was so moisturizing and it made my lips look and feel better, even after applying once. It does wear off with food and drink, but even if you just applied it once a day you'd probably see a difference. I got the strawberry one because I have heard about the weird smell and white cast of the original. It smells a little weird but not bad. I definitely recommend giving it a try. It works really well for me.

author: Liviiiiii
headline: HOLY GRAIL!
comment: Saw this on Tiktok as an alternative to the Summer Fridays balm, which I found drying and honestly bad. I have INCREDIBLY dry lips where most lip products dont do enough, especially most people's "holy grails" both high and low end. Bought Cocoa first and OMG. Thick and glossy but not sticky. Lovely tint left on the lips and extremely long lasting. I cant always reapply and do find it will last for a few hours which is insane for me. Smellls great. Just bought the creme brulee one as well! Only con is the price, but to me it's worth it. Wait for a sale!!

headline: Do not buy crème brûlée

So lesson is, smell the balm before you buy.

I was very disappointed with this product. I returned it and I certainly won't be repurchasing it. The hunt shall continue for the perfect lip balm.

author: Adela
headline: Genuine Favorite
comment:
I'm not big on lip glosses/masks in general due to how fast they dissipate but this product is like the perfect medium between a gloss, a lip mask, and a lip balm. It's rich and thick, and surprisingly remains on my lips for hours. I often use it overnight and it's still there in the morning. I haven't used it for that long yet but I'm already finding that it does hydrate and plump my lips enough that its effect lasts long after I've removed it, or has diminished on its own - perfectly kissable lips.
Truly worth every penny. I never thought I'd say that about a lip mask type of product.

headline: Hyaluronic acid + peptides = mini filler effect
comment: I had been in the market for lip products that contained hyaluronic acid and peptides because I had heard it gives a plumping effect, almost like filler. Just a couple applications throughout the day consistently for a couple of days, and it really looks like mini filler! It's not the most hydrating for me compared to the Laneige lip mask, but more hydrating than Summer Fridays lip balm. I have a feeling products like this will become super popular in the future so I'm planning on purchasing more before then. The orange is okay, but I like the Strawberry more. Wish they had more colors and flavors.

author: Mimi
headline: Not a lip treatment!
comment:
I purchased this a little over three weeks ago and so far have noticed a visible difference in the fullness of my lips from my side profile. 
Yet, when I ran into flaky/chapped/cracked lips, it didnt help. I had a crack in the corner of my mouth about a week or so after using the lip product (in no relation to the product I believe) and kept using the "lip treatment". Unfortunately it didn't provide any deep hydration or help for it. 
I ended up switching back to the Clinique moisture surge lip treatment to help and haven't found a reason to return to the Pout Preserve.

author: LisaKER
headline: It's fine.
comment: My standard for a lip balm/mask used to simply be something that was moisturizing and didn't make my super sensitive lips react. This passes that standard. But now that there are more lippie options out there, I say you can do better. I got the citrus scent and I don't enjoy it. It's a very artificial dreamsicle smell that doesn't dissipate. It makes me think of hospitals… like a bad orange popsicle you'd get after having your tonsils out, so artificial it's almost clinical lol. The formula is comfortable and hydrating but it's not the most hydrating. It's more nourishing than Laneige, which I don't find particularly amazing, but I don't find it to be as scrumptuous as Summer Fridays, Revision, Patchology or just straight Aquafore for comfortable, lasting, cushy, deep hydration without a weird scent. I did wear it daily for 10 days and didn't see a noticeable change in the fullness of my lips from the peptides.

author: daniT
headline: Gentle moisturizer, but pills up on your skin!
comment: I was excited to use this lotion for the first time. I have sensitive skin, and am anyways on the lookout for a gentle unscented moisturizer. I THOUGHT this was it. But a few hours after applying, I wiped my mouth with a napkin (after eating) and noticed lots of little white dots. I was unsure where they came from, so I went and checked in a mirror, and discovered that the lotion had pulled up all over my face, and my (almost black) eyebrows looked grey and like I had dandruff. And this is even without trying to put any makeup on top ! I was so sad! I love everything else about this lotion, but if it makes my face look all flakey and gross, it's a no go. Now I'm just going to have to use it as a night cream until it's gone... I wouldn't recommend.

author: Karolina
headline: My First Holy Grail Moisturizer
comment:
I was a little hesitant to try this moisturizer because I'd seen a lot of negative reviews, but my skin drinks it up like water in the desert. I have combination to dry, sensitive skin, and this is one of the few moisturizers that actually leaves my skin feeling truly satisfied once it absorbs. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy or heavy and leaves a smooth, glowy finish that lasts throughout the day

One of the biggest challenges for me has been finding a moisturizer that works under my mineral sunscreen. Even with products that should be compatible, like a water-based sunscreen over a water-based moisturizer, my SPF still flakes or pills no matter how long I wait before applying it. With this one, I usually wait just 5-10 minutes and my sunscreen glides on perfectly, stays in place all day, and doesn't disturb the moisturizer underneath. This has made it a staple in my morning routine.

It's fragrance-free, but it also doesn't have that odd "fragrance-free" smell, which I really appreciate. The texture is lightweight yet nourishing, and it doesn't irritate my skin or clog my pores. I've never had breakouts from it. I'm already on my third bottle, which says a lot because I usually rotate through products pretty quickly.
comment_ko:
부정적인 리뷰를 많이 봤기 때문에 이 모이스처라이저를 사용하는 것을 조금 주저했지만, 피부가 사막의 물처럼 흡수합니다. 저는 건조하고 민감한 피부를 위한 조합을 가지고 있는데, 이 제품은 실제로 흡수되면 피부에 진정 만족감을 주는 몇 안 되는 모이스처라이저 중 하나입니다. 번들거림이나 무거운 느낌 없이 피부를 촉촉하게 유지해 주고, 하루 종일 매끄럽고 윤기 있게 마무리해줍니다.

저에게 있어 가장 큰 과제 중 하나는 미네랄 자외선 차단제에 적합한 모이스처라이저를 찾는 것이었습니다. 수성 모이스처라이저 대신 수성 자외선 차단제를 바르는 것처럼 호환되어야 하는 제품을 사용하더라도 SPF는 바르기 전에 얼마나 오래 기다려도 여전히 벗겨지거나 알약이 됩니다. 이 제품을 사용하면 보통 5~10분만 기다리면 자외선 차단제가 완벽하게 발려 하루 종일 그 자리에 머물며 밑에 있는 모이스처라이저를 방해하지 않습니다. 이것이 내 아침 일과의 필수 요소가 되었습니다.

headline: Ouch.

I did the same routine the very next day before work. By the time I had gotten to work, my eyes watering, tears down my face, burning, nose running, and sneezing. Throughout the day, my coworkers kept asking me if I was okay because my eyes were THAT SWOLLEN. I tried eye drops multiple times to wash out my eyes, it did not work. I went to the bathroom and finally decided to wash my face with water. I got some relief but, nothing really made my symptoms go away until I completely washed my face and took a benedryl. I recommend skipping this product entirely and going with Clinique moisture surge or a Pur moisturizer!!!

For years I have struggled with finding a good moisturizing product for my face and most of the time I would just put vaseline or aquaphor on my face because everything else broke me out. One of my friends suggested for me to try this product and at first I was very hesitant because I was tired of wasting money on products I couldn't use and I didn't want to deal with another flare. I started using this product about 10 months ago and I probably will never go to anything else. I suggest you to try out a small bottle because I do realize that what works for one may not work for another but hopefully you will find some relief with using this product.

author: Heidi
headline: I love it
comment:
I use this as my night moisturizer and it's my new favorite. Ive tried moisturizers at most price points, too ($5-$150). First, it is rated highly on Yuka. Then, there's scent, it is a non-greasy texture, and absorbs into the skin quickly. Here's the best part though - it made my pores appear smallers literally overnight. I know they say that it's not possible to shrink pores, but i legit think this one shrunk mine lol. I can now wear my shimmery blushes without thinking "OH GOSH MY PORES" when i catch a glimpse of myself. 

Lastly, the only negative i can say as it sometimes peels slightly. I use it as my nighttime moisturizer only so this is not an issue for me. It may be an issue if wearing under makeup, however.

author: Serena
headline: Good for acne prone, gives dewy skin
comment: I needed a good moisturizer to use with my retinol since it's extremely drying and I tried using La Roche Posay's Lipkar lotion with it since it was supposed to be noncomedogenic (not pore clogging) and then it gave me cystic acne. My dermatologist told me even though Lipkar is for extremely dry skin, which I have, it was probably too heavy for me and that I needed a lighter one. I saw this one and decided to try it and it has been working much better and I haven't broken out from it and I have very acne prone skin. I use it at night and wake up with hydrated, dewy skin in the morning. I'm not sure if I'd use it during the day as it does have a little bit of an oily feel and looks that way for an hour or two but for nighttime slugging it's good and I don't have to use moisturizer during the day because it's so hydrated from using it overnight, which is what I prefer since I don't like to do a daytime routine.
comment_ko: 레티놀은 매우 건조하기 때문에 좋은 모이스처라이저가 필요했고, 비코메도제닉(모공 막힘이 아님)이어야 했기 때문에 라로슈포제의 립카 로션을 사용해 보더니 낭포성 여드름이 생겼습니다. 제 피부과 전문의는 Lipkar가 제가 가지고 있는 극도로 건조한 피부를 위한 제품이지만 아마도 저에게는 너무 무거워서 더 가벼운 제품이 필요하다고 말했습니다. 나는 이것을 보고 그것을 시도하기로 결정했고 그것은 훨씬 더 잘 작동하고 있으며 나는 그것에서 벗어나지 않았고 매우 여드름이 나는 피부를 가지고 있습니다. 밤에 사용하고 아침에는 촉촉하고 촉촉한 피부로 깨어납니다. 약간의 오일리한 느낌이 있어서 한두시간 정도는 그런 느낌이 있어서 낮에는 써도 될지 모르겠지만 밤에 바르면 좋고 밤에 바르면 수분감이 너무 좋아서 낮에는 보습제를 따로 바르지 않아도 되는 편인데 낮에 바르는 걸 별로 안 좋아해서 그런 편이에요.

author: Hannah M
headline: Another moisturizer that pills
comment:
I have VERY dry skin. Ive been on the hunt to find something to replace my $150 cream.
So many rave reviews for this but it fell very short for me. It goes on super thin and slippery feeling, but as soon as it dries down - one touch of the face or the next and its pilling into little balls. If you try to put tinted sunscreen over it - you look a mess. 
Its a no for me. Gave it to my husband to use.
comment_ko:
저는 매우 건조한 피부를 가지고 있습니다. 나는 150달러짜리 크림을 대체할 제품을 찾기 위해 노력했습니다.
이에 대한 많은 호평이 있었지만 나에게는 매우 부족했습니다. 매우 얇고 미끄러운 느낌이 들지만, 마르자마자 얼굴에 한 번 터치하거나 다음 터치하면 작은 공 모양으로 보풀이 일어납니다. 그 위에 착색된 자외선 차단제를 바르려고 하면 지저분해 보입니다. 
나에게는 아니오입니다. 남편이 사용하라고 줬어요.

Such a game changer for my face.

author: Issa
headline: Use with caution
comment: So this was a dream to put on and felt so hydrating. HOWEVER, afterwards I went to watch tv for a but and before bed I looked in the mirror and seen I had a red splotchy face. It didnt itch or hurt but man my skin definitely had some sort of reaction and my face felt soo warm to the touch. I'm never one to test moisturizers on my skin because my skin usually does well with most things but I definitely will now. Just a friendly word of caution to do a spot test incase you have sensitive skin. Luckily, I woke up the next morning and my skin was back to normal. I'll be returning.
comment_ko: 그래서 이건 정말 바르고 싶은 꿈이었고 수분감이 너무 좋았습니다. 그런데 그 후 한동안 TV를 보다가 자기 전에 거울을 보니 얼굴에 붉은 반점이 생겼습니다. 가렵거나 아프지는 않았지만 내 피부는 확실히 어떤 종류의 반응을 보였고 내 얼굴은 만졌을 때 너무 따뜻했습니다. 나는 내 피부가 일반적으로 대부분의 것들에 잘 반응하기 때문에 내 피부에 보습제를 테스트하는 사람이 아니지만 이제는 확실히 그렇게 할 것입니다. 피부가 민감한 경우를 대비해 현장 테스트를 하라는 친절한 주의 사항입니다. 다행히 다음날 아침에 일어났더니 피부가 원래대로 돌아왔습니다. 나는 돌아올 것이다.

author: Nikki
headline: Don't Believe the Cons
comment: Listen, the truth of the matter is that most people are using wayyyyy TOO many products in their skincare routine. So here's the story: after 3 years of not wearing any makeup, I went to take family photos with my kids and decided to wear makeup. I also bought the Good Molecules bundle and started using it. Literally a day later my face was broken out bad and I didn't know whether it was from the makeup, the Good Molecules, or both. Soooo I decided to buy the Laroche Posay face wash and this moisturizer, both in the white bottles, and to completely stop using anything else on my face. No oils, no serums, no nothing! Yall, within the next 3 days my face had cleared up. Now, my skin was looking dry when I'd wake up in the morning but I was like I'm going to give the Laroche Posay another week and if ya'll could see my face! It is CLEAR and smooth!! It's giving photo filter for real!! So for the people complaining of pilling and all of that, you are most likely using too many things on your face. You don't need all that extra stuff. It's doing more harm than good!! Also, follow the directions on the bottle friend. They are there for a reason. So for instance, when I wash and rinse my face I don't rub it dry. I just let it air dry a little and then add this moisturizer and yes, it soaks right into my skin. Someone mentioned that as a con lol. Friend you don't want the product to sit on top of your skin. It's meant to repair your barrier, not give the appearance that you slapped Vaseline on your face and if you want that look, then just add a little Vaseline after this product has absorbed into your skin. You can't cake your 8 products on your face and then say this product pilled! Duhhhhh lol. Cake face.
comment_ko: 들어보세요, 문제의 진실은 대부분의 사람들이 스킨케어 루틴에 너무 많은 제품을 사용하고 있다는 것입니다. 그래서 사연은 이렇습니다. 3년 동안 화장을 하지 않은 후, 아이들과 함께 가족 사진을 찍으러 갔는데 화장을 하기로 결정했습니다. 저도 Good Molecules 번들을 구매해서 사용하기 시작했어요. 문자 그대로 하루 만에 내 얼굴이 심하게 망가졌고 그것이 메이크업 때문인지, Good Molecules 때문인지, 아니면 둘 다 때문인지 알 수 없었습니다. 그래서 나는 Laroche Posay 세안제와 이 보습제를 흰색 병에 구입하기로 결정하고 얼굴에 다른 것을 사용하는 것을 완전히 중단했습니다. 오일도 없고 세럼도 없고 아무것도 없습니다! 여러분, 다음 3일 안에 내 얼굴이 깨끗해졌습니다. 이제 아침에 일어났을 때 피부가 건조해 보였지만 라로슈 포제를 일주일 더 바르고 얼굴을 볼 수 있다면 좋을 것 같았습니다! 깔끔하고 매끄러워요!! 진짜 사진필터를 주는군요!! 따라서 보풀이 생기는 것에 대해 불평하는 사람들의 경우 얼굴에 너무 많은 것을 사용하고 있을 가능성이 높습니다. 추가 항목이 모두 필요하지 않습니다. 득보다 실이 더 많네요!! 또한 병 친구의 지시 사항을 따르십시오. 그들은 이유가 있어서 거기에 있습니다. 예를 들어, 저는 세수를 하고 얼굴을 헹굴 때 문질러서 건조시키지 않습니다. 그냥 자연 건조시킨 다음 이 모이스처라이저를 추가하면 피부에 바로 흡수됩니다. 누군가 그것을 콘으로 언급했습니다. 친구여, 당신은 제품이 당신의 피부 위에 닿는 것을 원하지 않습니다. 이는 장벽을 복구하기 위한 것이지, 바셀린을 얼굴에 바른 듯한 느낌을 주는 것이 아니라, 그런 느낌을 원할 경우 이 제품이 피부에 흡수된 후 바셀린을 조금 추가하기만 하면 됩니다. 8가지 제품을 얼굴에 바르고 이 제품이 필링되었다고 말할 수는 없습니다! 으아아아아 ㅋㅋㅋ 케이크 얼굴.
text_for_model: Listen, the truth of the matter is that most people are using wayyyyy TOO many products in their skincare routine. So here's the story: after 3 years of not wearing any makeup, I went to take family photos with my kids and decided to wear makeup. I also bought the Good Molecules bundle and started using it. Literally a day later my face was broken out bad and I didn't know whether it was from the makeup, the Good Molecules, or both. Soooo I decided to buy the Laroche Posay face wash and this moisturizer, both in the white bottles, and to completely stop using anything else on my face. No oils, no serums, no nothing! Yall, within the next 3 days my face had cleared up. Now, my skin was looking dry when I'd wake up in the morning but I was like I'm going to give the Laroche Posay another week and if ya'll could see my face! It is CLEAR and smooth!! It's giving photo filter for real!! So for the people complaining of pilling and all of that, you are most likely using too many things on your face. You don't need all that extra stuff. It's doing more harm than good!! Also, follow the directions on the bottle friend. They are there for a reason. So for instance, when I wash and rinse my face I don't rub it dry. I just let it air dry a little and then add this moisturizer and yes, it soaks right into my skin. Someone mentioned that as a con lol. Friend you don't want the product to sit on top of your skin. It's meant to repair your barrier, not give the appearance that you slapped Vaseline on your face and if you want that look, then just add a little Vaseline after this product has absorbed into your skin. You can't cake your 8 products on your face and then say this product pilled! Duhhhhh lol. Cake face.

author: Brianna
headline: Grew on me
comment:
First off, I have super dry skin. When I first bought this, it was in winter when my skin is the driest. I loved the way it applied, and it was very soothint, however, it did not provide nearly enough moisture, and I was ready to throw it in the trash. 

Fast forward to summer, and there I was again looking for an effective, lightweight moisturizer. The difference has literally been night and day. It sinks in quickly and provides a perfect base for makeup. I have gotten countless compliments about my makeup since trying this out again, so I don't believe it's just a coincidence. This is a great moisturizer for summer, but if you have dry skin, I would caution against using it for Winter, because it will not provide adequate moisture.

author: Emily
headline: Pills horribly and is too expensive
comment: I was excited to try this moisturizer as I've heard so many great things about it but upon using it for a month I am very disappointed. First off there is not much product given considering it being almost thirty dollars. When applied to the face, it blends in well and feels very think and greasy and after about fifteen minutes the feeling goes away. However, as soon as you rub your face after applying it starts to peel horribly and looks/feels like dead skin. If you are a makeup user, this would be a horrible cream to get as it will make the foundation application horrible do to the peeling. If you have dry, sensitive skin, do not wear makeup, don't have sensory issues then this will be good for you.

author: Jaz
headline: I absolutely love this moisturizer although…
comment:
For how expensive this product is, you would expect the packaging to be much better but it's not. The container is made of cheap plastic, and the gold top piece that holds the applicator actually broke off, which was really frustrating.

That said, I genuinely love the moisturizer itself. It makes my skin feel amazing, it doesn't burn or irritate my skin, and it leaves my complexion looking great. I even get compliments on my skin when I use it. It also works well under makeup and blends nicely with other products.

My biggest issues are the price and the packaging. For something this expensive, the packaging should feel far more luxurious. At the very least, it should be made of glass or designed to be refillable so you could reuse the container and just purchase inserts. That would add a lot more value. Unfortunately, the current packaging just feels very low quality for the price.

author: Christine
headline: Just seemed to never absorb into my dry skin
comment: I have been using the cream in the pot, not the pump. Which I noticed a lot of these reviews were about the lighter dewy cream that comes in the pump, even though i clicked on the reviews for the thicker dewy cream. So be aware that the reviews on this page may not be about the Tacha dewy cream that comes in the pot with a spatula. Anyways, I've used almost all of it, and no matter how I use it, it NEVER absorbs into my skin. Whether I use it by itself or with other products, it just sits there. I use it at night and I'll stay up for a few hours and by the time I go to bed, it feels just as wet as when I applied it. It basically only stops being greasy and wet in the morning after Ive rubbed it all off on my pillows while sleeping. I have dry skin, so I have no clue why this just doesnt work for me. It smells great and the spatula is a nice touch. I wont be buying it again. I gave it a solid go, but yea, no matter what I did or how little I used, my skin just felt wet and greasy until I wiped or washed it off.
headline_ko: 건조한 피부에 흡수가 안 되는 것 같았어요

author: Brooke
headline: Wanted to love, absolutely despise.
comment:
I was so excited for this, especially bc i have such dry skin & the reviews were amazing. I've used most of it so i feel justified in leaving a review, although im not sure where to start.
This did nothing for my dry skin. It gave me a moisturized, greasy look, but mostly sat on top of my skin while doing nothing to heal it. Secondly, ive had the worst breakouts of my life while using this product. I thought sticking it out would be worth it, but no. This also does not work well with make up. It basically peeled right off my face, no matter how little i used. I could cry knowing i spent $100 just to look the worst i have in years. I still have dry skin, now its just covered in acne, and my make up looks awful. I wont be using this again. While im glad others seem to have good luck with it, its not for me. At all.

author: Apurva loke
headline: Loved it
comment: Complimentary from tatcha Tatcha Dewy Moisture Cream – My Thoughts Tatcha just launched their Dewy Moisture Cream, and after trying it, I can say it lives up to the name. It's a rich, deeply hydrating formula made for dry or mature skin. The ingredients are impressive—hyaluronic acid, red algae, squalane, Japanese purple rice, and their signature Hadasei‑3 complex—all focused on locking in moisture and strengthening the skin barrier. The texture is creamy and smooth, and it melts into the skin beautifully. It leaves a soft, dewy finish that makes the skin look fresh and well-nourished. If you have oily or acne-prone skin, this might feel a bit heavy—so a patch test is a good idea before fully using it. Overall, it's a luxurious cream for anyone needing intense hydration, especially during colder months or when the skin feels dull and tight. A great addition to any nighttime routine.

author: Salley
headline: Luxurious
comment:
So I have been a loyal DE Protini purchaser for awhile now and always felt satisfied with that specific product UNTIL I decided to give this girl a try and oh...my... goodness! It is indescribably luxurious and long lasting! If DE Protini and Bora Barrier had a baby, THIS would be her!!!! 

So I have loved DE Protini for my morning routine and DE Bora Barrier for night routine because it is MUCH thicker (almost TOO thick). But I would normally feel like my skin was moisturized when I woke up in the morning, but some mornings not so much. But this Tatcha Dewy Skin is perfection in a container- a little goes a long way, especially after the first few steps in my routine, and the moisturizing effect lasts until I wash my face again, but doesn't feel heavy and wet if you know what I mean? Some moisturizers are great, but they do not seem to absorb as intended, and like a layer of damp on my face ready to grab any wisps of hair near my face. This product TRULY absorbs, and continuously works as a true moisturizing mask until washed off. LOVE it! Sorry DE, but definitely retiring my Bora Barrier permanently.

So I have loved DE Protini for my morning routine and DE Bora Barrier for night routine because it is MUCH thicker (almost TOO thick). author: Marideth
headline: Not for combination / sensitive skin
comment: I have never made a review for a product and I had also not broken out in years before using this product. I've used a multitude of moisturizers in all ranges of prices, and this one is the worst. After using it for a couple of days my skin broke out in pimples and my pores  became glogged and irritated. Genuinly this moisturizer is the equivalent of putting a thick layer of oil on top of your skin. I would not recommend for those with skin on the more sensitive side or for combination skin. Save yourself the money and all of the time it will take to get your skin back in check.

author: NurseFace
headline: Ewwww.
comment: Ok, this cream is pretty expensive for the average person which is cool if it works. The packaging and luxury feel of the product is a major awe factor. When trying it in the store, it smells amazing and the texture is on point. (Only rain I have two stars and not one.) It does appear "dewy" as advertised. However, when using for every day purposes, it feels like it just sits on top of the skin like a mask. When using it under a very light foundation, it even started to pill halfway through the day. I'm glad this product works for some of y'all, but I don't get all the hype.
